papers.title: Deeply-Recursive Convolutional Network for Image Super-Resolution

tldr.en: DRCN applies a single convolutional layer recursively, up to 16 recursions, for image super-resolution, adding depth without new parameters; recursive-supervision and skip-connection ease training, and it outperforms previous methods.
tldr.zh: DRCN 在图像超分辨率中递归应用同一个卷积层（最多 16 次递归），加深网络而不增加参数；递归监督和跳跃连接缓解了训练困难，效果超过以往方法。

papers.title: Neural GPUs Learn Algorithms

tldr.en: The Neural GPU repeats shared convolutional GRU layers for n steps on length-n inputs; trained with parameter sharing relaxation on up to 20-bit numbers, it adds and multiplies much longer binary numbers without errors.
tldr.zh: Neural GPU 在长度为 n 的输入上把同一组卷积 GRU 层重复 n 步；借助参数共享松弛在最多 20 比特的数上训练后，它对长得多的二进制数做加法和乘法也没有错误。

papers.title: Adaptive Computation Time for Recurrent Neural Networks

tldr.en: Introduces Adaptive Computation Time, a differentiable halting mechanism that lets an RNN learn how many steps to take per input; it improves performance on four synthetic tasks, while gains on character-level language modelling are small.
tldr.zh: 提出 Adaptive Computation Time（ACT），一种可微的停止机制，让 RNN 学习每个输入要计算多少步；它在四个合成任务上提升了性能，但在字符级语言建模上收益很小。

papers.title: Early Improving Recurrent Elastic Highway Network

tldr.en: EI-REHN adds an ACT-style elastic gate to Recurrent Highway Networks to set the recurrence depth per input, and a hypernetwork that updates intermediate-layer weights instead of sharing them; it beats other recurrent networks on synthetic regression, activity recognition and Penn Treebank language modeling.
tldr.zh: EI-REHN 为 Recurrent Highway Network 加入 ACT 式弹性门，按每个输入设定循环深度，并用 hypernetwork 更新各中间循环层的权重而不是共享权重；它在合成数据回归、人体活动识别和 Penn Treebank 语言建模上优于其他循环网络。

papers.title: Neural Ordinary Differential Equations

tldr.en: Neural ODEs replace discrete hidden layers with one network that parameterizes the hidden state's derivative, integrated by a black-box ODE solver; these continuous-depth models have constant memory cost, adapt their evaluation strategy to each input, and backpropagate scalably through any ODE solver.
tldr.zh: Neural ODE 不再堆叠离散的隐藏层，而是用一个神经网络参数化隐藏状态的导数，再由黑盒 ODE 求解器计算输出；这种连续深度模型的内存开销恒定，能针对每个输入调整求值策略，并能可扩展地对任意 ODE 求解器做反向传播。

papers.title: Universal Transformers

tldr.en: Universal Transformer applies the same Transformer block recurrently over depth, with dynamic per-position halting; it is Turing-complete under some assumptions and outperforms standard Transformers on algorithmic and language tasks, gaining 0.9 BLEU on WMT14 En-De.
tldr.zh: Universal Transformer 在深度方向上循环使用同一个 Transformer 块，并按位置动态停止；在一定假设下它是图灵完备的，在算法和语言任务上优于标准 Transformer，在 WMT14 En-De 上提高 0.9 BLEU。

papers.title: Recurrent Stacking of Layers for Compact Neural Machine Translation Models

tldr.en: Shares parameters across all layers of an NMT encoder and decoder; a single layer recurrently stacked 6 times translates comparably to 6 separate layers, and back-translated data improves it further.
tldr.zh: 在 NMT 模型的编码器和解码器中让所有层共享参数；把单层循环堆叠 6 次的翻译质量与 6 个独立层相当，加入回译数据后进一步提升。

papers.title: Trellis Networks for Sequence Modeling

tldr.en: TrellisNet is a temporal convolutional network whose weights are tied across depth and whose input is injected into every layer, generalizing truncated RNNs; it outperforms the then state of the art on word- and character-level language modeling and long-term memory stress tests.
tldr.zh: TrellisNet 是一种在深度方向上绑定权重、并把输入直接注入每一层的时间卷积网络，可看作截断 RNN 的推广；它在词级和字符级语言建模以及长期记忆压力测试上超过了当时的最佳方法。

papers.title: Attending to Mathematical Language with Transformers

tldr.en: On character-level evaluation of math expressions with symbolic variables, a standard Transformer, a Universal Transformer with recurrence and an adaptive Universal Transformer with recurrence and adaptive computation time reach test accuracies as high as 76.1%, 78.8% and 84.9%.
tldr.zh: 在带符号变量的字符级数学表达式求值任务上，标准 Transformer、带循环的 Universal Transformer 和带循环与自适应计算时间的自适应 Universal Transformer 的测试准确率最高分别达到 76.1%、78.8% 和 84.9%。

papers.title: Latent Universal Task-Specific BERT

tldr.en: Latent Universal Task-Specific BERT replaces BERT's stacked self-attention blocks with one recurring three-layer block plus ACT, as in the Universal Transformer; on tweets the Universal Model has 46.3M parameters versus 110.1M for the base model, with masked LM accuracy 0.508 versus 0.507.
tldr.zh: Latent Universal Task-Specific BERT 仿照 Universal Transformer，把 BERT 依次堆叠的自注意力块换成一个循环使用的三层块并加入 ACT；在推文上，Universal Model 有 46.3M 参数（基础模型为 110.1M），masked LM 准确率为 0.508（基础模型为 0.507）。

papers.title: Universal Transforming Geometric Network

tldr.en: UTGN replaces the LSTMs of the recurrent geometric network with a Universal Transformer encoder whose 6-layer stack recurs up to 10 times with ACT halting; on CASP12 protein structure prediction it improves on RGN by 1.7 Å on free modeling and 0.7 Å on template based modeling.
tldr.zh: UTGN 用 Universal Transformer 编码器替换循环几何网络中的 LSTM，编码器的 6 层堆叠在 ACT 停机控制下最多循环 10 次；在 CASP12 蛋白质结构预测上，它在自由建模部分比 RGN 提升 1.7 Å，在基于模板的建模部分提升 0.7 Å。

papers.title: Deep Equilibrium Models

tldr.en: DEQ finds the fixed point of a weight-tied layer by root-finding and backpropagates through it implicitly; on language modeling such as WikiText-103 it often beats similar-size models while cutting memory by up to 88%.
tldr.zh: DEQ 通过求根直接求出权重共享层的不动点，并用隐式微分反传；在 WikiText-103 等语言建模任务上，它常常优于参数量相近的模型，内存最多减少 88%。

papers.title: ALBERT: A Lite BERT for Self-supervised Learning of Language Representations

tldr.en: ALBERT reduces BERT's parameters with a factorized embedding and cross-layer parameter sharing, adds an inter-sentence coherence loss, and sets new state-of-the-art results on GLUE, RACE and SQuAD with fewer parameters than BERT-large.
tldr.zh: ALBERT 用因式分解的词嵌入和跨层参数共享减少 BERT 的参数量，并加入句间连贯性损失；它以少于 BERT-large 的参数在 GLUE、RACE 和 SQuAD 上取得新的最好结果。

papers.title: Neural Execution of Graph Algorithms

tldr.en: Trains graph neural networks to imitate each step of classical graph algorithms by repeating an encode-process-decode network with a learned termination network; max-based message passing works best, and learning reachability alongside improves shortest-path learning.
tldr.zh: 训练图神经网络逐步模仿经典图算法，每一步重复同一个 encode-process-decode 网络并由学到的终止网络决定何时停止；基于最大值聚合的消息传递效果最好，同时学习可达性任务能改进最短路径算法的学习。

papers.title: Addressing Some Limitations of Transformers with Feedback Memory

tldr.en: Feedback Transformer makes every layer attend to per-timestep memory vectors that mix all layers' past representations, exposing high-level past states to low layers; small, shallow models beat comparable Transformers on language modeling, translation and RL.
tldr.zh: Feedback Transformer 让每一层都关注逐时间步的记忆向量，该向量由各层过去的表示加权求和得到，使低层也能看到过去的高层表示；小而浅的模型在语言建模、机器翻译和强化学习上优于可比的 Transformer。

papers.title: RAFT: Recurrent All-Pairs Field Transforms for Optical Flow

tldr.en: RAFT builds all-pairs 4D correlation volumes and iteratively updates a flow field with a weight-tied recurrent update operator; it reaches 5.10% F1-all error on KITTI and 2.855 pixels end-point error on Sintel (final pass).
tldr.zh: RAFT 为光流任务构建全像素对的 4D 相关体，并用权重共享的循环更新算子反复更新光流场；在 KITTI 上 F1-all 误差为 5.10%，在 Sintel（final pass）上端点误差为 2.855 像素。

papers.title: Monotone operator equilibrium networks

tldr.en: Introduces monDEQ, an implicit-depth model built on monotone operator theory whose parameterization guarantees a unique equilibrium, solved with operator-splitting methods that converge stably; it outperforms Neural ODE-based models while being more computationally efficient.
tldr.zh: 提出 monDEQ，一种基于单调算子理论的隐式深度模型，其参数化保证唯一平衡点存在，并用稳定收敛的算子分裂方法求解；它优于基于 Neural ODE 的模型，且计算效率更高。

papers.title: Multiscale Deep Equilibrium Models

tldr.en: MDEQ solves for and backpropagates through the equilibrium points of several feature resolutions at once, using implicit differentiation with O(1) memory; on ImageNet classification and Cityscapes segmentation it matches or exceeds competitive vision models.
tldr.zh: MDEQ 借助隐式微分同时求解多个特征分辨率的平衡点并对其反传，只需 O(1) 内存；在 ImageNet 分类和 Cityscapes 语义分割上达到或超过有竞争力的视觉模型。

papers.title: Implicit Feature Pyramid Network for Object Detection

tldr.en: i-FPN replaces a detector's stacked cross-scale FPN blocks with the fixed point of one weight-shared transformation, solved DEQ-style with a residual-like iteration; on MS COCO it adds +3.4, +3.2, +3.5, +4.2, +3.2 mAP to ResNet-50-FPN RetinaNet, Faster-RCNN, FCOS, ATSS and AutoAssign.
tldr.zh: i-FPN 把检测器中堆叠的跨尺度 FPN 块换成同一个权重共享变换的不动点，按 DEQ 方式求解并采用类残差迭代；在 MS COCO 上，它让基于 ResNet-50-FPN 的 RetinaNet、Faster-RCNN、FCOS、ATSS 和 AutoAssign 分别提升 +3.4、+3.2、+3.5、+4.2、+3.2 mAP。

papers.title: Subformer: Exploring Weight Sharing for Parameter Efficiency in Generative Transformers

tldr.en: Subformer shares parameters across the central layers of generative Transformers, with unshared first and last layers and self-attentive factorized embeddings; it can beat the Transformer on translation, summarization and language modeling with fewer parameters.
tldr.zh: Subformer 在生成式 Transformer 中让中间各层共享参数，首尾两层不共享，并使用自注意力式的分解 embedding；在机器翻译、摘要和语言建模上，它能以更少的参数超过 Transformer。

papers.title: Of Non-Linearity and Commutativity in BERT

tldr.en: Analyzing BERT, the paper finds its layers largely commutative, mainly due to skip connections; ALBERT-like models that repeat one fine-tuned layer 12 times fall to random guessing but improve after 3 more fine-tuning epochs, which the authors take as support for recurrent and weight-shared Transformers.
tldr.zh: 论文分析 BERT，发现其各层在很大程度上可交换，主要源于跳跃连接；把一个微调后的层重复 12 次得到的 ALBERT 式模型起初退化为随机猜测，再微调 3 个 epoch 后明显改善，作者据此解释循环和权重共享 Transformer 的良好表现。

papers.title: On the Theory of Implicit Deep Learning: Global Convergence with Implicit Layers

tldr.en: For deep equilibrium models with nonlinearity only on weights, proves that gradient dynamics reach a global optimum at a linear rate without width assumptions, and relates them to trust region Newton on a shallow layer.
tldr.zh: 针对只在权重上有非线性的深度均衡模型，证明其梯度动力学不需要宽度假设就能以线性速率收敛到全局最优，并把这一动力学与浅层显式层上的信赖域牛顿法联系起来。

papers.title: Perceiver: General Perception with Iterative Attention

tldr.en: Perceiver repeatedly cross-attends from a small latent array to large inputs, with weights shared across repeats after the first, like an RNN unrolled in depth; it is competitive across images, point clouds, audio and video.
tldr.zh: Perceiver 用一个小的隐变量数组反复对大规模输入做 cross-attention，除第一次外各次重复共享权重，相当于沿深度展开的 RNN；它在图像、点云、音频和视频上都有竞争力。

papers.title: JFB: Jacobian-Free Backpropagation for Implicit Networks

tldr.en: JFB trains implicit networks, which infer by solving a fixed-point equation, by omitting the Jacobian term from backpropagation, keeping training memory fixed; on MNIST, SVHN and CIFAR-10 they are competitive with feedforward and prior implicit networks of the same parameter count.
tldr.zh: JFB 训练通过求解不动点方程进行推理的隐式网络，在反向传播中省略 Jacobian 项，使训练内存保持固定；在 MNIST、SVHN 和 CIFAR-10 上，这些隐式网络与参数量相同的前馈网络和已有隐式网络表现相当。

papers.title: Lessons on Parameter Sharing across Layers in Transformers

tldr.en: The paper builds an N-layer Transformer encoder-decoder from M independent layers assigned by sequence, cycle or cycle (rev), relaxing Universal Transformers' one-layer sharing; on WMT English-to-German with M=6 and N=12, all three train faster than Universal Transformers with slightly better BLEU.
tldr.zh: 论文用 M 个独立层构建 N 层 Transformer 编码器-解码器，按 sequence、cycle 或 cycle (rev) 分配各层参数，放宽了 Universal Transformer 所有层共享一层的做法；在 WMT 英德翻译上取 M=6、N=12 时，三种策略的训练速度都快于 Universal Transformer，BLEU 也略高。

papers.title: Staircase Attention for Recurrent Processing of Sequences

tldr.en: Staircase attention runs a shared Transformer core chunk by chunk, carrying backward tokens so each token passes through the core N times (Ladder repeats it on the full sequence); at equal parameters it solves tracking tasks Transformers fail and lowers language-modeling and dialogue perplexity.
tldr.zh: Staircase attention 让共享的 Transformer 核心逐 chunk 处理序列，并在步与步之间传递 backward token，使每个 token 经过核心 N 次（Ladder 变体则在完整序列上重复该核心）；参数量相同时，它能解决 Transformer 做不到的追踪任务，并降低语言建模和对话任务的困惑度。

papers.title: Can You Learn an Algorithm? Generalizing from Easy to Hard Problems with Recurrent Networks

tldr.en: Trains weight-tied recurrent networks with few iterations on easy prefix-sum, maze and chess problems and shows that running extra iterations at test time lets them solve harder instances.
tldr.zh: 用较少的迭代次数在简单的前缀和、迷宫和国际象棋问题上训练权重共享的循环网络，发现测试时增加迭代次数即可解出更难的实例。

papers.title: Stabilizing Equilibrium Models by Jacobian Regularization

tldr.en: Regularizing the Jacobian of the DEQ fixed-point update stabilizes forward and backward convergence; on WikiText-103 a Pre-LN DEQ-Transformer that diverges without it reaches 24.5 perplexity, and DEQ-Transformer training time falls from 3.1× to 1.5× that of Transformer-XL.
tldr.zh: 对 DEQ 不动点更新的 Jacobian 做正则化，可以稳定前向和反向收敛；在 WikiText-103 上，不加正则时会发散的 Pre-LN DEQ-Transformer 达到 24.5 的困惑度，DEQ-Transformer 的训练时间从 Transformer-XL 的 3.1× 降到 1.5×。

papers.title: PonderNet: Learning to Ponder

tldr.en: PonderNet runs a step function recurrently with a learned probabilistic halting policy; it outperforms earlier adaptive-computation methods on parity, succeeds at extrapolation, and matches state-of-the-art bAbI accuracy with less compute.
tldr.zh: PonderNet 循环调用同一个 step function，并端到端学习概率化的停止策略；在 parity 任务上优于以往的自适应计算方法并能外推，在 bAbI 上以更少的计算达到当时的最优水平。

papers.title: Semantic Communication with Adaptive Universal Transformer

tldr.en: Uses Universal Transformers with adaptive computation time halting as encoder and decoder of a semantic communication system; it reports higher BLEU and lower symbol error ratio than a fixed-depth Transformer system on noisy channels.
tldr.zh: 把带自适应计算时间（ACT）停止机制的 Universal Transformer 用作语义通信系统的编码器和解码器；在有噪声的信道上，它的 BLEU 高于固定深度的 Transformer 系统，符号错误率也更低。

papers.title: The Devil is in the Detail: Simple Tricks Improve Systematic Generalization of Transformers

tldr.en: Revisits simple configuration choices, including Universal Transformer variants with weights shared across layers; a relative-position Universal Transformer reaches 85% on the PCFG productivity split versus 50% previously reported, and universal variants beat standard ones except on COGS and CFQ MCD 1.
tldr.zh: 重新审视若干简单的配置选择，其中包括跨层共享权重的 Universal Transformer 变体；使用相对位置编码的 Universal Transformer 在 PCFG productivity 划分上达到 85%，此前报告为 50%；除 COGS 和 CFQ MCD 1 外，universal 变体均优于标准 Transformer。

papers.title: The Neural Data Router: Adaptive Control Flow in Transformers Improves Systematic Generalization

tldr.en: Neural Data Router adds a copy gate, which lets a column skip a step, and geometric attention to a Transformer with shared layer weights; it reaches 100% length generalization accuracy on compositional table lookup and near-perfect accuracy on simple arithmetic and a ListOps variant.
tldr.zh: Neural Data Router 在层间共享权重的 Transformer 中加入可让某列跳过一步的 copy gate 和几何注意力（geometric attention）；它在组合查表任务上达到 100% 的长度泛化准确率，在简单算术任务和一个 ListOps 变体上准确率接近完美。

papers.title: Sliced Recursive Transformer

tldr.en: SReT shares weights across depth in vision transformers by looping each block; naive recursion gives a ~2% gain, and sliced group self-attention across recursions cuts the added cost by 10~30% with minimal performance loss.
tldr.zh: SReT 通过循环执行每个块在视觉 Transformer 的深度上共享权重；朴素递归带来 ~2% 的提升，跨递归的切片分组自注意力把额外开销降低 10~30%，性能损失很小。

papers.title: Universal Transformer Hawkes Process with Adaptive Recursive Iteration

tldr.en: UTHP recursively applies one Universal Transformer encoding layer, with a CNN in its feed-forward part and modified ACT halting, to event sequences; it beats previous state-of-the-art point process models overall with fewer parameters, and ablations favor ACT over fixed iteration counts.
tldr.zh: UTHP 对事件序列编码递归应用同一个 Universal Transformer 编码层，在前馈部分加入 CNN，并使用改进的 ACT 停止机制；它总体上优于以往最先进的点过程模型且参数更少，消融实验显示 ACT 总体优于固定迭代次数。

papers.title: Deep Equilibrium Models for Video Snapshot Compressive Imaging

tldr.en: Applies deep equilibrium models to video snapshot compressive imaging, computing the fixed point of a learned nonexpansive operator for unlimited iterations at constant memory; DEQ versions of an RNN and a Plug-and-Play reconstruction method are effective and stable on several datasets and real data.
tldr.zh: 将深度均衡模型用于视频快照压缩成像，求解学习到的非扩张算子的不动点，以恒定内存实现无限次迭代；基于 RNN 和 Plug-and-Play 两种重建方法构建的 DEQ 版本在多个数据集和真实数据上有效且稳定。

papers.title: End-to-end Algorithm Synthesis with Recurrent Networks: Logical Extrapolation Without Overthinking

tldr.en: Adds recall, which feeds the input into every iteration of a recurrent block, and a progressive loss over random iteration counts; together they prevent overthinking and let networks trained on small problems solve larger ones.
tldr.zh: 提出 recall 结构，把输入拼接到循环块每次迭代的输入中，并用随机迭代次数的渐进式损失训练；二者共同避免 overthinking，使在小问题上训练的网络能解更大的问题。

papers.title: DRT: A Lightweight Single Image Deraining Recursive Transformer

tldr.en: DRT builds a lightweight image-deraining Transformer from recursive blocks that reapply shared Swin Transformer blocks with residual connections; it uses only 1.3% of the parameters of the best-performing deraining model while beating state-of-the-art methods on Rain100L by at least 0.33 dB.
tldr.zh: DRT 用递归块构建轻量的图像去雨 Transformer，每个递归块带残差连接并反复调用共享的 Swin Transformer 块；它的参数量只有当前最佳去雨模型的 1.3%，在 Rain100L 上比现有最优方法至少高 0.33 dB。

papers.title: Lightweight Bimodal Network for Single-Image Super-Resolution via Symmetric CNN and Recursive Transformer

tldr.en: LBNet pairs a parameter-shared Symmetric CNN with a Recursive Transformer whose two Transformer modules each feed their output back as input S times, for lightweight super-resolution; on Set5 ×4, recursing each module 2 times raises PSNR from 32.23 to 32.29 with parameters unchanged at 741.7K.
tldr.zh: LBNet 面向轻量单图超分辨率，把参数共享的 Symmetric CNN 与 Recursive Transformer 结合，后者的两个 Transformer 模块各自把输出当作新输入循环 S 次；在 Set5 ×4 上，每个模块递归 2 次使 PSNR 从 32.23 升至 32.29，参数量仍为 741.7K。

papers.title: Representation Recycling for Streaming Video Analysis

tldr.en: StreamDEQ computes per-frame video representations as fixed points of an implicit (DEQ) network, starting each frame's fixed-point iterations from the previous frame's representation; on video segmentation, detection and pose estimation it matches the baseline's accuracy with 2-4x higher throughput.
tldr.zh: StreamDEQ 把每帧视频表示定义为隐式（DEQ）网络的不动点，并以上一帧的表示作为本帧不动点迭代的起点；在视频语义分割、视频目标检测和视频人体姿态估计上，它与基线精度相当，吞吐量提升 2-4x。

papers.title: Unveiling Transformers with LEGO: a synthetic reasoning task

tldr.en: Introduces the LEGO chain-of-reasoning task and compares BERT with weight-tied ALBERT: trained on variables #0-#5, ALBERT reaches near-perfect accuracy on #6 and #7, probing shows it progresses more like a for-loop, and sampling depth between 6 and 12 during training further improves length extrapolation.
tldr.zh: 提出 LEGO 链式推理任务，并比较 BERT 与跨层权重共享的 ALBERT：只用变量 #0-#5 训练时，ALBERT 在 #6 和 #7 上接近满分，探针显示其逐层推进更像 for 循环；训练时在 6 到 12 之间随机采样深度可进一步改善长度外推。

papers.title: Transformers discover an elementary calculation system exploiting local attention and grid-like problem representation

tldr.en: A Universal Transformer with local attention over a grid-like memory and a PonderNet-style halting transformer learns multi-digit addition and place value alignment; trained on up to 4 operands of up to 10 digits, a variant reaches 0.99 sequence accuracy on 2-term additions of 1000-digit numbers.
tldr.zh: 一种 Universal Transformer 在网格式记忆上使用局部注意力，并配有 PonderNet 式停止 Transformer，学会了多位数加法和按数位对齐；在最多 4 个操作数、每个最多 10 位的数据上训练后，其一个变体在两个 1000 位数相加上达到 0.99 的序列准确率。

papers.title: Stable Invariant Models via Koopman Spectra

tldr.en: SIM describes the weight-tied, infinitely deep dynamics of DEQs via Koopman and Perron-Frobenius spectra, giving models trained like feedforward networks (single-tier SIMs use three transformations) that converge to a fixed point or a broader invariant set; SIMs match or beat DEQs on several tasks.
tldr.zh: SIM 用 Koopman 与 Perron-Frobenius 算子的谱刻画 DEQ 权重共享、无限深的动力学，得到可像前馈网络一样训练、收敛到不动点或更一般不变集的模型（single-tier SIM 只需三步变换）；SIM 在多项任务上与 DEQ 相当或更好。

papers.title: MiniALBERT: Model Distillation via Parameter-Efficient Recursive Transformers

tldr.en: MiniALBERT distills fully parameterised LMs such as BERT into a compact recursive student that reuses one shared Transformer layer at every iteration, optionally with per-iteration bottleneck adapters; students with no more than 18M parameters perform competitively on general and biomedical NLP tasks.
tldr.zh: MiniALBERT 把 BERT 等全参数语言模型蒸馏成紧凑的递归学生模型，每次迭代都复用同一个共享 Transformer 层，并可为每次迭代加入 bottleneck adapter；参数不超过 18M 的学生模型在通用和生物医学 NLP 任务上表现有竞争力。

papers.title: Path Independent Equilibrium Models Can Better Exploit Test-Time Computation

tldr.en: In equilibrium models, upward generalization to harder instances with more test-time iterations correlates with path independence (reaching the same fixed point from any initialization); promoting it improves generalization and penalizing it degrades it.
tldr.zh: 在均衡模型中，用更多测试时迭代向更难实例泛化的能力与路径无关性（从任意初始化都收敛到同一不动点）相关；提升路径无关性能改善泛化，惩罚它则会变差。

papers.title: Lightweight and Flexible Deep Equilibrium Learning for CSI Feedback in FDD Massive MIMO

tldr.en: Builds CSI feedback for FDD massive MIMO from implicit equilibrium blocks, fixed-point iterations with parameters shared across iterations that mimic an infinite-depth network; it matches benchmarks at much-reduced complexity, and the number of forward iterations can follow users' computation capability.
tldr.zh: 用隐式均衡块构建 FDD 大规模 MIMO 的 CSI 反馈方案：该块由不动点迭代定义，各次迭代共享可训练参数，以模拟无限深网络；它以大幅降低的复杂度达到与基准相当的性能，前向迭代次数可按用户算力调整。

papers.title: Looped Transformers as Programmable Computers

tldr.en: Shows that a looped 13-layer transformer with programmed weights, reading instructions and memory from its input, emulates a small instruction-set computer and runs a calculator, linear algebra routines and in-context learning algorithms.
tldr.zh: 证明一个权重经过编程设定的循环 13 层 transformer 能从输入中读取指令和内存，模拟一台小型指令集计算机，并运行计算器、线性代数例程和 in-context learning 算法。

papers.title: Beyond Universal Transformer: block reusing with adaptor in Transformer for automatic speech recognition

tldr.en: BRST reuses one Transformer block 12 times in the encoder and one 6 times in the decoder of a CTC-attention speech recognizer, adding a small adapter module (ADM) after each reuse; on AISHELL-1 it reaches 9.3%/6.63% CER with 7.6M/8.3M parameters without/with the ADM.
tldr.zh: BRST 在 CTC-attention 语音识别 Transformer 中让编码器的一个块重复 12 次、解码器的一个块重复 6 次，并在每次复用后加入少量参数的适配器模块（ADM）；在 AISHELL-1 上，不加和加 ADM 时分别以 7.6M/8.3M 参数取得 9.3%/6.63% 的 CER。

papers.title: Revisiting Implicit Models: Sparsity Trade-offs Capability in Weight-tied Model for Vision Tasks

tldr.en: Revisiting implicit models on vision tasks, the paper finds weight-tied models, which reuse one layer across depth, more effective, stable and efficient than DEQ variants, adds distinct sparse masks to the tied layers to raise capacity, and gives depth, width and sparsity guidelines.
tldr.zh: 该文在视觉任务上重新审视隐式模型，发现跨深度重复使用同一层的权重共享模型比 DEQ 变体更有效、更稳定、更高效；它为共享层加入不同的稀疏掩码以提升模型容量，并给出深度、宽度和稀疏度的选择指南。

papers.title: Federated Deep Equilibrium Learning: Harnessing Compact Global Representations to Enhance Personalization

tldr.en: FeDEQ gives federated clients a shared deep equilibrium layer, solved by fixed-point iteration, followed by personalized explicit layers, jointly trained via ADMM; it matches state-of-the-art personalized FL while cutting communication by up to 4 times and training memory by 1.5 times.
tldr.zh: FeDEQ 让联邦学习各客户端共享一个用不动点迭代求解的深度均衡层，其后接本地个性化显式层，并用 ADMM 联合训练；它与最先进的个性化联邦学习方法性能相当，同时把通信量最多减少 4 倍、训练内存占用减少 1.5 倍。

papers.title: Sparse Universal Transformer

tldr.en: Adds sparse mixture-of-experts and stick-breaking dynamic halting to the Universal Transformer, matching strong baselines on WMT'14 with half the computation and parameters; halting saves around 50% inference computation on formal language tasks with little loss.
tldr.zh: 在 Universal Transformer 中加入稀疏 MoE 和基于 stick-breaking 的动态停止机制，在 WMT'14 上以一半的计算量和参数量达到强基线水平；停止机制在形式语言任务上节省约 50% 的推理计算，性能下降很小。

papers.title: Adaptivity and Modularity for Efficient Generalization Over Task Complexity

tldr.en: Hyper-UT, a Universal Transformer with per-token ACT, uses hyper-modules to build each layer's weights from a weight-embedding pool shared across layers; it generalizes better to more computation steps on conditional pointer value retrieval and matches ViT on image recognition with over 70% average savings.
tldr.zh: Hyper-UT 在带逐 token ACT 的 Universal Transformer 中加入超网络模块，由跨层共享的权重嵌入池生成每层权重；在条件指针取值（C-PVR）任务上它对更多计算步数泛化得更好，在图像识别上与 ViT 性能相当，平均节省超过 70% 的计算。

papers.title: CoTFormer: A Chain-of-Thought Driven Architecture with Budget-Adaptive Computation Cost at Inference

tldr.en: CoTFormer re-applies the same layers several times and lets each pass attend to tokens from earlier passes, like chain-of-thought; it approaches much larger models, and a token-wise adaptive-depth variant cuts compute without losing accuracy.
tldr.zh: CoTFormer 多次重复应用同一组层，并像 chain-of-thought 一样让每一遍都能关注前几遍产生的 token；准确率接近大得多的模型，按 token 自适应深度的变体能在不损失准确率的情况下降低计算成本。

papers.title: Looped Transformers are Better at Learning Learning Algorithms

tldr.en: Trains a looped transformer with input injection to solve in-context data-fitting problems such as linear regression; it performs comparably to a standard transformer while using less than 10% of the parameters.
tldr.zh: 训练带输入注入的循环 Transformer，在上下文中求解线性回归等数据拟合问题；其表现与标准 Transformer 相当，参数量不到后者的 10%。

papers.title: Investigating Recurrent Transformers with Dynamic Halt

tldr.en: Compares depth-wise Universal Transformer recurrence with chunk-wise Temporal Latent Bottleneck recurrence and proposes GUT, a gated UT with global mean-based dynamic halting; GUT generally beats UT on ListOps and Logical Inference, while chunk-wise recurrence is more robust in flip-flop LM and length generalization.
tldr.zh: 比较 Universal Transformer 的深度循环与 Temporal Latent Bottleneck 的分块时间循环，并提出带全局均值动态停止机制的门控 UT（GUT）；GUT 在 ListOps 和 Logical Inference 上总体优于 UT，而分块循环在 flip-flop 语言建模和长度泛化上更稳健。

papers.title: Simulation of Graph Algorithms with Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Proves by construction that a looped transformer with extra graph-reading attention heads simulates BFS, DFS, Dijkstra and Kosaraju's algorithm with parameters independent of graph size, within finite-precision limits, and is Turing complete at constant width.
tldr.zh: 通过构造证明，带额外读图注意力头的循环 Transformer 能以与图大小无关的参数量模拟 BFS、DFS、Dijkstra 和 Kosaraju 算法，但受有限精度限制，并且在常数宽度下图灵完备。

papers.title: AlgoFormer: An Efficient Transformer Framework with Algorithmic Structures

tldr.en: AlgoFormer puts a weight-shared looped transformer between a pre- and a post-transformer, mirroring preprocess-iterate-postprocess algorithms; constructions show it can run gradient descent and Newton's method, and on IWSLT 2015 German-English it scores 14.72 BLEU versus 9.30 standard and 10.56 vanilla looped.
tldr.zh: AlgoFormer 在前置 Transformer 与后置 Transformer 之间放一个权重共享的循环 Transformer，对应先预处理、再迭代、后处理的算法结构；构造性结果表明它能执行梯度下降和牛顿法，在 IWSLT 2015 德英翻译上 BLEU 为 14.72，标准 Transformer 为 9.30，普通循环 Transformer 为 10.56。

papers.title: MobileLLM: Optimizing Sub-billion Parameter Language Models for On-Device Use Cases

tldr.en: MobileLLM builds deep-and-thin sub-billion LMs with embedding sharing and grouped-query attention, gaining 2.7%/4.3% accuracy over prior 125M/350M models; MobileLLM-LS computes each Transformer block twice in a row (immediate block-wise weight sharing), adding 0.7%/0.8% with no increase in model size.
tldr.zh: MobileLLM 用深而窄的结构、embedding 共享和 grouped-query attention 构建十亿参数以下的 LM，准确率比此前的 125M/350M 模型高 2.7%/4.3%；MobileLLM-LS 让每个 Transformer 块紧接着连续计算两次（相邻块权重共享），在不增加模型大小的情况下再提高 0.7%/0.8%。

papers.title: Subhomogeneous Deep Equilibrium Models

tldr.en: Proves that deep equilibrium models built from subhomogeneous operators have unique fixed points, via nonlinear Perron-Frobenius theory and weaker weight assumptions than monotone-operator DEQs; SubDEQs need fewer fixed-point iterations than MonDEQ and are tested on feedforward, convolutional and graph networks.
tldr.zh: 利用非线性 Perron-Frobenius 理论，证明由次齐次算子构成的深度均衡模型存在唯一不动点，所需的权重假设弱于 monotone-operator DEQ；由此得到的 SubDEQ 比 MonDEQ 需要更少的不动点迭代，并在前馈、卷积和图神经网络上做了验证。

papers.title: MoEUT: Mixture-of-Experts Universal Transformers

tldr.en: MoEUT is a shared-layer Transformer with mixture-of-experts feedforward and attention layers, layer grouping and peri-layernorm; it slightly outperforms standard Transformers on language modeling tasks such as BLiMP and PIQA using less compute and memory.
tldr.zh: MoEUT 是在前馈层和注意力层都使用 MoE 的共享层 Transformer，并采用层分组和 peri-layernorm 方案；它在 BLiMP、PIQA 等语言建模任务上略优于标准 Transformer，同时计算和内存更少。

papers.title: On the Design Space Between Transformers and Recursive Neural Nets

tldr.en: Formalizes Neural Data Routers, a Universal Transformer variant sharing parameters across layers, and Continuous Recursive Neural Networks as repeated application of one shared function, showing these strong algorithmic generalizers bridge Transformers and recursive neural nets, and discusses limits.
tldr.zh: 把 Neural Data Router（一种跨层共享参数的 Universal Transformer 变体）和 Continuous Recursive Neural Network 都形式化为同一个共享函数的反复应用，说明这两个算法泛化能力很强的模型是连接 Transformer 与递归神经网络的桥梁模型，并讨论了它们的局限。

papers.title: Loop Neural Networks for Parameter Sharing

tldr.en: Loop Neural Network loops GPT-2 Transformer layers with a residual update at each iteration; a model with 6 layers looped 6 times (81M parameters) reaches validation loss 3.11 on OpenWebText, comparable to 3.12 for the 12-layer GPT-2 124M.
tldr.zh: Loop Neural Network 循环复用 GPT-2 的 Transformer 层，每次迭代以残差方式更新隐状态；6 层循环 6 次（81M 参数）的模型在 OpenWebText 上验证损失为 3.11，与 12 层 GPT-2 124M 的 3.12 相当。

papers.title: Looped Transformers for Length Generalization

tldr.en: Trains looped decoder-only Transformers on tasks with known iterative RASP-L solutions, supervising only the final answer after an input-dependent number of steps; adapting the step count at test time improves length generalization.
tldr.zh: 在有已知迭代 RASP-L 解法的任务上训练循环 decoder-only Transformer，只在与输入相关的步数之后监督最终答案；测试时按输入调整循环步数可以改善长度泛化。

papers.title: On Expressive Power of Looped Transformers: Theoretical Analysis and Enhancement via Timestep Encoding

tldr.en: Derives approximation rates for looped Transformers, revealing a limitation specific to looping, and adds per-loop scaling parameters conditioned on timestep encoding; in experiments more loops improve performance and timestep encoding adds further gains.
tldr.zh: 推导循环 Transformer 的逼近速率，揭示循环结构特有的局限，并据此加入以时间步编码为条件的每遍缩放参数；实验中循环次数越多效果越好，时间步编码带来进一步提升。

papers.title: On Logical Extrapolation for Mazes with Recurrent and Implicit Networks

tldr.en: Weight-tied RNNs and implicit networks that solve larger mazes by iterating longer lose accuracy when the start may have several neighbors or the maze has cycles; one RNN matches deadend-filling on 98.8% of 143k test mazes, and models can be correct while converging to limit cycles, not fixed points.
tldr.zh: 靠增加迭代次数解更大迷宫的权重共享 RNN 和隐式网络，在起点可有多个邻居或迷宫含环时准确率下降；其中一个 RNN 在 143k 个测试迷宫中有 98.8% 与 deadend-filling 算法输出一致，且模型在收敛到极限环而非不动点时也能给出正确解。

papers.title: Can Looped Transformers Learn to Implement Multi-step Gradient Descent for In-context Learning?

tldr.en: Proves that for in-context linear regression, the global minimizer of a linear looped Transformer's training loss implements multi-step preconditioned gradient descent, and that gradient flow converges fast despite non-convexity; synthetic experiments agree.
tldr.zh: 证明在 in-context 线性回归中，线性循环 Transformer 总体训练损失的全局最小点实现了多步预条件梯度下降，且尽管损失非凸，梯度流仍能快速收敛；合成实验与理论一致。

papers.title: Looped ReLU MLPs May Be All You Need as Practical Programmable Computers

tldr.en: Proves by construction that a looped 23-layer ReLU-MLP can emulate the SUBLEQ instruction and so act as a programmable computer, more efficiently than a looped Transformer, indicating that simple modules are more expressive than expected.
tldr.zh: 通过构造证明，循环的 23 层 ReLU-MLP 能模拟 SUBLEQ 指令，从而作为可编程计算机运行，且比循环 Transformer 更高效，说明简单模块的表达能力强于此前预期。

papers.title: Bypassing the Exponential Dependency: Looped Transformers Efficiently Learn In-context by Multi-step Gradient Descent

tldr.en: Proves that linear looped Transformers implement multi-step gradient descent efficiently for in-context learning on linear vector generation: with a constant input condition number, e.g. n = O(d), they reach small error, avoiding the n = exp(Ω(T)) examples earlier results needed for T loops.
tldr.zh: 证明线性循环 Transformer 在线性向量生成任务的 in-context learning 中能高效实现多步梯度下降：只要输入数据的条件数为常数（例如 n = O(d)），就能达到较小误差，不再需要以往结果对 T 次循环所要求的 n = exp(Ω(T)) 个上下文示例。

papers.title: Advancing the Understanding of Fixed Point Iterations in Deep Neural Networks: A Detailed Analytical Study

tldr.en: For a looped network repeatedly applying one layer g(Wx+b), gives a sufficient condition for multiple fixed points depending on the input region, extends it to robust fixed points, and shows such networks may have 2^d robust fixed points (d: feature dimension) under polynomial or exponential activations.
tldr.zh: 针对重复应用同一层 g(Wx+b) 的循环神经网络，给出随输入区域不同而存在多个不动点的充分条件，并推广到鲁棒不动点；在多项式或指数激活下，这类网络可能有 2^d 个鲁棒不动点（d 为特征维度）。

papers.title: ALTA: Compiler-Based Analysis of Transformers

tldr.en: ALTA compiles programs with loops into Transformers whose layers share all attention and MLP weights, including Universal Transformers with dynamic halting; it builds length-invariant parity and addition and a SCAN solution, and uses execution-trace supervision to study why end-to-end training misses them.
tldr.zh: ALTA 把带循环的程序编译成各层共享全部注意力和 MLP 权重的 Transformer，包括带动态停止的 Universal Transformer；它构造出与长度无关的奇偶校验和加法算法以及 SCAN 的解法，并用执行轨迹监督研究端到端训练为何学不到这些算法。

papers.title: Relaxed Recursive Transformers: Effective Parameter Sharing with Layer-wise LoRA

tldr.en: Converts pretrained LLMs into Recursive Transformers that loop one shared block, optionally relaxed with depth-wise LoRA; recursive Gemma 1B beats TinyLlama 1.1B, Pythia 1B and distillation baselines and recovers most of Gemma 2B's performance.
tldr.zh: 把预训练 LLM 转换为循环复用同一组共享层的 Recursive Transformer，并可用逐深度 LoRA 放松权重共享；recursive Gemma 1B 优于 TinyLlama 1.1B、Pythia 1B 和知识蒸馏基线，并恢复了原始 Gemma 2B 的大部分性能。

papers.title: On the Role of Depth and Looping for In-Context Learning with Task Diversity

tldr.en: For in-context linear regression with condition numbers in [1, κ], proves log(κ) (or √κ) lower bounds on linear attention layers; multilayer Transformers attain them yet are not robust even to O(e^{-L}) shifts, while Looped Transformers attain them, are provably robust, and alone have loss monotonic in depth.
tldr.zh: 针对条件数位于 [1, κ] 的 in-context 线性回归，证明需要 log(κ)（或 √κ）层线性注意力的下界；多层 Transformer 能达到该下界，但连小至 O(e^{-L}) 的分布偏移都不鲁棒；循环 Transformer 表达能力相当、可证明鲁棒，且只有它的损失随深度单调变化。

papers.title: Training Large Language Models to Reason in a Continuous Latent Space

tldr.en: Coconut feeds the last hidden state back as the next input embedding rather than decoding it into a token; these continuous thoughts can encode alternative next steps, and Coconut outperforms CoT on search-heavy logical reasoning.
tldr.zh: Coconut 不把最后的隐藏状态解码成 token，而是直接作为下一个输入 embedding 送回模型；这种连续思维可以编码多个候选的下一步，Coconut 在需要大量搜索的逻辑推理任务上优于 CoT。

papers.title: Neural Algorithmic Reasoning for Hypergraphs with Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Proves by construction that a looped Transformer with constant layers and constant feature dimensions simulates hypergraph algorithms: Dijkstra, BFS and DFS through a mechanism that degrades the incidence matrix to an adjacency matrix, and Helly's algorithm through a hyperedge-aware encoding.
tldr.zh: 通过构造证明，循环 Transformer 只需常数层数和常数特征维度即可模拟超图算法：借助把关联矩阵退化为邻接矩阵的机制模拟 Dijkstra、BFS 和 DFS，借助感知超边的编码方案模拟 Helly 算法。

papers.title: StagFormer: Time Staggering Transformer Decoding for RunningLayers In Parallel

tldr.en: StagFormer lets a later Transformer stack see earlier-stack outputs only for past tokens, so stacks run in parallel during decoding; when its 2 staggered 18-layer stacks share all weights except cross-attention, it reaches 3.896 Pile perplexity vs 4.026 for the 18-layer and 3.780 for the 36-layer baseline.
tldr.zh: StagFormer 让后一个 Transformer 栈只能看到前一个栈对过去 token 的输出，使各栈在解码时并行执行；当 2 个交错的 18 层栈共享除 cross-attention 外的全部权重时，Pile 困惑度为 3.896，18 层和 36 层基线分别为 4.026 和 3.780。

papers.title: DeltaLLM: Compress LLMs with Low-Rank Deltas between Shared Weights

tldr.en: DeltaLLM compresses pretrained LLMs by sharing weights between layers in subsequent Transformer blocks and adding low-rank delta matrices trained on approximately 30M-40M tokens; DeltaLLAMA and DeltaPHI cut parameters by 12% while retaining 90% of base Llama and Phi performance.
tldr.zh: DeltaLLM 让相邻 Transformer 块中的层共享权重并加入低秩差值矩阵来压缩预训练 LLM，低秩模块只需约 30M-40M token 训练；DeltaLLAMA 和 DeltaPHI 减少 12% 参数，保留基础 Llama 和 Phi 模型 90% 的性能。

papers.title: Scaling up Test-Time Compute with Latent Reasoning: A Recurrent Depth Approach

note.en: Huginn-0125 has 8 distinct layers in a (2,4,2) layout with hidden size 5280 and 55 heads of size 96. The core starts with an adapter that maps the concatenation of the state and the prelude output from 2h to h, and the first state is random noise. At r=32 the model unrolls to 132 effective layers. Small ablation models use (1,4,1) with h=1024.
note.zh: Huginn-0125 共 8 个不同的层，布局 (2,4,2)，hidden size 5280，55 个 96 维的 head。核心块开头的 adapter 把状态和 prelude 输出的拼接从 2h 映射到 h，初始状态是随机噪声。r=32 时展开为 132 层。小规模消融模型用 (1,4,1)，h=1024。

baseline.en: A fixed-depth twin with the same architecture, data and training setup that passes through the core block once, trained for 180B tokens (256 nodes, batch size 2 per GPU).
baseline.zh: 同架构、同数据、同训练设置的固定深度孪生模型，只过一遍核心块，训练 180B token（256 个节点，每张 GPU batch size 2）。

headline.en: The 3.5B model trained on 800B tokens improves on reasoning benchmarks as test-time recurrence grows, up to a computation load equivalent to 50B parameters. At 180B tokens and r=32 it scores 9.02/10.24 on GSM8K CoT against 1.82/2.20 for the fixed-depth twin, which the paper calls 5 times better.
headline.zh: 800B token 训练的 3.5B 模型，测试时循环次数越多，推理类基准越好，算力最多相当于 50B 参数的模型。180B token 时，r=32 的 GSM8K CoT 为 9.02/10.24，固定深度孪生模型为 1.82/2.20，论文称是基线的 5 倍。

results.setting: 3.5B parameters, both models at 180B tokens (0.18T), same data and setup

note.en: GSM8K CoT pairs are copied as printed; the Table 2 caption says the paper reports flexible and strict extract.
note.zh: GSM8K CoT 的两个数照原文抄录；Table 2 标题说明报告的是 flexible 和 strict extract。

results.setting: Huginn-0125 (3.5B, 800B tokens), lm-eval zero-shot at different test-time recurrences r

note.en: arXiv v1 printed different values in the r=4, 8 and 16 rows of Table 1; these are the v2 values.
note.zh: arXiv v1 的 Table 1 中 r=4、8、16 三行数值与此不同；这里用 v2 的数值。

results.setting: Huginn-0125 at r=32 next to fixed-depth open models
Huginn-0125, first-turn MT-Bench, inference schemes used zero-shot

note.en: s is the per-token KV-cache budget in recurrence steps. The paper states no difference from the baseline is statistically significant.
note.zh: s 是每个 token 的 KV cache 预算（递归步数）。论文说明与基线的差异都不显著。

findings.en: Evaluated with one recurrence, the model barely changes between the 180B and 800B checkpoints (ARC-C 23.72 and 24.06); the authors conclude that later gains sit in the recurrent iterations, not in the prelude or coda.
findings.zh: 只跑 1 次循环时，180B 和 800B 两个 checkpoint 几乎没有差别（ARC-C 23.72 和 24.06）；作者据此认为后续提升来自循环迭代，而不在 prelude 或 coda。

findings.en: Useful depth depends on task and context. HellaSwag is near its peak at 8 recurrences; ARC-C saturates around 8-12 iterations with no few-shot examples, around 20 with 1 example and around 32 with 25-50 examples.
findings.zh: 有用的迭代次数取决于任务和上下文。HellaSwag 在 8 次左右接近峰值；ARC-C 没有 few-shot 示例时约 8-12 次饱和，1 个示例时约 20 次，25-50 个示例时约 32 次。

findings.en: Tested at r=64 (training mean 32), an EMA of the last 75 checkpoints reaches 47.23% flexible (38.59% strict) on GSM8K.
findings.zh: 在 r=64（训练均值为 32）下测试，最后 75 个 checkpoint 的 EMA 在 GSM8K 上达到 47.23%（flexible）/ 38.59%（strict）。

findings.en: In ablations, a core block that takes the step index as input interacted badly with path independence and gave models that cannot extrapolate; adding noise at each step did not help.
findings.zh: 消融中，以步数为输入的核心块破坏了路径无关性，得到的模型无法外推；每步加噪声也没有帮助。

findings.en: Two earlier large-scale runs failed. In one, all tokens collapsed to the same hidden state; in the other, the model learned to ignore the recurrent state, with the same validation perplexity at 1 or 32 recurrences. The successful run used sandwich norms and a peak learning rate of 4×10^-5.
findings.zh: 此前两次大规模训练失败。一次所有 token 坍缩成相同的隐状态；另一次模型学会忽略循环状态，1 次和 32 次循环的验证 perplexity 相同。成功的那次用 sandwich 归一化，峰值学习率 4×10^-5。

tldr.en: Pretrain a 3.5B prelude-core-coda transformer with a randomly sampled number of core iterations, so test-time compute scales by iterating the core more.
tldr.zh: 用随机采样的核心块迭代次数预训练 3.5B 的 prelude-core-coda Transformer，测试时多迭代核心块即可增加算力。

problem.en: Mainstream reasoning models scale test-time compute by generating more tokens in long chains of thought, which needs specialized training data and long context windows. The paper scales compute by iterating a recurrent block in latent space instead.
problem.zh: 主流推理模型靠生成更多 token（长 CoT）增加测试时算力，需要专门的训练数据和长上下文窗口。本文改为在隐空间反复迭代一个循环块来增加算力。

en: Split a decoder-only transformer into a prelude, a weight-shared recurrent core and a coda. At every iteration the core receives the prelude output through an adapter on concat(state, prelude output); the first state is random.
Sample the iteration count from a log-normal Poisson distribution with mean 32 (one count per micro-batch, synchronized across workers) and backpropagate through only the last 8 iterations.

Train once at (2,4,2) with h=5280 on 800B tokens of public data weighted toward code and math, on 4096 AMD MI250X GPUs, with sandwich normalization (four RMSNorms per layer) and a scaled initialization.
At inference the iteration count is free; the paper also tries zero-shot per-token early exit, KV-cache sharing, continuous-CoT warm starts and self-speculative decoding.
zh: 把 decoder-only Transformer 分成 prelude、权重共享的循环核心块和 coda。每次迭代，核心块通过对 concat(状态, prelude 输出) 的 adapter 接收 prelude 输出；初始状态随机。
迭代次数从均值 32 的 log-normal Poisson 分布采样（每个 micro-batch 一个值，各 worker 同步），只反传最后 8 次迭代。
以 (2,4,2)、h=5280 的形状，在 4096 张 AMD MI250X 上用 800B token 的公开数据（偏重代码和数学）训练一次，采用 sandwich 归一化（每层四个 RMSNorm）和缩放初始化。
推理时迭代次数可自由设定；论文还零样本尝试了逐 token 提前退出、KV cache 共享、连续 CoT 热启动和自推测解码。

en: A single large run with 3.5B parameters and 800B tokens, on a data mixture the authors could not ablate and with a constant learning rate that was never cooled down (47000 steps).
The looped-vs-fixed-depth comparison exists only at 180B tokens. It matches parameters and tokens but not compute, since the baseline passes through the core once.
The comparisons with Amber, Pythia, OLMo and StarCoder2 models (Tables 1-3) are not matched in parameters, tokens or data.
Training uses 4096-token sequences and backpropagates through only the last 8 core iterations.

Early exit, KV-cache sharing and continuous CoT are zero-shot uses of a model not trained for them, measured only on first-turn MT-Bench, where the differences are not statistically significant (Table 6). Self-speculative decoding has no reported measurements.
zh: 只训练了一个大模型，3.5B 参数、800B token；数据配比作者没能做消融，学习率一直是常数、没有退火（47000 step）。
循环与固定深度的对比只在 180B token 处做过；对齐了参数和 token，没对齐算力，基线只过一遍核心块。
与 Amber、Pythia、OLMo、StarCoder2 等模型的对比（Table 1-3）在参数、token 和数据上都没有对齐。
训练序列长 4096 token，只反传核心块最后 8 次迭代。
提前退出、KV cache 共享和连续 CoT 都是对未专门训练的模型的零样本用法，只在 MT-Bench 第一轮测过，差异不显著（Table 6）。自推测解码没有给出测量结果。

papers.glyph: P (2 layers) -> [R (4 layers)] x log-normal Poisson, mean 32 -> C (2 layers); injection concat; KV per-pass

papers.title: Recursive Inference Scaling: A Winning Path to Scalable Inference in Language and Multimodal Systems

tldr.en: RINS splits a model into two equal blocks and recursively applies the first to its own output before the second; at matched training compute it outperforms +55 other recursion variants in language modeling, improves data scaling exponents and limits, and adds +2% 0-shot ImageNet accuracy for SigLIP-B/16.
tldr.zh: RINS 把模型分成两个等大的块，先让第一个块对自身输出递归应用多次，再送入第二个块；在训练计算量相同时，它在语言建模上优于 +55 种其他递归变体，改善了数据 scaling law 的渐近极限和指数，并使 SigLIP-B/16 的 0-shot ImageNet 准确率提升 +2%。

papers.title: Implicit Language Models are RNNs: Balancing Parallelization and Expressivity

tldr.en: Implicit Mamba2 and Llama3 models self-iterate the stack to an approximate fixed point, gaining RNN-like non-linear state transitions that solve the S5 word problem; with a bounded-then-free iteration curriculum up to 1.3B parameters and 207B tokens, they beat explicit counterparts on standard benchmarks.
tldr.zh: 隐式 Mamba2 和 Llama3 模型把整个层栈自迭代到近似不动点，获得类似 RNN 的非线性状态转移，能解决 S5 word problem；采用先限定迭代步数、再放开迭代的课程训练，规模达到 1.3B 参数、207B token，在标准基准上优于对应的显式模型。

papers.title: Enhancing Auto-regressive Chain-of-Thought through Loop-Aligned Reasoning

tldr.en: RELAY aligns each iteration of a looped Transformer with one chain-of-thought step and supervises every iteration, keeping length generalization while producing explicit reasoning chains; its chains for problems beyond the training length fine-tune an auto-regressive model and improve its performance.
tldr.zh: RELAY 把循环 Transformer 的每次循环迭代与一步 CoT 推理对齐，并对每次迭代施加中间监督，在保持长度泛化能力的同时输出显式推理链；它为超出训练长度的问题生成的推理链被用来微调自回归模型，提升了后者的表现。

papers.title: Hyper-SET: Designing Transformers via Hyperspherical Energy Minimization

tldr.en: Hyper-SET derives a weight-shared recurrent-depth Transformer layer from iterative energy minimization on the hypersphere; with fewer parameters it is competitive or better on Sudoku, image classification and masked image modeling, and gains more than a Transformer when Sudoku test iterations grow to 2× training.
tldr.zh: Hyper-SET 从超球面上的迭代能量最小化推导出一个权重共享的循环深度 Transformer 层；它以更少的参数在 Sudoku、图像分类和掩码图像建模上取得相当或更好的结果，并且当 Sudoku 测试迭代次数增至训练时的 2× 时，提升幅度大于 Transformer。

papers.title: Zero Token-Driven Deep Thinking in LLMs: Unlocking the Full Potential of Existing Parameters via Cyclic Refinement

tldr.en: Zero Token Transformer keeps the first and last layers out of parameter cycling, loops only the middle layers, and adds per-cycle zero tokens with trainable keys whose attention scores guide each cycle and trigger early exit; under a 6-cycle budget it averages 33.52 versus 32.79 for cycling all layers.
tldr.zh: Zero Token Transformer 让首层和末层不参与参数循环，只循环中间层，并在每次循环中加入带可训练 key 的 zero token，其注意力分数指导每次循环的计算并触发提前退出；在 6 个计算周期的预算下，其平均分为 33.52，循环全部层的基线为 32.79。

papers.title: Inner Thinking Transformer: Leveraging Dynamic Depth Scaling to Foster Adaptive Internal Thinking

tldr.en: ITT turns every other layer into a looped layer whose learned routers send selected tokens through extra steps of the same layer, accumulated by residual thinking connections; with 162M parameters it reaches 96.5% of a 466M Transformer's performance, saves 43.2% of training data and beats Transformer and Loop variants on 11 benchmarks.
tldr.zh: ITT 把每隔一层换成循环层，由学到的路由器挑出 token 在同一层上多算几步，再用 Residual Thinking Connection 累加各步结果；162M 的 ITT 达到 466M Transformer 96.5% 的性能，训练数据省 43.2%，在 11 个基准上超过 Transformer 和 Loop 变体。

papers.title: Reasoning with Latent Thoughts: On the Power of Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Shows that a k-layer transformer looped L times nearly matches a kL-layer model on synthetic reasoning and is competitive on language-model reasoning tasks, and proves T loops can simulate T steps of CoT.
tldr.zh: 表明 k 层 Transformer 循环 L 次在合成推理任务上接近 kL 层模型，在语言模型的下游推理任务上也能与之竞争，并证明 T 次循环可以模拟 T 步 CoT。

papers.title: CODI: Compressing Chain-of-Thought into Continuous Space via Self-Distillation

tldr.en: CODI jointly trains explicit-CoT teacher and implicit-CoT student tasks, aligning a designated token's hidden states to compress CoT into continuous space; at GPT-2 scale it matches explicit CoT on GSM8k with 3.1x compression.
tldr.zh: CODI 联合训练显式 CoT 教师任务和隐式 CoT 学生任务，通过对齐指定 token 的隐藏状态把 CoT 压缩到连续空间；在 GPT-2 规模上它在 GSM8k 上追平显式 CoT，压缩率为 3.1x。

papers.title: Transformers Learn to Implement Multi-step Gradient Descent with Chain of Thought

tldr.en: Proves that with CoT a one-layer linear Transformer learns multi-step gradient descent in context, but without CoT only one step; the same technique shows looped Transformers reach strictly lower asymptotic loss than a non-looped one-layer Transformer on in-context linear regression when L≥2.
tldr.zh: 证明借助 CoT，单层线性 Transformer 能在上下文中学会多步梯度下降，不用 CoT 时只能执行一步；用同样的技术还证明，在上下文线性回归中，当 L≥2 时循环 Transformer 的渐近损失严格低于不循环的单层 Transformer。

papers.title: A Little Depth Goes a Long Way: The Expressive Power of Log-Depth Transformers

tldr.en: Proves that looped transformers repeating middle layers Θ(log n) times recognize regular languages and solve graph connectivity, which fixed-depth transformers cannot under standard conjectures; growing depth is more efficient than growing width or chain-of-thought steps.
tldr.zh: 证明中间层重复 Θ(log n) 次的循环 transformer 能识别正则语言并求解图连通性，而在标准复杂性猜想下固定深度 transformer 做不到；增加深度比增加宽度或 chain-of-thought 步数更高效。

papers.title: Fixed-Point RNNs: Interpolating from Diagonal to Dense

tldr.en: Fixed-Point RNNs compute a dense linear RNN as the fixed point of a parallelizable diagonal linear RNN, iterated to convergence, so iterations trade expressivity for efficiency at fixed parameters; they set state-of-the-art results on state-tracking benchmarks A5 and S5 and match baselines on copying.
tldr.zh: Fixed-Point RNN 把稠密线性 RNN 表示为可并行的对角线性 RNN 的不动点并迭代至收敛，使迭代次数在参数量不变时权衡表达力与效率；它在状态追踪基准 A5 和 S5 上取得最优结果，在复制等任务上与基线相当。

papers.title: Intra-Layer Recurrence in Transformers for Language Modeling

tldr.en: Intra-Layer Recurrence (ILR) repeats individual layers of a LLaMA-style decoder within one forward pass according to a per-layer reuse map; reusing earlier layers helps most, and the [4,2,1,1] map lowers small-model perplexity from 16.57 to 14.62 with NoPE and from 14.38 to 13.63 with ALiBi.
tldr.zh: Intra-Layer Recurrence（ILR）按逐层复用表在一次前向中重复执行 LLaMA 式解码器的单个层；复用靠前的层收益最大，复用表 [4,2,1,1] 使小模型困惑度在 NoPE 下从 16.57 降至 14.62，在 ALiBi 下从 14.38 降至 13.63。

papers.title: LARES: Latent Reasoning for Sequential Recommendation

tldr.en: LARES iterates a core-block after a pre-block so every latent reasoning step refines all item tokens of a user sequence, training with self-supervised alignment and then RL; it beats all baselines on four datasets and raises FMLP-Rec's NDCG@10 by 15.3% on Instrument and 21.4% on Scientific.
tldr.zh: LARES 在 pre-block 之后循环迭代 core-block，每个潜在推理步都精炼用户序列中的全部物品 token，先做自监督对齐预训练再做 RL 后训练；它在四个数据集上超过所有基线，并把 FMLP-Rec 在 Instrument 和 Scientific 上的 NDCG@10 分别提升 15.3% 和 21.4%。

papers.title: Exact Expressive Power of Transformers with Padding

tldr.en: Proves that averaging-hard-attention transformers with polynomial padding recognize exactly FO-uniform TC^0, and that looping a middle block O(log^d n) times raises this to exactly FO-uniform TC^d, so polylogarithmic looping with polynomial padding reaches FO-uniform NC.
tldr.zh: 证明带多项式 padding 的 averaging-hard-attention Transformer 恰好识别 FO-uniform TC^0，把中间层块循环 O(log^d n) 次后恰好识别 FO-uniform TC^d，因此多对数次循环加多项式 padding 可达到 FO-uniform NC。

papers.title: Recurrent Self-Attention Dynamics: An Energy-Agnostic Perspective from Jacobians

tldr.en: Jacobian analysis of looped self-attention (AKOrN and ItrSA, mostly on Sudoku): normalization curbs SA's Lipschitzness and complex Jacobian eigenvalues, normalized dynamics sit near a critical state that signals high inference performance, and Jacobians yield regularizers and a pseudo-energy.
tldr.zh: 通过 Jacobian 分析循环自注意力（AKOrN 和 ItrSA，主要在 Sudoku 上）：归一化抑制了自注意力的 Lipschitz 性和 Jacobian 的复特征值，归一化后的动力学接近临界状态，这种临界性预示着较高的推理性能；Jacobian 视角还给出了训练正则化方法和用于监控推理动力学的伪能量。

papers.title: PonderLM: Pretraining Language Models to Ponder in Continuous Space

tldr.en: PonderLM feeds the probability-weighted sum of token embeddings back into the same model for several forward passes per token, learned by self-supervised pretraining; PonderPythia-2.8B surpasses Pythia-6.9B and rivals Pythia-12B.
tldr.zh: PonderLM 在预测每个 token 时，把按预测分布加权的 token 嵌入之和加回输入，再送入同一个模型做下一次前向，并通过自监督预训练学会这种思考；PonderPythia-2.8B 超过 Pythia-6.9B，并与 Pythia-12B 相当。

papers.title: DiffusionBlocks: Block-wise Neural Network Training via Diffusion Interpretation

tldr.en: DiffusionBlocks trains each residual block independently as a denoiser for its own noise range; on the recurrent-depth model Huginn it replaces training over an average of 32 recurrent iterations with single-pass denoiser training, keeps iterative inference, and raises LM1B MAUVE from 0.49 to 0.70.
tldr.zh: DiffusionBlocks 把残差网络的每个块作为各自噪声区间的去噪器独立训练；用于循环深度模型 Huginn 时，它把平均 32 次循环迭代的训练换成单次前向的去噪训练，推理仍多次迭代，LM1B 上的 MAUVE 从 0.49 提高到 0.70。

papers.title: Beyond Parameters: Exploring Virtual Logic Depth for Scaling Laws

tldr.en: Virtual logical depth reuses layers in sequence, cycle or inverse-cycle patterns to add effective depth without new parameters; knowledge capacity stays nearly unchanged while reasoning improves, e.g. the cycle pattern raises a 4-layer model's accuracy from 46.3% to 70.7% with a VLD factor of 5.
tldr.zh: 虚拟逻辑深度（VLD）按顺序、循环或逆循环模式复用层，在不增加参数的情况下增加有效深度；知识容量几乎不变而推理能力提升，例如循环模式在 VLD 因子为 5 时把 4 层模型的准确率从 46.3% 提高到 70.7%。

papers.title: Chain-of-Experts: Unlocking the Communication Power of Mixture-of-Experts Models

tldr.en: Chain-of-Experts iterates each MoE layer, re-routing tokens among its experts with a dedicated router per iteration; under fixed compute it cuts math validation loss from 1.20 to 1.12 versus standard MoE, and 2x iterations match 3x expert selections with 17.6-42% less memory than other scaling strategies.
tldr.zh: Chain-of-Experts 在每个 MoE 层内迭代，每次迭代用专属路由器在该层的专家中为 token 重新选择专家；在固定计算量下，它把数学验证损失从标准 MoE 的 1.20 降到 1.12，2x 迭代即可匹配 3x 专家选择数的效果，内存占用比其他扩展策略低 17.6-42%。

papers.title: Hierarchical Reasoning Model

tldr.en: HRM couples a slow high-level and a fast low-level recurrent module; with 27 million parameters and 1000 training samples, it nearly solves complex Sudoku and large mazes and beats larger models on ARC.
tldr.zh: HRM 把慢速的高层循环模块和快速的低层循环模块耦合在一起；只用 27M 参数和 1000 个训练样本，就在复杂 Sudoku 和大型迷宫上接近完美，并在 ARC 上超过更大的模型。

papers.title: Energy-Based Transformers are Scalable Learners and Thinkers

tldr.en: Energy-Based Transformers predict by gradient descent on a learned energy over input-prediction pairs; versus Transformer++, they show up to 35% higher training scaling rate and 29% more gain from System 2 Thinking on language tasks.
tldr.zh: Energy-Based Transformer 学习输入与候选预测之间的能量，通过对能量做梯度下降来给出预测；与 Transformer++ 相比，训练时的 scaling 速率最高高出 35%，在语言任务上 System 2 Thinking 带来的提升多 29%。

papers.title: Latent Chain-of-Thought? Decoding the Depth-Recurrent Transformer
papers.venue: COLM 2025 Workshop on the Application of LLM Explainability to Reasoning and Planning

tldr.en: Probing Huginn-3.5B with Logit Lens and Coda Lens on arithmetic finds little evidence of latent CoT and probing results that shift sharply across recurrent blocks; on GSM8K without CoT, 4 to 32 recurrent steps lift accuracy only from 3.11 to 4.93, far below 24.87/38.13 with explicit CoT.
tldr.zh: 用 Logit Lens 和 Coda Lens 在算术任务上探测 Huginn-3.5B，几乎找不到 latent CoT 的证据，且探测结果在不同循环块之间差异很大；在不用 CoT 的 GSM8K 上，循环步数从 4 增到 32 只让准确率从 3.11 升到 4.93，远低于显式 CoT 的 24.87/38.13。

papers.title: AbbIE: Autoregressive Block-Based Iterative Encoder for Efficient Sequence Modeling

tldr.en: AbbIE loops a middle Body of Transformer blocks between a Head and a Tail, carrying the input through the residual stream; trained with only 2 iterations, it upward generalizes to more test-time iterations, improving zero-shot in-context learning by up to 12% and perplexity by up to 5% at up to 350M parameters.
tldr.zh: AbbIE 在 Head 和 Tail 之间循环一个由 Transformer 块组成的 Body，并借助残差流携带输入；训练时只用 2 次迭代，测试时能向上泛化到更多迭代，在最大 350M 参数的模型上，zero-shot 上下文学习任务最多提升 12%，语言困惑度最多改善 5%。

papers.title: Mixture-of-Recursions: Learning Dynamic Recursive Depths for Adaptive Token-Level Computation

passes.train: 1-3 per token, set by the router (Nr=3)
passes.test: 1-3 per token, set by the router

note.en: Middle-Cycle sharing on a Llama-style model keeps the first and last layers unique and applies one shared block up to Nr times (360M base with Nr=3 uses 1+10+1 unique layers; Nr=2 uses 1+15+1). Routers decide how many recursions each token gets. Expert-choice keeps the top-k tokens at each step (3/3, 2/3 and 1/3 of the tokens for Nr=3), and only tokens kept at step r can be kept at r+1; token-choice assigns each token its depth once. The router score scales the block output that is added to the residual. Each step caches KV only for its active tokens and attends only among them; a variant reuses the first recursion's KV at every step.
note.zh: 在 Llama 式模型上用 Middle-Cycle 共享：首尾两层独立，中间一个共享块最多重复 Nr 次（360M 基座、Nr=3 时为 1+10+1 个独立层；Nr=2 为 1+15+1）。由路由器决定每个 token 递归几次。expert-choice 每步保留 top-k token（Nr=3 时依次为 3/3、2/3、1/3），只有第 r 步被保留的 token 才能在第 r+1 步再被选中；token-choice 一开始就给每个 token 定好深度。路由分数缩放共享块的输出，再加回残差。每一步只为仍在计算的 token 存 KV，注意力也只在这些 token 之间计算；另一种变体在每一步都复用第一遍的 KV。

baseline.en: Vanilla Llama-style Transformer (315M non-embedding parameters at the 360M base) and fixed-depth Recursive Transformers with the same Middle-Cycle sharing (Nr=2-4).
baseline.zh: Llama 式 vanilla Transformer（360M 基座，315M 非 embedding 参数），以及同样采用 Middle-Cycle 共享、固定深度的递归 Transformer（Nr=2-4）。

headline.en: At 16.5e18 training FLOPs, expert-choice MoR with Nr=2 reaches validation NLL 2.7511 and 43.1% average few-shot accuracy with 167M non-embedding parameters, against 2.7824 and 42.3% for the 315M vanilla model. At an equal 20B tokens it uses 25% fewer training FLOPs, 19% less training time and 25% less peak memory than vanilla.
headline.zh: 训练 FLOPs 同为 16.5e18 时，Nr=2 的 expert-choice MoR 用 167M 非 embedding 参数达到验证 NLL 2.7511、few-shot 平均准确率 43.1%，315M 的 vanilla 为 2.7824 和 42.3%。同为 20B token 时，它比 vanilla 少用 25% 训练 FLOPs、19% 训练时间和 25% 峰值显存。

results.setting: 360M base, FineWeb-Edu, 16.5e18 training FLOPs (tokens vary), Middle-Cycle sharing
360M base, FineWeb-Edu, 20B training tokens (FLOPs vary)
results.metric: training FLOPs (×1e18) / validation NLL / average few-shot accuracy

results.setting: Equal training FLOPs per row, Nr=3, expert-choice MoR with recursion-wise KV caching, FineWeb-Edu
118M unique non-embedding parameters, 10B tokens, Middle-Cycle MoR
Fixed-depth Recursive Transformers on the 360M base, Nr=3, 10B tokens; four parameter-sharing schemes

note.en: Cycle reuses the whole block in order [(0,1,2),(0,1,2),...]; Sequence repeats each layer back to back; the Middle variants keep the first and last layers unique.
note.zh: Cycle 按 [(0,1,2),(0,1,2),...] 的顺序重复整个块；Sequence 把每层连续重复；Middle 变体保留首尾两层独立。

findings.en: In Table 9, weight sharing alone (fixed-depth recursion) has higher validation NLL than vanilla at every size and budget. MoR has lower NLL than vanilla at 2e18 and 5e18 from the 360M base up, and at 16.5e18 only at the 1.7B base; at 135M it stays above vanilla.
findings.zh: Table 9 中，只做权重共享（固定深度递归）在所有规模和预算下验证 NLL 都高于 vanilla。MoR 从 360M 基座起在 2e18 和 5e18 预算下 NLL 低于 vanilla，16.5e18 预算下只有 1.7B 基座低于 vanilla；135M 时始终高于 vanilla。

findings.en: At the 1.7B base with 68.5e18 FLOPs, vanilla averages 48.9 few-shot accuracy against 48.4 for the best MoR (expert, Nr=2); the authors say this might signal that the current MoR design is not suitable for scaling.
findings.zh: 1.7B 基座、68.5e18 FLOPs 时，vanilla 的 few-shot 平均准确率为 48.9，最好的 MoR（expert，Nr=2）为 48.4；作者说这可能说明目前的 MoR 设计不适合扩展。

findings.en: With unique parameters fixed at 252M (730M base, Nr=3), Middle-Cycle with 1+8+1 layers (26 effective) beats Cycle with 10 layers (30 effective), with NLL 2.7552 vs 2.7573 and average accuracy 42.32 vs 41.90.
findings.zh: 唯一参数固定为 252M（730M 基座，Nr=3）时，1+8+1 层的 Middle-Cycle（26 个有效层）优于 10 层的 Cycle（30 个有效层），NLL 为 2.7552 对 2.7573，平均准确率为 42.32 对 41.90。

findings.en: At the 135M base, Cycle is slightly ahead of Middle-Cycle at Nr=2 (NLL 3.0071 vs 3.0330), while Middle-Cycle leads at Nr=3 and at the 360M base for both depths. In up-training from SmolLM checkpoints, both Middle strategies do better than the others in all settings.
findings.zh: 135M 基座、Nr=2 时 Cycle 略好于 Middle-Cycle（NLL 3.0071 对 3.0330）；Nr=3 时以及 360M 基座的两种深度下都是 Middle-Cycle 领先。从 SmolLM checkpoint 继续训练（up-training）时，两种 Middle 策略在所有设置下都优于其他策略。

findings.en: At Nr=3, expert-choice routing beats token-choice (42.6% vs 40.0% average accuracy in Table 3). In the 10B-token ablation, recursive KV sharing raises training NLL for expert-choice MoR (2.8667 to 2.8895) but lowers it for token-choice MoR (2.9358 to 2.9155).
findings.zh: Nr=3 时 expert-choice 路由优于 token-choice（Table 3 中平均准确率 42.6% 对 40.0%）。在 10B token 的消融中，recursive KV sharing 让 expert-choice MoR 的训练 NLL 升高（2.8667 到 2.8895），却让 token-choice MoR 的训练 NLL 降低（2.9358 到 2.9155）。

findings.en: With continuous depth-wise batching at the 360M scale, every MoR variant decodes faster than vanilla, and MoR-4 reaches up to a 2.06× speedup at the maximum batch size, with a slight drop in quality.
findings.zh: 在 360M 规模下用 continuous depth-wise batching 解码，所有 MoR 变体都比 vanilla 快，MoR-4 在最大 batch size 下最高提速 2.06×，质量略有下降。

findings.en: Log-likelihood improves as the maximum recursion depth at inference is raised step by step up to the trained Nr (models with Nr=2, 3 and 4 at the 360M base); no run goes beyond the trained Nr.
findings.zh: 推理时把最大递归深度逐步提高到训练时的 Nr，log-likelihood 随之提升（360M 基座，Nr=2、3、4 的模型）；没有实验超过训练时的 Nr。

tldr.en: Routers give each token its own number of passes through a shared middle block, and each pass caches KV only for its active tokens; at equal training FLOPs MoR beats fixed-depth recursive baselines and often vanilla, with fewer parameters.
tldr.zh: 路由器给每个 token 分配穿过共享中段的遍数，每一遍只为仍在计算的 token 存 KV；同等训练 FLOPs 下，MoR 优于固定深度的递归基线，也常优于 vanilla，且参数更少。

problem.en: Efficiency work usually targets either parameter sharing or adaptive computation. Recursive Transformers mostly apply one fixed depth to every token and keep a separate KV cache per depth, while early-exit methods need extra training stages and leave exited tokens without KV at deeper layers.
problem.zh: 提效工作通常只做参数共享或自适应计算之一。递归 Transformer 大多给所有 token 同样的固定深度，每个深度各存一份 KV；early-exit 方法需要额外的训练阶段，而且提前退出的 token 在更深的层没有 KV。

en: Middle-Cycle sharing keeps the first and last layers unique and cycles one shared block of middle layers up to Nr times.

Lightweight routers trained from scratch give each token its own recursion depth. Expert-choice picks the top-k tokens at every step with hierarchical filtering and adds an auxiliary BCE loss so the choice can be made causally at inference; token-choice assigns the depth once and uses a balancing loss.
Recursion-wise caching stores KV at each step only for the tokens routed there and restricts attention to them; recursive KV sharing instead reuses the first step's KV at every step.
Vanilla, fixed-depth recursive and MoR models (135M-1.7B base sizes, FineWeb-Edu, 2K context) are compared at equal training FLOPs (2e18, 5e18, 16.5e18) and at equal tokens (20B).
zh: Middle-Cycle 共享：首尾两层独立，中间层组成一个共享块，最多循环 Nr 次。
从头训练的轻量路由器给每个 token 分配递归深度。expert-choice 每步按层级过滤选出 top-k token，并加辅助 BCE loss，使推理时能按因果方式做选择；token-choice 一开始就定好深度，并用负载均衡 loss。
recursion-wise caching 在每一步只为被路由到该步的 token 存 KV，注意力也只在这些 token 之间计算；recursive KV sharing 则在每一步都复用第一步的 KV。
在相同训练 FLOPs（2e18、5e18、16.5e18）和相同 token（20B）下比较 vanilla、固定深度递归和 MoR 模型（基座 135M-1.7B，FineWeb-Edu，2K 上下文）。

en: Models go up to a 1.7B base (0.67B-0.87B unique non-embedding parameters for MoR) with 2K context, are trained only on FineWeb-Edu and are evaluated by NLL and six few-shot benchmarks; the authors leave models above 3B to future work (Section 7.1).
The main comparison fixes training FLOPs, not parameters or tokens; MoR has fewer unique parameters and sees more tokens (27B-31B against 20B in Table 3).
FLOPs are approximate forward-pass counts that leave out FlashAttention, normalization and non-linearities, and token-choice FLOPs assume perfect balancing (Appendix D).
At the 135M base, and at the 1.7B base with 68.5e18 FLOPs, vanilla beats MoR (Section 3.2; Appendix C.1).

Expert-choice top-k selection is non-causal during training; inference relies on an auxiliary loss to predict it, and the near-binary router outputs make top-k hard to change after training (Section 2.2.1; Section 7.1).
Throughput is measured only at the 360M scale, generating from an empty prefix, and excludes the time spent caching and updating KV (Appendix E).
Vanilla, recursive and MoR runs share one set of optimizer settings (learning rate 3e-3 in the released 360M configs); the paper reports no separate tuning.
zh: 模型最大到 1.7B 基座（MoR 的唯一非 embedding 参数为 0.67B-0.87B），2K 上下文，只用 FineWeb-Edu 训练，只评测 NLL 和六个 few-shot 基准；作者把 3B 以上的模型留作后续工作（Section 7.1）。
主要对比对齐了训练 FLOPs，没对齐参数和 token：MoR 唯一参数更少，看到的 token 更多（Table 3 中 27B-31B 对 20B）。
FLOPs 是近似的前向计算量，不含 FlashAttention、归一化和非线性运算，token-choice 的 FLOPs 按完美负载均衡估算（Appendix D）。
135M 基座时，以及 1.7B 基座、68.5e18 FLOPs 时，vanilla 都优于 MoR（Section 3.2；Appendix C.1）。
expert-choice 的 top-k 选择在训练时不满足因果性；推理时靠辅助 loss 来预测，而路由输出几乎是二值的，训练后很难再改 top-k（Section 2.2.1；Section 7.1）。
吞吐只在 360M 规模上测，从空前缀开始生成，不计缓存和更新 KV 的时间（Appendix E）。
vanilla、递归和 MoR 共用一套优化器设置（公开的 360M 配置里学习率都是 3e-3）；论文没有提到单独调参。

papers.glyph: first layer (1 layer) -> [shared block (10 layers)] x 1-3 per token, set by the router (Nr=3) -> last layer (1 layer); injection none; KV per-pass

papers.title: Deep Equilibrium Convolutional Sparse Coding for Hyperspectral Image Denoising

tldr.en: DECSC casts the proximal-gradient iterations of convolutional sparse coding, with an embedded Swin Transformer, as one weight-tied layer solved to a fixed point by Anderson acceleration; on 50 ICVL test HSIs with non-i.i.d. Gaussian noise of σ in [0, 95], its 45.64 PSNR is the best among compared methods.
tldr.zh: DECSC 把卷积稀疏编码模型的近端梯度迭代（内嵌 Swin Transformer）写成一个权重共享层，用 Anderson 加速求解其不动点；在 ICVL 的 50 幅测试高光谱图像上，面对 σ 取 [0, 95] 的非独立同分布高斯噪声，PSNR 达到 45.64，为对比方法中最高。

papers.title: Beyond Memorization: Extending Reasoning Depth with Recurrence, Memory and Test-Time Compute Scaling

tldr.en: On a 1D cellular-automata benchmark with disjoint train and test rules, 4-layer Transformers, LSTMs and SSMs fail as more reasoning steps are needed; Adaptive Computation Time, repeating layers until a learned halt, adds roughly +1 depth of state prediction without new parameters, while GRPO and CoT go further.
tldr.zh: 在训练与测试规则互不重叠的一维元胞自动机基准上，4 层 Transformer、LSTM 和 SSM 在所需推理步数增加时失效；Adaptive Computation Time 重复执行层直到学到的停止信号触发，在不增加参数的情况下把状态预测深度提高约 +1 步，GRPO 和 CoT 则能推得更远。

papers.title: PonderLM-2: Pretraining LLM with Latent Thoughts in Continuous Space

tldr.en: PonderLM-2 feeds each position's last hidden state back into the same model as a latent thought, with the same positional encoding, to predict the next token; at identical inference cost, PonderLM-2-Pythia-1.4B pretrained on 300B Pile tokens surpasses vanilla Pythia-2.8B trained on the same data.
tldr.zh: PonderLM-2 把当前位置的最后隐藏状态作为潜在思维、以相同的位置编码送回同一个模型来预测下一个 token；在相同推理成本下，用 Pile 的 300B token 预训练的 PonderLM-2-Pythia-1.4B 超过用相同数据训练的 vanilla Pythia-2.8B。

papers.title: Two-Scale Latent Dynamics for Recurrent-Depth Transformers

tldr.en: In looped blocks of a recurrent-depth Transformer, steps grow smaller and more orthogonal over training while states drift more across blocks; exiting on the second-order difference in step size beats Geiping et al.'s KL-divergence exit and a first-order rule in performance, stability and time-efficiency.
tldr.zh: 在循环深度 Transformer 的循环块内，随着训练进行，每步更新越来越小且彼此越来越正交，而跨块时状态漂移更大；基于步长二阶差分的退出规则在性能、稳定性和时间效率上优于 Geiping 等人的 KL 散度退出和一阶规则。

papers.title: A Formal Comparison Between Chain of Thought and Latent Thought

tldr.en: Formally compares looped Transformers (latent thought) with chain of thought: latent thought admits more efficient parallel computation than inherently sequential CoT, while CoT's stochastic decoding enables approximate counting and sampling, indicating which tasks suit depth-driven recursion.
tldr.zh: 形式化比较循环 Transformer 中的 latent thought 与思维链：latent thought 比本质上串行的 CoT 更能高效并行计算，而 CoT 借助随机解码可以做近似计数和采样，由此指出哪些任务更适合深度递归。

papers.title: Less is More: Recursive Reasoning with Tiny Networks

tldr.en: TRM, a single 2-layer network that recursively refines a latent state and an answer, generalizes better than HRM on puzzles; with 7M parameters it reaches 45% on ARC-AGI-1 and 8% on ARC-AGI-2.
tldr.zh: TRM 只用一个 2 层小网络递归地更新潜在状态和答案，在谜题任务上比 HRM 泛化更好；7M 参数在 ARC-AGI-1 上达到 45%，在 ARC-AGI-2 上达到 8%。

papers.title: Encode, Think, Decode: Scaling test-time reasoning with recursive latent thoughts

tldr.en: Encode-Think-Decode (ETD) mid-trains OLMo-2 1B Base to iterate a 4-layer block of reasoning-relevant layers between 7 encoder and 5 decoder layers, adding no parameters or data; it gains on 17 reasoning benchmarks, including +28.4% relative accuracy on GSM8K and +36% on MATH.
tldr.zh: Encode-Think-Decode（ETD）在 mid-training 阶段训练 OLMo-2 1B Base 循环一个位于 7 层编码器和 5 层解码器之间、与推理相关的 4 层块，不增加参数和数据；它在 17 个推理基准上带来提升，其中 GSM8K 相对准确率提高 +28.4%，MATH 提高 +36%。

papers.title: MeSH: Memory-as-State-Highways for Recursive Transformers

tldr.en: MeSH gives recursive Transformers an explicit memory buffer and lightweight routers that vary computation across iterations; on Pythia (160M-6.9B) it beats recursive baselines, and at 1.4B it tops the larger non-recursive model by +1.06% average downstream accuracy with 33% fewer non-embedding parameters.
tldr.zh: MeSH 把循环 Transformer 的状态管理外置到显式记忆缓冲区，并用轻量路由器让各次迭代的计算有所区分；在 Pythia（160M-6.9B）上它稳定优于循环基线，在 1.4B 规模上以少 33% 的非 embedding 参数超过更大的非循环模型，平均下游准确率提高 +1.06%。

papers.title: What Makes Looped Transformers Perform Better Than Non-Recursive Ones

tldr.en: The paper attributes the advantage of looped Transformers (Looped-Attn) over non-recursive ones to a conjectured landscape-level bias toward steep River-V-Valleys, and proposes SHIFT, which trains Single-Attn first and then switches to Looped-Attn to accelerate training with comparable performance.
tldr.zh: 该文把循环 Transformer（Looped-Attn）优于非循环 Transformer 的原因归结为一种推测的损失地形偏置，即偏向陡峭的 River-V-Valley；并提出 SHIFT，先训练 Single-Attn 再切换到 Looped-Attn，在性能相当的情况下加快训练。

papers.title: DND: Boosting Large Language Models with Dynamic Nested Depth

tldr.en: DND adds a router at the end of each intermediate layer of a pretrained LLM; tokens it selects pass through the same layer again and the result is fused with the first-pass output; integrated in post-training, it boosts dense Qwen3-1.7B by 1.88% and MoE Qwen3-30B-A3B by 0.87%.
tldr.zh: DND 在预训练 LLM 每个中间层的末尾加入路由器，被选中的 token 再经同一层处理一遍，结果与第一遍输出融合；在后训练阶段接入后，稠密模型 Qwen3-1.7B 提升 1.88%，MoE 模型 Qwen3-30B-A3B 提升 0.87%。

papers.title: Dr.LLM: Dynamic Layer Routing in LLMs

tldr.en: Dr.LLM equips a frozen pretrained LLM with lightweight per-layer routers that skip, execute, or repeat each block, trained on MCTS-derived layer configurations; on ARC and DART it improves accuracy by up to +3.4%p while saving 5 layers per example on average.
tldr.zh: Dr.LLM 为冻结的预训练 LLM 的每一层配备轻量路由器，决定跳过、执行还是重复该块，路由器用 MCTS 搜得的层配置训练；在 ARC 和 DART 上，它把准确率最多提高 +3.4%p，同时平均每个样本少执行 5 层。

papers.title: On the Reasoning Abilities of Masked Diffusion Language Models

tldr.en: Proves that in the finite-precision log-width setting masked diffusion language models are equivalent to polynomially-padded looped transformers, which repeat a middle block of layers; MDMs can also solve all problems CoT transformers can and are more efficient on some classes, including regular languages.
tldr.zh: 证明在有限精度、对数宽度设定下，掩码扩散语言模型（MDM）与重复中间层块的多项式填充循环 Transformer 等价；MDM 还能解决 CoT Transformer 可解的所有问题，并在包括正则语言在内的某些问题类上效率更高。

papers.title: Efficient Parallel Samplers for Recurrent-Depth Models and Their Connection to Diffusion Language Models

tldr.en: A diffusion forcing sampler for recurrent-depth models decodes new tokens at every forward pass and keeps refining their latent states in parallel through the recurrence; applied to an existing 3.5B recurrent-depth Transformer without any tuning, it gives up to a 5x speedup.
tldr.zh: 为循环深度模型设计的 diffusion forcing 采样器在每次前向时都解码新 token，并通过循环并行地继续细化这些 token 的潜状态；无需任何调参直接用于现有的 3.5B 循环深度 Transformer，最高带来 5x 加速。

papers.title: ReXMoE: Reusing Experts with Minimal Overhead in Mixture-of-Experts

tldr.en: ReXMoE lets each MoE router pick experts from a group of adjacent layers, so one expert can be reused at several depths, and grows the candidate pool during training; on MoE-2.3BA0.3B, the 4-layer-group ReXMoE raises average downstream accuracy from 49.15% to 50.23%.
tldr.zh: ReXMoE 让每层的 MoE 路由器从相邻多层组成的专家池中选择专家，使同一专家可在多个深度复用，并在训练中逐步扩大候选池；在 MoE-2.3BA0.3B 上，以 4 层为一组复用专家的 ReXMoE 把下游平均准确率从 49.15% 提高到 50.23%。

papers.title: ScaleNet: Scaling up Pretrained Neural Networks with Incremental Parameters

tldr.en: ScaleNet deepens pretrained ViTs by inserting layers that share parameter tensors with corresponding pretrained layers, plus small parallel adapters per layer; a 2× depth-scaled DeiT-Base gains 7.42% accuracy over training from scratch on ImageNet-1K with only one-third of the training epochs.
tldr.zh: ScaleNet 向预训练 ViT 插入新层，每个新层与对应的预训练层共享参数张量，并为每层加入少量并行 adapter 参数；在 ImageNet-1K 上，深度扩展 2× 的 DeiT-Base 比从头训练准确率高 7.42%，且只需三分之一的训练轮数。

papers.title: Parallel Loop Transformer for Efficient Test-Time Computation Scaling

note.en: Each loop runs the whole stack with tied weights. Before every non-first loop, the previous loop's last-layer states are shifted right by one token and added to the token embeddings, so at decoding time loop l of token i runs in the same forward pass as loop l+1 of token i-1. Non-first loops attend globally to the first loop's KV and locally to their own KV through SWA (w=64), mixed by a head-wise sigmoid gate. The in-house Seed-MoE layer count is not disclosed; the open-source OLMo/OLMoE runs use 16 layers (Appendix A.2.1).
note.zh: 每一遍都跑整个模型，权重共享。每个非首遍之前，把上一遍最后一层的输出右移一个 token，再加上 token embedding，所以解码时 token i 的第 l 遍和 token i-1 的第 l+1 遍在同一次前向里执行。非首遍对首遍的 KV 做全局注意力，对自己的 KV 做窗口 w=64 的 SWA，两者用按 head 的 sigmoid 门控混合。内部 Seed-MoE 的层数未公开；开源 OLMo/OLMoE 实验用 16 层（Appendix A.2.1）。

baseline.en: Unlooped in-house Seed-MoE 680M/13B and the same model looped twice without CLP; CLP, KV sharing and G-SWA are then added one at a time.
baseline.zh: 不循环的内部 Seed-MoE 680M/13B，以及不带 CLP、直接循环两遍的同一模型；之后把 CLP、KV 共享和 G-SWA 逐个加上去对比。

headline.en: On a 680M/13B MoE trained on 150B tokens, PLT-2 reaches the vanilla two-loop model's average accuracy of 39.7 (34.7 without loops) at 4.9 ms decoding latency and 284M KV cache (batch size 4), against 9.4 ms and 560M for the vanilla two-loop model and 4.8 ms and 280M for the unlooped model.
headline.zh: 在 150B token 训练的 680M/13B MoE 上，PLT-2 的平均精度与普通两遍循环模型相同，都是 39.7（不循环为 34.7）； batch size 4 时 PLT-2 解码延迟 4.9 ms、KV 284M，普通两遍循环是 9.4 ms、560M，不循环模型是 4.8 ms、280M。

results.setting: In-house Seed-MoE, 680M activated / 13B total, 150B tokens; latency and KV cache at batch size 4
results.metric: Avg. accuracy / decoding latency (ms) / KV cache

note.en: The Section 3.1.2 text gives PLT-3's latency as 4.8→4.9 ms; Table 2 prints 5.0 ms.
note.zh: Section 3.1.2 正文写 PLT-3 的延迟是 4.8→4.9 ms，Table 2 印的是 5.0 ms。

results.setting: Same models as Table 2; FP8 attention, W4A8 linear layers, 5000-token prefill, one GPU, mean of five runs that each decode 256 tokens
results.metric: per-token decoding latency in ms (ratio to Seed-MoE), bs=4 / bs=64

results.setting: In-house MoE, baseline trained on 1T tokens; PLT-2 uses two-thirds of the baseline's layers

note.en: Section 3.2 reports about 30% lower decoding latency for PLT-2 across batch sizes 4 to 64 (Figure 5) and a KV cache roughly two-thirds of the baseline's.
note.zh: Section 3.2 称 PLT-2 在 batch size 4 到 64 下解码延迟约低 30%（Figure 5），KV 约为基线的三分之二。

results.setting: OLMo-based 1.2B dense and OLMoE-based 1B/7B MoE, 16 layers, 400B tokens, L=2
OLMo-based dense ablation (hidden 1536, GQA with 16 query and 4 KV heads), 100B tokens, latency on one H800
results.metric: Loss / Avg. accuracy / latency in ms at bs=1 / at bs=16

findings.en: Adding CLP to the two-loop model leaves average accuracy nearly unchanged (39.7 to 39.6) and cuts decoding latency from 9.4 ms to 5.9 ms, while the KV cache stays at 560M.
findings.zh: 两遍循环模型加上 CLP 后，平均精度基本不变（39.7 到 39.6），解码延迟从 9.4 ms 降到 5.9 ms，KV 仍是 560M。

findings.en: Sharing the first loop's KV halves the KV cache (560M to 280M) but lowers average accuracy from 39.6 to 36.2; adding G-SWA with a 64-token window brings it back to 39.7 at 284M.
findings.zh: 共享首遍 KV 让 KV 减半（560M 到 280M），但平均精度从 39.6 降到 36.2；再加窗口 64 的 G-SWA，精度回到 39.7，KV 为 284M。

findings.en: With the same parameters, three loops beat two, with average accuracy 40.8 for PLT-3 against 39.7 for PLT-2; Table 2 lists 5.0 vs 4.9 ms latency and 287M vs 284M KV.
findings.zh: 参数相同时三遍好于两遍，PLT-3 平均精度 40.8，PLT-2 为 39.7；Table 2 中两者延迟为 5.0 和 4.9 ms，KV 为 287M 和 284M。

findings.en: At batch sizes 32 and 64, PLT-2 cuts per-token decoding latency by 47% relative to the vanilla two-loop model and runs at 1.06× and 1.04× the latency of the unlooped model.
findings.zh: batch size 为 32 和 64 时，PLT-2 的每 token 解码延迟比普通两遍循环低 47%，分别是不循环模型的 1.06 倍和 1.04 倍。

findings.en: A PLT-2 with two-thirds of the baseline's layers (1.7B/40B) averages 62.6 against 62.1 for the 2.5B/60B Seed-MoE, with about 30% lower decoding latency.
findings.zh: 层数为基线三分之二的 PLT-2（1.7B/40B）平均 62.6，2.5B/60B 的 Seed-MoE 为 62.1，PLT-2 解码延迟约低 30%。

tldr.en: Run loop l of token i in the same forward pass as loop l+1 of token i-1, let later loops reuse the first loop's KV plus a gated SWA, and a looped model decodes at close to unlooped latency and KV.
tldr.zh: 让 token i 的第 l 遍和 token i-1 的第 l+1 遍在同一次前向里执行，后续遍复用首遍 KV 并加门控 SWA，循环模型的解码延迟和 KV 接近不循环模型。

problem.en: In a vanilla looped Transformer the loops run one after another, so per-token compute, decoding latency and KV cache all grow linearly with the number of loops.
problem.zh: 普通循环 Transformer 的各遍依次串行执行，每 token 计算、解码延迟和 KV 都随遍数线性增长。

en: Cross-loop parallelism (CLP) shifts the previous loop's last-layer states right by one token and adds the embeddings before each non-first loop, so loop l of token i, loop l+1 of token i-1 and so on are decoded as one micro-batch in a single forward pass.
Non-first loops keep their own queries but attend globally to the first loop's KV, so only one global KV cache is stored.

Gated SWA (G-SWA) lets non-first loops also attend to their own KV within a 64-token window and mixes local and global outputs through a head-wise sigmoid gate; these loops cache only the most recent w KV entries.
zh: 跨遍并行（CLP）在每个非首遍之前把上一遍最后一层的输出右移一个 token 再加上 embedding，解码时 token i 的第 l 遍、token i-1 的第 l+1 遍等组成一个 micro-batch，在一次前向里算完。
非首遍保留自己的 query，但对首遍的 KV 做全局注意力，所以只需存一份全局 KV。
门控 SWA（G-SWA）让非首遍再在 64 token 的窗口内看自己的 KV，局部和全局输出用按 head 的 sigmoid 门控混合；这些遍只缓存最近 w 个 KV。

en: The main results use in-house Seed-MoE models whose data and other training details are withheld; the open-source OLMo/OLMoE runs (1.2B dense and 1B/7B MoE at 400B tokens, plus a 100B-token dense ablation) test only L=2.
Each model is trained and evaluated at one fixed loop count (L=2 or 3); the paper does not report running a different number of loops at inference.

Parameters and training tokens are matched but compute is not; an L-loop PLT spends L times the per-token compute of the baseline (Table 1), and its latency advantage rests on decoding being memory-bound.
CLP parallelizes decoding only; training stays serial along the loop dimension (Figure 4).
Latency is per-token decoding latency on one GPU with FP8 attention, W4A8 linear layers and a 5000-token prefill; the latency and KV columns of Table 2 are at batch size 4.
Hyperparameters of the in-house runs are not given, so the paper does not say whether the baseline was tuned separately.
zh: 主要结果来自内部 Seed-MoE 模型，数据和其他训练细节未公开；开源的 OLMo/OLMoE 实验（400B token 的 1.2B dense 和 1B/7B MoE，以及 100B token 的 dense 消融）只测了 L=2。
每个模型训练和评测都用同一个固定遍数（L=2 或 3）；论文没有报告推理时换用其他遍数。
对齐了参数和训练 token，没对齐算力；L 遍的 PLT 每 token 计算是基线的 L 倍（Table 1），延迟优势依赖解码受显存带宽限制。
CLP 只让解码并行；训练在遍数维度上仍是串行（Figure 4）。
