延迟是单卡上的每 token 解码延迟，attention 用 FP8、线性层用 W4A8，prefill 长度 5000；Table 2 的延迟和 KV 列是 batch size 4 下的值。
内部实验的超参没有给出，论文没说基线是否单独调过。

papers.glyph: [all layers, every loop (100% of layers)] x 2 or 3 (PLT-2 / PLT-3); injection additive; KV first-pass

papers.title: Scaling Latent Reasoning via Looped Language Models

passes.test: 4 by default; the exit gate can stop earlier

note.en: The whole decoder stack loops: Ouro 1.4B repeats its 24 layers and Ouro 2.6B its 48 layers, which were upcycled from the 24 layers by layer duplication; embedding and LM head sit outside the loop. The embedding enters only before the first step, and each step takes the previous step's output. After every step an LM head and an exit gate read the hidden state. Training always runs T_max steps and weights each step's loss by the learned exit distribution. Each step keeps its own KV cache.
note.zh: 整个 decoder 层栈循环：Ouro 1.4B 重复全部 24 层，Ouro 2.6B 重复 48 层（由这 24 层复制 upcycle 而来）；embedding 和 LM head 在循环外。embedding 只在第一步之前输入，之后每一步接上一步的输出。每一步之后由 LM head 和退出门读取隐状态。训练时总是跑满 T_max 步，按学到的退出分布给各步 loss 加权。每一步各存一份 KV。

baseline.en: Public dense base models run through the same evaluation pipeline (Gemma3, Llama3.1/3.2, Qwen2.5 and Qwen3, 1B to 12B); the Thinking models are compared with Qwen3 and DeepSeek-Distill-Qwen.
baseline.zh: 用同一评测流程测试的公开 dense 基座模型（Gemma3、Llama3.1/3.2、Qwen2.5、Qwen3，1B 到 12B）；Thinking 模型对比 Qwen3 和 DeepSeek-Distill-Qwen。

headline.en: Ouro 1.4B R4 (7.7T tokens) matches or beats the 4B Qwen3-Base (36T tokens) on BBH (71.02 vs 70.95), GSM8K (78.92 vs 72.86) and MATH500 (82.40 vs 59.60); Ouro 2.6B R4 scores 55.73 on MMLU-Pro, 80.46 on BBH and 90.85 on MATH500, against 53.72, 77.65 and 62.30 for the 8B Qwen3-Base.
headline.zh: Ouro 1.4B R4（7.7T token）在 BBH（71.02 对 70.95）、GSM8K（78.92 对 72.86）和 MATH500（82.40 对 59.60）上持平或超过 4B 的 Qwen3-Base（36T token）；Ouro 2.6B R4 的 MMLU-Pro、BBH、MATH500 分别为 55.73、80.46、90.85，8B 的 Qwen3-Base 为 53.72、77.65、62.30。

results.setting: Base models; Ouro runs 4 recurrent steps (R4); all models use the same evaluation pipeline (Appendix C.1)
Base models; Ouro runs 4 recurrent steps (R4)
Ouro base models trained with 4 steps, evaluated at T=1-8 (T=5-8 is extrapolation)
Ouro-Thinking models trained with 4 steps, evaluated at T=1-8
Ouro 1.4B, KV cache reuse during decoding only; prefill keeps all four caches

note.en: The paper does not name the model size in Table 14; the project page labels the same table Ouro-1.4B.
note.zh: 论文 Table 14 没写模型规模；项目页把同一张表标为 Ouro-1.4B。

results.setting: Mano task (modular arithmetic answered without intermediate steps); k⊗n is k layers looped n times, and 12⊗1 is the iso-FLOP baseline
results.metric: exact-match accuracy at maximum expression length L=10 / 16 / 24

note.en: Each setting reports the best of 3 random seeds (Appendix B.2).
note.zh: 每个设置报告 3 个随机种子中最好的结果（Appendix B.2）。

findings.en: Training with 8 recurrent steps in Stage 1a led to loss spikes and gradient oscillations, so the authors cut to 4 steps from Stage 1b on.
findings.zh: Stage 1a 用 8 个循环步训练时出现 loss 尖峰和梯度震荡，作者从 Stage 1b 起改为 4 步。

findings.en: The trained depth is not always best for the Thinking models. The 1.4B model scores higher at T=5 than at T=4 on OlympiadBench (72.30 vs 71.55) and SuperGPQA (48.73 vs 47.37), and the 2.6B model peaks at T=3 on AIME 2024 (70.33, against 64.70 at T=4).
findings.zh: Thinking 模型并不总在训练深度上最好：1.4B 在 OlympiadBench（72.30 对 71.55）和 SuperGPQA（48.73 对 47.37）上 T=5 高于 T=4；2.6B 在 AIME 2024 上 T=3 最高（70.33，T=4 为 64.70）。

findings.en: Safety on HEx-PHI improves as the number of recurrent steps grows (tested 1-8), including the extrapolated steps 5-8. At 4 steps the harmful rate is 0.009 for Ouro 1.4B Thinking and 0.003 for Ouro 2.6B Thinking (Qwen3-4B-Thinking 0.009).
findings.zh: HEx-PHI 上的安全性随循环步数增加而改善（测了 1-8 步），外推的第 5-8 步也是如此。4 步时 Ouro 1.4B Thinking 和 2.6B Thinking 的有害率分别为 0.009 和 0.003（Qwen3-4B-Thinking 为 0.009）。

findings.en: On MMLU, the gate with Stage II exit training reaches 66% accuracy at an average of 2.5 exit rounds, against about 64% for the gate from pre-training alone; fixed-depth exit gives 40% at 1 round and 67.35% at 4.
findings.zh: 在 MMLU 上，经过 Stage II 退出训练的门在平均 2.5 步退出时准确率为 66%，只经过预训练的门约为 64%；固定深度退出在 1 步时为 40%，4 步时为 67.35%。

findings.en: Reusing KV caches during prefill costs more than 10 points on GSM8K, so all four steps keep their own KV during prefill.
findings.zh: prefill 阶段复用 KV 会让 GSM8K 下降 10 分以上，所以 prefill 时四步都各存 KV。

findings.en: On the synthetic Capo task, looped (4 steps) and non-looped models with the same parameter count both store about 2 bits of knowledge per parameter.
findings.zh: 在合成的 Capo 任务上，参数量相同的循环模型（4 步）和不循环模型都存下约 2 bit/参数的知识。

findings.en: In 20B-token FineWeb-Edu runs at 53M-1.36B, a Standard model with unshared layers and the same executed depth scores higher than LoopLM in every case, and the gap grows with the step count (in Table 18 the 1.3B gap is 0.017 at 2 steps and 0.025 at 4).
findings.zh: 在 53M-1.36B、20B token FineWeb-Edu 的实验中，执行层数相同但各层不共享的 Standard 模型在所有设置下都高于 LoopLM，差距随步数增大（Table 18 中 1.3B 的差距在 2 步时为 0.017，4 步时为 0.025）。

tldr.en: Pre-train a weight-tied layer stack that repeats 4 times, with a learned exit gate, on 7.7T tokens; the authors report that the 1.4B and 2.6B models match dense models of up to 12B parameters.
tldr.zh: 在 7.7T token 上预训练共享权重、重复 4 遍的层栈，并学习退出门；作者称 1.4B 和 2.6B 模型可比肩最大 12B 参数的 dense 模型。

problem.en: LLMs mostly learn to reason through explicit chain-of-thought added after pre-training. The paper asks whether looping shared layers in latent space, built into pre-training at multi-trillion-token scale, scales better than non-recursive Transformers.
problem.zh: LLM 主要靠预训练之后加入的显式 CoT 来推理。论文研究把共享层的隐空间循环放进数万亿 token 规模的预训练，是否比不循环的 Transformer 扩展得更好。

en: Repeat the whole decoder stack (24 layers for 1.4B, 48 for 2.6B) with shared weights; after every step an LM head computes a loss and an exit gate predicts the probability of stopping.
Stage I minimizes the per-step losses weighted by the gate's exit distribution minus an entropy bonus, which equals a KL term toward a uniform prior over exit steps up to a constant.

Stage II freezes the LM and trains only the gate to continue while the next step still lowers the loss by more than a threshold; at inference the model exits at the first step whose cumulative exit probability reaches q.
Pre-train on 7.7T tokens in four stages (8 steps in Stage 1a, then 4; the 2.6B model is upcycled from the 24-layer model), then run reasoning SFT on about 8.3M examples for the Thinking models.
zh: 整个 decoder 层栈共享权重重复执行（1.4B 为 24 层，2.6B 为 48 层）；每一步之后 LM head 计算 loss，退出门预测停止的概率。
Stage I 最小化按退出分布加权的各步 loss 再减去熵奖励，除一个常数外等价于朝均匀先验的 KL 项。
Stage II 冻结 LM，只训练退出门：下一步还能让 loss 下降超过阈值就继续；推理时在累计退出概率首次达到 q 的那一步退出。
分四个阶段预训练 7.7T token（Stage 1a 用 8 步，之后用 4 步；2.6B 由 24 层模型 upcycle 而来），再用约 8.3M 条数据做推理 SFT 得到 Thinking 模型。

en: The headline comparisons (Tables 7-9) are against separately trained public models that differ in parameters and training tokens (2T-36T); no budget is matched, and Ouro runs its stack 4 times per token.
The models are trained at 4 steps; base benchmark scores are strongest around T=4 and degrade moderately at T=5-8, and the Thinking models degrade at T=6-8 (Tables 10-13).
By default every step keeps its own KV cache (4× memory at 4 steps); last-step-only reuse was tested for decoding only, because prefill needs all four caches (Section 5.4.2).
Reasoning results come from an in-house harness with an LLM judge and temperature 1.0, top_p 0.7 for every model (Section 5.2; Table 17).

Controlled looped-versus-unlooped studies are small; they use synthetic tasks (Capo with 1M-40M GPT-2-style models, Mano, multi-hop QA) and 53M-1.36B models trained on 20B FineWeb-Edu tokens (Section 6; Appendix D).
The authors did not run exhaustive learning-rate sweeps (Section 4.3), and RLVR with DAPO and GRPO did not improve on the SFT checkpoint (Section 4.5).
zh: 主要对比（Tables 7-9）是与独立训练的公开模型比，参数量和训练 token（2T-36T）都不同，没有对齐任何预算；Ouro 每个 token 要把层栈跑 4 遍。
模型按 4 步训练；基座模型的 benchmark 分数在 T=4 附近最好，T=5-8 小幅下降，Thinking 模型在 T=6-8 下降（Tables 10-13）。
默认每一步各存一份 KV（4 步即 4× 显存）；只存末步 KV 的做法只在 decoding 测过，因为 prefill 需要全部四份 KV（Section 5.4.2）。
推理类结果来自内部评测框架，用 LLM 评判，所有模型都用 temperature 1.0、top_p 0.7（Section 5.2；Table 17）。
循环与不循环的受控对比规模都很小：合成任务（Capo 用 1M-40M 的 GPT-2 式模型，Mano，多跳问答）以及在 20B FineWeb-Edu token 上训练的 53M-1.36B 模型（Section 6；Appendix D）。
作者没有做全面的学习率搜索（Section 4.3）；用 DAPO 和 GRPO 做 RLVR 也没有超过 SFT checkpoint（Section 4.5）。

papers.title: Teaching Pretrained Language Models to Think Deeper with Retrofitted Recurrence
orgs: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems

note.en: Shown is TinyLlama (4,8,4); labels are layer indices in the 22-layer TinyLlama-1.1B-3T parent, whose layers 4-9 are dropped. OLMo-2-0425-1B and Llama-3.2-1B use (4,6,4) with layers L0-3, L6-11 and L12-15, dropping L4-5. Sections 4.1-4.2 use a (2,4,2) model built from Llama-3.2-1B. The recurrence count is sampled from a Poisson-Lognormal distribution whose mean follows the curriculum, so depth is both sampled and scheduled.
note.zh: 图示为 TinyLlama (4,8,4)；标签是 22 层父模型 TinyLlama-1.1B-3T 中的层号，第 4-9 层被删掉。OLMo-2-0425-1B 和 Llama-3.2-1B 用 (4,6,4)，取 L0-3、L6-11、L12-15，删掉 L4-5。Section 4.1-4.2 用的是由 Llama-3.2-1B 构造的 (2,4,2)。递归次数从 Poisson-Lognormal 分布采样，分布均值按课程变化，所以深度既是采样的，也按计划递增。

baseline.en: The parent model (TinyLlama, OLMo or Llama) post-trained without recurrence on the same data in the same order. Figures 5-7 compare accuracy against training FLOPs and at the final checkpoint.
baseline.zh: 父模型（TinyLlama、OLMo 或 Llama）不加循环，用相同数据、按相同顺序继续训练。Figure 5-7 按训练 FLOPs 和最终 checkpoint 比较准确率。

headline.en: Converting a pretrained model to a recurrent one gives better math accuracy at a given training compute budget than post-training the non-recurrent model. After the same ~50B math tokens, OLMo (4,6,4) at train and test recurrence 32 scores 51.6 on GSM8K and 29.3 on MATH, against 35.3 and 25.1 for the post-trained non-recurrent OLMo.
headline.zh: 把预训练模型改造成循环模型，在给定训练算力下数学准确率高于直接继续训练非循环模型。用同样约 50B 的数学 token 训练后，训练和测试递归次数都为 32 的 OLMo (4,6,4) 在 GSM8K 和 MATH 上为 51.6 和 29.3，继续训练的非循环 OLMo 为 35.3 和 25.1。

results.setting: TinyLlama-1.1B-3T converted to (4,8,4), about 50B tokens of Nemotron-CC-Math-v1-4plus, test recurrence 32
OLMo-2-0425-1B converted to (4,6,4), same data, test recurrence 32
Llama-3.2-1B converted to (4,6,4), same data, test recurrence 32
TinyLlama (4,8,4) at train recurrence 4. Single phase is 26B tokens of FineWeb-Edu mixed with Nemotron SFT data; two phase first trains on 26B tokens of FineWeb-Edu (52B in total)
(2,4,2) model, about 120B tokens of FineWeb-Edu, mean recurrence 32, zero-shot

findings.en: Linearly ramping the mean recurrence up to 32 slightly lowers validation loss per step and greatly lowers it per training FLOP ((2,4,2) from Llama, 48 hours on 4 MI300A GPUs, about 1e20 FLOPs).
findings.zh: 把平均递归次数线性升到 32，按 step 看验证 loss 略低，按训练 FLOPs 看低很多（Llama 初始化的 (2,4,2)，4 张 MI300A 跑 48 小时，约 1e20 FLOPs）。

findings.en: On GSM8K, larger training recurrences give a larger gain per training FLOP for OLMo and Llama, but not for TinyLlama.
findings.zh: 在 GSM8K 上，OLMo 和 Llama 的训练递归次数越大，每单位训练 FLOP 的提升越大；TinyLlama 不符合这一趋势。

findings.en: A 26B-token FineWeb-Edu healing phase before the mixed data raises the recurrent model's Arc-C by 5% over single-phase training, while the non-recurrent model changes little.
findings.zh: 在混合数据之前先用 26B token 的 FineWeb-Edu 做 healing，循环模型的 Arc-C 比单阶段训练高 5%，非循环模型变化不大。

findings.en: Among the tested layer choices for a (2,4,2) model from Llama-1b, taking early layers for the prelude and later layers for the core and coda gave the lowest training loss; on TinyLlama (4,8,4) this choice also reached lower loss than layers picked with ShortGPT.
findings.zh: 在从 Llama-1b 构造 (2,4,2) 的几种选层方式中，prelude 取前面的层、核心块和 coda 取后面的层，训练 loss 最低；在 TinyLlama (4,8,4) 上，这种选法的 loss 也低于用 ShortGPT 选出的层。

findings.en: Muon trains the recurrent models more stably than AdamW, whose loss spiked to NaN at learning rate 5e-5; for the non-recurrent TinyLlama the gap is much smaller, with a small gain for Muon.
findings.zh: Muon 训练循环模型比 AdamW 稳定，AdamW（学习率 5e-5）的 loss 出现尖峰并变成 NaN；对非循环的 TinyLlama，两者差距小得多，Muon 略好。

tldr.en: Turn pretrained 1B models into prelude-core-coda recurrent models by dropping middle layers and looping a block, then keep training while a curriculum raises the mean recurrence.
tldr.zh: 从预训练 1B 模型中删掉中间几层、把一段层改为循环块，得到 prelude-core-coda 循环模型，再继续训练，并按课程逐步提高平均递归次数。

problem.en: Pretraining a depth-recurrent model from scratch is costly. Huginn-0125 used 800B tokens, and running many recurrences per step slows training compared with a fixed-depth model of the same parameter count. The paper studies how to convert existing pretrained non-recurrent models into recurrent ones efficiently.
problem.zh: 从头预训练深度循环模型代价高。Huginn-0125 用了 800B token，每步多次递归也让训练比同参数量的固定深度模型慢。本文研究如何高效地把现有的非循环预训练模型改造成循环模型。

en: Take a pretrained model's early layers as the prelude and later layers as the recurrent core and coda, dropping the layers in between, e.g. (4,8,4) from TinyLlama-1.1B-3T and (4,6,4) from OLMo-2-0425-1B and Llama-3.2-1B.

Keep Huginn-0125's recurrence, with a linear adapter on concat(prelude output, state), a random initial state, a Poisson-Lognormal recurrence count and gradients through at most the last 8 core passes.
Raise the mean of the recurrence distribution with a curriculum (1-sqrt over the first 75% of training in the main runs) to 4, 8, 16 or 32, and optimize with Muon.
Train on about 50B tokens of Nemotron-CC-Math-v1-4plus. To keep general ability, first heal on 26B tokens of FineWeb-Edu, then train on 26B tokens mixing FineWeb-Edu with Nemotron SFT data.
zh: 用预训练模型的前几层做 prelude，后几层做循环核心块和 coda，删掉中间的层，例如从 TinyLlama-1.1B-3T 取 (4,8,4)，从 OLMo-2-0425-1B 和 Llama-3.2-1B 取 (4,6,4)。
沿用 Huginn-0125 的循环方式，对 concat(prelude 输出, 状态) 做线性 adapter，初始状态随机，递归次数从 Poisson-Lognormal 分布采样，梯度最多只过最后 8 遍核心块。
用课程把递归分布的均值升到 4、8、16 或 32（主实验在前 75% 的训练里用 1-sqrt 课程），优化器用 Muon。
在约 50B token 的 Nemotron-CC-Math-v1-4plus 上训练。为保住通用能力，先用 26B token 的 FineWeb-Edu 做 healing，再用 26B token 的 FineWeb-Edu 与 Nemotron SFT 混合数据训练。

en: Models have about 1B parameters and are post-trained on about 50B tokens (about 120B in the initialization study); the authors say larger model and data scales still need testing.
All models are trained with a 1024-token context.

Against the non-recurrent parent, data and tokens are matched but parameters and compute are not. The recurrent models keep 72.7% (TinyLlama) or 87.5% (OLMo, Llama) of the parent's parameters and use more FLOPs per training step.
All models share one hyperparameter set (Muon with learning rate 0.001 and weight decay 1e-4, Appendix D); the baselines are not tuned separately.

Training only on math slightly lowers HellaSwag, Arc and OpenBookQA (Section 4.4). GSM8K and MATH use one in-context example, flexible extract for GSM8K and Minerva criteria with Math-Verify for MATH.
zh: 模型约 1B 参数，后训练约 50B token（初始化对比实验约 120B token）；作者表示更大的模型和数据规模还有待验证。
所有模型都用 1024 token 的上下文训练。
与非循环父模型相比，对齐了数据和 token，没对齐参数和算力。循环模型只保留父模型 72.7%（TinyLlama）或 87.5%（OLMo、Llama）的参数，每个训练 step 的 FLOPs 更多。
所有模型共用一套超参（Muon，学习率 0.001，weight decay 1e-4，Appendix D），基线没有单独调。
只用数学数据训练会让 HellaSwag、Arc、OpenBookQA 略降（Section 4.4）。GSM8K 和 MATH 用 1 个上下文示例评测，GSM8K 取 flexible extract，MATH 用 Minerva 标准加 Math-Verify。

papers.glyph: L0-3 (4 layers) -> [L10-17 (8 layers)] x Poisson-Lognormal, mean ramped to 4, 8, 16 or 32 -> L18-21 (4 layers); injection concat; KV n/a

papers.title: Think-at-Hard: Dynamic Looped Transformers for Improved Reasoning

tldr.en: TaH re-iterates a Qwen3 backbone only on tokens that a lightweight neural decider flags as likely wrong, using duo-causal attention over earlier positions and shallower iterations; at identical parameter counts it beats always-iterate baselines by 3.8-4.4% while skipping iterations on 93% of tokens.
tldr.zh: TaH 只在轻量神经决策器判定可能出错的 token 上让 Qwen3 主干再迭代，并用 duo-causal attention 关注之前的位置和更浅的迭代深度；参数量相同时，它比每个 token 都迭代的基线高 3.8-4.4%，同时 93% 的 token 跳过迭代。

papers.title: Latent Reasoning in TRMs is Secretly a Policy Improvement Operator

tldr.en: Frames latent recursion in Tiny Recursive Models as policy improvement and supervises each recursive step with an intermediate target from a discrete diffusion schedule, dropping the halting head; on TRM this avoids dead compute and cuts total forward passes by 18x while maintaining performance.
tldr.zh: 把 Tiny Recursive Model 的潜在递归形式化为策略改进，并用离散扩散调度生成的中间目标监督每个递归步，去掉了停止头；在 TRM 上这避免了无效计算，在保持性能的同时把前向传播总次数减少 18x。

papers.title: Closed-Loop Transformers: Autoregressive Modeling as Iterative Latent Equilibrium

tldr.en: Equilibrium Transformers add a module to every layer that runs proximal gradient descent on a learned energy to refine the hidden state before each token is emitted; on binary cumulative parity they beat standard Transformers by +3.28% on average at challenging lengths, up to +8.07%.
tldr.zh: Equilibrium Transformer 在每一层加入一个模块，对学到的能量函数做近端梯度下降，在输出每个 token 前迭代精炼隐藏状态；在二进制累积奇偶任务的困难长度上，它平均比标准 Transformer 高 +3.28%，最高高出 +8.07%。

papers.title: Improving Recursive Transformers with Mixture of LoRAs

tldr.en: ModernALBERT, a recursive Transformer encoder sharing layer parameters within groups, adds token-routed LoRA experts inside the shared FFN (Mixture of LoRAs); its 50M to 120M models are state of the art among compact models on GLUE, SQuAD-v2 and BEIR and surpass larger fully parameterised baselines.
tldr.zh: ModernALBERT 是按组共享层参数的递归 Transformer encoder，它在共享 FFN 内部加入按 token 路由的 LoRA 专家（Mixture of LoRAs）；50M 到 120M 的模型在 GLUE、SQuAD-v2 和 BEIR 上达到紧凑模型中的最好水平，并超过更大的全参数基线。

papers.title: VersatileFFN: Achieving Parameter Efficiency in LLMs via Adaptive Wide-and-Deep Reuse

tldr.en: VersatileFFN reuses one FFN both as sub-experts (width path) and recursively with a learned per-token loop count (depth path), mixed by a difficulty-aware gate; at the 1.21B scale it reaches 60.47% average zero-shot accuracy versus 59.65% for MoE and 60.05% for 6-Loop.
tldr.zh: VersatileFFN 用同一个 FFN 既构造子专家（宽度路径），又按 token 学习循环次数递归应用（深度路径），并用难度感知门控融合两条路径；在 1.21B 规模上，其平均 zero-shot 准确率为 60.47%，高于 MoE 的 59.65% 和 6-Loop 的 60.05%。

papers.title: Universal Reasoning Model

tldr.en: Analyzing Universal Transformer variants, the paper attributes ARC-AGI gains mainly to the recurrent inductive bias and strong nonlinearity; URM adds short convolution and truncated backpropagation through loops to a looped 4-layer Transformer and reaches 53.8% pass@1 on ARC-AGI 1 and 16.0% on ARC-AGI 2.
tldr.zh: 论文分析 Universal Transformer 变体，认为 ARC-AGI 上的提升主要来自循环归纳偏置和强非线性组件；URM 在循环的 4 层 Transformer 中加入短卷积和跨循环截断反向传播，在 ARC-AGI 1 和 ARC-AGI 2 上的 pass@1 分别达到 53.8% 和 16.0%。

papers.title: Block-Recurrent Dynamics in Vision Transformers

tldr.en: Raptor rewrites pretrained ViTs as a few weight-tied blocks, each applied recurrently over a contiguous phase of depth; with only 2 blocks it recovers 96% of DINOv2 ImageNet-1k linear probe accuracy at equivalent runtime, and its depth dynamics converge into class-dependent angular basins.
tldr.zh: Raptor 把预训练 ViT 改写为少数几个权重共享块，每个块在一段连续的深度阶段内循环应用；仅用 2 个块、在相同运行时间下即可恢复 DINOv2 ImageNet-1k linear probe 准确率的 96%，其深度动力学会收敛到与类别相关的角度吸引盆。

papers.title: Context Collapse: In-Context Learning and Model Collapse

tldr.en: For in-context linear regression with a linear Transformer whose layers all share one weight matrix, the thesis reduces the forward pass to preconditioned gradient descent and proves the optimal solution gains a skew-symmetric component above a critical context length; it also studies model collapse.
tldr.zh: 论文研究各层共享同一权重矩阵的线性 Transformer 做上下文线性回归，把其前向计算化归为预条件梯度下降，证明上下文长度超过临界值后最优解会出现斜对称分量；论文还研究了模型坍缩。

papers.title: Context-Free Recognition with Transformers

tldr.en: Proves that looped transformers with O(log(N)) looping layers and O(N^6) padding symbols recognize all context-free languages, and unambiguous CFLs need only O(N^3) padding; empirically, looped and padded transformers recognize CFLs better than fixed-depth transformers.
tldr.zh: 证明带 O(log(N)) 个循环层和 O(N^6) 个 padding 符号的循环 Transformer 能识别所有上下文无关语言（CFL），无歧义 CFL 只需 O(N^3) padding；实验中，循环且加 padding 的 Transformer 识别 CFL 的效果优于固定深度 Transformer。

papers.title: Energy-Entropy Regularization: The True Power of Minimal Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Energy-Entropy Regularization uses Tsallis entropy and Hamiltonian dynamics to reshape the loss landscape of single-head looped Transformers; with it, a single-head looped Transformer with model dimension d = 8 solves the induction head task with input sequence length of 1000 tokens.
tldr.zh: Energy-Entropy Regularization 利用 Tsallis 熵和哈密顿动力学重塑单头循环 Transformer 的损失地形；借助它，模型维度 d = 8 的单头循环 Transformer 能在输入序列长度为 1000 个 token 时解决 induction head 任务。

papers.title: Loop as a Bridge: Can Looped Transformers Truly Link Representation Space and Natural Language Outputs?

tldr.en: Tests whether looping lets Ouro close the gap between internal representations and verbal outputs; more loops narrow it partly because representational knowledge degrades, and injected concepts are perceived only in the final loop.
tldr.zh: 检验循环能否让 Ouro 弥合内部表示与语言输出之间的差距；循环次数增加会缩小差距，但部分原因是表示中承载的知识在退化，且模型只在最后一遍循环中才能感知注入的概念。

papers.title: Scale-Consistent State-Space Dynamics via Fractal of Stationary Transformations

tldr.en: FROST iterates one weight-tied ResNet or ViT transition as a contractive, self-similar state-space update so intermediate states approximate the final one, making ranking-based halting stable; on CIFAR-100, accuracy rises from 45.39% at average depth 4.37 to 61.99% at full depth 16.00.
tldr.zh: FROST 把同一个权重共享的 ResNet 或 ViT 变换迭代为收缩、自相似的状态空间更新，使中间状态逼近最终表示，从而让基于排序的停止机制稳定可用；在 CIFAR-100 上，准确率从平均深度 4.37 时的 45.39% 升至完整深度 16.00 时的 61.99%。

papers.title: Depth-Recurrent Attention Mixture (Dreamer): Giving Latent Reasoning the Attention it Deserves

tldr.en: Dreamer combines sequence attention, depth attention and sparse expert attention in a depth-recurrent model; against FLOP-, parameter- and memory-matched baselines it needs 2 to 8x fewer training tokens for the same accuracy on language reasoning.
tldr.zh: Dreamer 在深度循环模型中结合序列注意力、沿深度的注意力和稀疏专家注意力；与 FLOP、参数和显存都匹配的基线相比，在语言推理基准上达到相同准确率所需的训练 token 少 2 到 8 倍。

papers.title: Beyond What Seems Necessary: Hidden Gains from Scaling Training-Time Reasoning Length under Outcome Supervision

tldr.en: Shows in theory and experiments that under outcome-only supervision, OOD performance keeps improving as training-time reasoning length (looped-Transformer loop count, RL token budget) grows past ID saturation; on a synthetic induction task, ID accuracy saturates around 2 loops while OOD accuracy keeps rising.
tldr.zh: 从理论和实验两方面表明，在仅有结果监督时，随着训练时推理长度（循环 Transformer 的循环次数、RL 的 token 预算）增加，OOD 性能在 ID 性能饱和后仍持续提升；在一个合成归纳任务上，ID 准确率在约 2 次循环时饱和，而 OOD 准确率继续上升。

papers.title: LoopViT: Scaling Visual ARC with Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Loop-ViT iterates a weight-tied hybrid convolution-attention block on ARC-AGI grids and at inference halts once predictive entropy is low; the 18M model reaches 65.8% on ARC-AGI-1, above 73M-parameter ensembles.
tldr.zh: Loop-ViT 在 ARC-AGI 网格上反复迭代一个权重共享的卷积加注意力混合块，推理时在预测熵足够低时停止；18M 模型在 ARC-AGI-1 上达到 65.8%，超过 73M 参数的集成模型。

papers.title: Lipschitz Multiscale Deep Equilibrium Models: A Theoretically Guaranteed and Accelerated Approach

tldr.en: Lipschitz MDEQ modifies the multiscale DEQ so hyperparameters set the Lipschitz constant of its weight-tied fixed-point mapping, guaranteeing forward and backward fixed-point convergence; on CIFAR-10 classification it gives up to a 4.75× speed-up for a minor drop in accuracy.
tldr.zh: Lipschitz MDEQ 改造多尺度 DEQ，让超参数决定其权重共享不动点映射的 Lipschitz 常数，从而保证前向和反向传播中的不动点收敛；在 CIFAR-10 图像分类上最高带来 4.75× 加速，代价是准确率略有下降。

papers.title: Multimodal Latent Reasoning via Hierarchical Visual Cues Injection

tldr.en: HIVE builds a multimodal model on Huginn's recurrent core and injects ViT features from layers 6, 12, 18 and 24 into the first recurrent iterations, one tier per step; on ScienceQA-Img accuracy rises from 32.82% at r=1 to 91.57% at r=32, vs 89.39% without hierarchical cues.
tldr.zh: HIVE 在 Huginn 的循环核心块上构建多模态模型，把 ViT 第 6、12、18、24 层的特征注入前几次循环迭代，每步一层；在 ScienceQA-Img 上，准确率从 r=1 时的 32.82% 升至 r=32 时的 91.57%，不用层级视觉线索时为 89.39%。

papers.title: Recurrent-Depth VLA: Implicit Test-Time Compute Scaling of Vision-Language-Action Models via Latent Iterative Reasoning

tldr.en: RD-VLA gives a VLA a weight-tied recurrent action head that stops on latent convergence; tasks failing at one iteration exceed 90 percent success with four, and inference is up to 80x faster than reasoning VLAs.
tldr.zh: RD-VLA 为 VLA 加入权重共享的循环动作头，并按隐状态收敛自适应停止；单次迭代完全失败的任务在四次迭代时成功率超过 90%，推理速度比以往基于推理的 VLA 最多快 80x。

papers.title: Emergent Search and Backtracking in Latent Reasoning Models

tldr.en: Decoding looped Huginn-0125's answer beliefs at every recurrence step on multiple-choice QA reveals exploration, tentative commitment, then convergence or backtracking; backtracking occurs in 32% of instances with a 34% accuracy gain, and implausible distractors shorten exploration by 54%.
tldr.zh: 在多选问答上逐个循环步解码循环模型 Huginn-0125 对各选项的预测概率，发现隐空间中的搜索过程：先探索，再暂时押注领先选项，最后收敛或回溯；32% 的实例出现回溯，比未回溯实例准确率高 34%，把干扰项换成不合理选项后探索阶段缩短 54%。

papers.title: Understanding Dynamic Compute Allocation in Recurrent Transformers

tldr.en: ANIRA's decider sets each token's number of recurrent-block iterations from the prelude or by online halting; on tasks of controllable difficulty, allocation tracks complexity without difficulty labels (Spearman up to +0.666), yet accuracy drops sharply at unseen input sizes.
tldr.zh: ANIRA 的决策器在 prelude 之后提前设定、或在每次迭代后在线停止，以决定每个 token 的循环块迭代次数；在难度可控的任务上，计算分配无需难度标注即与复杂度一致（Spearman 相关最高 +0.666），但在训练未覆盖的输入规模上准确率急剧下降。

papers.title: Looping Back to Move Forward: Recursive Transformers for Efficient and Flexible Large Multimodal Models

tldr.en: RecursiveVLM loops a multimodal model's LLM backbone, adding a Recursive Connector that fuses intermediate-layer states per modality and a Monotonic Recursion Loss; it gains +3% over standard Transformers and +7% over vanilla recursive baselines.
tldr.zh: RecursiveVLM 循环多模态模型的 LLM 主干，加入按模态融合中间层状态的 Recursive Connector 和 Monotonic Recursion Loss；相比标准 Transformer 提升 +3%，相比普通递归基线提升 +7%。

papers.title: Step-resolved data attribution for looped transformers

tldr.en: Step-Decomposed Influence (SDI) unrolls a looped Transformer to split TracIn data attribution into per-iteration influence scores, using TensorSketch so per-example gradients are never materialised; on looped GPT-style models and algorithmic tasks it matches full-gradient baselines with low error.
tldr.zh: Step-Decomposed Influence（SDI）展开循环 Transformer 的循环计算，把 TracIn 数据归因拆成每次循环迭代各自的影响分数，并用不显式生成逐样本梯度的 TensorSketch 实现；在循环 GPT 式模型和算法任务上，它与全梯度基线结果一致且误差很低。

papers.title: Prioritize the Process, Not Just the Outcome: Rewarding Latent Thought Trajectories Improves Reasoning in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: RLTT replaces GRPO's final-state credit with reward spread over the whole latent thought trajectory of looped LMs; on Ouro-Thinking it raises mean math accuracy over GRPO by +5.8% at 1.4B and +10.9% at 2.6B.
tldr.zh: RLTT 不再像 GRPO 那样只给最终隐状态分配信用，而是把奖励分配到循环语言模型的整条隐式思考轨迹上；在 Ouro-Thinking 上，数学基准平均准确率比 GRPO 在 1.4B 规模提高 +5.8%，在 2.6B 规模提高 +10.9%。

papers.title: LoopFormer: Elastic-Depth Looped Transformers for Latent Reasoning via Shortcut Modulation

tldr.en: Trains one looped Transformer for many depths via time and step-size conditioning and a shortcut-consistency loss; it performs well on language modeling and reasoning under tight compute budgets and improves as the budget grows.
tldr.zh: 通过时间与步长条件化和 shortcut-consistency 损失，让同一个循环 Transformer 适配多种深度；它在较紧的计算预算下仍能在语言建模和推理上表现良好，并随预算增加而提升。

papers.title: SpiralFormer: Looped Transformers Can Learn Hierarchical Dependencies via Multi-Resolution Recursion

tldr.en: SpiralFormer runs a looped Transformer's shared core at a different sequence resolution each iteration, coarse to fine; from 160M to 1.4B it beats looped and non-looped baselines in parameter and compute efficiency.
tldr.zh: SpiralFormer 让循环 Transformer 的共享核心在每次迭代中以不同的序列分辨率运行（由粗到细）；在 160M 到 1.4B 规模上，其参数效率和计算效率都优于循环与非循环基线。

papers.title: Tiny Recursive Reasoning with Mamba-2 Attention Hybrid

tldr.en: Replaces the Transformer blocks inside TRM's recursion with a Mamba-2 + attention hybrid at parameter parity (6.83M vs 6.86M); on ARC-AGI-1 the hybrid raises pass@2 by +2.0% (45.88% vs 43.88%) and leads by +4.75% at pass@100, with pass@1 parity.
tldr.zh: 在参数量基本一致（6.83M 对 6.86M）的条件下，把 TRM 递归中的 Transformer 块换成 Mamba-2 + attention 混合算子；在 ARC-AGI-1 上，混合模型的 pass@2 提高 +2.0%（45.88% 对 43.88%），pass@100 领先 +4.75%，pass@1 持平。

papers.title: Inner Loop Inference for Pretrained Transformers: Unlocking Latent Capabilities Without Training

tldr.en: Inner looping re-applies a middle block range of frozen pretrained LMs at inference, interpolating looped states with earlier ones to limit distribution shift; on Gemma 2-2B, looping layers 10–13 with uniform interpolation raises GSM8K from 25.02 to 26.00, while Llama 3-8B responds less consistently.
tldr.zh: Inner looping 在推理时对冻结的预训练语言模型重复应用中间的一段层，并把循环状态与之前的状态插值以减轻分布偏移；在 Gemma 2-2B 上用均匀插值循环第 10–13 层，GSM8K 从 25.02 提升到 26.00，而 Llama 3-8B 的效果波动较大。

papers.title: From Growing to Looping: A Unified View of Iterative Computation in LLMs

tldr.en: Looped and depth-grown (middle-layer duplication) LLMs share depth-wise signatures of iterative computation; looping a middle block of a depth-grown model at inference, without loop training, raises accuracy on some reasoning primitives by up to 2x.
tldr.zh: 循环模型与深度生长（复制中间层）得到的 LLM 具有共同的逐层迭代计算特征；在推理时对未经循环训练的深度生长模型循环其中间块，可使部分推理基元的准确率最多提升到 2 倍。

papers.title: Turbo Connection: Reasoning as Information Flow from Higher to Lower Layers

tldr.en: TurboConn routes dense residual connections from higher-layer hidden states of token t into lower layers of token t+1 in fine-tuned pretrained LLMs; it gains 0.9% to over 10% on GSM8K, Parity and multi-step arithmetic, and lifts Qwen-3-1.7B on Parity from 53.78% to 100%.
tldr.zh: TurboConn 在微调预训练 LLM 时，把 token t 多个高层的隐藏状态通过密集残差连接送入 token t+1 的低层；它在 GSM8K、Parity 和多步算术上提升 0.9% 到 10% 以上，并把 Qwen-3-1.7B 在 Parity 上的准确率从 53.78% 提高到 100%。

papers.title: AdaPonderLM: Gated Pondering Language Models with Token-Wise Adaptive Depth

tldr.en: AdaPonderLM, a recurrent LM, learns token-wise halting with iteration-specific MLP gates and reuses KV states of halted tokens; it cuts inference compute by about 10% at comparable perplexity, spending more compute on high-NLL tokens.
tldr.zh: AdaPonderLM 是一种循环语言模型，用每次迭代专属的 MLP 门控学习按 token 停止，并复用已停止 token 的 KV；在困惑度相当的情况下推理计算量减少约 10%，并把更多计算分配给高 NLL 的 token。

papers.title: PonderLM-3: Adaptive Token-Wise Pondering with Differentiable Masking

tldr.en: PonderLM-3 adds a router that sets how many PonderLM-2 pondering steps (the last hidden state fed back through the same model) each token gets; a differentiable attention mask in pretraining matches hard stopping at inference, beating recursive or adaptive baselines in perplexity at equal inference FLOPs.
tldr.zh: PonderLM-3 加入路由器，决定每个 token 使用多少个 PonderLM-2 式 pondering 步（把最后隐藏状态送回同一个模型再算一次）；预训练时用可微注意力掩码，推理时用与之匹配的硬停止规则，在相同推理 FLOPs 下预训练困惑度低于已有的循环或自适应基线。

papers.title: Mixture of Universal Experts: Scaling Virtual Width via Depth-Width Transformation

tldr.en: MoUE reuses a shared pool of universal experts across MoE layers under a fixed activation budget; it beats matched MoE baselines by up to 1.3% and converts existing MoE checkpoints with up to 4.2% gains.
tldr.zh: MoUE 在固定的激活预算下让多个 MoE 层复用同一个通用专家池；它比匹配的 MoE 基线最多高 1.3%，并能把已有 MoE checkpoint 转换过来，最多带来 4.2% 的提升。

papers.title: Tiny Autoregressive Recursive Models

tldr.en: Adapts TRM's nested two-stream refinement to causal next-token decoders and compares it with untied depth and Universal Transformer variants at matched block passes on character-level algorithmic tasks; some two-level refinement baselines are strong, but the full Autoregressive TRM gives no reliable gains.
tldr.zh: 把 TRM 的双流嵌套细化改造成因果 next-token 解码器，在 block 计算次数相同的条件下，于字符级算法任务上与非共享深度和 Universal Transformer 变体比较；部分两级细化基线表现很强，但完整的 Autoregressive TRM 没有带来可靠提升。

papers.title: Adaptive Loops and Memory in Transformers: Think Harder or Know More?

tldr.en: Lets each block loop with learned halting and adds gated memory banks; looping mainly helps math, memory banks help commonsense tasks, and combined they beat an iso-FLOP baseline with three times the layers on math.
tldr.zh: 让每个 Transformer 块借助学习的停止机制自适应循环，并加入门控记忆库；循环主要提升数学推理，记忆库有助于常识任务，两者结合后在数学基准上超过层数为其三倍的等 FLOP 基线。

papers.title: SCORE: Replacing Layer Stacking with Contractive Recurrent Depth

tldr.en: SCORE replaces stacked layers with one shared block applied for a fixed number of steps through the contractive update ht+1 = (1 - dt) * ht + dt * F(ht); on GNNs for ESOL, MLPs and nanoGPT it generally speeds convergence while cutting parameters, and simple Euler steps give the best cost trade-off.
tldr.zh: SCORE 用一个共享块按固定步数迭代取代逐层堆叠，采用收缩式更新 ht+1 = (1 - dt) * ht + dt * F(ht)；在 ESOL 上的 GNN、MLP 和 nanoGPT 中，它通常加快收敛并减少参数，简单的 Euler 积分在计算成本与性能之间折中最好。

papers.title: LoopRPT: Reinforcement Pre-Training for Looped Language Models

tldr.en: LoopRPT brings reinforcement pre-training to looped LMs, rewarding each latent loop step against an EMA teacher via noisy latent rollouts and training the exit policy; on Ouro-2.6B it boosts Hard Peak next-token reasoning accuracy by +3.58 while reducing average steps from 3.51 to 2.28.
tldr.zh: LoopRPT 为循环语言模型引入强化预训练，借助 EMA teacher 和带噪声的 latent rollout 为每个潜在循环步分配奖励并训练退出策略；在 Ouro-2.6B 上，它把 Hard Peak 下一 token 推理准确率提高 +3.58，同时把平均步数从 3.51 降到 2.28。

papers.title: Thinking Deeper, Not Longer: Memory-Efficient Test-Time Reasoning with Depth-Recurrent Transformers for Compositional Generalization

tldr.en: A shared-weight Transformer block, kept stable for 20+ thinking steps by final-output-only supervision, LayerScale initialization and an identity-biased gate, extrapolates past its training range and comes within two points of fixed-depth Transformers with 4-6.4× more parameters on two sequence tasks.
tldr.zh: 一个共享权重的 Transformer 块被反复迭代，靠只监督最终输出、LayerScale 初始化和偏向恒等的门控在 20+ 个思考步内保持稳定；它能外推到训练范围之外，在两个序列任务上与参数多 4-6.4× 的固定深度 Transformer 相差不到两个点。

papers.title: Sparse Growing Transformer: Training-Time Sparse Depth Allocation via Progressive Attention Looping

tldr.en: SGT loops only the highest-entropy attention heads and grows this recurrence from deeper to shallower layers during training; it outperforms static block-level looping baselines while cutting the extra training FLOPs over a standard Transformer from approximately 16–20% to 1–3%.
tldr.zh: SGT 只对熵最高的注意力头做循环，并在训练中把循环从深层逐步扩展到浅层；它优于训练期静态的块级循环基线，同时把相对标准 Transformer 的额外训练 FLOPs 从约 16–20% 降到 1–3%。

papers.title: LA-Sign: Looped Transformers with Geometry-aware Alignment for Skeleton-based Sign Language Recognition

tldr.en: LA-Sign reuses a shared encoder-decoder Transformer block recurrently to refine skeleton-based sign representations, regularized by contrastive alignment of skeletal and textual features in adaptive hyperbolic space; it reaches state-of-the-art results on WLASL and MSASL with fewer unique layers.
tldr.zh: LA-Sign 循环复用共享的编码器-解码器 Transformer 块来细化基于骨架的手语表示，并用自适应双曲空间中骨架特征与文本特征的对比对齐来约束这一过程；它在 WLASL 和 MSASL 上用更少的独立层取得最先进结果。

papers.title: Universal YOCO for Efficient Depth Scaling

note.en: Section 4.1 model, a 20-layer YOCO with MoE FFNs (1.3B activated, 10B total). The 10-layer self-decoder uses SWA with window 512 and RoPE and is applied T=3 times with shared weights; its final output is projected once into the global KV that all 10 cross-decoder layers (NoPE) read. Each iteration keeps its own window cache. Figure 6 trains separate 1.3B models with 1, 2, 3 and 5 loops.
note.zh: Section 4.1 的模型是 20 层 YOCO，FFN 为 MoE（1.3B 激活，10B 总参数）。10 层 self-decoder 用窗口 512 的 SWA 和 RoPE，共享权重连续跑 T=3 次；最后一次的输出只投影一次，得到 10 层 cross-decoder（NoPE）共用的全局 KV。每次迭代各存自己的窗口缓存。Figure 6 另外训练了 1、2、3、5 遍的 1.3B 模型。

baseline.en: Non-recursive YOCO with the same configuration and hyperparameters (Loop=1); Section 4.2 adds a Transformer, a Universal Transformer looped twice, RINS and ParScale at 1.3B dense.
baseline.zh: 配置和超参都相同、不循环的 YOCO（Loop=1）；Section 4.2 另有 1.3B dense 的 Transformer、整模型循环两遍的 Universal Transformer、RINS 和 ParScale。

headline.en: With the same 1.3B-activated / 10B-total MoE, YOCO-U at equal training FLOPs averages 46.23 on the Table 2 tasks against 41.78 for non-recursive YOCO (+4.45), and 47.08 at equal steps; at equal FLOPs its loss is lower by 0.033.
headline.zh: 同样 1.3B 激活 / 10B 总参数的 MoE，等训练 FLOPs 时 YOCO-U 在 Table 2 任务上平均 46.23，不循环的 YOCO 为 41.78（+4.45）；等步数时为 47.08；等 FLOPs 时 loss 低 0.033。

results.setting: Section 4.1 MoE (1.3B activated, 10B total), 20 layers, 8192 training length, trained up to 300B tokens, T=3

note.en: The paper does not state how many training tokens the Equal FLOPS row used.
note.zh: 论文没写 Equal FLOPS 那一行训练了多少 token。

results.setting: Thinking SFT from the 280B checkpoint, 20B tokens of math thinking data, 32768 maximal length; greedy decoding up to 32,768 tokens
1.3B dense, 20 layers, hidden 2560, 20B tokens; the compute-scaling variants are aligned to approximately 2× the FLOPs of a standard 20-layer Transformer
1.3B dense ablations; the YOCO and YOCO-U rows repeat the Table 3 values at two decimals

note.en: Deep and Deeper double the depth at the same model size (Deeper has hidden size 1792 and 40 layers). Upper Loop loops the cross-decoder instead of the self-decoder; the w/o Shared KV variant uses self-attention there.
note.zh: Deep 和 Deeper 在模型大小不变时把深度加倍（Deeper 的 hidden 为 1792、40 层）。Upper Loop 改为循环 cross-decoder；w/o Shared KV 变体在那里改用 self-attention。

results.setting: 1.3B configuration of Section 4.4, Nano-vLLM in BF16 on H100-80GB, generation batch size 32, length 128
results.metric: at 256K length, prefill tokens/s / decode tokens/s / KV cache MB

note.en: Section 4.5 states that YOCO-U gives up 5% of YOCO's decoding throughput, decodes 2.21× faster than the Transformer at 256K, and that RINS needs 38× the KV memory of YOCO-U.
note.zh: Section 4.5 称 YOCO-U 的解码吞吐比 YOCO 低 5%，256K 时解码速度是 Transformer 的 2.21 倍；RINS 的 KV 显存是 YOCO-U 的 38 倍。

findings.en: Looping the cross-decoder instead of the self-decoder averages 47.34 (46.41 without the shared KV), against 48.25 for YOCO-U and 46.95 for non-recursive YOCO; the authors conclude that recursion on deeper layers gives diminishing improvement regardless of the KV cache strategy.
findings.zh: 改为循环 cross-decoder 平均 47.34（不共享 KV 时 46.41），YOCO-U 为 48.25，不循环的 YOCO 为 46.95；作者据此认为在更深的层上循环收益递减，与 KV 策略无关。

findings.en: At about 2× FLOPs, looping the whole 20-layer Transformer twice averages 47.8, while RINS and YOCO-U both reach 48.3; the authors read this as scaling FLOPs on bottom blocks being more effective than on all blocks.
findings.zh: 约 2 倍 FLOPs 下，整个 20 层 Transformer 循环两遍平均 47.8，RINS 和 YOCO-U 都是 48.3；作者认为把 FLOPs 加在底部的块上比加在所有块上更有效。

findings.en: Separately trained 1.3B models with 1, 2, 3 and 5 loops show consistent improvements in validation loss as the loop count grows; Loop=5 uses 3 times the FLOPs of the non-recursive model. The figure prints no per-loop values.
findings.zh: 分别训练 1、2、3、5 遍的 1.3B 模型，验证 loss 随遍数增加持续改善；Loop=5 的 FLOPs 是不循环模型的 3 倍。图中没有印出各遍数的数值。

findings.en: YOCO-U trained on 80B tokens is comparable with non-recursive YOCO trained on 210B tokens (approximately 62% fewer tokens).
findings.zh: YOCO-U 训练 80B token 的效果与不循环的 YOCO 训练 210B token 相当（约少用 62% 的 token）。

findings.en: With training steps fixed, YOCO-U matches YOCO with 50% fewer parameters; when activated parameters are aligned, the authors say YOCO-U narrows the gap to non-recursive models and is near-comparable above 10B.
findings.zh: 训练步数相同时，YOCO-U 用少 50% 的参数达到 YOCO 的效果；按激活参数对齐时，作者称 YOCO-U 与不循环模型的差距缩小，超过 10B 时接近持平。

findings.en: On Needle-in-a-Haystack, YOCO-U scores 1.00 (S-NIAH-1) and 0.95 (S-NIAH-2), against 0.87 and 0.82 for the Transformer and 0.99 and 0.91 for RINS.
findings.zh: Needle-in-a-Haystack 上 YOCO-U 得分 1.00（S-NIAH-1）和 0.95（S-NIAH-2），Transformer 为 0.87 和 0.82，RINS 为 0.99 和 0.91。

tldr.en: Loop only YOCO's self-decoder, whose layers use sliding-window attention, so extra depth costs compute while the cross-decoder's global KV is still computed once.
tldr.zh: 只循环 YOCO 的 self-decoder（这些层用 SWA），加深只多花计算，cross-decoder 用的全局 KV 仍只算一次。

problem.en: Looping a standard Transformer re-runs every layer, which regenerates KV caches and repeats global attention, so memory and compute grow with depth.
problem.zh: 循环标准 Transformer 要重跑所有层，每遍重新生成 KV、重复全局注意力，显存和计算都随深度增长。

en: Start from YOCO, where an L/2-layer self-decoder with efficient self-attention (SWA by default) produces one global KV cache that every layer of the L/2-layer cross-decoder reads through cross-attention.
Replace the self-decoder with a Universal Self-Decoder that applies the same L/2 layers T times in sequence (T=3 by default, 2× the total FLOPs of the non-recursive baseline).
Project the global KV from the final iteration's output, so its size does not depend on T; only the SWA window caches grow with T.
zh: 以 YOCO 为基础：L/2 层的 self-decoder 用高效注意力（默认 SWA），产出一份全局 KV，L/2 层的 cross-decoder 每层都通过 cross-attention 读它。
把 self-decoder 换成 Universal Self-Decoder，同一组 L/2 层依次跑 T 次（默认 T=3，总 FLOPs 是不循环基线的 2 倍）。
全局 KV 由最后一次迭代的输出投影得到，大小与 T 无关；只有 SWA 的窗口缓存随 T 增长。

en: The headline runs are a 1.3B-activated / 10B-total MoE trained on up to 300B tokens; the architecture comparison, ablations and loop scaling use 1.3B dense models trained on 20B tokens, and the efficiency tests use the same 1.3B configuration. Training length is 8192 in Sections 4.1 and 4.4.
Each model is trained and tested with one fixed loop count (3 by default; 1, 2, 3 and 5 in Figure 6); the paper does not report changing the loop count at inference.
Training FLOPs are computed as tokens × layers (Section 4.1), and the Equal FLOPS row of Table 2 does not state its token count.
The KV cache is not identical to YOCO's because each self-decoder iteration keeps its own window cache (Table 10, 46 MB vs 26 MB at 8K and 542 vs 522 MB at 256K).
Prefill throughput is below non-recursive YOCO's, 76301 vs 220407 tokens/s at 256K (Table 8).
Table 5 does not state the loop count or FLOPs of the Upper Loop variants.
zh: 主结果是 1.3B 激活 / 10B 总参数的 MoE，最多训练 300B token；架构对比、消融和遍数扩展用 1.3B dense 模型，训练 20B token，效率测试也用这个 1.3B 配置。Section 4.1 和 4.4 的训练长度是 8192。
每个模型训练和测试都用同一个固定遍数（默认 3，Figure 6 中有 1、2、3、5）；论文没有报告推理时改变遍数。
训练 FLOPs 按 token × 层数计算（Section 4.1），Table 2 的 Equal FLOPS 行没写训练了多少 token。
KV 和 YOCO 并不完全相同，因为 self-decoder 每次迭代各存自己的窗口缓存（Table 10，8K 时 46 MB 对 26 MB，256K 时 542 MB 对 522 MB）。
prefill 吞吐低于不循环的 YOCO，256K 时为 76301 对 220407 tokens/s（Table 8）。
Table 5 没写 Upper Loop 变体的遍数和 FLOPs。

papers.glyph: [Universal Self-Decoder, SWA-512 (10 layers)] x 3 -> Cross-Decoder, shared global KV (10 layers); injection none; KV single-global

papers.title: Exploration of Fast-Slow Latent Recurrence for Train-Short, Test-Long Generalization

tldr.en: FSRM applies a weight-shared recurrent core several times per observation and carries the latent state across the stream without reset; trained on Dyck sequences of length ≤40, it keeps ≈80% token accuracy up to length 10^5 and generalizes OOD better than recurrent, state-space and Transformer baselines.
tldr.zh: FSRM 对每个观测用权重共享的循环核心做多次潜在更新，并把潜在状态不经重置地沿数据流传递；在长度 ≤40 的 Dyck 序列上训练后，它在长度 10^5 时仍保持 ≈80% 的 token 准确率，OOD 泛化优于循环、状态空间和 Transformer 基线。

papers.title: Ouroboros: Dynamic Weight Generation for Recursive Transformers via Input-Conditioned LoRA Modulation

tldr.en: Ouroboros adds a Controller hypernetwork that makes each step of a recursive block input-dependent by modulating frozen SVD-initialized LoRA bases; on Qwen2.5-3B cut to Prelude/Recurrent/Coda (17 of 36 layers) it cuts training loss by 43.4% over the 17-layer baseline, but not held-out loss.
tldr.zh: Ouroboros 加入一个 Controller 超网络，通过调制冻结的、SVD 初始化的 LoRA 基，让递归块的每一步都依赖输入；在切分为 Prelude/Recurrent/Coda（保留 36 层中的 17 层）的 Qwen2.5-3B 上，训练损失比 17 层基线降低 43.4%，但留出文本上的损失没有改善。

papers.title: One-Shot Localisation of the Global Minimum of a Noisy One-Dimensional Function: A Controlled Comparison of an Iterative Neural Minimizer, Set Transformers and Classical Estimators

tldr.en: The Neural Function Minimizer runs a weight-tied read-iterate-update loop for fifteen steps, moving a position and re-reading twenty noisy samples of a one-dimensional function; its regret is 2.90 and 3.12 points of the range lower than a same-size one-pass Set Transformer's (one and two heads).
tldr.zh: Neural Function Minimizer 让权重共享的读取-迭代-更新循环运行 15 步，每步移动位置并重新读取一维函数的 20 个带噪样本；与同等规模、单次前向的 Set Transformer 相比，它在一个和两个输出头下的 regret 分别低 2.90 和 3.12 个点（按值域计）。

papers.title: Loop, Think, & Generalize: Implicit Reasoning in Recurrent-Depth Transformers

tldr.en: Trains recurrent-depth Transformers from scratch on implicit multi-hop knowledge composition; unlike vanilla Transformers they generalize systematically through a three-stage grokking process and extrapolate to deeper compositions with more inference-time iterations, until overthinking degrades predictions.
tldr.zh: 在隐式多跳知识组合任务上从头训练循环深度 Transformer；与普通 Transformer 不同，它们经过三阶段 grokking 实现系统性泛化，并能随推理时迭代次数增加外推到更深的组合，但过度迭代（overthinking）会使预测变差。

papers.title: Loom: A Scalable Analytical Neural Computer Architecture

tldr.en: Loom runs C programs inside a looped Transformer with analytically derived weights: each pass through 8 layers executes one instruction of a 22-opcode set, repeating until the program counter reaches zero; the default d = 155, n = 1024 machine has 4.7 million parameters and 928 instruction slots.
tldr.zh: Loom 在权重经解析推导的循环 Transformer 中运行由 C 编译的程序：每次通过 8 层执行 22 个操作码指令集中的一条指令，反复迭代直到程序计数器归零；默认配置 d = 155、n = 1024 有 4.7M 参数和 928 个指令槽。

papers.title: ELT: Elastic Looped Transformers for Visual Generation

tldr.en: ELT loops weight-shared transformer blocks for image and video generation and distills the maximum-loop output into intermediate loops for any-time inference; with 4× fewer parameters at iso-inference compute, it reaches FID 2.0 on ImageNet 256×256.
tldr.zh: ELT 用权重共享的循环 Transformer 块做图像和视频生成，并把最大循环次数的输出蒸馏给中间各遍以支持随时退出的推理；在推理算力相同、参数少 4× 的设置下，它在 ImageNet 256×256 上达到 FID 2.0。

papers.title: Reading Human Preference from Looped Transformer Internal States

tldr.en: Probes hidden states of the looped Ouro-2.6B-Thinking, which runs its layers four times per token, for human preference on HH-RLHF; a linear probe picks the preferred reply 61.5% of the time and a nonlinear network scoring each reply separately 64.9%, so preference is readable but faint.
tldr.zh: 在 HH-RLHF 数据上用探针读取循环模型 Ouro-2.6B-Thinking（每个 token 把各层运行四遍）隐藏状态中的人类偏好；线性探针选中被偏好回复的比例为 61.5%，逐条回复打分的小型非线性网络为 64.9%，偏好可以读出但信号很弱。

papers.title: A Mechanistic Analysis of Looped Reasoning Language Models

tldr.en: Analyzes latent states of pretrained looped language models; in many, each recurrent-block layer converges to a distinct fixed point and each iteration repeats feedforward-like stages of inference, depending on input injection and normalization.
tldr.zh: 分析预训练循环语言模型的隐状态；在许多被研究的模型中，循环块的每一层都收敛到各自不同的不动点，每次迭代都重复与前馈模型相似的推理阶段，这些现象受输入注入和归一化方式影响。

papers.title: Parcae: Scaling Laws For Stable Looped Language Models

note.en: Shown for the 1.3B model of the Transformer comparison (Table 18), which has 8 prelude, 8 recurrent and 8 coda blocks against a 24-layer Transformer; the 140M, 370M and 770M models use 2, 4 and 6 blocks per unit, and all loop the middle third. Each step computes h_{t+1} = Ā h_t + B̄ e + R̄(h_t, e) with Ā = exp(ΔA) for a negative diagonal A (ZOH), B̄ = ΔB (Euler) and a normalized prelude output e. The Section 5.1 models are also evaluated at T = 1-16 and the Section 5.3 models up to T = 24.
note.zh: 图示为 Transformer 对比中的 1.3B 模型（Table 18）：prelude、循环块、coda 各 8 层，对照是 24 层 Transformer；140M、370M、770M 每段分别为 2、4、6 层，循环的都是中间三分之一。每一步计算 h_{t+1} = Ā h_t + B̄ e + R̄(h_t, e)，其中 Ā = exp(ΔA)，A 为负对角矩阵（ZOH 离散化），B̄ = ΔB（Euler），e 是归一化后的 prelude 输出。Section 5.1 的模型还在 T = 1-16 上评测，Section 5.3 的模型评测到 T = 24。

baseline.en: Fixed-depth Transformers in a simplified nanochat setup with the same parameter count and training data; Huginn-style RDMs with matched parameters and data are a second baseline.
baseline.zh: 简化 nanochat 设置下参数量和训练数据相同的定深 Transformer；另一组对照是参数和数据都对齐的 Huginn 式 RDM。

headline.en: At 1.3B parameters and the same data, Parcae (T=8) scores 28.44 Core and 17.08 Core-Extended against the Transformer's 25.45 and 15.90 (+2.99 and +1.18 points); the 770M Parcae's 25.07 Core is comparable to the 1.3B Transformer with roughly half the parameters.
headline.zh: 1.3B 参数、相同数据下，Parcae（T=8）的 Core / Core-Extended 为 28.44 / 17.08，Transformer 为 25.45 / 15.90（高 2.99 和 1.18 分）；770M 的 Parcae Core 为 25.07，用约一半参数与 1.3B Transformer 相当。

results.setting: Transformer setup (simplified nanochat), FineWeb-Edu, 2,048 context, parameter- and data-matched pairs trained on 11.2B, 29.6B, 61.6B and 104B tokens at 140M, 370M, 770M and 1.3B; Parcae evaluated at T=8
RDM setup of Geiping et al. (Huginn data and tokenizer); 100M evaluated at T=16, 350M at T=8
results.metric: validation PPL / WikiText PPL / zero-shot average of six tasks

results.setting: Transformer setup at 140M and 370M with parameters and training FLOPs fixed (tokens shrink as μ_rec grows); fixed depth means μ_rec = 1
results.metric: optimal μ_rec* / Core at μ_rec* / Core at fixed depth

results.setting: RDM-setup Parcae models (100M trained with μ_rec 16, 350M with μ_rec 8), depth sampled per micro-batch or per sequence

findings.en: Run at up to twice the training mean (μ_rec = 8), the 140M-1.3B models' gains plateau near T = μ_rec; the authors read this as training depth setting the test-time ceiling.
findings.zh: 140M–1.3B 模型推理时跑到训练均值 μ_rec = 8 的两倍，收益在 T = μ_rec 附近就饱和；作者认为训练深度决定了推理时 scaling 的上限。

findings.en: Loss against test-time T follows L(T) = L∞ + Z·exp(−zT); fitted on T ≤ μ_rec and tested on T > μ_rec, this form has the lowest error of the four forms tried (Huber loss 3.18 and 2.29 x10^-7 at 140M and 370M).
findings.zh: loss 随推理遍数 T 的变化符合 L(T) = L∞ + Z·exp(−zT)；用 T ≤ μ_rec 拟合、在 T > μ_rec 上检验时，它在四种候选形式中误差最低（140M 和 370M 的 Huber loss 为 3.18 和 2.29 x10^-7）。

findings.en: Sampling the total depth from Λ(μ_rec) and then truncating backprop, instead of sampling only the no-gradient steps as Geiping et al. do, keeps validation loss at T = 4, 16 and 64 closer to full backprop (100M models, 10B tokens, μ_rec = μ_bwd = 8).
findings.zh: 先从 Λ(μ_rec) 采样总遍数再截断反传，而不是像 Geiping et al. 那样只采样不带梯度的步数，能让 T = 4、16、64 时的验证 loss 更接近全程反传（100M 模型，10B token，μ_rec = μ_bwd = 8）。

findings.en: With parameters and FLOPs fixed, the optimal μ_rec grows with the budget (2 at 1x10^18 to 10 at 64x10^18 FLOPs for 140M) and follows a power law with exponent about 0.40; the optimal token count follows one with exponent about 0.78.
findings.zh: 固定参数和 FLOPs 时，最优 μ_rec 随预算增大（140M 从 1x10^18 FLOPs 时的 2 增到 64x10^18 时的 10），服从指数约 0.40 的幂律；最优 token 数服从指数约 0.78 的幂律。

findings.en: In early RDM runs made before the Appendix H sampling fix (10B tokens, μ_bwd = 4, evaluated at T = μ_rec), μ_rec = 8 gave the lowest validation loss (2.453) among values from 4 to 32; in a second sweep at μ_rec = 20 (8.5B tokens), raising μ_bwd from 4 to 12 lowered it from 2.500 to 2.474.
findings.zh: 在 Appendix H 采样修正之前的早期 RDM 实验里（10B token，μ_bwd = 4，按 T = μ_rec 评测），μ_rec 取 4 到 32 时 μ_rec = 8 的验证 loss 最低（2.453）；另一组 μ_rec = 20 的实验（8.5B token）中，把 μ_bwd 从 4 提到 12，loss 从 2.500 降到 2.474。

findings.en: Across learning rates from 2e-4 to 1e-3, the Pre-Norm RDM converges only at 2e-4 and the residual-norm RDM up to 4e-4, while Parcae converges at all five.
findings.zh: 学习率从 2e-4 到 1e-3 的五档中，Pre-Norm RDM 只在 2e-4 收敛，残差归一化 RDM 只到 4e-4，Parcae 五档全部收敛。

tldr.en: Constrain the loop's injection to a stable negative-diagonal form, sample depth per sequence, and fit training and test-time scaling laws for looping at fixed parameter count.
tldr.zh: 把循环的注入约束成稳定的负对角形式，按序列采样遍数训练，并在固定参数量下拟合循环的训练和推理 scaling law。

problem.en: Middle-looped models such as Huginn-style RDMs diverge or show loss spikes unless hyperparameters are chosen carefully; the paper traces this to injection parameters whose linearized state matrix reaches a spectral radius of 1 or more, and asks whether a stable looped model scales predictably with loops.
problem.zh: Huginn 式 RDM 等中段循环模型若超参没选好就会发散或出现 loss spike；论文把原因归到注入参数线性化后的状态矩阵谱半径达到或超过 1，并研究稳定后的循环模型能否随循环遍数可预测地 scale。

en: Write each loop step as h_{t+1} = Ā h_t + B̄ e + R̄(h_t, e) and parameterize A as a negative diagonal discretized with ZOH, so the spectral radius of Ā stays below 1; the prelude output e is normalized before injection.
Sample the depth T per sequence from a Poisson distribution with mean μ_rec, backpropagate through the last μ_bwd = ⌈μ_rec/2⌉ steps, and loop the middle third of a nanochat-style Transformer.
Fit isoFLOP scaling laws over μ_rec and tokens at fixed parameters (140M, 370M) and a saturating exponential law for loss against test-time T, then join them in one unified law.
zh: 把每一步循环写成 h_{t+1} = Ā h_t + B̄ e + R̄(h_t, e)，A 参数化为负对角矩阵并用 ZOH 离散化，使 Ā 的谱半径始终小于 1；prelude 输出 e 注入前先归一化。
每条序列的遍数 T 从均值为 μ_rec 的 Poisson 分布采样，只反传最后 μ_bwd = ⌈μ_rec/2⌉ 步；循环 nanochat 式 Transformer 中间三分之一的层。
在固定参数（140M、370M）下拟合 μ_rec 与 token 数的 isoFLOP scaling law，再拟合 loss 随推理遍数 T 变化的饱和指数律，最后合成一个统一的 scaling law。

en: Experiments stop at 1.3B parameters, 104B tokens and a 2,048-token context with dense FFNs; the scaling laws are fitted only at 140M and 370M, and the authors say their observations are limited to small architectures (Section 6).

Parameters and data are matched (Parcae has 0.35-0.83% more parameters, Table 19) but compute is not; at T = 8 the recurrent block runs 8 times per token, and the paper reports neither KV-cache size nor inference cost.
The Transformer and RDM baselines got their own learning-rate sweeps, and Parcae reused the baselines' best settings without a sweep of its own (Section 5.1; Appendix Q).
Test-time gains saturate near the training mean μ_rec, and the authors note that a larger μ_rec needs more test-time steps for equivalent quality (Section 5.3; Section 6).
zh: 实验最大到 1.3B 参数、104B token、2,048 上下文，FFN 为 dense；scaling law 只在 140M 和 370M 上拟合，作者也说结论仅限于小模型（Section 6）。
对齐了参数（Parcae 多 0.35-0.83%，Table 19）和数据，没对齐算力：T = 8 时循环块每个 token 跑 8 遍；论文没有报告 KV 大小或推理成本。
Transformer 和 RDM 基线各自扫过学习率，Parcae 直接沿用基线的最优设置，没有单独扫（Section 5.1；Appendix Q）。
推理收益在训练均值 μ_rec 附近饱和；作者指出 μ_rec 越大，达到同等质量需要的推理步数越多（Section 5.3；Section 6）。

papers.glyph: prelude 8 layers -> [core 8 layers] x Poisson with mean 8, per sequence -> coda 8 layers; injection gated; KV n/a

papers.title: Hierarchical vs. Flat Iteration in Shared-Weight Transformers

tldr.en: HRM-LM replaces independent Transformer layers with a two-speed recurrent pair shared across steps, a Fast module every step and a Slow module every T steps; at ≈1.2B parameters on OpenWebText, a flat Universal Transformer (UniTF) plateaus at ≈7.6 nats across five runs while HRM-LM converges to 4.18.
tldr.zh: HRM-LM 用跨步共享参数的两速循环模块对替代独立 Transformer 层：Fast 模块每步运行，Slow 模块每 T 步运行；在 OpenWebText 上约 1.2B 参数规模下，扁平迭代的 Universal Transformer（UniTF）在五次运行中都停在 ≈7.6 nats，而 HRM-LM 收敛到 4.18。

papers.title: Stability and Generalization in Looped Transformers

tldr.en: A fixed-point analysis of looped transformers proves that models without recall cannot achieve strong input-dependence, while recall with outer normalization yields stable, input-dependent fixed points; small models on chess, sudoku and prefix-sums follow these predictions.
tldr.zh: 对循环 Transformer 的不动点分析证明，没有 recall 的模型无法获得强输入依赖，而 recall 加外层归一化能得到稳定且依赖输入的不动点；在国际象棋、数独和前缀和任务上训练的小模型符合这些预测。

papers.title: One Step Forward and K Steps Back: Better Reasoning with Denoising Recursion Models

tldr.en: Denoising Recursion Models mask the target and train a weight-tied TRM-style transformer to undo the corruption over multiple recursive steps, giving a curriculum of intermediate states; on ARC2-Eval with NVARC pretraining, the 14M DRM reaches 24.9 pass@2 versus 21.8 for TRM and 22.6 for the 4B NVARC LLM.
tldr.zh: Denoising Recursion Models 用掩码噪声破坏目标，再训练权重共享的 TRM 式 Transformer 在多个递归步内还原，从而提供中间状态的课程；在 ARC2-Eval 上（NVARC 数据预训练），14M 的 DRM pass@2 为 24.9，TRM 为 21.8，4B 的 NVARC LLM 为 22.6。

papers.title: LoopCTR: Unlocking the Loop Scaling Power for Click-Through Rate Prediction

tldr.en: LoopCTR, a click-through rate model, loops a shared block between entry and exit blocks with hyper-connected residuals, MoE and supervision at every loop depth; trained with several loops, it beats all baselines even with zero loops at inference, and oracle analysis shows 0.02–0.04 AUC of untapped headroom.
tldr.zh: LoopCTR 面向点击率预测，在入口块和出口块之间循环复用一个共享的 Loop Block，并配合 Hyper-Connected Residuals、MoE 和每个循环深度上的过程监督；多循环训练后，即使推理时完全不循环也超过所有基线，oracle 分析显示仍有 0.02–0.04 AUC 的未利用空间。

papers.title: How Much Is One Recurrence Worth? Iso-Depth Scaling Laws for Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Fits a joint scaling law over an iso-depth pretraining sweep of looped language models and measures a recurrence-equivalence exponent of 0.46, so replacing unique blocks with shared recurrences raises validation loss at matched training compute.
tldr.zh: 在循环语言模型的等深度预训练扫描上拟合联合 scaling law，测得 recurrence-equivalence 指数为 0.46，说明在训练算力匹配时用共享的循环替换独立块会提高验证损失。

papers.title: Hyperloop Transformers

tldr.en: Hyperloop Transformers loop the middle block and add loop-level hyper-connections with matrix-valued residual streams; across scales they compare well with depth-matched Transformer and mHC baselines while using approximately 50% fewer parameters.
tldr.zh: Hyperloop Transformer 只循环中段模块，并在每次循环后用 hyper-connections 写入矩阵形式的多路残差流；在多个规模上，它用约 50% 更少的参数，与深度匹配的 Transformer 和 mHC 基线相比表现良好。

papers.title: Universal Transformers Need Memory: Depth-State Trade-offs in Adaptive Recursive Reasoning

tldr.en: Studies learned memory tokens in a single-block Universal Transformer with ACT on Sudoku-Extreme; without them no configuration reaches non-trivial accuracy, and inverting the halting-router bias to -3 avoids an initialization trap that breaks most runs.
tldr.zh: 研究单块 Universal Transformer 加 ACT 在 Sudoku-Extreme 上使用可学习 memory token 的效果；没有 memory token 时任何配置都达不到有意义的准确率，把停止路由器的偏置反转为 -3 可避开导致多数训练失败的初始化陷阱。

papers.title: Associative-State Universal Transformers: Sparse Retrieval Meets Structured Recurrence

tldr.en: UniMatrix, a Universal Transformer style byte-level LM, reuses one shared matrix-state recurrent block across depth; it slightly beats a parameter-matched Transformer on WikiText-2 (5.084 and 5.083 vs 5.124 bits-per-byte) but stays near chance on associative recall until sparse pointer retrieval reaches 75.6 percent.
tldr.zh: UniMatrix 是 Universal Transformer 式的字节级 LM，在深度上反复复用同一个共享的矩阵状态循环块；在 WikiText-2 上它略优于参数匹配的 Transformer（5.084 和 5.083 对 5.124 bits-per-byte），但在联想回忆上接近随机水平，直到加入稀疏指针检索后才达到 75.6%。

papers.title: State Stream Transformer (SST) V2: Parallel Training of Nonlinear Recurrence for Latent Space Reasoning

tldr.en: SST V2 adds an FFN-driven latent state stream at every decoder layer, carried across positions and across repeated full-stack passes on one token; co-trained into a 27B backbone, with an oracle picking one to four passes per token it reaches a 61.11% GPQA-Diamond capacity bound, +15.15 points over a matched baseline.
tldr.zh: SST V2 在每个解码器层加入由 FFN 驱动的潜在状态流，状态在位置之间以及同一 token 上重复运行整个层栈时传递；共训练进 27B 主干后，由 oracle 为每个 token 选择一到四次前向，它在 GPQA-Diamond 上的能力上界为 61.11%，比匹配的微调基线高 15.15 个百分点。

papers.title: RD-ViT: Recurrent-Depth Vision Transformer for Semantic Segmentation with Reduced Data Dependence Extending the Recurrent-Depth Transformer Architecture to Dense Prediction

tldr.en: RD-ViT replaces a ViT's unique blocks with one shared block looped T times between prelude and coda blocks, with LTI-stable injection and ACT halting; on ACDC cardiac MRI it beats standard ViT at 10% training data (Dice 0.774 vs 0.762), and its 3D MoE variant reaches Dice 0.812 with 3.0M parameters.
tldr.zh: RD-ViT 用一个在 prelude 与 coda 之间循环 T 次的共享块替代 ViT 中各不相同的 Transformer 块，并加入 LTI 稳定注入和 ACT 停止机制；在 ACDC 心脏 MRI 分割上，它在 10% 训练数据时优于标准 ViT（Dice 0.774 vs 0.762），3D MoE 版本以 3.0M 参数达到 Dice 0.812。

papers.title: SMolLM: Small Language Models Learn Small Molecular Grammar

tldr.en: SMolLM, a 53K-parameter weight-shared Transformer, generates novel SMILES with 95% validity on ZINC-250K, outperforming a standard GPT with 10 times more parameters; across passes the same block resolves brackets first, rings second and valence last.
tldr.zh: SMolLM 是 53K 参数的权重共享 Transformer，在 ZINC-250K 上生成新 SMILES 的有效率为 95%，优于参数多 10 倍的标准 GPT；同一个块在逐次循环中先解决括号，再解决环，最后解决化合价。

papers.title: Is One Layer Enough? Understanding Inference Dynamics in Tabular Foundation Models

tldr.en: Studying layerwise dynamics in 6 tabular in-context learning models, the paper finds substantial depthwise redundancy that suggests iterative refinement; as a proof of concept, a single Transformer block looped six times uses only 20% of the original model's parameters with comparable performance.
tldr.zh: 论文分析 6 个表格上下文学习模型的逐层动态，发现深度方向存在大量冗余，提示推理过程在做迭代精炼；作为概念验证，单个 Transformer 块循环六次的模型只用原模型 20% 的参数就取得相当的性能。

papers.title: Transformers Efficiently Perform In-Context Logistic Regression via Normalized Gradient Descent

tldr.en: Constructs softmax transformers whose layers each run one normalized gradient descent step for in-context logistic regression, and proves that training one self-attention layer under one-step gradient descent supervision and looping it yields such a model, with convergence and OOD guarantees.
tldr.zh: 构造出每层执行一步归一化梯度下降、用于 in-context 逻辑回归的 softmax Transformer，并证明用一步梯度下降监督训练单个自注意力层再循环应用即可得到这种模型，同时给出收敛和分布外泛化保证。

papers.title: Bifurcation Models: Learning Set-Valued Solution Maps with Weight-Tied Dynamics

tldr.en: Bifurcation models iterate a weight-tied update so different initializations converge to different stable equilibria; the paper proves this represents broad set-valued maps with locally Lipschitz branches, and on frustrated Ising models the dynamics find multiple valid equilibria without branch labels.
tldr.zh: Bifurcation 模型反复迭代同一个权重共享的更新，让不同初始化收敛到不同的稳定平衡点；论文证明这种方式能表示分支局部 Lipschitz 的广泛集值映射，并且在受挫 Ising 模型上，该动力学无需分支标签就能找到多个有效平衡点。

papers.title: Revisiting Transformer Layer Parameterization Through Causal Energy Minimization

tldr.en: CEM casts weight-tied attention and gated MLPs as gradient steps on energy functions and repeats these steps within a layer; T=2 consistently improves on T=1, recursive CEM attention can beat the Llama baseline with fewer parameters, and simply reapplying the same block gives little or no gain.
tldr.zh: CEM 把权重绑定的注意力和门控 MLP 视为能量函数上的梯度步，并在同一层内重复这些步；T=2 稳定优于 T=1，递归 CEM 注意力能以更少参数超过 Llama 基线，而简单地重复使用同一个块几乎没有收益。

papers.title: Memory-Efficient Looped Transformer: Decoupling Compute from Memory in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: MELT, fine-tuned from Ouro, keeps one KV cache per layer that is shared across loops and updated by a learned gate; it outperforms comparable-size LLMs with a similar memory footprint, far smaller than Ouro's.
tldr.zh: MELT 从 Ouro 微调而来，每层只保留一份跨循环共享、由可学习门控更新的 KV cache；它优于参数规模相当的标准 LLM，显存占用与之相近，远小于 Ouro。

papers.title: Sparse Layers are Critical to Scaling Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Compares dense and MoE transformers with and without looping; Looped-MoE out-scales the standard baseline while dense looped models do not, since routing picks different experts per pass, and loop boundaries are better early-exit points.
tldr.zh: 比较带循环和不带循环的 dense 与 MoE Transformer；Looped-MoE 的 scaling 优于标准基线而 dense 循环模型不然，原因是路由在每一遍激活不同的专家；循环边界也是更好的 early exit 点。

papers.title: LoopVLA: Learning Sufficiency in Recurrent Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Models

tldr.en: LoopVLA iterates a shared Transformer block over multimodal tokens, producing a candidate action and a learned sufficiency score at each iteration to decide when to stop; on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus and VLA-Arena it reduces parameters by 45% and improves inference throughput by up to 1.7 times.
tldr.zh: LoopVLA 用共享的 Transformer 块反复细化多模态 token，每次迭代都输出候选动作和学习得到的充分性分数来决定何时停止；在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 VLA-Arena 上，它把参数量减少 45%，推理吞吐量最多提升 1.7 倍。

papers.title: Minimum Neural Weight Norm = Kolmogorov Complexity

tldr.en: Proves that in looped neural networks with constant-precision weights (stated for a looped Transformer block), the smallest weight norm of a network computing a function is asymptotically equivalent to its Kolmogorov complexity divided by its logarithm, linking norm minimization to algorithmic simplicity.
tldr.zh: 证明在常数精度权重的循环神经网络中（定理以循环 Transformer 块表述），计算某函数的网络的最小权重范数渐近等价于该函数的 Kolmogorov 复杂度除以其对数，从而把范数最小化与算法简单性联系起来。

papers.title: LoopUS: Recasting Pretrained LLMs into Looped Latent Refinement Models

tldr.en: LoopUS splits a pretrained LLM into encoder, looped reasoning block and decoder, adding a selective gate, random deep supervision and a confidence head for early exit; this improves reasoning-oriented performance without recurrent training from scratch.
tldr.zh: LoopUS 把预训练 LLM 拆成 encoder、循环的推理块和 decoder，并加入选择性门控、随机深度监督和用于提前退出的置信度头；无需从头训练循环模型即可提升偏推理任务的表现。

papers.title: Latent Chain-of-Thought Improves Structured-Data Transformers

tldr.en: Latent chain-of-thought for structured-data transformers compresses query-position hidden states into feedback tokens, appends them to the input and reruns the same transformer; it beats a same-depth baseline on 7/9 time-series datasets (+12.63% average gain) and 23/27 tabular datasets (+3.25% average gain).
tldr.zh: 面向结构化数据 Transformer 的潜在思维链把查询位置的隐藏状态压缩成反馈 token，追加到输入后再次运行同一个 Transformer；它在 7/9 个时间序列数据集（平均增益 +12.63%）和 23/27 个表格数据集（平均增益 +3.25%）上优于同深度基线。

papers.title: Solve the Loop: Attractor Models for Language and Reasoning

tldr.en: Attractor Models refine a backbone's output embedding by solving for a fixed point with implicit gradients, keeping training memory constant; a 770M model outperforms a 1.3B Transformer trained on twice as many tokens.
tldr.zh: Attractor Models 先由 backbone 给出输出嵌入，再由 attractor 模块求解不动点进行精炼，并用隐式微分求梯度，训练显存不随有效深度增长；770M 的 Attractor Model 超过用两倍 token 训练的 1.3B Transformer。

papers.title: One Pass Is Not Enough: Recursive Latent Refinement for Generative Models

tldr.en: RTM swaps the single-pass MLP mapping network of style-based generators for a TRM-style shared block iterated in nested refinement cycles; with IMLE it reaches the highest precision and recall among current state-of-the-art approaches at competitive FID, and it also improves StyleGAN2 and StyleGAN2-ADA.
tldr.zh: RTM 把风格生成器中单次前向的 MLP 映射网络换成 TRM 式共享块，在嵌套的细化循环中迭代；结合 IMLE 时，它在 FID 保持竞争力的同时取得当前最先进方法中最高的 precision 和 recall，也能提升 StyleGAN2 和 StyleGAN2-ADA。

papers.title: Reshape and Recur: Improving SSMs with Input Reshaping and Depth Recurrence

tldr.en: Reshape and Recur reuses SSM blocks periodically across depth in LRU, S5, LinOSS and LrcSSM on time-series tasks; one block applied 6 times cuts parameters by 5.3-5.9× while staying competitive, and adaptive inference typically picks 2 to 5 repetitions while maintaining classification performance.
tldr.zh: Reshape and Recur 在 LRU、S5、LinOSS 和 LrcSSM 中沿深度周期性复用 SSM 块处理时间序列任务；单个块重复 6 次可把参数量减少 5.3-5.9×，性能仍有竞争力，自适应推理通常选择 2 到 5 次重复，同时保持分类性能。

papers.title: LoopQ: Quantization for Looped Language Models

tldr.en: LoopQ quantizes looped LMs with one shared quantized backbone plus loop-aware activation scaling, cross-loop state alignment and trajectory-aware calibration; under W4A4 it achieves a 67.8% average relative improvement in five-task mean accuracy across four backbones over the strongest static PTQ baseline.
tldr.zh: LoopQ 对循环语言模型做训练后量化，保留一个共享的量化主干，并加入循环感知的激活缩放、跨循环状态对齐和轨迹感知校准；在 W4A4 下，相比最强的静态 PTQ 基线，它在四个主干上的五任务平均准确率平均相对提升 67.8%。

papers.title: One Model, Two Roles: Emergent Specialization in a Shared Recurrent Transformer

tldr.en: AIR reuses one Transformer for both latent updates of an HRM/TRM-style reasoner and injects the input only into L-updates; on Sudoku-Extreme and Maze, z_H acts as a committed proposal state while z_L keeps local uncertainty, and specialization needs the shared model to tell the two update types apart.
tldr.zh: AIR 在 HRM/TRM 式推理器中用同一个 Transformer 完成两种隐状态更新，只在 L 更新中注入输入；在 Sudoku-Extreme 和 Maze 上，z_H 表现为已确定的候选解状态，z_L 保留局部不确定性，而角色分化要求共享模型能区分两类更新。

papers.title: Simply Stabilizing the Loop via Fully Looped Transformer

tldr.en: Fully Looped Transformer injects the previous loop's output into every layer by reusing self-attention, adding no parameters; it curbs residual explosion and gradient oscillation and trains stably up to 12 loop iterations, where baselines collapse.
tldr.zh: Fully Looped Transformer 通过复用 self-attention 把上一遍循环的输出注入每一层，不增加参数；它抑制残差爆炸和梯度振荡，可稳定训练到 12 次循环，而基线循环模型在这一设置下会崩溃。

papers.title: Generative Recursive Reasoning

tldr.en: GRAM makes recursive reasoning models stochastic latent-variable generative models trained by amortized variational inference, scaling inference by recursion depth and parallel trajectory sampling; it beats deterministic recursive baselines on structured and multi-solution reasoning.
tldr.zh: GRAM 把递归推理模型变成带随机潜在轨迹的隐变量生成模型，用摊销变分推断训练，推理时可按递归深度和并行采样的轨迹数扩展；在结构化推理和多解约束满足任务上优于确定性的循环和递归基线。

papers.title: Probabilistic Tiny Recursive Model

tldr.en: PTRM injects Gaussian noise at each deep recursion step of a trained TRM to run parallel trajectories and selects among them with its Q head; without retraining, Sudoku-Extreme accuracy rises from 87.4% to 98.75%.
tldr.zh: PTRM 在训练好的 TRM 每个深度递归步注入高斯噪声以并行运行多条轨迹，并用模型自带的 Q head 选出答案；无需重新训练，Sudoku-Extreme 准确率从 87.4% 提高到 98.75%。

papers.title: HRM-Text: Efficient Pretraining Beyond Scaling

tldr.en: HRM-Text pretrains a hierarchical recurrent language model with MagicNorm, warmup deep credit assignment and a task-completion objective on instruction-response pairs; a 1B model on 40 billion unique tokens performs competitively with 2-7B open models.
tldr.zh: HRM-Text 用 MagicNorm、warmup deep credit assignment 和基于指令-回复对的任务完成目标预训练分层循环语言模型；在 40 billion 个不重复 token 上训练的 1B 模型与 2-7B 参数的开源模型表现相当。

papers.title: LT2: Linear-Time Looped Transformers

tldr.en: LT2 replaces softmax attention in looped transformers with linear or sparse attention; looping refines linear-attention memory and widens the sparse receptive field, and hybrid variants match or surpass the standard looped transformer at lower cost.
tldr.zh: LT2 把循环 Transformer 中的 softmax 注意力换成线性或稀疏注意力；循环会迭代细化线性注意力的记忆并扩大稀疏注意力的有效感受野，混合变体以更低成本达到或超过标准循环 Transformer。

papers.title: Equilibrium Reasoners: Learning Attractors Enables Scalable Reasoning

tldr.en: Equilibrium Reasoners frame iterative latent reasoning as learning task-conditioned attractors and scale depth and breadth at test time; gains track convergence to solution attractors, reaching over 99% on Sudoku-Extreme versus 2.6% for feedforward models.
tldr.zh: Equilibrium Reasoners 把迭代式隐空间推理视为学习任务条件下的吸引子，并在测试时沿深度和广度扩展计算；收益与向解吸引子的收敛程度紧密相关，在 Sudoku-Extreme 上准确率超过 99%，而前馈模型只有 2.6%。

papers.title: Training-Free Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Loops a contiguous mid-stack block of a frozen checkpoint at inference without training; naive reapplication usually hurts, but damped sub-steps of the block's ODE update help, e.g. +2.64 pp MMLU-Pro on Qwen3-4B-Instruct.
tldr.zh: 在推理时不经训练地循环冻结 checkpoint 中一段连续的中间层块；朴素重复通常会降低性能，而把循环看作该块 ODE 更新的阻尼子步则能带来提升，例如 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 在 MMLU-Pro 上提高 +2.64 pp。

papers.title: Boosting Inference with Guided Reasoning: Stochastic Exploration for Recursive Models

tldr.en: Views TRM inference as approximate inference over latent trajectories: noise in the inner recursion proposes neighbouring trajectories, which the model's early-stopping head reweights in a particle filter; without retraining, Sudoku-Extreme exact-solve accuracy rises from 85.9% to 98.0% and PPBench from 62.5% to 77.9%.
tldr.zh: 把 TRM 的推理视为对潜在推理轨迹的近似推断：在内层递归中注入噪声以提出相邻轨迹，再用模型自带的提前停止头在粒子滤波中对其重新加权；无需重新训练，Sudoku-Extreme 的精确求解率从 85.9% 提高到 98.0%，PPBench 从 62.5% 提高到 77.9%。

papers.title: Do Language Models Need Sleep? Offline Recurrence for Improved Online Inference

tldr.en: An SSM-attention hybrid 'sleeps' before evicting its KV cache, looping its whole block stack N times over the accumulated context to update SSM fast weights, then predicts in one pass; on a cellular-automaton task the no-loop model stays near 10% exact accuracy, while three and four sleep loops exceed 30%.
tldr.zh: SSM-attention 混合模型在清空 KV cache 前进入“睡眠”，在累积的上下文上把整个层栈循环 N 次以更新 SSM 快速权重，之后用单次前向完成预测；在元胞自动机任务上，不循环的模型精确准确率约为 10%，三次和四次睡眠循环则超过 30%。

papers.title: Looped Diffusion Language Models

tldr.en: LoopMDM loops a few early-middle layers of a masked diffusion language model, sampling the loop count in training; it matches same-size MDMs with up to 3.3× fewer training FLOPs, beats them by up to 8.5 points on GSM8K, and scales inference compute by adding loops.
tldr.zh: LoopMDM 循环掩码扩散语言模型中靠前的几个中间层，训练时随机采样循环次数；它达到同规模 MDM 的性能所需的训练 FLOPs 最多少 3.3×，在 GSM8K 上最多高出 8.5 分，并能通过增加循环次数扩展推理计算。

papers.title: Stabilizing Recurrent Dynamics for Test-Time Scalable Latent Reasoning in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: STARS trains looped LMs with Jacobian spectral radius regularization and random loop sampling so latent states approach stable fixed points, giving reliable test-time scaling on arithmetic and less degradation with deeper recurrence in math reasoning.
tldr.zh: STARS 用 Jacobian 谱半径正则和随机循环次数采样训练循环语言模型，使隐状态趋向稳定不动点；在算术任务上实现可靠的 test-time scaling，在数学推理中循环加深时性能下降更少。

papers.title: Latent Recurrent Transformer: Architecture Exploration, Training Strategies, and Scaling Behavior

tldr.en: LRT feeds the previous token's high-level hidden state into the next token's layers; at matched effective compute it improves BPB and CORE and matches a three-loop Transformer in BPB, with one forward per token.
tldr.zh: LRT 把前一个 token 的高层隐藏状态送入下一个 token 的各层；在等效算力相同时提升 BPB 和 CORE，BPB 与三遍循环 Transformer 持平，且每个 token 仍只需一次前向。

papers.title: A Dual-Path Architecture for Scaling Compute and Capacity in LLMs

tldr.en: Each layer pairs a deep sublayer re-applied K times with shared parameters and a wide sublayer with an enlarged FFN applied once, mixed by per-token gates; at two FLOP budgets this beats iso-FLOP loop-only and width-only controls with 17-33% fewer parameters than the width-scaled baseline.
tldr.zh: 每层并行放置一个以共享参数重复 K 次的深子层和一个只算一次、FFN 加宽的宽子层，并用按 token 的门控组合两者；在两个 FLOP 预算下，它优于同 FLOP 的纯循环和纯加宽对照，参数比加宽基线少 17-33%。

papers.title: Déjà View: Looping Transformers for Multi-View 3D Reconstruction

tldr.en: DéjàView applies a single looped transformer block to per-view features for K refinement steps in multi-view 3D reconstruction; it matches or beats much larger feed-forward models on five benchmarks and beats an untied per-step variant.
tldr.zh: DéjàView 在多视角 3D 重建中把同一个循环 transformer block 在每个视角的特征上应用 K 步精炼；在五个基准上达到或超过大得多的前馈模型，也优于每步参数独立的变体。

papers.title: Revisiting Padded Transformer Expressivity: Which Architectural Choices Matter and Which Don't

tldr.en: The paper shows that padded Transformers' expressivity is robust to attention type, width and uniformity, depending mainly on precision and depth; looping adds circuit-like sequential processing: log^d N-looped constant-precision Transformers reach FO-uniform AC^d, growing-precision ones FO-uniform TC^d.
tldr.zh: 论文证明 padded Transformer 的表达能力对注意力类型、宽度和一致性假设都很稳健，主要取决于数值精度和深度；循环带来类似电路的顺序处理，log^d N 次循环的常数精度 Transformer 达到 FO-uniform AC^d，增长精度的则达到 FO-uniform TC^d。

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought and Compressed Looped Transformers: A Memory-Budget Separation

tldr.en: Proves that a looped Transformer whose recurrent state is a small set of latent slots remains a small-space reasoner however long it runs, so under a standard complexity assumption it cannot decide P-complete problems that polynomial-length CoT can; loops carrying state at every input position avoid this limit.
tldr.zh: 证明循环状态只有少量隐变量槽位的循环 Transformer 无论运行多少步都仍是小空间推理器，因此在标准复杂度假设下无法判定多项式长度 CoT 能判定的 P 完全问题；在每个输入位置都保存状态的循环不受此限制。

papers.title: Fixed-Point Masked Generative Modeling

tldr.en: FP-MGMs replace a masked generative denoiser's middle layers with a fixed-point solver over shared attention layers, plus cross-step consistency and warm-starts; on OpenWebText versus MDLM, parameters fall 38.8% and generative perplexity improves from 830.8 to 101.8 at 96 transformer-block forward passes.
tldr.zh: FP-MGM 把掩码生成模型去噪器的中间层换成在共享注意力层上迭代求不动点的模块，并加入跨步一致性损失和求解器热启动；在 OpenWebText 上与 MDLM 相比，参数减少 38.8%，在 96 次 Transformer 块前向的预算下生成困惑度从 830.8 降到 101.8。

papers.title: Looped Transformers with Layer Normalization Provably Learn the Power Method

tldr.en: Proves that a looped linear Transformer with layer normalization, trained by gradient descent only for principal component prediction, converges to the power method, each self-attention layer performing one power iteration; a Transformer without LN cannot exactly learn it even with layerwise guidance.
tldr.zh: 证明带 layer normalization（LN）的循环线性 Transformer 只以主成分预测为目标、用梯度下降训练时，会收敛到幂迭代法（power method），每个 self-attention 层执行一次幂迭代；不带 LN 的 Transformer 即使有逐层指导也无法精确学到该方法。

papers.title: CART: Context-Anchored Recurrent Transformer -- A Parameter-Efficient Architecture with Learned Stability

tldr.en: CART loops one shared core block R times over K and V computed once by a multi-layer prelude, with a learned LTI gate for stability; prelude depth P dominates loop count R, and at d=1024 it trails a parameter-matched dense baseline by 1-2% at stored-parameter parity and ~10% at effective-parameter parity.
tldr.zh: CART 让一个共享核心块循环 R 次，核心块只交叉注意由多层 prelude 一次性算出的 K 和 V，并用可学习的 LTI 门保持稳定；prelude 深度 P 比循环次数 R 更关键，在 d=1024 时，它在存储参数对齐下比参数匹配的 dense 基线差 1-2%，在有效参数对齐下差 ~10%。

papers.title: LoopMoE: Unifying Iterative Computation with Mixture-of-Experts for Language Modeling

tldr.en: LoopMoE loops an MoE block with iteration- and token-conditioned normalization (IterAdaLN); over a vanilla MoE with identical parameters and FLOPs, its average gain grows from over 1 point at 3B to approximately 3 at 9B.
tldr.zh: LoopMoE 循环复用一个 MoE 块，并用同时以迭代序号和每个 token 隐状态为条件的归一化（IterAdaLN）区分各次迭代；与总参数和每 token FLOPs 相同的 vanilla MoE 相比，平均提升从 3B 规模的 1 分以上增至 9B 规模的约 3 分。

papers.title: Test-Time Compute Scaling for ASR with Depth-Conditioned Looped Transformers

tldr.en: LARM loops a shared Transformer block as an ASR acoustic encoder, adding sparse CTC checkpoints, supervision-clock embeddings, FiLM depth conditioning and delayed soft-posterior feedback; on LibriSpeech it improves WER as inference loops increase and is competitive with deeper unshared-parameter baselines.
tldr.zh: LARM 把共享的 Transformer 块循环用作 ASR 声学编码器，并加入稀疏 CTC 检查点、监督时钟嵌入、FiLM 深度调制和延迟软后验反馈；在 LibriSpeech 上，WER 随推理循环次数增加而改善，性能与更深的不共享参数基线相当。

papers.title: Skip a Layer or Loop It? Learning Program-of-Layers in LLMs

tldr.en: Shows that frozen pretrained LLMs admit per-input programs that skip or repeat layer segments, and trains a lightweight predictor of such programs that improves math reasoning accuracy over standard inference, often using fewer layers.
tldr.zh: 发现冻结的预训练 LLM 对每个输入都存在跳过或重复层段的执行程序，并训练一个轻量预测网络生成这类程序，在数学推理上比标准推理更准确，且常常执行更少的层。

papers.title: Rethinking Depth: A study of the Recursive-Transformer for Speech Recognition

tldr.en: Studies Recursive-Transformer ASR encoders, including a Latent-Recursive-Transformer that loops a shared middle block between a prelude and a coda; with a restricted number of loops it performs comparably to standard Transformers while reducing the parameter count by 66%.
tldr.zh: 研究 ASR 编码器中的 Recursive-Transformer，包括在 prelude 与 coda 之间循环共享中间块的 Latent-Recursive-Transformer；在限制循环次数时，它与标准 Transformer 性能相当，同时把参数量减少 66%。

papers.title: Slots, Transitions, Loops: Learning Composable World Models for ARC

tldr.en: Loop-OWM encodes ARC grids into color-prototype slots, summarizes demonstrations into task tokens, and applies a shared transition module for 4 recurrent steps; the 10.63M model reaches 68.5 on ARC-1 and 22.5 on ARC-2 (pass@2), above the 18M LoopViT-L at 65.8 and 14.2.
