tldr.zh: Loop-OWM 把 ARC 网格编码为颜色原型 slot，把示例对汇总为任务 token，再用共享的转移模块循环 4 步更新查询状态；10.63M 参数的模型在 ARC-1 和 ARC-2 上 pass@2 分别为 68.5 和 22.5，高于 18M 的 LoopViT-L（65.8 和 14.2）。

papers.title: Tying the Loop -- Tied Expert Layers in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models

tldr.en: Expert Tying shares MoE expert weights across groups of consecutive layers while keeping routing and attention per layer; on OLMoE, Qwen3 and DeepSeek-style MoEs it reduces memory footprint by almost 2x, and tying in groups of four cuts total parameters by up to 52% with negligible quality loss.
tldr.zh: Expert Tying 让连续若干层共享 MoE 专家权重，同时保留逐层独立的路由和注意力；在 OLMoE、Qwen3 和 DeepSeek 式 MoE 上，它把内存占用降低近 2x，按每四层一组共享时总参数最多减少 52%，质量损失可忽略。

papers.title: Recursive Scaling in Masked Diffusion Models

tldr.en: R-MDMs apply one shared denoising Transformer L times within each masked-diffusion step; recursion matches substantially larger non-recursive models at matched FLOPs, and entropy-guided rules for loop count and token commits improve the quality–compute frontier on Sudoku, Countdown, RNA and executable math generation.
tldr.zh: R-MDM 在掩码扩散模型的每个去噪步内把同一个共享去噪 Transformer 重复应用 L 次；在 FLOPs 相同时，递归可追平大得多的非递归模型，而用熵决定循环次数和提交哪些 token 的自适应规则在 Sudoku、Countdown、RNA 和可执行数学程序生成上改善了质量与算力的权衡。

papers.title: LoopCoder-v2: Only Loop Once for Efficient Test-Time Computation Scaling

tldr.en: LoopCoder-v2 trains 7B Parallel Loop Transformer coders on 18T tokens; two loops lift SWE-bench Verified from 43.0 (non-looped) to 64.4, but three or more regress as later-loop gains shrink against a roughly fixed position-offset cost.
tldr.zh: LoopCoder-v2 在 18T token 上训练 7B 的 Parallel Loop Transformer 代码模型；两遍循环把 SWE-bench Verified 从不循环时的 43.0 提到 64.4，三遍及以上反而退步，因为后续循环的收益递减，而位置偏移代价大致不变。

papers.title: Fixed-Point Reasoners: Stable and Adaptive Deep Looped Transformers

tldr.en: FPRM stabilizes deep looped Transformers with pre-norm layers and residual scaling and halts when the hidden state reaches a fixed point, adapting compute to task difficulty; it is effective on Sudoku, Maze, state-tracking and ARC-AGI.
tldr.zh: FPRM 用 pre-norm 层和残差缩放稳定深层循环 Transformer，并在隐藏状态到达不动点时停止，使算力随任务难度变化；在 Sudoku、Maze、状态追踪和 ARC-AGI 上有效。

papers.title: Looped World Models

tldr.en: LoopWM refines latent environment states by iterating a parameter-shared Transformer block between a prelude and coda, with a spectrally constrained update and Poisson-sampled loop counts; on ScienceWorld text world modelling, the about 1B-parameter model beats claude-opus-4-6-max by 21.2% on EM.
tldr.zh: LoopWM 在 prelude 和 coda 之间迭代一个参数共享的 Transformer 块来精炼潜在环境状态，采用谱约束的状态更新和按 Poisson 分布采样的循环次数；在 ScienceWorld 文本世界建模任务上，这个约 1B 参数的模型在 EM 上比 claude-opus-4-6-max 高 21.2%。

papers.title: Loop-$μ$P: Residual Scaling and Hyperparameter Transfer in Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Loop-μP scales each residual branch of a looped Transformer by 1/N for N loops, combined with Depth-μP's L^{-1/2} for depth L, since a shared layer adds positively correlated increments every loop; in language modeling the smallest model's tuned base learning rate stays best for up to 8 loops and 384 executed layers.
tldr.zh: Loop-μP 指出共享层在每次循环都加入正相关的增量，因此把循环 Transformer 的每个残差分支按循环次数 N 乘以 1/N，并与 Depth-μP 针对深度 L 的 L^{-1/2} 因子结合；在语言建模中，在最小模型上调好的基础学习率在最多 8 次循环、执行深度最多 384 层时仍然最优。

papers.title: Repeated Shared Access Enables Grokking, but Edit Propagation Depends on an Addressable Memory

tldr.en: Crossing loop recurrence with shared memory on synthetic knowledge-graph QA, looped recomputation and memory rereading both cross the OOD grokking barrier a dense transformer fails, but a factual edit reaches 2-hop queries mainly with memory (LMC 0.78-0.92, Dense+Mem 0.71-0.96), weakly in Loop (0.04-0.30).
tldr.zh: 在合成知识图谱问答上交叉比较循环递归与共享记忆：循环重算和反复读取记忆都能跨过 dense Transformer 跨不过的 OOD grokking 门槛，但单条事实编辑向 2-hop 问题的传播主要依赖记忆（LMC 0.78-0.92，Dense+Mem 0.71-0.96），在 Loop 中很弱（0.04-0.30）。

papers.title: Dense Supervision Is Not Enough: The Readout Blind Spot in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Per-loop cross-entropy through RMSNorm readouts cannot see hidden-state scale, so 44M and 129M looped Transformers without inter-loop normalization reach final norms in the thousands or tens of thousands; scale-visible readouts or norm penalties keep norms in the tens and lower perplexity at matched inference depth.
tldr.zh: 经 RMSNorm 读出的逐循环交叉熵看不到隐状态尺度，因此没有循环间归一化的 44M 和 129M 循环 Transformer 的最终隐状态范数会增长到数千甚至数万；可见尺度的读出或范数惩罚能把范数控制在几十，并在相同推理深度下降低困惑度。

papers.title: What Survives When You Compress a Recursive Reasoner for the Edge?

tldr.en: Compresses recursive reasoning models (TRM, HRM) for edge hardware: pruning, distillation and linear attention drive puzzle-exact accuracy to zero while cell accuracy holds; one recursive cycle matches full-depth accuracy at 6x fewer FLOPs, and calibrated INT4 brings the backbone to 3.3 MB, inside a 4 MB budget.
tldr.zh: 研究如何为边缘硬件压缩递归推理模型（TRM、HRM）：剪枝、蒸馏和线性注意力让整题精确准确率降到零，而单元格准确率保持不变；只跑一个递归周期即可用少 6x 的 FLOPs 达到全深度准确率，校准后的 INT4 把主干压到 3.3 MB，满足 4 MB 预算。

papers.title: Flow Reasoning Models: Turning Flows Into Efficient Recurrent Reasoners

tldr.en: Flow Reasoning Models feed their own clean-solution prediction back into the same flow denoiser and train it with Fixed-Point Forcing on self-generated states; they solve 99.5%, 100.0% and 99.9% of Sudoku-Extreme, Zebra and Maze-Unique and match the next-best 98.7% on Sudoku-Extreme with 44× fewer inference FLOPs.
tldr.zh: Flow Reasoning Models 把 flow 模型对完整解的预测反馈回同一个去噪器做循环精炼，并用 Fixed-Point Forcing 在模型自身推理产生的状态上训练；它在 Sudoku-Extreme、Zebra 和 Maze-Unique 上的求解率分别为 99.5%、100.0% 和 99.9%，在 Sudoku-Extreme 上以少 44× 的推理 FLOPs 达到次优方法 98.7% 的峰值求解率。

papers.title: Stabilizing Extrapolation in Looped Transformers via Learned Stochastic Stopping

tldr.en: Traces OOD variance in looped Transformers' length generalization to a spurious correlation between sequence length and loop count; random training loop counts reduce it, and learned stochastic stopping (RL-Halting) often improves the accuracy-stability trade-off on binary addition, Dyck-1, Unique Set and Copy.
tldr.zh: 把循环 Transformer 在长度泛化上分布外方差高的问题归因于序列长度与循环次数之间的虚假相关；训练时随机化循环次数可降低这一方差，学习得到的随机停止（RL-Halting）在 binary addition、Dyck-1、Unique Set 和 Copy 上常能改善准确率与稳定性之间的权衡。

papers.title: Bridging the Gap Between Latent and Explicit Reasoning with Looped Transformers

tldr.en: LOTUS loops a pretrained LM over padded latent blocks and supervises each latent position with its gold CoT-step token; at 3B scale it closes the gap to explicit CoT while cutting thought-phase latency 2.5x-6.9x.
tldr.zh: LOTUS 让预训练语言模型在填充的 latent 块上循环计算，并用对应 CoT 步骤的 gold token 逐位置监督每个 latent；在 3B 规模上它弥合了与显式 CoT 的差距，同时把思考阶段延迟降低 2.5x-6.9x。

papers.title: CHERRY: Compressed Hierarchical Experts with Recurrent Representational Yield

tldr.en: CHERRY merges adjacent layers of a 48-layer Korean language model into 6 unique blocks, unrolls the middle layers as a recurrent core and heals the result with selected-token supervision; the 227M model reaches loss 2.934 vs 2.926 for a 566M dense model, and MoEE fusion of compressed models reaches 2.789.
tldr.zh: CHERRY 把 48 层韩语语言模型的相邻层合并为 6 个独立块，将中间层作为循环核心展开，并用选定 token 监督修复性能；227M 模型的损失为 2.934，566M 稠密模型为 2.926，压缩模型经 MoEE 融合后达到 2.789。

papers.title: DiscoLoop: Looping Discrete Embeddings and Continuous Hidden States for Multi-hop Reasoning

tldr.en: Finds that a looped transformer's first loop leaves the two-hop bridge entity decodable but misaligned with its embedding; DiscoLoop adds a decoded-embedding channel between loops and outperforms looped baselines on multi-hop tasks and in pretraining.
tldr.zh: 发现循环 Transformer 第一遍循环后两跳问题的桥接实体已可解码，但隐藏状态与其 token embedding 不对齐；DiscoLoop 在循环之间增加一条解码后的 embedding 通道，在多跳任务和预训练中都优于循环基线。

papers.title: Soft Mixture-of-Recursions: Going Deeper with Recursive Vision Transformers

tldr.en: SR-ViT recursively reuses shared intermediate ViT blocks and mixes the outputs of all recursion steps with learned token-wise weights (SoftMoR); on ImageNet-1K, raising recursion depth from T=1 to T=3 improves top-1 accuracy from 79.83% to 82.45% with only 1.1M additional parameters.
tldr.zh: SR-ViT 递归复用共享的中间 ViT 块，并用逐 token 学习的权重融合所有递归步的输出（SoftMoR）；在 ImageNet-1K 上，递归深度从 T=1 增至 T=3，top-1 准确率从 79.83% 提升到 82.45%，只增加 1.1M 参数。

papers.title: CHASE: Cache-Hole-Adapted Skip Exit for Looped State-Space Language Models

tldr.en: Loops a shared Mamba (or hybrid Mamba-Transformer) block and adapts Ouro's exit gate; since skipped steps leave cache holes in the recurrent state, CHASE continues training on cache-hole-consistent passes, keeping perplexity close to full computation while executing roughly half of the recurrent steps.
tldr.zh: 循环复用一个共享的 Mamba（或 Mamba-Transformer 混合）块，并移植 Ouro 的退出门；由于跳过的步不会写入循环状态而留下缓存空洞，CHASE 在与缓存空洞一致的前向过程上继续训练，使困惑度接近完整计算，同时只执行约一半的循环步。

papers.title: Energy-guided Recursive Model

tldr.en: ERM uses Hopfield-type memories of valid local and global structures to assign energies to a recursive model's candidate trajectories, which guide selection and suggest an effective recurrent depth; it reaches 98.97% on Sudoku, 88.04% on PPBench and 99.30% on Maze, and cuts RedPajama-V2 perplexity by 1.74%.
tldr.zh: ERM 用记录有效局部与全局结构的 Hopfield 型记忆为递归模型的候选轨迹赋予能量，用来选择候选并给出有效的递归深度范围；在 Sudoku 上达到 98.97%，PPBench 上达到 88.04%，Maze 上达到 99.30%，并把 RedPajama-V2 困惑度降低 1.74%。

papers.title: Spectral Margins and Memory Routing in Looped Transformers

tldr.en: In a small LayerNorm-based Parcae loop, fixed points are stable because the Jacobian's spectral radius stays below 1, though its distance from 1 shrinks as the carry nears 1; on multi-hop copy, carries frozen at 0.5, 0.02 or 0 match a learned carry at fixed depth, but with sampled depth 0.02 and 0 fail to train.
tldr.zh: 在一个基于 LayerNorm 的小型 Parcae 循环中，不动点之所以稳定，是因为 Jacobian 的谱半径保持在 1 以下，但它与 1 的距离随 carry 趋近 1 而缩小；在多跳复制任务上，固定深度训练时冻结在 0.5、0.02 或 0 的 carry 与可学习 carry 效果相当，而采样深度训练时 0.02 和 0 无法训练成功。

papers.title: The Equilibrium Is the Initialization: Lazy Identity Collapse in Physics-Structured Deep Equilibrium Reasoning

tldr.en: On ProofWriter entailment and graph reachability, a port-Hamiltonian DEQ with a learned initialization returns its start point as the equilibrium: bypassing the solver changes test accuracy by +0.00 percentage points in 18 of 19 training runs, which the paper traces to gradient starvation.
tldr.zh: 在 ProofWriter 蕴含判断和图可达性任务上，带学习初始化的 port-Hamiltonian DEQ 求得的均衡点就是求解器的起点：19 次训练中有 18 次完全绕过求解器后测试准确率变化 +0.00 个百分点，论文把原因追溯到梯度饥饿。

papers.title: DeepLoop: Depth Scaling for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: DeepLoop derives a residual-scaling rule for looped Transformers that counts repeated visits to shared blocks; in GPT-2 small and medium looped language models it improves validation loss and downstream accuracy once blocks are revisited.
tldr.zh: DeepLoop 为循环 Transformer 推导出考虑共享块被重复访问的残差缩放规则；在 GPT-2 small 和 medium 规模的循环语言模型上，一旦块被重复使用，它就能改善验证损失和下游准确率。

papers.title: Per-Token Fixed-Point Convergence in Depth-Recurrent Transformers

tldr.en: In a 135M-class depth-recurrent Transformer trained with randomized recursion counts, each token's state converges to a fixed point; a training-free exit that halts a token once its output stabilizes attains uniform depth-8 quality at 4.94 average loops, while a trained linear router gives no reduction.
tldr.zh: 用随机循环次数训练的 135M 级深度循环 Transformer，其循环状态会收敛到逐 token 的不动点；一种无需训练、在 token 输出稳定后即停止该 token 的规则，以平均 4.94 次循环达到统一深度 8 的质量，而训练得到的线性路由器没有减少任何深度。

papers.title: T^2MLR: Transformer with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence

tldr.en: T2MLR fuses a middle-layer state cached from the previous token into an earlier layer at the current token; it beats data- and parameter-matched Transformers, and recurrence over a middle block often beats full-layer recurrence.
tldr.zh: T2MLR 把上一个 token 缓存的中间层表示融合进当前 token 的较早层；它优于数据和参数匹配的 Transformer 基线，而且只在中间一段层上做循环往往优于全层循环。

papers.title: Looped Latent Attention: Cross-Loop KV Compression for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Looped Latent Attention, a post-training codec, stores the per-loop KV cache as compact latents and rebuilds loop-specific K/V on read; at matched cache budget it beats head-axis MLA, cross-layer sharing, KV quantization and final-loop reuse.
tldr.zh: Looped Latent Attention 是一种在模型训练后加装的 KV 缓存编解码器，把循环 Transformer 每遍的 KV 缓存存成紧凑的 latent，在注意力读取时再重建各遍的 K/V；在相同缓存预算下，它优于 head 维度的 MLA、跨层共享、KV 量化和复用末遍 KV。

papers.title: Loop the Loopies!

tldr.en: Loopie comprises two open-source looped MoE Transformers (20B with 2B active, 6B with 0.6B active) that repeat each layer in place; ablations show they outperform vanilla Transformers trained with the same compute budget.
tldr.zh: Loopie 包括两个开源的循环 MoE Transformer（20B 总参数、2B 激活，以及 6B 总参数、0.6B 激活），每一层原地重复执行；消融实验显示它们优于相同训练算力下的 vanilla Transformer 基线。

papers.title: Quantizing Recursive Reasoning Models

tldr.en: Quantizing weight-tied recursive puzzle reasoners (TRM, EqR) shows that per-tensor 4-bit activations let a systematic bias accumulate over reuse, cutting Sudoku exact accuracy from 84.1% to 0.0%; per-block activation scaling with MXInt4 restores accuracy across architectures and transfers to ARC-AGI.
tldr.zh: 对权重共享的递归谜题推理模型（TRM、EqR）做量化发现，按张量的 4-bit 激活量化会让系统性偏差随复用累积，使 Sudoku 精确解准确率从 84.1% 降到 0.0%；采用 MXInt4 的按块激活缩放可在各架构上恢复准确率，并能迁移到 ARC-AGI。

papers.title: Mobius Learning: Cyclic Depth Folding in Transformers

tldr.en: Mobius Learning runs each worker's data through a looped Transformer's block groups in a cyclically shifted order, so every group trains in shallow and deep roles; with a 124M modded GPT-2 on 2.5B FineWeb tokens, it reaches lower validation loss than a fixed-order looped Transformer at 6, 10 and 15 passes.
tldr.zh: Mobius Learning 让不同 worker 的数据以循环移位的块顺序依次经过循环 Transformer 的各个块组，使每个块组同时在浅层和深层角色上得到训练；在用 2.5B FineWeb token 训练的 124M modded GPT-2 上，它在 6、10 和 15 遍时的验证损失低于固定顺序的循环 Transformer。

papers.title: Operational Proto-Introspection in Looped Language Models: Reading Correctness Before the Answer

tldr.en: Probes the per-loop hidden states of the 2.6B looped model Ouro-RLTT: from the first 48 reasoning tokens a probe predicts answer correctness with AUROC 0.758 versus 0.515 for token confidence, prefers the correct of two answers 74% of the time, and ranks answers well at layer 8 by the third loop.
tldr.zh: 探测 2.6B 循环模型 Ouro-RLTT 每次循环的隐藏状态：读取前 48 个推理 token 的探针预测答案是否正确的 AUROC 为 0.758，token 置信度为 0.515；在同一问题的两个答案中，探针有 74% 的情况给正确答案更高分；到第三次循环时，第 8 层的答案排序探针已与最后几层一样准。

papers.title: LatentMT: Machine Translation with Latent Reasoning

tldr.en: LatentMT trains per-language-pair LoRA adapters on a frozen 2.6B-parameter looped LM (Ouro-2.6B-Thinking) run at a fixed number of recurrent steps; across 32 translation directions it matches models three to five times larger, and gains from more steps saturate after the early steps.
tldr.zh: LatentMT 在冻结的 2.6B 参数循环语言模型（Ouro-2.6B-Thinking）上为每个语言对训练 LoRA adapter，并固定循环步数；在 32 个翻译方向上，它的表现与大三到五倍的模型相当，增加循环步数的收益在前几步之后很快饱和。

papers.title: Reproducing Recurrent Transformers: The CoTFormer

tldr.en: Reproduces CoTFormer, which reapplies weight-tied layers while keeping earlier repeats attendable: perplexity results reproduce, adaptive-depth claims are less clean, and looping helps p-hop induction (roughly 0.66 vs 0.4676 test accuracy for a 1×1 Transformer) but not OOD shifted-start counting.
tldr.zh: 复现 CoTFormer（重复应用权重共享的层，并让后续重复能关注之前各次重复的状态）：困惑度结果可以复现，自适应深度的结论不够干净；循环有助于 p-hop induction（测试准确率约 0.66，1×1 Transformer 为 0.4676），但对分布外的 shifted-start 计数没有帮助。

papers.title: Adaptive Depth in Looped Transformers: Diagnosing Learned Halting Gates and Trajectory Readouts

tldr.en: Splits adaptive depth in looped Transformers into trajectory formation and exit readout; fixed-prior depth supervision plus confidence readouts often matches or beats learned halting gates, and Ouro's pretrained gates are competitive but not uniformly Pareto-optimal.
tldr.zh: 把循环 Transformer 的自适应深度拆成轨迹形成和退出读出两部分；固定先验的深度监督配合置信度读出常常追平或超过学到的停止门控，Ouro 预训练的门控有竞争力但并非处处 Pareto 最优。

papers.title: When Does Recurrence Become an Algorithm? Convergence Selection in Weight-Tied Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Trains weight-tied looped transformers on group word problems; training installs a serial frontier that solves about n_train/T_train positions per loop, and weight tying, not expressivity, selects it over the parallel scans untied models learn.
tldr.zh: 在群的字问题（group word problem）上训练权重共享的循环 Transformer；训练会形成每遍约求解 n_train/T_train 个位置的串行前沿，选出这种算法的是权重共享这一结构先验而不是表达能力，未共享权重的标准深度 Transformer 则学到并行扫描。

papers.title: Memoir: Should a Model Write to Its Memory While It Thinks?

tldr.en: Memoir asks whether each variable-depth pondering iteration should rewrite the per-sample fast memory it reads; on associative recall with key interference, read-only pondering beats the coupled arm after 240 steps (0.6557 vs 0.5203 recall, 10 of 12 seeds), and both reach 1.0000 after 960 steps.
tldr.zh: Memoir 研究可变深度的每次 pondering 迭代是否应改写它所读取的逐样本快速记忆；在带键干扰的联想回忆任务上，训练 240 步后只读 pondering 优于耦合写入（回忆率 0.6557 对 0.5203，12 个种子中赢 10 个），训练 960 步后两者都达到 1.0000。

papers.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B: Unlocking Agentic Capabilities in a Compact Model

tldr.en: Nanbeige4.2-3B is pretrained from scratch on 28T tokens as a Looped Transformer that reuses its layer stack, then post-trained with SFT and RL; it outperforms larger models including Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma4-12B on agentic benchmarks.
tldr.zh: Nanbeige4.2-3B 采用复用整个层栈的 Looped Transformer，在 28T token 上从头预训练，再经 SFT 和 RL 后训练；在 agentic 基准上超过 Qwen3.5-9B 和 Gemma4-12B 等更大的模型。

papers.title: Penelope: Localized Latent Recurrence for Efficient Structured Reasoning

tldr.en: Penelope makes a pretrained decoder-only Transformer run its lower layers once and then loop only a late interval (layers [11,16) of Llama-3.2-1B) over fixed-size memory states; after a CoT-to-latent curriculum, its accuracy is competitive with established latent-reasoning models at lower measured latency.
tldr.zh: Penelope 让预训练的 decoder-only Transformer 下层只运行一次，之后只在固定大小的记忆状态上循环一个靠后的区间（Llama-3.2-1B 的 [11,16) 层）；经 CoT 到潜在推理的渐进课程训练后，其准确率与已有潜在推理模型相当，实测延迟更低。

papers.title: Recursive transformers for semiconductor thermo-mechanical reliability

tldr.en: Compares three weight-sharing recursive Transformers, including a proposed Depth Recursive model and TRM, as surrogates for semiconductor package stress, warpage and a Laplace PDE; the Depth Recursive models give the strongest or near-strongest retrieval accuracy with among the fewest parameters and lowest FLOPs.
tldr.zh: 比较三种权重共享递归 Transformer（包括作者提出的 Depth Recursive 模型和 TRM）作为半导体封装应力、翘曲和 Laplace PDE 的代理模型；Depth Recursive 模型的检索准确率最高或接近最高，参数量和 FLOPs 也属最少之列。

papers.title: Looped Transformers with Source-Centered State Evolution

tldr.en: SCSE removes repeated input injection from looped Transformers: the shared block evolves only the hidden state's deviation from a learned input-conditioned anchor, kept an exact fixed point by a zero-deviation mask, which improves the controlled recurrent quality frontier on WikiText, web-text and LAMBADA.
tldr.zh: SCSE 去掉了循环 Transformer 每一步重复的输入注入：共享块只演化隐藏状态相对于可学习的输入条件锚点的偏差，零偏差掩码保证锚点是精确的不动点；它在 WikiText、网页文本和 LAMBADA 基准上改善了受控的循环质量前沿。

papers.title: ReLoop-UME: Recurrent Depth with Learnable Retrieval Registers for Universal Multimodal Embedding

tldr.en: ReLoop-UME, a multimodal embedding model, runs early layers once, loops a shared retrieval-forming block, then the final mapping layers, with registers carrying evidence across loops; on MMEB-V2 and MRMR it improves retrieval across backbones and runs 44.9x faster than UME-R1 and 1.5x faster than PLUME.
tldr.zh: ReLoop-UME 让多模态 embedding 模型的前几层只运行一次，循环复用参数共享的检索特征形成块，最后一轮后再接最终映射层，并用可学习的检索寄存器跨循环累积和交换证据；在 MMEB-V2 和 MRMR 上，它在不同主干上都提升了检索效果，速度比 UME-R1 快 44.9x、比 PLUME 快 1.5x。

papers.title: REIMU: Efficient Heterogeneous Hierarchical Reasoning for SSL-Based Speech Deepfake Detection

tldr.en: On SSL features for speech deepfake detection, REIMU finds that weight-shared recurrence and HRM-style hierarchy alone do not beat single-pass backbones on ASVspoof 2019 and 2021, but a heterogeneous HRM with self-attention and linear-attention modules stays competitive with 10.8% fewer downstream parameters.
tldr.zh: REIMU 在基于 SSL 特征的语音深度伪造检测上发现，权重共享循环和 HRM 式层级分解本身在 ASVspoof 2019 和 2021 上并不优于单次前向骨干，而由自注意力与线性注意力模块组成的异构 HRM 在下游参数少 10.8% 的情况下仍有竞争力。

papers.title: TextNCA: Neural Cellular Automata for Language Modeling via Hierarchical Local Attention

tldr.en: TextNCA cascades three stages (windows 8, 32, 128) that each iterate shared-weight causal windowed attention; at roughly 30M parameters on WikiText-103 it reaches 60.3 PPL vs 52.8 for Transformer-6L, a non-iterating model with the same schedule comes within +4.1 PPL, and iteration is best at T_s=4.
tldr.zh: TextNCA 级联三个阶段（窗口 8、32、128），每个阶段迭代共享权重的因果窗口注意力；在 WikiText-103 上约 30M 参数时 PPL 为 60.3，Transformer-6L 为 52.8，采用相同调度但不迭代的模型与它相差不超过 +4.1 PPL，迭代次数在 T_s=4 时最优。

papers.title: Loop-Mamba: A Loop Mamba with Degradation-Aware and Shared Memory for Old Photo Restoration

tldr.en: Loop-Mamba restores old photos by repeatedly applying a degradation-guided Mamba state-evolution operator with shared structural memory to one persistent restoration state, 3 cycles by default; on SynOld it has the best PSNR (30.13), SSIM, FSIM and ODRS among compared methods with fewer FLOPs and MACs.
tldr.zh: Loop-Mamba 在老照片修复中反复用退化引导的 Mamba 状态演化算子和共享结构记忆更新同一个持久的修复状态（默认 3 个循环）；在 SynOld 上，它的 PSNR（30.13）、SSIM、FSIM 和 ODRS 在对比方法中最好，且 FLOPs 和 MACs 更少。

papers.title: The Ignition Is Real, and It Lives at the Readout: Latent composition, difficulty-clocked ignition, and the interface-constituted commit in a recurrent-depth reasoner

tldr.en: Regrowing a published 30M-parameter recurrent-depth reasoner shows its compositional ignition is real and sits at the readout: arrival time rises with problem depth, the decision margin jumps 5.8-8.0 logits in one iteration at commitment, and intermediates never surface through the tied readout.
tldr.zh: 从头重新训练一个已发表的 30M 参数循环深度推理模型，发现其组合式“点火”真实存在且发生在读出端：到达时间随问题深度上升，提交答案时决策 margin 在一次迭代内跳升 5.8-8.0 logits，而中间结果始终无法通过与 embedding 绑定的读出层恢复。

papers.title: LoopMTP: A looped transformer guided by latent multi-token prediction

tldr.en: LoopMTP loops the whole Transformer stack, softly aligning the hidden state of loop t with the embedding of the token t steps ahead and gating information across iterations; it improves average accuracy by up to 8.1% (relative) over the non-looped baseline, with training stable for up to 15 loops.
tldr.zh: LoopMTP 循环整个 Transformer 堆叠，把第 t 次循环的隐状态软对齐到 t 步之后 token 的 embedding，并用轻量门控在各次迭代间保留有用信息；相对不循环基线，平均准确率最多相对提升 8.1%，训练在最多 15 次循环时仍保持稳定。

papers.title: MACRO: Markov Chain Routing of Transformer Layers

tldr.en: MACRO learns a task-specific Markov policy over skip, repeat and hidden-state-addition moves through a frozen LLM's layers, decoded with top-k Viterbi; it gains +5.0% average accuracy over unrouted baselines and +7.2% over Dr. LLM while cutting route-search time 9.4x (from 14.8 to 1.6 hours).
tldr.zh: MACRO 在冻结 LLM 的各层之上学习任务级 Markov 策略，支持跳层、重复层和隐藏状态相加，并用 top-k Viterbi 解码路由；它比未路由基线平均准确率高 +5.0%，比 Dr. LLM 高 +7.2%，路由搜索时间缩短 9.4x（从 14.8 小时降到 1.6 小时）。

papers.title: Iterate or Widen? When Test-Time Refinement Helps LiDAR Scene Completion: A Controlled Study of Evidence Geometry, Training Coverage, and Compute

tldr.en: For LiDAR scene completion, a 0.53M-parameter weight-tied multigrid refiner iterated on a frozen one-shot predictor beats a parameter-matched wider predictor by 0.911 mIoU points under contiguous angular removal, but adds only 0.300 under 75% thinning, where observation-family augmentation adds 5.975.
tldr.zh: 在 LiDAR 语义场景补全中，一个 0.53M 参数、每步复用同一组权重的多重网格细化器作用于冻结的单次预测器，在连续角度区域移除下比参数量匹配的更宽单次预测器高 0.911 个 mIoU 点，但在 75% 独立稀疏化下只多 0.300 个点，而观测族数据增强可多 5.975 个点。

papers.title: bioMoR: Biology-Guided Mixture-of-Recursions for Effective Genomic Learning

tldr.en: bioMoR applies Mixture-of-Recursions to omics data, adding biological-graph knowledge to embeddings, attention and the router that sets each gene or pathway token's recursion depth; across eight benchmarks it raises average macro-F1 by 8.2 percentage points over the best biology-agnostic MoR baseline.
tldr.zh: bioMoR 把 Mixture-of-Recursions 用于组学数据，在 token 嵌入、注意力以及决定每个基因或通路 token 递归深度的路由器中加入生物知识图谱；在八个基准上，它的平均 macro-F1 比最强的不含生物知识的 MoR 基线高 8.2 个百分点。

papers.title: Think Deep, Speak Once: Relit, A Recursive Latent Implicit Transformer Framework

tldr.en: ReLIT places a trainable recursive Transformer block with learned halting between a frozen TinyLlama-1.1B backbone and its frozen LM head, refining a latent state over iterations; training only this block, it reaches 98.60% accuracy on ProofWriter and 97.60% on RuleTaker.
tldr.zh: ReLIT 在冻结的 TinyLlama-1.1B 主干和冻结的 LM head 之间放入一个可训练、带学习式停止的递归 Transformer 块，通过多次迭代细化潜在状态；只训练这个块，它在 ProofWriter 上达到 98.60% 的准确率，在 RuleTaker 上达到 97.60%。

papers.title: Full-bandwidth transformer

tldr.en: Fuses each step's top-layer state with the sampled token embedding through a gate and feeds it back as the next input; 1B models match or approach standard transformers trained on roughly 1.5x more tokens.
tldr.zh: 把每一步的顶层状态与采样 token 的 embedding 经门控融合后送回作为下一步输入；1B 模型的效果达到或接近用约 1.5x token 训练的标准 Transformer。

papers.title: Depth-adaptive Inference of Looped Language Models via Continuous Depth Batching

tldr.en: Continuous depth batching forms new batches between loop steps so looped LMs can serve tokens exiting at different depths; on Ouro 1.4B and Huginn 3.5B it realizes up to 99% of the estimated maximum speedup.
tldr.zh: Continuous depth batching 在循环步之间重新组 batch，使循环语言模型能同时处理在不同深度退出的 token；在 Ouro 1.4B 和 Huginn 3.5B 上最多实现估计最大加速的 99%。

papers.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning

tldr.en: BDH-CQ writes ARC demonstrations into a recurrent memory, then solves the query by iterating one latent update before decoding; a 150M-parameter configuration reaches 29.5% pass@2 on the public ARC-AGI-1 evaluation set at a computed inference cost of $0.0007 per task.
tldr.zh: BDH-CQ 先把 ARC 示例写入循环记忆，再反复迭代同一个潜空间更新来求解查询并解码输出；150M 参数的配置在公开的 ARC-AGI-1 评测集上达到 29.5% pass@2，推算的推理成本为每个任务 $0.0007。

papers.title: Retrofitting Recurrent Depth into a Pretrained Language Model: Installation, Extrapolation, Transfer, and Retention at Two Parameter Budgets

tldr.en: Splits Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct into prelude, weight-tied recurrent block and coda; with intermediate-step supervision it computes one task step per loop, extrapolates to roughly 1.5 times its supervised depth, and beats a scratchpad model 84% versus 72%.
tldr.zh: 把 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 拆成 prelude、权重共享的循环块和 coda；在中间步骤监督下，模型每遍循环完成一步任务，可外推到约 1.5 倍的监督深度，总体准确率以 84% 对 72% 胜过 scratchpad 训练的模型。

papers.title: MergeOver: Post-Training Token Merging for Recursive Vision Transformers

tldr.en: MergeOver adds Token Merging to the weight-shared Sliced Recursive Transformer without retraining, merging at each stage's first block and keeping length fixed across its recursions; on ImageNet-1K top-1 drops 1.47 percentage points while GPU peak activation memory falls 37.3% and 38.4% at batch sizes 1 and 16.
tldr.zh: MergeOver 无需重新训练，把 Token Merging 加入递归共享权重的 Sliced Recursive Transformer：在每个 stage 的第一个块合并 token，并在之后的递归迭代中保持序列长度不变；在 ImageNet-1K 上 top-1 准确率下降 1.47 个百分点，batch size 为 1 和 16 时 GPU 峰值激活内存分别降低 37.3% 和 38.4%。

papers.title: Mimir: A Sub-2B Hierarchical Reasoning Model Trained on Permissible Data Punches Above Its Weight Class

tldr.en: Mimir is a 1.78B HRM-Text model whose low- and high-level stacks are applied repeatedly in an interleaved schedule, trained from scratch on 161 permissible datasets; across 20 benchmarks Mimir v1.5 has the best average of all sub-2B models in every domain, beating HRM-Text 1B, Ouro 1.4B and Ouro 2.6B.
tldr.zh: Mimir 是基于 HRM-Text 的 1.78B 模型，其低层栈和高层栈按交错顺序重复应用，并在 161 个符合许可要求的数据集上从头训练；在 20 个基准上，Mimir v1.5 在每个领域的平均分都是所有 2B 以下模型中最高的，超过 HRM-Text 1B、Ouro 1.4B 和 Ouro 2.6B。

papers.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B on Apple Silicon: Fixing Deployment Bugs and Decreasing Looped Transformer Memory Overhead

tldr.en: Fixes five bugs that stop the Nanbeige4.2-3B looped Transformer (one layer stack run twice) from running on Apple Silicon, and adds chunked prefill against its doubled peak attention memory, extending allowable context width by 2.7× on 32 GiB; the patched model completes up to 30% of MCPMark-subset tasks.
tldr.zh: 修复五个使循环 Transformer Nanbeige4.2-3B（同一层栈运行两遍）无法在 Apple Silicon 上运行的 bug，并用 chunked prefill 缓解层复用带来的双倍峰值注意力内存，在 32 GiB 共享内存上把可用上下文长度扩大 2.7×；修复后的模型在 MCPMark 子集上最多完成 30% 的任务。

papers.title: Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning

tldr.en: Mobius-v0 shares one global FFN memory across all layers, queried repeatedly by self-attention reasoners via hidden states; a 7B model trained from scratch matches a 7B Transformer with 62.6% of its training data, and Intern-S2-Mobius (from Qwen3.5-35B) gives nearly 4x end-to-end inference speedup.
tldr.zh: Mobius-v0 让所有层共享一个全局 FFN 记忆，多个 self-attention 推理器通过隐状态反复查询它；从头训练的 7B 模型只用 7B Transformer 基线 62.6% 的训练数据就达到相近的下游得分，从 Qwen3.5-35B 继续预训练的 Intern-S2-Mobius 下游得分相近，端到端推理加速接近 4x。

papers.title: Gated Recurrent Transformers: Expressive Depth through Recurrent Modulation

tldr.en: Gated Recurrent Transformer iterates a shared core between prelude and coda blocks, gating each update on the hidden state, prelude output and noise; a 3-layer model matches 12-layer GPT-2 Small at similar FLOPs, and at large scale it cuts parameters by 63% and peak decoding memory by 59% for 10% more latency.
tldr.zh: Gated Recurrent Transformer 在 prelude 与 coda 块之间迭代一个共享核心，并以隐藏状态、prelude 输出和噪声为条件对每次更新做门控；3 层模型在相近 FLOPs 下与 12 层 GPT-2 Small 精度相当，在大规模下参数减少 63%、峰值解码内存减少 59%，延迟只增加 10%。

papers.title: Recirculation

tldr.en: Recirculation feeds part of a deep layer activation into a shallow layer of frozen pretrained transformers, adding recurrence over depth and tokens; adaptive recirculation on Gemma3 lowers perplexity and raises relative GSM8k accuracy by 21%.
tldr.zh: Recirculation 把深层激活的一部分送入冻结的预训练 transformer 的浅层，形成跨深度和跨 token 的循环；在 Gemma3 上，adaptive recirculation 降低了困惑度，并使 GSM8k 的相对准确率提高 21%。

papers.title: Looped Language Models Improve Compositional Tool Calling

tldr.en: Evaluates native (Ouro) and retrofitted (Llama-3.2-1B, OLMo-2-1B) looped LMs on API-Bank, BFCL and NESTful with matched fine-tuning; looping mainly helps compositional, dependency-aware tool calls, multi-step accuracy generally rises with depth, and adaptive inference gives a better compute-performance trade-off.
tldr.zh: 在相同监督微调配方下，用 API-Bank、BFCL 和 NESTful 评测原生（Ouro）与改造（Llama-3.2-1B、OLMo-2-1B）的循环语言模型；循环主要提升组合式、依赖感知的工具调用，多步工具调用准确率通常随循环深度提高，自适应推理的计算与性能权衡更好。

papers.title: Think Shallow, Solve Deep: Controlling Recurrent Dynamics for Reliable Test-Time Depth

tldr.en: Shows that a trained recurrent operator's dynamical regime (settling, marginal or drifting) predicts whether extra test-time iterations help, preserve or degrade answers on algorithmic tasks; a terminal fixed-point objective controls the regime.
tldr.zh: 表明训练后循环算子的动力学状态（趋稳、临界或漂移）能预测在算法任务上增加测试时迭代会提升、保持还是损害答案；终端不动点目标可以控制这一状态。

papers.title: Allocating Recurrent Compute in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: MixerLoop repeats each Gated DeltaNet mixer while applying the dense FFN once per layer; it surpasses full-block recurrence on aggregate CORE at 15M and keeps 41.5% of full-block recurrence's CORE improvement at 110M while cutting recurrent-backbone projection FLOPs by 45.9%.
tldr.zh: MixerLoop 在每层中重复执行 Gated DeltaNet mixer，而 dense FFN 只执行一次；它在 15M 规模的总体 CORE 上超过整块循环，在 110M 规模保留整块循环 41.5% 的 CORE 提升，同时把循环主干的投影 FLOPs 减少 45.9%。

papers.title: TANGO: Treating Tokens as Operators

tldr.en: TANGO merges attention and FFN in a looped model's shared block into one operator where attention-averaged source-token gates scale destination features; at matched parameters and data it has the lowest mean test NLL in all 16 settings, and its development loss never rises from depth 4 to 8 to 16.
tldr.zh: TANGO 把循环模型共享块中的注意力和 FFN 合并为一个算子：注意力对各源 token 的门控取平均，再用来缩放目标位置的特征；在参数量和训练数据相同时，它在全部 16 个设置中平均测试 NLL 最低，深度从 4 增至 8 再到 16 时其开发集损失从未上升。

papers.title: Steering Recurrent Reasoners at Inference Time with Readout Feedback

tldr.en: Readout Feedback (RoFB) feeds a recurrent reasoner's intermediate readout probabilities back into its latent dynamics as token-wise pairwise coupling forces at test time; on Sudoku and Maze with AKOrN, ItrSA++ and TRM it clearly helps four of six model-task pairs, beyond what more steps or trajectories reach.
tldr.zh: Readout Feedback（RoFB）在测试时把循环推理模型的中间读出概率转换为逐 token 的成对耦合力，回送到其潜在动力学中；在 Sudoku 和 Maze 上用 AKOrN、ItrSA++ 和 TRM 测试，它在六个模型-任务组合中的四个明显提升，超过单纯增加步数或多轨迹选择所能达到的效果。

papers.title: Can a Dynamic Internal Field Govern a Transformer's Cognition? Certifiability, not Superiority, in Homeostatic Compute Control

tldr.en: A homeostatic field (PDEs on the module graph) modulates the halting threshold and block gain of a PonderNet-style looped reasoner in 4.2–5.6M-parameter Transformers on S5 state tracking; wave, diffusion, gated and Navier-Stokes physics tie on accuracy, and its edge is an exact runtime stability check.
tldr.zh: 一个由模块图上的 PDE 控制的稳态场，在 S5 状态追踪任务上调节 4.2–5.6M 参数 Transformer 中 PonderNet 式循环推理块的停止阈值和块增益；波动、扩散、门控和 Navier-Stokes 物理在准确率上打平，它的优势在于可做精确的运行时稳定性检查。

papers.title: Dynamical phase selection controls compute scaling in looped transformers

tldr.en: Looped transformers that iterate one weight-tied attention-plus-MLP block and reach identical accuracy realize distinct dynamical phases depending on initialization; the fold phase gives the workload tail P(τ>N) ∼ N^-2, while in the Neimark-Sacker phase this fold scaling law disappears.
tldr.zh: 迭代同一个权重共享 attention-plus-MLP 块、准确率相同的循环 Transformer 会因初始化不同形成不同的动力学相；fold 相给出 P(τ>N) ∼ N^-2 的负载尾部，而在 Neimark-Sacker 相中这一 fold 标度律消失。

papers.title: Squeezing More from Limited Data with Recursive Transformers

tldr.en: RecursiveGPT applies one shared Transformer block R times with step-specific norms and factorized embeddings; in BabyLM-scale pretraining the 404.1M RecursiveGPT-Large averages 63.93 at 100M words versus 63.47 for a 1.22B standard Transformer, and a 27.6M model wins all three evaluations at 10M words.
tldr.zh: RecursiveGPT 把一个共享 Transformer 块重复应用 R 次，配合每步独立的归一化参数和分解嵌入；在 BabyLM 规模的预训练中，404.1M 的 RecursiveGPT-Large 在 100M 词预算下平均分为 63.93，高于 1.22B 标准 Transformer 的 63.47；27.6M 的模型在 10M 词预算下赢下全部三项评测。

papers.title: Training-Free Hidden-State Refinement for Flow-Matching Image Generators

tldr.en: A training-free method repeats selected transformer layers inside each denoising call of frozen flow-matching image generators, controlling token scope, sampling-progress gating and Loop Guidance; on Scale-RAE DiT2.4B, Loop Guidance raises GenEval from 0.4471 to 0.5691 and DPG-Bench from 0.7656 to 0.8053.
tldr.zh: 一种无需训练的方法在冻结的 flow-matching 图像生成器每次去噪调用中重复执行选定的 Transformer 层，并控制 token 范围、采样进度门控和 Loop Guidance；在 Scale-RAE DiT2.4B 上，Loop Guidance 把 GenEval 从 0.4471 提高到 0.5691，把 DPG-Bench 从 0.7656 提高到 0.8053。

papers.title: Evaluating Tiny Recursive Models Across Training for Code Generation

tldr.en: Compares a ~28M-parameter autoregressive Tiny Recursive Model (TRM-AR) that reuses one two-layer block with parameter- and depth-matched Transformers on Python code generation; it beats the parameter-matched control at roughly 175 times its per-step cost, but the depth-matched model fits and generates better.
tldr.zh: 在 Python 代码生成任务上，比较约 28M 参数、反复使用同一个两层块的自回归 Tiny Recursive Model（TRM-AR）与参数匹配、深度匹配的 Transformer；TRM-AR 优于参数匹配对照，但每步成本约为后者的 175 倍，而深度匹配模型的拟合与生成都更好。

papers.title: Universal Transformers for Circuit Computations: Perfect Length Generalization in Tiny Transformers

tldr.en: A provably correct Universal Transformer (280 learnable parameters for Boolean algebra) cuts circuit depth by one per iteration via a depth-tracking positional encoding and halts after d iterations on depth-d inputs; trained on depths 1 and 2, it reaches 100% accuracy on deeper Boolean, modular arithmetic and ListOps problems.
tldr.zh: 一个可证明正确的 Universal Transformer（Boolean 代数任务只有 280 个可学习参数）借助追踪电路深度的位置编码，每次迭代把电路深度削减一层，对深度为 d 的输入在 d 次迭代后停止；只在深度 1 和深度 2 上训练，它就在更深的 Boolean、模运算和 ListOps 问题上达到 100% 准确率。

papers.title: Latent Recurrent Thoughts: Recurrent Refinement of Proposed Latents for Reasoning with Frozen LLMs

tldr.en: LRT feeds a frozen Qwen3-8B decoder latents that a task-dedicated proposer drafts and a tiny TRM-style recurrent reasoner refines over many steps; it beats prior frozen-decoder continuous-space reasoning methods and, at a small fraction of its inference compute, non-thinking-mode CoT prompting.
tldr.zh: LRT 冻结 Qwen3-8B 解码器，由任务专用的提议网络生成初始潜变量，再由一个很小的 TRM 式循环推理器多步细化后输入解码器；它优于已有的冻结解码器连续空间推理方法，并以非思考模式 CoT 提示一小部分的推理算力超过后者。

papers.title: SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers

note.en: Shown for the 200M scale (L = 12) used in all design ablations; the middle 6 of 12 layers run twice, so 18 layers execute per token. All four scales loop the middle 50% twice and place ⌊(L − m)/2⌋ layers before the span (looped layers 3-7, 4-9, 6-15 and 8-22 for L = 10, 12, 20 and 30). Inside the loop each sublayer's residual update is scaled by 1/r (here 1/2), and every layer execution computes its own Q, K and V; smaller heads at a higher GQA ratio keep the KV cache close to the Baseline's.
note.zh: 图示为所有设计消融所用的 200M 规模（L = 12）：12 层中间的 6 层跑两遍，每个 token 执行 18 层。四个规模都循环中间 50% 的层两遍，循环段之前放 ⌊(L − m)/2⌋ 层（L = 10、12、20、30 时循环的分别是第 3-7、4-9、6-15、8-22 层）。循环内每个子层的残差更新乘 1/r（这里是 1/2），每次执行都重新计算 Q、K、V；用更小的 head 和更高的 GQA 比例让 KV 接近 Baseline。

baseline.en: Unlooped MoE Transformer from the same internal family (top-8 routing, GQA), trained on identical token sequences in each of 16 grid cells (four scales; S = 0% and S ≈ 85%, 95%, 97%).
baseline.zh: 同一内部家族、不循环的 MoE Transformer（top-8 路由，GQA），在 16 个网格单元（四个规模；S = 0% 及 S ≈ 85%、95%、97%）里都用相同的 token 序列训练。

headline.en: With per-token FLOPs, total non-embedding parameters and KV cache matched (typical mismatch under 4%, 1% and 4%), SMELT reaches lower loss than the Baseline at every scale and sparsity level, and its separately fitted frontier saves 6.8-18.0% of training FLOPs at 10^20-10^21 FLOPs (14.7% at 10^21 and S ≈ 97%).
headline.zh: 每 token FLOPs、总非 embedding 参数和 KV 都对齐（典型偏差分别低于 4%、1%、4%）时，SMELT 在每个规模和稀疏度上的 loss 都低于 Baseline；分别拟合的前沿在 10^20-10^21 FLOPs 处省下 6.8-18.0% 的训练 FLOPs（10^21、S ≈ 97% 时为 14.7%）。

results.setting: 200M, L = 12, two passes, per-token FLOPs, total parameters and KV matched; contiguous middle span from 0 layers (Baseline) to all 12
results.metric: validation loss at S ≈ 85% / S ≈ 95% (lower is better)

note.en: DCLM Core does not track validation loss in this sweep; at S ≈ 95% it peaks at 67% span (31.78) and is 29.68 at 50%. The authors select the span on validation loss and train each configuration once.
note.zh: 这组实验中 DCLM Core 与验证 loss 走势不一致：S ≈ 95% 时 Core 在 67% 跨度最高（31.78），50% 跨度为 29.68。作者按验证 loss 选跨度，每个配置只训练一次。

results.setting: 200M, S ≈ 85%, middle 50% looped, physical depth 12, FLOPs, parameters and KV matched (more passes force a narrower model)
results.metric: validation loss / DCLM Core / DCLM Completion

results.setting: Separate fits of L(F, S, D) for each architecture on S ≈ 85%, 95% and 97% (72 + 72 endpoints spanning 1.3x10^19 to 2.2x10^21 training FLOPs)
results.metric: CE Gain, the share of training compute SMELT saves at equal frontier loss, at S ≈ 85% / 95% / 97%

note.en: Cell-bootstrap 95% intervals are wide, e.g. [1,22] at 10^20 FLOPs and S ≈ 85%; the 10^22 row lies beyond the fitted window and two of its three intervals reach 0.
note.zh: cell bootstrap 的 95% 区间很宽，例如 10^20 FLOPs、S ≈ 85% 时为 [1,22]；10^22 一行超出拟合范围，三个区间中有两个下限为 0。

results.setting: C = 10^21 FLOPs, S ≈ 95%; per-category intercepts fitted with the aggregate exponents

findings.en: At 200M with all budgets matched, looping the middle 6 of 12 layers gives lower validation loss than looping all 12 (1.9257 vs 1.9322 at S ≈ 85%, 1.8517 vs 1.8601 at S ≈ 95%), and every span tested beats the unlooped Baseline.
findings.zh: 200M、预算全部对齐时，循环 12 层中间的 6 层比循环全部 12 层的验证 loss 更低（S ≈ 85% 时 1.9257 对 1.9322，S ≈ 95% 时 1.8517 对 1.8601），且测试的每种跨度都优于不循环的 Baseline。

findings.en: Two passes beat three and four at matched FLOPs, parameters and KV (validation loss 1.9257 vs 1.9385 and 1.9360, DCLM Core 27.57 vs 27.15 and 27.30); the authors attribute the regression to the narrower model that extra passes force.
findings.zh: FLOPs、参数和 KV 对齐时，循环两遍优于三遍和四遍（验证 loss 1.9257 对 1.9385 和 1.9360，DCLM Core 27.57 对 27.15 和 27.30）；作者认为原因是多出的遍数迫使模型变窄。

findings.en: SMELT's fitted capacity and data exponents are both larger (a = 0.3892 vs 0.3703, c = 0.7011 vs 0.6594), giving frontier exponents of 0.250 vs 0.237; the irreducible losses differ by 0.005 nats, less than either fit's RMSE.
findings.zh: SMELT 拟合出的容量指数和数据指数都更大（a = 0.3892 对 0.3703，c = 0.7011 对 0.6594），前沿指数为 0.250 对 0.237；两者的不可约 loss 相差 0.005 nats，小于任一拟合的 RMSE。

findings.en: SMELT wins 96 of 96 matched pairs on DCLM Completion, 83 of 96 on DCLM Core and 29 of the 30 MMLU pairs whose Baseline is at least 10 points above chance, and it scores better than a Baseline at the same validation loss would (positive mean residual on all three at every scale).
findings.zh: SMELT 在 DCLM Completion 上赢下全部 96 对，DCLM Core 赢 83 对（共 96 对），MMLU 在 Baseline 高于随机水平至少 10 个点的 30 对中赢 29 对；而且比同等验证 loss 的 Baseline 预期得分更好（三项指标在每个规模上的平均残差都为正）。

findings.en: The gain is larger on longer samples and with in-context examples; the loss improvement on the four longest length buckets is 1.52x that on the four shortest, and the few-shot accuracy gap widens from 0.9 pp at k = 0 to 1.9 pp at k = 1, holding through k = 8.
findings.zh: 样本越长、in-context 示例越多，收益越大：最长四个长度桶的 loss 改善是最短四个的 1.52 倍；few-shot 准确率差距从 k = 0 时的 0.9 pp 扩大到 k = 1 时的 1.9 pp，并保持到 k = 8。

findings.en: The second visit shrinks the attention sink; for the 1.6B Dyck head, BOS attention mass falls from 0.60 to 0.02 and mass on demonstration answers rises from 0.24 to 0.85.
findings.zh: 第二遍会削弱 attention sink：1.6B 模型的 Dyck head 上，BOS 的注意力从 0.60 降到 0.02，示例答案上的注意力从 0.24 升到 0.85。

tldr.en: With per-token FLOPs, total parameters and KV cache matched, looping the middle half of an MoE Transformer twice lowers loss at four scales up to 54B non-embedding parameters and saves 6.8-18.0% of training FLOPs on the fitted frontier.
tldr.zh: 每 token FLOPs、总参数和 KV 都对齐时，把 MoE Transformer 中间一半的层循环两遍，在最大 54B 非 embedding 参数的四个规模上都降低了 loss，并在拟合前沿上省下 6.8-18.0% 的训练 FLOPs。

problem.en: Most looped-model gains are reported at fixed parameter count, where the looped model also spends more FLOPs and KV cache, so architecture and extra compute are conflated; the paper asks whether looping still helps when per-token FLOPs, total parameters and KV cache are all held fixed.
problem.zh: 多数循环模型的收益是在固定参数量下报告的，循环模型同时多花了 FLOPs 和 KV，结构优势和额外算力混在一起；论文研究每 token FLOPs、总参数和 KV 都固定时，循环是否仍然有用。

en: Pay for the extra pass by narrowing the hidden size (1280 to 1056 at 200M, S ≈ 95%), recover total parameters by adding experts (192 to 288 per layer), and use smaller heads at a higher GQA ratio to keep the KV cache within 4%.
Choose the recipe with three 200M ablations under these budgets; loop the middle 50% of layers twice, keep the Baseline's physical depth, and scale each looped sublayer's residual update by 1/r.

Train matched Baseline / SMELT pairs over 4 scales x 4 sparsity levels with six WSD decay branches each (up to about 215B tokens), and fit a separate Chinchilla-style law L(F, S, D) per architecture to compare compute-optimal frontiers.
zh: 用更窄的隐藏维度支付多出的一遍（200M、S ≈ 95% 时从 1280 降到 1056），增加专家补回总参数（每层从 192 增到 288），并用更小的 head 和更高的 GQA 比例把 KV 偏差控制在 4% 以内。
在这些预算约束下用三组 200M 消融确定配方：中间 50% 的层循环两遍，物理深度与 Baseline 相同，循环内每个子层的残差更新乘 1/r。
在 4 个规模 × 4 个稀疏度上训练成对的 Baseline / SMELT，每个 run 有六个 WSD 衰减分支（最长约 215B token），并为两种结构分别拟合 Chinchilla 式的 L(F, S, D)，比较 compute-optimal 前沿。

en: Active parameters and executed depth are not matched; at 200M and S ≈ 95% SMELT has 0.142B active parameters against the Baseline's 0.209B and executes 18 layers instead of 12 (Section 3.2; Tables 9-10).

The span, depth and loop-count ablations ran only at 200M, with one training run per configuration and the same loop count in training and evaluation; the authors note the best span or count may differ at larger scales (Section 3.3; Section 7).
Budget matching equates arithmetic FLOPs, parameters and KV-cache size, not wall-clock cost (Section 7).
The model family and training stack are proprietary and cannot be released, pretraining uses an internal corpus, and training contexts are 4096 tokens (Section 3.1; Appendix A).
SMELT shares the Baseline's optimizer, schedule and data; the Baseline configurations come from a tuned MoE family, and no separate tuning for SMELT is reported (Section 3.1; Appendix A).
zh: 激活参数和执行深度没有对齐：200M、S ≈ 95% 时 SMELT 的激活参数为 0.142B，Baseline 为 0.209B，执行 18 层而不是 12 层（Section 3.2；Tables 9-10）。
跨度、深度和遍数消融只在 200M 上做，每个配置只训练一次，训练和评测用同一个遍数；作者指出更大规模下最优跨度或遍数可能不同（Section 3.3；Section 7）。
预算对齐的是算术 FLOPs、参数和 KV 大小，不是墙钟时间（Section 7）。
模型家族和训练框架是专有的、无法公开，预训练用内部语料，训练上下文为 4096 token（Section 3.1；Appendix A）。
SMELT 与 Baseline 共用优化器、学习率调度和数据；Baseline 配置来自一个调过的 MoE 家族，论文没有提到为 SMELT 单独调参（Section 3.1；Appendix A）。

papers.glyph: L1-3 (3 layers) -> [L4-9 (6 layers)] x 2 -> L10-12 (3 layers); injection none; KV per-pass

papers.title: Diffusion as a Training Curriculum for Timestep-Free Iterative Reasoning
papers.venue: NeurIPS 2026 Beyond Next Token Prediction Workshop

tldr.en: A timestep-free diffusion denoiser with a persistent hidden state, built from a looped block reused at every step, becomes an anytime solver that improves with inference depth, reaching 99.90% exact solve on Sudoku-Extreme and 98.93% on Maze-Unique; annealed corruption matters mainly as a training curriculum.
tldr.zh: 该文为去掉时间步条件的扩散去噪器加入持久隐藏状态，并在每一步复用同一个循环块，得到随推理深度持续提升的 anytime 求解器：Sudoku-Extreme 精确求解率达 99.90%，Maze-Unique 达 98.93%；有序退火加噪主要作为训练课程起作用。

papers.title: Looped Transformers under the Jacobian Lens: Does the Global Workspace Survive Recurrence?

tldr.en: Applies an extended Jacobian lens to Ouro-2.6B and Huginn-0125: both form a workspace in their iterated part, but Ouro rebuilds content every loop, while Huginn carries it forward and interventions act within about two recurrences.
tldr.zh: 把扩展后的 Jacobian lens 用于 Ouro-2.6B 和 Huginn-0125：两者都在迭代部分形成工作空间，但 Ouro 在每个 loop 中重建其内容，Huginn 则把内容向后续递归传递，而干预只在大约两次递归的窗口内起作用。

papers.title: RecurTrace: Adaptive Latent Reasoning with Loop-Time Memory

tldr.en: Loops a middle block of an LM, adding attention over earlier loop states and an oracle-supervised halting head; on MathQA it reaches 56.9% with 2.0 loops on average, 2.2 points above the best fixed depth.
tldr.zh: 在语言模型中循环一个中间层块，加入对先前各遍状态的注意力（Loop Memory Attention）和由 oracle 监督的停止头；在 MathQA 上以平均 2.0 遍达到 56.9% 准确率，比最佳固定循环深度高 2.2 个点。

papers.title: Looped GPT-BERT: Trading Parameters for Computation in Small Language Modeling

tldr.en: Looped GPT-BERT runs four physical layers for twelve traversals with GPT-BERT's MNTP and CLM objectives in BabyLM 2026 Strict-small; the 12.18M-parameter 4×12 model scores 71.19 on BLiMP, near GPT-BERT causal-focus at 71.66 and above GPT-2 at 65.23, but trails both on GLUE.
tldr.zh: Looped GPT-BERT 在 BabyLM 2026 Strict-small 设置下结合 GPT-BERT 的 MNTP 与 CLM 目标，让四个物理层循环十二遍；12.18M 参数的 4×12 模型 BLiMP 得分 71.19，接近 GPT-BERT causal-focus 的 71.66，高于 GPT-2 的 65.23，但 GLUE 低于两者。

papers.title: LoopVAE: Recurrent Depth Across Scales for Visual Tokenization

tldr.en: LoopVAE reuses one scale- and loop-conditioned four-block core across all scales and loops of a visual tokenizer's encoder and decoder (28 block applications each); on ImageNet-256 the 29M-parameter CNN reaches 0.28 rFID and 32.54 dB PSNR with approximately 65% fewer parameters than 84M reference VAEs.
tldr.zh: LoopVAE 在视觉 tokenizer 的编码器和解码器中各用一个以尺度和循环步为条件的四块核心，在所有尺度和循环步上复用（各执行 28 次块计算）；在 ImageNet-256 上，29M 参数的 CNN 达到 0.28 rFID 和 32.54 dB PSNR，参数比 84M 的参考 VAE 少约 65%。

papers.title: Thinking with Looped Flows

tldr.en: Trains looped models with local denoising objectives at decreasing noise levels and infers by integrating a probability flow; across six reasoning benchmarks it outperforms prior looped models overall, reaching 58.8% test accuracy on ARC-AGI-1.
tldr.zh: 用噪声水平逐步降低的局部去噪目标训练循环模型，并把推理写成对概率流的积分；在六个推理基准上总体优于此前的循环模型，ARC-AGI-1 测试准确率达到 58.8%。

papers.title: Temporal Recurrence Favors Fewer Layers

tldr.en: Sweeps within-step depth, expert width and expert count at matched per-step compute for models that carry latent state across steps (the Transformer feeds its final residual stream into the first layer at the next token); on Sokoban and FineWeb, recurrence shifts the best observed allocation toward substantially fewer layers.
tldr.zh: 针对在步与步之间传递潜在状态的模型（其中 Transformer 把最终残差流送入下一个 token 的第一层），在每步算力大致相同的条件下扫描每步内的层数、专家宽度和每层专家数；在 Sokoban 和 FineWeb 上，循环使最佳观测分配明显偏向更少的层。

papers.title: T-LoopFormer: Token-Level Elastic-Depth Looped Transformers with Dynamic Routing

tldr.en: T-LoopFormer's router gives each token its own number of loops through a shared block based on its initial hidden state, and a recursion-wise KV cache keeps per-loop entries only for active tokens; it decodes 2.24× faster than LoopFormer and has the lowest decoding latency among baselines.
tldr.zh: T-LoopFormer 的路由器根据每个 token 的初始隐状态为其分配通过共享块的循环次数，recursion-wise KV cache 只为仍在该次循环中的 token 保存逐循环的 KV；其解码速度比 LoopFormer 快 2.24×，解码延迟在各基线中最低。

papers.title: Right Direction, Wrong Step: Geometric Analysis of Finite-Step Failure in Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Analyzing Ouro-1.4B, Ouro-2.6B and Huginn-0125, the paper finds that harmful extra loop iterations often move in a locally helpful direction but take too large a step; a fixed quarter step recovers positive reference utility for 72.2–83.2% of selected failures across four settings.
tldr.zh: 论文分析 Ouro-1.4B、Ouro-2.6B 和 Huginn-0125，发现造成损害的额外循环迭代往往方向在局部有益但步长过大；固定取四分之一步长，可在四种设置中让 72.2–83.2% 的选定失败样本恢复正的参考效用。

papers.title: LoopSpec: Pipelined Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: LoopSpec, a training-free self-speculative decoder for looped Transformers, drafts tokens from early recurrent states and overlaps drafting with verification; it stays lossless under greedy and sampling decoding and reaches up to 6.83× speedup.
tldr.zh: LoopSpec 是面向循环 Transformer 的免训练自投机解码方法，从较早循环深度的状态中取 draft token，并把后续 token 的起草与当前 token 的验证流水线重叠；在 greedy 和采样解码下均无损，最高加速 6.83×。

papers.title: MoRE: Mixture of Reused Experts

tldr.en: MoRE shares MoE expert pools across groups of adjacent layers, keeping per-layer routers and a learnable depth embedding before routing; at 114M-1.15B parameters it gets lower perplexity and stronger downstream results than standard MoEs and weight-sharing architectures at matched compute and parameters.
tldr.zh: MoRE 让相邻层组共享 MoE 专家池，每层保留自己的 router，并在路由前加入可学习的深度嵌入；在 114M-1.15B 参数规模上，它在计算量和参数量相同的条件下，比标准 MoE 和最先进的权重共享架构困惑度更低、下游表现更强。

papers.title: How Model Growth, Recursion, and Boundary Operators Influence Scaling Exponents

tldr.en: In prelude-core-coda looped Transformers, growing the number of core passes during training, with or without shared weights, and a normalize-and-inject boundary operator raise pre-training scaling exponents; a 7.4B untied growth model matches GPT-3 13B on CORE with roughly 20× less compute.
tldr.zh: 在 prelude-core-coda 结构的循环 Transformer 中，训练过程中增加核心块的遍数（无论是否共享权重）以及先归一化再注入的边界算子都能提高预训练的 scaling 指数；一个 7.4B 的不共享权重增长模型用少约 20× 的算力在 CORE 上追平 GPT-3 13B。

papers.title: Storing Is Not Remembering: LSTM-UT and Bounded Gated Memory for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: On Rule 30, a state-only Block Universal Transformer (BUT) extrapolates and recalls better than CoTFormer, which caches every step's KV; LSTM-UT adds a small bounded gated cell state to the shared block, keeps 99.7% exact-row accuracy at depth 60 after training to depth 12, and beats BUT on OpenWebText2.
tldr.zh: 在 Rule 30 任务上，只保留当前状态的 Block Universal Transformer（BUT）在深度外推和延迟回忆上优于缓存每一步 KV 的 CoTFormer；LSTM-UT 给共享块加入一个小而有界的门控 cell state，训练到深度 12 后在深度 60 仍保持 99.7% 的整行准确率，并在 OpenWebText2 语言建模上优于 BUT。

papers.title: CoReLoop: Parameter-Efficient Controlled Recurrent Refinement for Audio Deepfake Detection

tldr.en: CoReLoop loops a frozen SSL audio deepfake detector's encoder on its own output, adding loop-specific LoRA and light modules that adapt recurrent inputs, regulate state updates and align outputs; on the 24-layer model two passes cut pooled EER from 4.85% to 3.74% while training about 11M of 598M parameters.
tldr.zh: CoReLoop 把冻结的 SSL 音频深度伪造检测器的编码器输出回送为下一次输入，用循环专属 LoRA 和轻量模块适配循环输入、调节状态更新并对齐输出；在 24 层模型上，两次前向把汇总 EER 从 4.85% 降到 3.74%，只训练 598M 参数中的约 11M。

papers.title: Beyond Depth Truncation: Controlled Evaluation of Depth Utilization in Recursive Language Models

tldr.en: The Depth Control Protocol decomposes depth-truncation curves of depth-recurrent LMs; on the 542.8M Sona model the 1.4251 nat naive depth effect splits into 47.9% block applications, -2.8% distinct depth and 54.8% inter-block composition, and sampled-depth training removes the calibration confounder.
tldr.zh: Depth Control Protocol 对深度循环语言模型的深度截断曲线进行分解；在 542.8M 参数的 Sona 模型上，1.4251 nat 的朴素深度效应拆分为 47.9% 的块执行次数、-2.8% 的不同深度和 54.8% 的块间组合，而采样深度训练能消除校准混杂因素。

papers.title: Prediction Dynamics in Depth-Recurrent Language Models

tldr.en: Analyzing how Huginn-3.5B and Ouro-1.4B change answer scores across recurrent depth, the paper derives a sharp margin characterization; accounting for update direction and competitor pairing reduces the mean earliest qualifying depth by a further 22.5-34.4% of the total depth beyond translation removal.
tldr.zh: 分析 Huginn-3.5B 和 Ouro-1.4B 的答案分数如何随循环深度变化，并推导出精确的 margin 刻画；考虑更新方向和竞争项配对后，平均最早合格深度在去除平移之外还能再减少总深度的 22.5-34.4%。

papers.title: Trading Depth for Time in Recurrent Transformers

tldr.en: Adds a latent thought token after each vocabulary token of a Latent Recurrent Transformer, refining the state again through the shared backbone; at matched training FLOPs it beats PonderLM-2, overtakes a two-loop Transformer as compute grows, and recovers on average 89% of the gains of doubling LRT depth.
tldr.zh: 在 Latent Recurrent Transformer 的每个词表 token 后插入一个潜在思考 token，让隐藏状态再经同一主干细化一次；训练 FLOPs 相同时，它优于 PonderLM-2，并随算力增加超过两遍循环 Transformer，平均收回 LRT 深度加倍所带来收益的 89%。

papers.title: WaveFront Decoding: Parallelized Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Wavefront Decoding is a training-free self-speculative decoder for looped language models that co-batches shallow drafting and full-depth verification in the same recurrent-block calls, reaching 2.42x speedup on Ouro-2.6B and 3.54x on Huginn-3.5B over autoregressive decoding.
tldr.zh: Wavefront Decoding 是面向循环语言模型的免训练自推测解码方法，在同一次批量循环块调用中同时做浅层起草和全深度验证，相对自回归解码在 Ouro-2.6B 上加速 2.42x、在 Huginn-3.5B 上加速 3.54x。

papers.title: LoopCD: Loop-wise Contrastive Decoding for Improving Reasoning in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: LoopCD contrasts the logits of an earlier loop iteration with those of the final iteration when decoding from looped LMs, refining uncertain hard tokens without training; it improves Huginn-0125 and Ouro-1.4B on arithmetic reasoning, code generation and question answering with negligible overhead.
tldr.zh: LoopCD 在循环语言模型解码时，用较早一次循环迭代的 logits 与最后一次迭代的 logits 做对比，无需训练即可修正不确定的难 token；它在算术推理、代码生成和问答任务上提升了 Huginn-0125 和 Ouro-1.4B 的表现，额外开销可忽略。

papers.title: Statistical Gains from Looped Estimation under Parameter Budgets

tldr.en: Looping one shared block lets residual feedforward networks and post-LN Transformers attain the minimax polynomial rate for Hölder targets up to logarithmic factors with a fixed number of bounded parameters, while at large fixed budgets the best untied family's worst-case risk stays bounded away from zero.
tldr.zh: 循环同一个共享块使残差前馈网络和 post-LN Transformer 只用固定数量的有界参数，就能对 Hölder 光滑目标达到极小极大多项式速率（至多相差对数因子）；而在足够大的固定预算下，最优的不共享参数网络族的最坏情况风险始终有正的下界。

papers.title: When Recursive Models Finish Computing

tldr.en: Extending attention- and MLP-based Tiny Recursive Models from their nominal 16 steps to 512 raises cumulative exact-solve accuracy on 1,000 hard Sudoku puzzles from 59.2% to 87.5% and from 74.4% to 91.9%; completed states are locally contractive along the trajectory while their Jacobians keep strongly expanding directions.
tldr.zh: 把基于注意力和基于 MLP 的 Tiny Recursive Model 从名义的 16 步递归延长到 512 步，在 1,000 道高难度数独上的累计完全求解准确率分别从 59.2% 升到 87.5%、从 74.4% 升到 91.9%；完成计算的状态沿轨迹方向局部收缩，而其 Jacobian 仍保留强烈扩张的方向。

papers.title: Attention Routing Stabilizes Early: Working-Set Inference for Recurrent Language Models

tldr.en: WISE, training-free, uses full attention in early recurrent steps of a recurrent-depth LM to find a block-sparse working set and reuses that support later; it largely preserves full-attention multi-hop QA performance, with up to a 1.76x late-step attention speedup over native FlashAttention at 4K context.
tldr.zh: WISE 无需训练：在循环深度语言模型的前几个循环步中用完整注意力找出块稀疏的工作集，之后的循环步复用这一注意力支撑；它在多跳 QA 上基本保持完整注意力的性能，并在 4K 上下文下使后期步注意力比原生 FlashAttention 最多快 1.76x。

papers.title: Stream Recursion Model (SRM)

tldr.en: SRM, an HRM variant built for interpretability, recursively refines multiple latent streams with a weight-tied layer function and learned stream-wise attention; on OpenWebText SRM-base reaches training loss 3.18 with 68M parameters at 7 times the compute time, versus 3.20 for a 124M GPT-2.
tldr.zh: SRM 是为可解释性设计的 HRM 变体，用权重共享的层函数和可学习的 stream-wise attention 递归精炼多条潜在流；在 OpenWebText 上，68M 参数的 SRM-base 以 7 倍计算时间达到 3.18 的训练损失，124M 参数的 GPT-2 为 3.20。

papers.title: FluidRain: Incompressible Rain Flow as an Attention Bias for Loop-in-Loop Video Deraining

tldr.en: FluidRain reuses one rain-flow-guided block stack across three scales, each output becoming the next scale's state, and one attention operator across three frames (Loop-in-Loop); the 0.80M-parameter video derainer stays competitive with substantially larger restoration models on four benchmarks.
tldr.zh: FluidRain 在三个尺度上复用同一组由雨流引导的块（每个尺度的输出作为下一尺度的状态），并在三帧之间复用同一个注意力算子（Loop-in-Loop）；这个仅 0.80M 参数的视频去雨模型在四个基准上与大得多的复原模型相当。

papers.title: Depth through recurrence: Looped transformers for flow-matching TTS

tldr.en: Compares seven weight-reuse layouts with 18 block calls in flow-matching TTS; SEQUENCE, running each of nine blocks twice in a row, stays competitive at 32 steps with 47.1% fewer parameters, while at four steps Suffix's word error rate exceeds Prefix's by 3.44 and 5.97 percentage points on the two datasets.
tldr.zh: 在 flow-matching TTS 中比较七种每次网络评估执行 18 次块调用的权重复用布局；SEQUENCE 把九个块各连续执行两次，在 32 步采样下以少 47.1% 的参数保持有竞争力的质量，而在四步采样时，Suffix 在两个数据集上的词错误率分别比 Prefix 高 3.44 和 5.97 个百分点。

papers.title: FlashLoop: Fast and Memory-Efficient Looped Transformers via Lazy Updates

tldr.en: FlashLoop, a training-free inference framework, cuts cross-loop redundancy in looped Transformers with token-sparse updates, sparse attention and KV-residual quantization, giving up to 1.64x speedup and 6x less KV-cache memory while largely preserving accuracy.
tldr.zh: FlashLoop 是一个无需训练的推理框架，通过 token 稀疏更新、稀疏注意力和 KV 残差量化减少循环 Transformer 的跨遍冗余，在基本保持精度的同时带来最高 1.64x 的加速和 6x 的 KV 缓存内存降低。

papers.title: Quantizing Looped Transformers: Feedback Exposure and Calibration Blindness

tldr.en: In post-training quantization of looped Transformers, per-channel INT4 on Huginn-3.5B fails mainly at the non-residual loop-entry adapter and one-step GPTQ is worse than RTN on five of nine checkpoints; accumulating GPTQ's Hessian across recurrence steps beats both on all nine and recovers bf16-level accuracy on Huginn.
tldr.zh: 在循环 Transformer 的训练后量化中，Huginn-3.5B 的 per-channel INT4 主要在没有残差通路的 loop 入口 adapter 处失效，单步 GPTQ 在九个 checkpoint 中有五个不如 RTN；把 GPTQ 的 Hessian 在各递归步上累积后，在全部九个 checkpoint 上都优于两者，并在 Huginn 上恢复到 bf16 水平的准确率。

papers.title: Programs-of-Layers in LLMs through the Lens of Cortical Areas

tldr.en: Reproducing PoLar's skip-or-repeat layer programs for frozen LLMs with MCTS on 6 models, repeating beats skipping and both together beat either, but with a format-fixing prompt the router's top prediction collapses to the standard pass, though its top-5 programs still gain.
tldr.zh: 复现 PoLar：让冻结的 LLM 按每个输入的程序跳过或重复层块，并在 6 个模型上用 MCTS 搜索；重复优于跳过，两者结合优于任一单独操作，但在已固定答案格式的提示下，路由器的首选预测退化为标准前向，不过其前 5 个程序合起来仍有提升。

papers.title: Write Back the $Δ$: Revisiting the Same Tokens with Fresh Representations

tldr.en: ReFlux trains a sparse router over a frozen Transformer that writes depth increments Δ back to earlier layers, in a second traversal of the same token or streamed to the next token; it lowers perplexity on ten corpora and raises accuracy by 2.1-2.3 points, reaching 4.7 on multi-hop reasoning.
tldr.zh: ReFlux 在冻结的 Transformer 上训练稀疏路由器，把深度增量 Δ 写回较早的层，可用于同一 token 的第二遍遍历，也可流式传给下一个 token；它在十个语料上降低困惑度，准确率提高 2.1-2.3 个点，多跳推理上最高提高 4.7 个点。

papers.title: Beyond the Training Horizon: Mechanisms and Limits of Length Generalization in Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Compares two looped Transformers: MR-Loop updates an intermediate state at a fixed readout, DR-Loop propagates intermediate states along an advancing frontier; both degrade at greater depths, and live-consumed and fresh-aged residual directions causally control computation beyond the training horizon.
tldr.zh: 对比两种循环 Transformer 的机制：MR-Loop 在固定读出位置更新中间状态，DR-Loop 沿推进的计算前沿传递中间状态；两者在更深的步数上都会失效，live-consumed 与 fresh-aged 两类残差方向因果地控制信息能否参与后续计算，包括超出训练范围时。

papers.title: Reasoning on the Simplex: Geometric Fixed-Point Models

tldr.en: GFPR iterates a weight-tied map on categorical beliefs over a product of simplices, whose argmax is the answer at every step; at about 7M parameters it reaches 95.1% on Sudoku-Extreme and 92.0% on Maze-Hard, and a 201M language model with 24 Picard steps beats GPT-2 small on four zero-shot tasks.
tldr.zh: GFPR 在单纯形乘积上的类别信念场上迭代权重共享映射，每一步的 argmax 即为答案；约 7M 参数时，它在 Sudoku-Extreme 上达到 95.1%、Maze-Hard 上达到 92.0%，用同一更新训练的 201M 语言模型在 24 步 Picard 迭代下于四项零样本任务上超过 GPT-2 small。

papers.title: Loop Dropout: Regularizing Shared Updates in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Loop Dropout randomly masks a shared LoRA adapter's application at individual loops of a looped LM and rescales kept applications by inverse survival probability; fine-tuning Ouro-1.4B on math, it raises MATH-500 accuracy from 38.87% with LoRA to 47.53%, keeping standard LoRA inference.
tldr.zh: Loop Dropout 在循环语言模型的各次循环中随机屏蔽共享 LoRA 适配器的应用，并按存活概率的倒数缩放保留的应用；在 Ouro-1.4B 上做数学微调时，它把 MATH-500 准确率从 LoRA 的 38.87% 提高到 47.53%，推理时仍为标准 LoRA。

papers.title: FlexLoop: Depth-Elastic Looped Policies for Adaptive Test-Time Computation in Deep RL

tldr.en: FlexLoop post-trains fixed-depth looped RL policies with the RL objective plus adjacent-depth policy distillation so shallower depths become reliable; on 30 long-horizon goal-conditioned environments it keeps full-depth performance, cuts average recurrent depth by up to 43% and gives up to 1.34× speedup in a stress test.
tldr.zh: FlexLoop 用原有 RL 目标加相邻深度策略蒸馏，对固定深度训练的循环 RL 策略做后训练，使较浅的循环深度也能可靠决策；在 30 个长时程目标条件环境中，它保持全深度性能，平均循环深度最多减少 43%，压力测试中墙钟时间最多加速 1.34×。

papers.title: Shallow Queries, Mature Values: Depth-Asynchronous Self-Speculation for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: DAS lets shallow-depth drafts in looped Transformers read full-depth values of the verified prefix (Mature-V) at no extra recurrent cost; DAS-Wave adds parallel refinement, progressive block growth and a full-depth verifier, reaching 4.00-6.96× mean throughput speedup over full-depth autoregressive decoding.
tldr.zh: DAS 让循环 Transformer 的浅层草稿直接读取已验证前缀的全深度 value（Mature-V），无需额外的循环计算；DAS-Wave 再加入并行精炼、渐进式块增长和独立的全深度验证器，相对全深度自回归解码取得 4.00-6.96× 的平均吞吐加速。

papers.title: Improving Test-Time Scaling with Adaptive Looped Transformers

tldr.en: TaH2 post-trains a looped Qwen3 backbone jointly with a token-level iteration decider supervised by online lookahead depth labels, so only tokens that benefit get extra iterations; on AIME it raises the accuracy-compute slope by 53% (2.74 vs. 1.79) over the non-looped baseline.
tldr.zh: TaH2 对循环的 Qwen3 骨干和 token 级迭代决策器进行联合后训练，决策器由在线前瞻深度标签监督，只让受益的 token 获得额外迭代；在 AIME 上，它相对非循环基线把准确率-计算斜率提高 53%（2.74 vs. 1.79）。

papers.title: How to Loop MoE: Flatten the Experts, Untie the Attention

tldr.en: Foil loops an MoE core whose experts and routers are shared across passes while each pass gets its own attention, and flattens it into fewer, wider layers with more passes at fixed expert parameters and compute; at 100B tokens the most flattened Foil ends 0.012 nat below the unflattened looped baseline.
tldr.zh: Foil 循环一个 MoE 核心块，专家和路由器在各遍之间共享、每遍有独立的注意力，并在专家参数和计算量固定时把它展平为层数更少、每层更宽、遍数更多的结构；在 100B token 时，展平程度最高的 Foil 比未展平的循环基线低 0.012 nat。

papers.title: LoopICL: Looping a single transformer block to solve tabular tasks

tldr.en: LoopICL loops a single Transformer block with coupled cell and row streams for tabular in-context learning, varying loop counts in pre-training and exiting with a learned gate; at the same FLOPs it performs competitively with TabICLv2 on TabArena and TALENT while using nearly 90% fewer parameters.
tldr.zh: LoopICL 循环单个 Transformer 块，以耦合的 cell 流和 row 流做表格 in-context learning，预训练时改变循环次数，并用学习到的退出门自动退出；在相同 FLOPs 下，它在 TabArena 和 TALENT 上与 TabICLv2 相当，参数量少近 90%。

papers.title: Transformers Stop Thinking Too Early, and a Tiny LoRA Fixes It

tldr.en: Thirteen base models reliably follow only 1.4-3.6 lines of in-context references and extra pretrained loops add little; a rank-8 LoRA at one early layer, weights frozen, lifts Qwen3-8B from 15.5% to 99% on 24-line chains and lets Ouro-1.4B reach 60 lines after four loops and at least 160 after eight.
tldr.zh: 十三个预训练基础模型只能可靠地追踪 1.4-3.6 行上下文引用，预训练模型的额外循环帮助不大；冻结全部权重、只在一个早期层加 rank-8 LoRA，就能把 Qwen3-8B 在 24 行链上的精确准确率从 15.5% 提高到 99%，并让 Ouro-1.4B 在四次循环后追踪 60 行、八次循环后至少 160 行。

papers.title: What Makes Recurrence Effective in Looped Language Models?

tldr.en: Pretrains looped LMs with a fixed loop count and tests them below, at and beyond it: extra loops help reasoning but hurt knowledge, non-recurrent output layers add robustness to under-unrolling, and channel-wise history-state injection with timestep conditioning better preserves knowledge under extended unrolling.
tldr.zh: 以固定循环次数从头预训练循环语言模型，并在少于、等于和超过训练循环次数时测试：额外循环有助于推理但损害知识类任务，非循环的输出层提高了循环次数不足时的稳健性，按通道的历史状态注入加 timestep 条件化在延长展开时能更好地保留知识。

papers.title: Scheduling Recursive Reasoning in Looped Transformers

tldr.en: TAPS adapts the scale of each recurrent update online from the balance of persistent progress and fluctuation, instead of a fixed unit scale; training-free, it improves TRM on Sudoku and Maze and Ouro and Huginn on language benchmarks, and with training it reaches up to 1.56 times wall-clock speedup at matched accuracy.
tldr.zh: TAPS 依据持续进展与波动的平衡在线调整每次循环更新的步长，取代固定的单位步长；无需重新训练即可提升 TRM 在数独和迷宫上、Ouro 和 Huginn 在语言基准上的准确率，结合训练时在准确率持平的情况下最高带来 1.56 倍的实际运行时间加速。

papers.title: Looped Transformers as Optimizers

tldr.en: Viewing the looped hidden state as a fast weight updated by local gradient steps, the paper derives loop transitions from a projection, objective and optimizer rule; its OperLoop beats the compared looped and non-looped baselines in average generative performance at matched training FLOPs.
tldr.zh: 该文把循环隐藏状态视为由局部梯度步更新的 fast weight，由投影、局部目标和优化器更新规则推导循环转移；据此设计的 OperLoop 在训练 FLOPs 相同时，平均生成性能超过对比的循环与非循环基线。

papers.title: Looped Actor: Depth-Recurrent Reasoning Models for Reinforcement Learning

tldr.en: Looped Actor, an RL policy, applies a shared Transformer block toward a fixed point and halts once its action distribution stabilizes; on 22 tasks in six environments it matches or beats an untied baseline with 16× more parameters, and on Boxoban its loop count grows with the pushes left.
tldr.zh: Looped Actor 是一种强化学习策略，反复应用共享的 Transformer 块让潜在表示趋向不动点，并在动作分布稳定时停止循环；在六个环境的 22 个任务上，它达到或超过参数多 16× 的非共享基线，在 Boxoban 上循环次数随剩余推箱次数增加。

papers.title: Thinking in Depth, Speaking Directly: Recurrent Latent Reasoning for Paralinguistically Grounded Spoken Dialogue

tldr.en: LoopSLM loops layers L9–11 of Qwen2.5-Omni-7B four times, re-anchoring each pass to acoustic memory, with two-stage CoT-to-response training; against the CoT-SFT baseline it gains over 20 points in reasoning accuracy while generating 64.5% fewer tokens at half the latency.
tldr.zh: LoopSLM 把 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 的 L9–11 层循环执行四次，并让每一遍重新锚定到声学记忆，采用从 CoT 到直接回复的两阶段训练；与 CoT-SFT 基线相比，推理准确率提高超过 20 分，同时生成的 token 少 64.5%，延迟减半。

papers.title: Pretraining Latent Information Feedback Transformers with Teacher Supervision

tldr.en: LIFT feeds each position's predicted state, a next-token distribution, back as input at the next position and trains in parallel on states precomputed by a pretrained teacher LM; from 135M to 1B parameters it beats standard Transformers at matched tokens and is on par with or ahead of compute-matched ones.
tldr.zh: LIFT 把每个位置预测的状态（下一 token 分布）作为输入送回下一个位置，训练时使用预训练教师 LM 预先算好的状态，因此可在各位置上并行；在 135M 到 1B 参数规模上，它在 token 数相同时优于标准 Transformer，并与算力相同的 Transformer 持平或更好。

papers.title: LoopVL: Recurrent Visual Intelligence

tldr.en: LoopVL-1B runs a joint vision-language state through two shared 16-layer stacks in an [L×3→H]×2 schedule (128 layer calls); trained from scratch on 0.14T tokens, it outperforms a range of similarly sized and larger non-recurrent models on multimodal understanding and visual reasoning benchmarks.
tldr.zh: LoopVL-1B 让统一的视觉-语言状态按 [L×3→H]×2 的顺序反复经过两个共享的 16 层 Transformer 栈，每次前向共 128 次层调用；它用 0.14T token 从头训练，在多模态理解和视觉推理基准上超过一系列规模相近或更大的非循环模型。

papers.title: A Tilted Bowl Is Not a Slippery Slope: Compressing Looped Models

tldr.en: In more than 30 compressed looped models from five families, fixed rounding error only shifts where a settling loop comes to rest; stopping at the halting head, then finishing with 8-bit loops, beats fixed depth by up to 15 points on Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Hard under a third of the weight traffic.
tldr.zh: 在五个家族的 30 多个压缩循环模型上，固定的舍入误差只会移动会收敛的循环最终停驻的位置，而不会累积；在 halting head 触发时停止、再用 8-bit 权重跑几次收尾循环，在 Sudoku-Extreme 和 Maze-Hard 上比固定深度最多高 15 分，权重访存量不到三分之一。

papers.title: Shared Weights, Selected Computations: How Looped Transformers Route What Each Loop Does

tldr.en: In looped Transformers trained on graph walks, each loop need not perform the same step: predictions advance by varying numbers of graph steps, and a learned linear map J on the entering hidden state steers a frozen loop to different transitions, which activation patching traces to attention routing.
tldr.zh: 在图游走任务上训练的循环 Transformer 中，每次循环不一定执行同一步：预测每次前进的图步数不同；对进入循环的隐藏状态施加学习得到的线性映射 J，可把冻结的循环引向不同转移，activation patching 表明这一效果经由注意力路由实现。

papers.title: What Limits Recursive Reasoning Models: Optimization, Architecture and Test-Time Scaling

tldr.en: Ablations of HRM-, TRM- and URM-style recursive reasoners show that stable training needs an intermediate gradient horizon, large physical batches and controlled state updates, not explicit hierarchy; its 13.6M-parameter model lifts Arithmetic OOD accuracy to 71.2% from 36.2% and reaches 98.41% on Sudoku.
tldr.zh: 对 HRM、TRM 和 URM 式递归推理模型的受控消融表明，稳定训练依赖中等长度的梯度回传范围、大的物理 batch 和受控的循环状态更新，并不需要显式层级结构；据此得到的 13.6M 参数模型把 Arithmetic OOD 准确率从 36.2% 提高到 71.2%，在 Sudoku 上达到 98.41%。

papers.title: Looped Diffusion Transformer

tldr.en: Looped-DiT repeats shared middle Transformer blocks within each denoising step of a text-to-image diffusion Transformer, adding deep supervision across loops and self-modulating attention; a 260M-parameter looped model surpasses a model 6.5x larger on multiple benchmarks with 4.9x lower inference compute.
tldr.zh: Looped-DiT 在文生图扩散 Transformer 的每个去噪步内重复运行共享的中间 Transformer 块，并采用跨循环深度监督和自调制注意力；260M 参数的循环模型在多个文生图基准上超过大 6.5x 的模型，推理计算量低 4.9x。

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Looped Mixture of Experts

tldr.en: Loop Scaling Laws jointly model recurrence, MoE sparsity, model size and data; looping the middle block gives ~2x total-parameter efficiency on reasoning and sparsity ~3x active-parameter efficiency, and at trillion-token scale a looped MoE matches a ~2x larger non-looped MoE on reasoning at matched compute.
tldr.zh: Loop Scaling Laws 联合建模循环、MoE 稀疏度、模型规模和数据量；循环中间块在推理任务上带来 ~2x 的总参数效率，稀疏带来 ~3x 的激活参数效率；在万亿 token 规模和相同训练算力下，循环 MoE 在推理基准上追平规模大 ~2x 的非循环 MoE。

papers.title: Random Recursive Models

tldr.en: RRM keeps a pool of L learned layers and, at each of T recursive steps, samples one layer with replacement per example; on reasoning tasks including Sudoku, Maze-Hard and ARC-AGI-1 it matches or exceeds baselines, often with 50-75% fewer parameters, and can run deeper at inference than in training.
tldr.zh: RRM 维护一个由 L 个学习层组成的层池，在 T 个递归步中每一步为每个样本有放回地随机抽取一层；在 Sudoku、Maze-Hard 和 ARC-AGI-1 等推理任务上，它达到或超过基线，参数常常少 50-75%，推理时还能运行比训练时更深的递归。

papers.title: Closing the Loop: Practical Training Recipes for Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Closing the Loop trains a 1.4B looped LM from scratch on 310B tokens instead of Ouro's 7.7T, beating a parameter-matched dense model on all 12 benchmarks (+14 points on GSM8K, +10 on MATH, +22 on DROP), and converts Qwen3-1.7B-Base into Looped Qwen with one learned input-mixing scalar and a smoothed exit loss.
tldr.zh: Closing the Loop 用 310B token（Ouro 用 7.7T）从头训练 1.4B 循环语言模型，在全部 12 个基准上超过参数匹配的稠密模型（GSM8K +14 分、MATH +10、DROP +22），并只用一个可学习的输入混合标量和平滑退出损失把 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 转换为 Looped Qwen。

papers.title: Looping Beyond Twice: A Scalable Recipe for Looped Mixture-of-Experts

tldr.en: LOOM loops a whole MoE decoder with residual scaling, input-embedding re-injection every loop, per-loop routers over shared experts and a Looping Residual; under near-iso-FLOP the 700M model performs best at 5 loops, cutting perplexity from 18.36 to 16.54 over the non-looped baseline.
tldr.zh: LOOM 循环整个 MoE 解码器，并采用残差缩放、每次循环重新注入输入嵌入、在共享专家之上为每次循环配独立路由器，以及 Looping Residual；在接近等 FLOPs 的条件下，700M 模型在 5 次循环时表现最好，相对不循环基线把困惑度从 18.36 降到 16.54。

papers.title: LAST: Looped Audio Spectrogram Transformer

tldr.en: LAST runs six shared blocks over all audio tokens once, then reuses them to refine only the class token against cached audio keys and values; on AudioSet ten-pass LAST reaches 0.345 mAP, 2.1% relative above a twelve-layer sequential transformer, with 49.4% fewer parameters and 42% fewer MACs.
tldr.zh: LAST 先用六个共享块处理全部音频 token 一遍，之后复用这些块，只在缓存的音频 key 和 value 上细化 class token；在 AudioSet 上，十遍 LAST 达到 0.345 mAP，比十二层顺序 Transformer 相对高 2.1%，参数少 49.4%，MACs 少 42%。

papers.title: Universal interpolation for deep residual self-attention networks

tldr.en: Proves universal interpolation for deep residual softmax attention under strong parameter reuse: two frozen single-head blocks with Gaussian-initialized projections, with only their order, signs and durations chosen per task, map any N sequences of n tokens to any other N, at continuous and finite depth.
tldr.zh: 证明强参数复用下深层残差 softmax 自注意力的通用插值性：两个投影矩阵为高斯初始化的冻结单头注意力块，只需按任务设定其应用顺序、符号和持续时长，就能把任意 N 条含 n 个 token 的序列映射为任意另外 N 条序列，在连续深度和有限深度下均成立。

papers.title: Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free

tldr.en: LoopCD, a training-free contrastive decoder, contrasts a looped Transformer's final prediction with an earlier recurrent pass; it lifts Ouro-2.6B-Thinking's AIME 2024 pass@1 from 61.88% to 73.33%, and at half the loops matches or exceeds full-depth unguided baselines while cutting forward FLOPs by 22.5% to 48.2%.
tldr.zh: LoopCD 是免训练的对比解码方法，用循环 Transformer 较早一遍循环的预测与最终预测作对比来选 token；它把 Ouro-2.6B-Thinking 的 AIME 2024 pass@1 从 61.88% 提高到 73.33%，循环次数减半时仍能达到或超过未引导的全深度基线，前向 FLOPs 减少 22.5% 到 48.2%。

papers.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Shared Memory in Looped Transformers

tldr.en: LPT pretrains looped LMs where only the first recursion writes a KV cache and later recursions read it plus a short local window; at 150M-1B parameters with five recursions, the hybrid variant cuts FineWeb-Edu validation perplexity by 1.12-1.82 versus a same-size standard Transformer with 76-79% less context memory.
tldr.zh: LPT 预训练的循环语言模型只让第一次递归写入 KV cache，后续递归读取它并只保留一个短的局部窗口；在 150M-1B 参数、五次递归下，混合变体在 FineWeb-Edu 上的验证困惑度比同规模标准 Transformer 低 1.12-1.82，上下文内存少用 76-79%。

papers.title: On the Chain-of-Thought Monitorability of Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Across eight MonitorBench tasks, raising Ouro-1.4B-Thinking's loop depth from T=4 to T=8 lowers stress-test CoT monitorability on some tasks (Logic 77.9% to 41.8% under Direct Concealment), but looped LMs are not systematically less monitorable than non-looped LMs matched on size or depth.
tldr.zh: 在 MonitorBench 的八个任务上，把 Ouro-1.4B-Thinking 的循环深度从 T=4 提高到 T=8 会降低部分任务在压力测试下的 CoT 可监控性（Direct Concealment 下 Logic 从 77.9% 降到 41.8%），但循环语言模型并不比规模或深度匹配的非循环模型系统性地更难监控。

papers.title: ALoDLM: Adaptively Looped Diffusion Language Models

tldr.en: ALoDLM converts Qwen3 into a diffusion language model whose recurrent core gives unresolved tokens extra passes while confident tokens commit as context, with exit schedules learned through a NELBO; at 1.7B and 8B it beats all evaluated DLMs and the AR baselines in average score on eleven benchmarks.
tldr.zh: ALoDLM 把 Qwen3 转换为扩散语言模型：循环核心对未确定的 token 继续做额外循环精炼，已确定的 token 作为离散上下文提交，退出调度通过 NELBO 学习；在 1.7B 和 8B 规模上，它在十一个基准上的平均分超过所有评测的 DLM 和对应的 AR 基线。

papers.title: Dynamic Routing as a New Dimension for Test-time Versatility of LLMs

tldr.en: Training-free dynamic routing fits programs that skip layers or repeat blocks of a frozen LLM's layers from 3 or 10 demonstrations, with the model's confidence arbitrating; it gains on average over MMLU's 49 tasks, doubles a 7B model's ARC-AGI accuracy where its CoT fails, and complements CoT.
tldr.zh: 无需训练的动态路由从 3 或 10 个示例中为冻结的 LLM 拟合跳过某些层或重复若干层块的执行程序，并由模型自身的置信度仲裁；它在 MMLU 的 49 个任务上平均带来提升，在 CoT 失效的 ARC-AGI 上让一个 7B 模型的准确率翻倍，并与 CoT 互补。

papers.title: LoopMoEVR: Loop-Based Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Unified UHD Video Restoration

tldr.en: LoopMoEVR loops two parameter-shared MoE layers between a video encoder and decoder, conditioned on degradation and video state, with a depth predictor setting the loop count; with approximately 0.884M parameters, one model handles four UHD video restoration tasks with the highest mean PSNR on UHV-4K-AIO.
tldr.zh: LoopMoEVR 在视频编码器和解码器之间循环执行两个参数共享的 MoE 层，以退化信息和视频状态为条件，并由深度预测器为每个输入选择循环次数；它只有约 0.884M 参数，单个模型即可处理四种 UHD 视频复原任务，并在 UHV-4K-AIO 上取得最高的平均 PSNR。

papers.title: Loopy: Low-Bit Quantization Framework for Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Loopy quantizes the shared core of looped LMs after training, picking channel-scaling and rotation configurations by final prediction loss at the target deployment depth, with calibration windows going to promising candidates; on Ouro-1.4B under W4A4 it cuts LAMBADA perplexity by 36.5% versus SpinQuant.
tldr.zh: Loopy 对循环语言模型的共享核心做训练后量化，按目标部署深度下的最终预测损失选择通道缩放和正交旋转配置，并把校准窗口分配给有希望的候选；在 Ouro-1.4B 的 W4A4 设置下，它的 LAMBADA 困惑度比 SpinQuant 降低 36.5%。

papers.title: LiFT: Loop Flow Transformers

tldr.en: LiFT loops a shared DiT core and trains each step toward a point on a straight path from the initial estimate to the flow-matching target, indexed by continuous depth, so it can loop past training depth; on ImageNet 256x256, LiFT-L/2 beats DiT-XL/2 by 3.34 FID with approximately 60% fewer parameters.
tldr.zh: LiFT 循环使用共享的 DiT 核心，让每一步逼近从初始估计到 flow-matching 目标的直线路径上由连续深度坐标索引的点，因此可以循环到超出训练深度；在 ImageNet 256x256 上，LiFT-L/2 的 FID 比 DiT-XL/2 低 3.34，参数约少 60%。

papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points

tldr.en: Shows that near fixed points looped LMs can skip recurrence paths in training, decoding, prefill and RL; its learned depth prior and orthogonal input injection lower perplexity over existing choices from 100M to 1.6B.
tldr.zh: 说明循环语言模型的状态接近不动点时，训练、解码、prefill 和 RL 都可以跳过递归路径；文中学习的深度先验和正交输入注入在 100M 到 1.6B 参数规模上都比已有做法困惑度更低。

papers.title: AdaLoop: Adaptive-Depth Latent Reasoning for Audio Language Models

tldr.en: AdaLoop replaces the encoder-to-LM connector of audio LMs with a shared Transformer block that iterates over audio features, guided by the question, until a learned halting unit stops it; with fewer than 3% extra parameters it raises average accuracy by 2.9 to 3.8 points on MMSU, MMAU-Pro and MMAR.
tldr.zh: AdaLoop 把音频语言模型中连接音频编码器与语言模型的 connector 换成一个共享 Transformer 块，在问题引导下对音频表示反复迭代，直到学习的停止单元让它退出；它增加的参数不到 3%，在 MMSU、MMAU-Pro 和 MMAR 上把平均准确率提高 2.9 到 3.8 分。
