papers.title: TAFFY: A Task-Adaptive Tabular Foundation Model with In-Context Diversity

tldr.en: TAFFY, a tabular foundation model, loops a shared ICL Transformer stack over contextual representations with a task-conditioned gate on the final update, and pretrains on contexts mixing causally related environments; it attains the lowest average rank across six classification and five regression benchmark datasets.
tldr.zh: TAFFY 是一个表格基础模型，它在上下文表示上循环应用共享的 ICL Transformer 堆栈，用任务条件化门控调节最后一次更新，并在混合多个因果相关环境的上下文上预训练；它在六个分类和五个回归基准数据集上取得最低的平均排名。

papers.title: Recurrent Looped Transformer

tldr.en: RLT splits its layers into a parallel causal encoder and a recurrent decoder fed the previous token's final decoder state; trained on at most 40 bits, two splits reach 100% parity accuracy at 256 bits, and on swap-based S_5 at eight times the training length it reaches 97% versus under 1% for a Transformer.
tldr.zh: RLT 把各层分为并行的因果编码器和循环解码器，解码器还接收前一 token 的最终解码器状态；在最多 40 位上训练后，两种层划分在 256 位奇偶校验上达到 100% 准确率，在八倍训练长度的基于交换的 S_5 置换跟踪上达到 97%，而 Transformer 不到 1%。

papers.title: SanSi: A Looped Typed Decision Model for System 1.5 Thinking

tldr.en: SanSi turns the pretrained looped LM Ouro into a typed decision model that reads option probabilities after every loop, each trained with a proper scoring rule; on 10,027 test decisions it reaches 72.0% accuracy, 13.5 points above a non-looped model of the same shape trained with the same recipe.
tldr.zh: SanSi 把预训练循环语言模型 Ouro 改造成 typed decision model，每次循环后读出各选项概率，并用 proper scoring rule 训练每次循环；在 10,027 个测试决策上准确率为 72.0%，比同形状、同配方训练的非循环模型高 13.5 个点。

papers.title: Hybrid Latent Attention for Looped Language Models

tldr.en: HLA keeps exact KV only for a window of recent tokens and stores older ones as compact latents that each loop's query reads directly; uptrained on frozen Ouro looped models (T=4), it cuts the cache 10.7x per token, speeds decoding up to 7.4x at 16K and retains over 97% of the original accuracy on math, knowledge and reasoning.
tldr.zh: HLA 只为最近窗口内的 token 保留精确的 key 和 value，较早的 token 存成紧凑的 latent，由每次循环的 query 直接读取；在冻结的 Ouro 循环模型（T=4）上 uptrain 后，每 token 缓存缩小 10.7x，16K 上下文的 decode 吞吐最高提升 7.4x，并在数学、知识和推理基准上保留 97% 以上的原始准确率。

papers.title: MoR-MLLM: Mixture of Recursions for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models

tldr.en: MoR-MLLM brings Mixture-of-Recursions to multimodal LLMs, giving each token an adaptive recursion depth, trained with a three-stage MoR-Tuning strategy and an entropy-regularized routing loss; versus recent tiny MLLMs it cuts training memory and computation while keeping vision-language performance.
tldr.zh: MoR-MLLM 把 Mixture-of-Recursions 引入多模态大模型，为每个 token 自适应分配递归深度，并用三阶段 MoR-Tuning 策略和鼓励路由多样性的熵正则化损失稳定训练；与近期的小型 MLLM 相比，它降低了训练显存和计算量，同时在多种视觉语言任务上保持高性能。

papers.title: Enabling Dynamic Computation in Looped LMs

tldr.en: Ragged KV, a best-available KV cache, lets early-exiting tokens in Ouro-style looped LMs stop computing by aliasing deeper KV entries to their exit-depth cache, cutting FLOPs and KV memory by up to 30% at full-depth performance; a corrected early-exit prior makes tokens exit at heterogeneous depths.
tldr.zh: Ragged KV 是一种“最佳可用”KV 缓存策略：提前退出的 token 不再继续计算，更深循环所需的 KV 条目直接复用其退出深度的缓存，在 Ouro 类循环语言模型上把 FLOPs 和 KV 内存最多减少 30%，同时保持全深度性能；修正早退先验的施加方式后，token 会按难度在不同深度退出。

papers.title: Input-Blind Controls Produce Substantial Oracle Headroom for Layer Programs in Multiple-Choice Evaluation

tldr.en: For 32 layer-skipping and repetition programs on Qwen3-4B-Base and Llama-3.1-8B, input-blind controls give 10.2-11.8 and 15.6-19.4 percentage points of oracle headroom with shared option order, above the real programs' 9.0 and 10.1, so headroom does not establish a layer-specific benefit.
tldr.zh: 在 Qwen3-4B-Base 和 Llama-3.1-8B 上比较 32 个跳层与重复层程序，选项顺序共享时，输入无关的对照扰动给出 10.2-11.8 和 15.6-19.4 个百分点的 oracle headroom，超过真实程序的 9.0 和 10.1，因此 headroom 不能证明所选层计算带来特定收益。

papers.title: ResidualQuant: KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers with 2-Bit Residuals

tldr.en: ResidualQuant keeps a looped Transformer's final-loop KV as reference and stores other loops as low-precision residuals, with least-square scaling, rotation and loop-wise mixed precision; it stays close to BF16 accuracy, cuts theoretical KV storage by 80.7% and improves peak throughput by up to 5.38x.
tldr.zh: ResidualQuant 以循环 Transformer 末遍的 KV 为参照，把其余各遍的 KV 存成低精度残差，并结合最小二乘缩放、旋转量化和按循环的混合精度；准确率接近 BF16，理论 KV 存储减少 80.7%，峰值吞吐最高提升至 5.38x。

papers.title: Executing Causal Structure Learning with Linear-Attention Transformers

tldr.en: Builds a fixed-weight linear-attention Transformer block that exactly performs one update of an acyclicity-constrained continuous causal-discovery method, so repeated blocks reproduce its trajectory; the multiplier must be carried between updates, and trained attention models do not reliably execute it.
tldr.zh: 构造一个固定权重的线性注意力 Transformer 块，其一次前向传播精确执行带无环约束的连续因果发现方法的一步更新，重复该块即可复现其优化轨迹；在更新之间保留乘子是精确执行的必要条件，而经过训练的普通注意力模型无法可靠地执行该更新。

papers.title: Recurrent Self-Improvement: Dynamic Cross-Loop On-Policy Distillation for Looped Language Models

tldr.en: LoopOPD post-trains a looped LM by distilling its frozen terminal-loop policy into an intermediate-loop student on the student's own rollouts, and D-LoopOPD refreshes that teacher as the shared weights update; on Ouro-2.6B-Thinking, D-LoopOPD raises terminal-loop AIME 2024 Avg@16 from 62.08 to 71.67.
tldr.zh: LoopOPD 在学生自己生成的 rollout 上，把循环语言模型冻结的最后一遍循环策略蒸馏给中间一遍循环的学生策略，D-LoopOPD 则随共享参数更新不断刷新这个教师；在 Ouro-2.6B-Thinking 上，D-LoopOPD 把最后一遍循环的 AIME 2024 Avg@16 从 62.08 提高到 71.67。

papers.title: Safe at One Loop, Risky at Another: Aligning Safety Across Recurrent Depths in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Jailbreaks on Ouro LoopLMs can succeed more at deeper recurrent depths and transfer across depths; SafeBridge adds depth-specific control of shared layers, selective state bridging and joint cross-depth safety supervision, cutting matched- and cross-depth attack success while improving general utility.
tldr.zh: 对 Ouro 循环语言模型的越狱攻击在更深的循环深度上可能更易成功，且可在深度间迁移；SafeBridge 为共享层加入深度专属控制、选择性状态桥接和跨深度联合安全监督，降低同深度与跨深度攻击的成功率，同时提升通用能力。

papers.title: Invariant-Measure Reasoners: Stable Representations for Latent Reasoning

tldr.en: ImR predicts from the prediction head's output averaged along a recurrent block's latent trajectory, approximating its invariant measure, rather than from the final state; head-only fine-tuning and from-scratch training reduce prediction instability and improve accuracy in many maze and Sudoku settings.
tldr.zh: ImR 不再用最终潜在状态做预测，而是用循环块潜在状态的不变测度下预测头输出的期望（沿轨迹取平均来估计）；只微调预测头和从头训练两种方式都在许多迷宫和 Sudoku 设置中降低了预测不稳定性并提高了准确率。

papers.title: From Chain-of-Thought to Loops: Non-Autoregressive Latent Reasoning via Looped Transformers

tldr.en: LLoCoT loops the full Qwen3-1.7B-Base backbone over a fixed workspace of latent slots, then samples all latent thoughts in parallel to condition answer decoding; on HumanEval and MBPP it matches explicit-CoT Reasoning SFT while cutting time to the first answer token by approximately 36×.
tldr.zh: LLoCoT 在固定的潜在槽位工作区上循环复用完整的 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 主干，再并行采样全部潜在思维来引导答案解码；在 HumanEval 和 MBPP 上，它与显式 CoT 的 Reasoning SFT 表现相当，首个答案 token 的时间缩短约 36×。

papers.title: Scaling to Tens of Thousands of Test-Time Iterations with Loop-Native Attention Residuals

tldr.en: InfiLoop swaps the carry-last state update of looped reasoners for a loop-native residual that weights past states by content and learned decay in constant memory; a 7M-parameter model reaches 97.9% exact accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme and 13.6% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-2, improving beyond 20,000 effective steps.
tldr.zh: InfiLoop 用一种循环原生的残差连接替换循环推理器中只传递最新状态（carry-last）的更新：按内容和可学习的衰减对过去的状态加权，且内存恒定；7M 参数的模型在 Sudoku-Extreme 上达到 97.9% 的精确准确率，在 ARC-AGI-2 上达到 13.6% pass@2，测试时循环超过 20,000 个有效步后仍在提升。

papers.title: One Block, Multiple Depths: Recurrent Vision Transformers with Depth-Programmed Experts

tldr.en: reViT reuses one Transformer block across a vision encoder's depth, with each depth's FFN a convex combination of shared experts programmed by normalized depth; trained from scratch, reViT-B/16 attains DeiT III accuracy with about 70% fewer stored parameters, and one checkpoint runs at multiple depths.
tldr.zh: reViT 在视觉编码器的整个深度上复用同一个 Transformer 块，每个深度的 FFN 是共享专家的凸组合，组合系数由归一化深度决定；从头训练的 reViT-B/16 以少约 70% 的存储参数达到 DeiT III 的准确率，且同一个 checkpoint 可在多个深度下运行。

papers.title: One Model to Loop Them All: Elastic Latent Recurrence for Language Models

tldr.en: ELR trains looped LMs without the one-loop tax using a gated state update, loop counts mixed within each optimizer update and loop-index and budget conditioning; on 4B dense and 30B-A3B MoE hybrids, one loop is 0.52 points below and 1.04 above the matched baseline (ten-task average), and four loops add 7.25 and 4.75 points.
tldr.zh: ELR 用带学习步长的门控状态更新、在每次优化器更新内混合多种循环次数、并以循环序号和预算为条件来训练循环语言模型，避免单循环时落后于同规模非循环模型；在 4B dense 和 30B-A3B MoE 混合模型上，单循环时十项任务平均分别比匹配基线低 0.52 分和高 1.04 分，四次循环再提高 7.25 和 4.75 分。

papers.title: RAMP: Recurrent Adaptive Mixed Precision for Efficient Prefill in Recurrent-Depth Language Models

tldr.en: RAMP runs the first 24 of Huginn-0125's 32 recurrent steps with FP8 weight-and-activation computation and the last 8 in BF16, as earlier quantization error is attenuated by later steps; up to 4K context it keeps near-full-precision prefill quality with up to 1.16× first-prefill speedup on an NVIDIA H100.
tldr.zh: RAMP 让 Huginn-0125 的 32 个循环步中前 24 步用 FP8 权重与激活计算、后 8 步恢复 BF16，因为较早引入的量化误差会被后续循环步衰减；在最长 4K 的上下文中，它保持接近全精度的 prefill 质量，在 NVIDIA H100 上首次 prefill 最多加速 1.16×。

papers.title: Scaling RNA Foundation Models through Iterative Refinement

tldr.en: Eco-RNA, an 80M-parameter RNA foundation model, repeats a shared input-conditioned Transformer core between a prelude and coda, trained at sampled depths; four iterations instead of one raise RNAGym aggregate absolute Spearman from 0.242 to 0.286 and beat Evo 2 40B on all three aggregate fitness metrics.
tldr.zh: Eco-RNA 是 80M 参数的 RNA 基础模型，在 prelude 和 coda 之间重复应用共享、以输入为条件的 Transformer 核心，并在采样深度上训练；把迭代从一次增加到四次，RNAGym 总体绝对 Spearman 相关从 0.242 升到 0.286，并在全部三项总体 fitness 指标上超过 Evo 2 40B。

papers.title: Rotate the Loop: Blockwise Conformality for Looped Transformers
papers.venue: NeurIPS 2026 Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training Workshop

tldr.en: Blockwise conformal injections make the map applied to the residual between loop steps rotate coordinate-aligned groups, each at its own rate; on A5 word problems, last-token accuracy at T=32 rises from 0.692 with Parcae's diagonal map to 0.894, and FineWeb perplexity and LAMBADA also improve.
tldr.zh: Blockwise conformal injection 让循环步之间作用于残差的线性映射在按坐标划分的各组内旋转，每组有各自的速率；在 A5 word problem 上，T=32 时的最后 token 准确率从 Parcae 对角映射的 0.692 提高到 0.894，FineWeb 困惑度和 LAMBADA 也有改善。

papers.title: Adaptive-Depth Is a Finishing Stage

tldr.en: Fixed-first training keeps a looped Transformer at one depth and varies depth only in a short final phase; at 200M, depth 2 for the first 67% of the run cuts modeled compute by 45% with mean NLL across inference depths within 0.5% of all-depth training, and at 1B it saves 31% to 37% with final NLL within 0.8%.
tldr.zh: Fixed-first 训练让循环 Transformer 先保持单一深度，只在最后一小段训练中改变深度；在 200M 规模上，前 67% 训练用深度 2 可把建模计算量减少 45%，各推理深度的平均 NLL 与全程多深度训练相差不超过 0.5%；在 1B 规模上可节省 31% 到 37% 的计算量，最终 NLL 相差不超过 0.8%。

papers.title: Learning to Extrapolate in Depth with Looped Transformers

tldr.en: For looped Transformers on all-pairs graph connectivity, proves that training at depth K converges to an update rule with one effective parameter, giving a finite extrapolation window with explicit endpoints; a test depth chosen from the training distribution alone can guarantee recovery on much harder graphs.
tldr.zh: 针对全点对图连通性任务上的循环 Transformer，证明在深度 K 上训练会收敛到只由一个有效参数控制的更新规则，从而形成端点明确的有限外推窗口；仅依据训练分布选定的测试深度即可保证在难得多的图上恢复连通性。

papers.title: Recurrent In-Context Learning for Tabular Foundation Models

tldr.en: Tab-Loop replaces the 12 untied in-context-learning blocks of the tabular foundation model TabICLv2 with 4 tied blocks applied k times; at matched pretraining and inference compute it matches the untied baseline with 62% fewer parameters (10.4M vs. 27.6M), and accuracy rises with the number of loops.
tldr.zh: Tab-Loop 把表格基础模型 TabICLv2 中 12 个不共享权重的上下文学习（ICL）块换成 4 个共享权重、循环 k 次的块；在预训练和推理算力都匹配时，它以少 62% 的参数（10.4M 对 27.6M）追平不共享基线，且准确率随循环次数增加而提升。

papers.title: Running Fewer Loops Removes Refusal Behaviour in Recurrent-Depth Language Models

tldr.en: At half its trained depth Ouro-1.4B-Thinking keeps 89% of its GSM8K accuracy, but its harmful-request help rate rises from 0.038 to 0.205 although a linear classifier still detects harm after one loop (ROC AUC 0.967); training at random depths keeps Huginn-0125 at or below 0.040 from 1 to 32 loops.
tldr.zh: 在训练深度的一半时，Ouro-1.4B-Thinking 保留 89% 的 GSM8K 准确率，但协助有害请求的比例从 0.038 升至 0.205，而线性分类器在一次循环后仍能读出请求是否有害（ROC AUC 0.967）；以随机深度训练使 Huginn-0125 在 1 到 32 次循环的每个深度上有害协助率都不超过 0.040。

papers.title: DeepThink: A Conceptual Model for Knowledge-Addressable Recurrent Language Modeling

tldr.en: DeepThink is a conceptual framework, without experiments, for recurrent language models: at each step a Knowledge Activator picks Knowledge Bank units to assemble a Shared Thinking Operator; for compatible templates, an existing fixed-depth model can be realized exactly under a fixed schedule.
tldr.zh: DeepThink 是一个面向循环语言模型的概念框架（没有实验）：每一步由 Knowledge Activator 从 Knowledge Bank 中选出知识单元，组装成 Shared Thinking Operator 来更新状态；对兼容的模板，已有的固定深度模型可以在固定调度下被精确实现。

papers.title: LoopQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: LoopQuant is a loop-aware PTQ framework for looped LMs that shares a quantization-friendly representation across loops and allocates activation precision per loop; on Ouro-2.6B its W4A4 surpasses all W4A8 baselines, cuts model memory by 65.3% and decodes 1.7 times faster than BF16.
tldr.zh: LoopQuant 是面向循环语言模型的 loop-aware PTQ 框架，在各循环间学习共享的易量化表示，并按循环分配激活精度；在 Ouro-2.6B 上，其 W4A4 超过所有 W4A8 基线，模型内存减少 65.3%，解码速度达到 BF16 的 1.7 倍。

papers.title: Chain Dimension Scaling: Communication-Efficient Loop-Style Scaling for Industrial Short-Video Ranking

tldr.en: CDS reuses each feature-interaction block of an industrial short-video ranker over several iterations with an intra-iteration residual; compressed, it cuts trainable parameters by 26.6% and raises training throughput by 6.4% within 0.03% of baseline offline quality, mainly via lower synchronization cost.
tldr.zh: CDS 在工业短视频排序模型中让每个特征交互块以共享参数迭代多次，并加入迭代内残差；在压缩设置下，可训练参数减少 26.6%，训练吞吐提高 6.4%，离线质量与基线相差在 0.03% 以内，提速主要来自跨设备同步开销的降低。

papers.title: Resample the Answer: Where to Spend Test-Time Compute in Recursive Reasoning

tldr.en: Gated Answer Resampling resamples the answer state y of a Tiny Recursive Model and restarts only puzzles its halting head rejects; with at most 64 restarts per puzzle and no training, it lifts TRM from 85.9% to 99.4% on Sudoku-Extreme and from 68.8% to 85.6% on Pencil Puzzle Bench validation.
tldr.zh: Gated Answer Resampling（GAR）对 Tiny Recursive Model 的答案状态 y 重新采样，只重启被模型自身 halting head 拒绝的谜题；每个谜题最多重启 64 次且无需训练，就把 TRM 在 Sudoku-Extreme 上的准确率从 85.9% 提高到 99.4%，在 Pencil Puzzle Bench 验证集上从 68.8% 提高到 85.6%。

papers.title: LoopREG: Representation Supervision Enables Test-Time Recurrent Depth in Diffusion Transformers

tldr.en: LoopREG reuses one diffusion Transformer block at the state that REG aligns to a pretrained visual encoder and adds visits at inference; on ImageNet 256 x 256 it lowers SiT-B/2 FID from 15.08 to 4.91 at 400K training steps, and in a checkpoint trained with two visits one extra visit improves FID from 14.71 to 5.34.
tldr.zh: LoopREG 在 REG 用预训练视觉编码器监督的表示位置反复使用同一个扩散 Transformer 块，推理时增加访问次数；在 ImageNet 256 x 256 上，400K 训练步时把 SiT-B/2 的 FID 从 15.08 降到 4.91，用两次访问训练的检查点在推理时多一次访问可把 FID 从 14.71 降到 5.34。

papers.title: Monitoring latent reasoning in looped language models

tldr.en: Five interpretability lenses on eight looped LMs from four families show carry-loop models (Ouro, LoopUS) predict best within their training depth and lose answers, language or refusals under noise, while re-read-loop models (Parcae, Rec-OLMo, Huginn) improve or plateau with more iterations and are unaffected by noise.
tldr.zh: 研究用五种机制可解释性视角考察四个系列的八个循环语言模型，发现 carry loop 模型（Ouro、LoopUS）在训练深度内预测最好，注入噪声后会丢失答案、语言能力或拒答对齐，而 re-read loop 模型（Parcae、Rec-OLMo、Huginn）随迭代增多而提升或持平，且不受噪声影响。

papers.title: LoOPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Looped Teachers

tldr.en: LoOPSD makes a teacher by searching for a contiguous layer block of the same LLM to run twice with unchanged weights, then distills its predictions on student-generated prefixes into the standard model over rounds; on GSM8K with a 400-token thinking budget, Qwen3-1.7B rises from 42.30% to 79.61%.
tldr.zh: LoOPSD 保持权重不变，搜索一段连续的层让它执行两次，以此用同一个 LLM 构造教师，再在多轮中把教师对学生生成前缀的预测蒸馏回按标准顺序执行的学生；在 GSM8K、400-token 思考预算下，Qwen3-1.7B 的准确率从 42.30% 提高到 79.61%。

papers.title: Looped Reasoning Finishes Earlier Than You Think

tldr.en: Since slowly decaying oscillatory modes bottleneck convergence in looped reasoners, QRR adds an exact per-token phase-rotation symmetry to FPRM's recurrent Transformer block; it converges stably and faster in quotient space and matches or beats recent recurrent reasoners on Sudoku, Maze and Mini-ARC.
tldr.zh: 该文发现缓慢衰减的振荡模态会拖慢循环推理模型的收敛，并提出 QRR：在 FPRM 的循环 Transformer 块上施加逐 token 的精确相位旋转对称性；它在商空间中收敛更稳定、更快，在 Sudoku、Maze 和 Mini-ARC 上达到或超过近期的循环推理模型。

papers.title: Tiny Recursive Message Passing

tldr.en: Applies TRM-style deep supervision, truncated recursion and deduction lattices to recursive message-passing networks; a 16k-parameter model reaches about 99% test accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme after about 10 minutes of H100 training, and models transfer zero-shot to larger N-queens and SAT instances.
tldr.zh: 把 TRM 式的深度监督、截断递归和 deduction lattice 用于递归消息传递网络；一个 16k 参数的模型在 H100 上训练约 10 分钟即可在 Sudoku-Extreme 上达到约 99% 的测试准确率，模型还能零样本迁移到更大的 N-queens 和 SAT 实例。

papers.title: Test-Time Forecasting: Recurrent Depth Enables In-Context Dynamics Prediction

tldr.en: Linking linear attention to (extended) dynamic mode decomposition, shows looped transformers can emulate dynamical-system propagators in context; Test-Time Forecasting uses gradient-descent iterations as recurrent depth, and small models trained on ODEs and PDEs generalize to out-of-distribution dynamics.
tldr.zh: 通过联系线性注意力与（扩展）动态模态分解，表明循环 Transformer 能在上下文中模拟动力系统的传播算子；Test-Time Forecasting 把梯度下降迭代当作循环深度，在 ODE 和 PDE 上训练的小模型能泛化到分布外的动力学。

papers.title: Learning to Compute Is Not Learning to Retain or Reuse in Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Separates computing, retaining and reusing answers in looped Transformers executing Mealy machines in context: models trained to answer at loop 32 keep only 22% of answers at loop 64 (99.8% when one random position is supervised), and freezing position k from loop k drops accuracy to 4–6%.
tldr.zh: 在上下文执行 Mealy 机的任务上区分循环 Transformer 的计算、保持与复用：训练成在第 32 次循环作答的模型到第 64 次循环只保留 22% 的答案（每例随机监督一个位置时为 99.8%），而从第 k 次循环起冻结位置 k 会使准确率降到 4–6%。

papers.title: LatentLoop: Scaling Looped MoE Models with Asymmetric Compute Allocation

tldr.en: In a looped MoE that visits its middle block twice, LatentLoop runs the first visit on a compressed sequence, shares only MoE weights across visits and widens the model; at 1.3B–7B it lowers validation NLL, with predicted compute savings of 19.0% and 7.9% over vanilla MoE and the looped baseline.
tldr.zh: 在中间块访问两次的循环 MoE 中，LatentLoop 让第一次访问只处理压缩后的序列，跨访问只共享 MoE 权重，并用省下的计算加宽模型；它在 1.3B–7B 规模上都降低了验证 NLL，预测比 vanilla MoE 和循环基线分别节省 19.0% 和 7.9% 的计算。

papers.title: LEV: Thinking Fast and Deep with Looped Decision Models

tldr.en: LEV turns natively looped language models into decision models that score options after each loop step, training all steps jointly; a 2.6B LEV rises from 63.2% at depth one to 76.2% at depth four on JevBench, and a stopper fitted on unlabelled requests saves 15% to 24% of compute for under one point.
tldr.zh: LEV 把原生循环的语言模型改造成决策模型，在每次循环后都对选项打分，并联合训练所有循环步；2.6B 的 LEV 在 JevBench 上从深度一的 63.2% 提升到深度四的 76.2%，用无标注请求拟合阈值的 stopper 可节省 15% 到 24% 的计算，准确率损失不到一个点。

papers.title: AdaLoop: Thinking with the Vision Encoder

tldr.en: AdaLoop loops a span of a VLM's frozen vision encoder, modulating the shared layers at each iteration with question-conditioned AdaLN; with matched data and optimizer updates, it beats standard fine-tuning and question-conditioned single-pass baselines on six VisRO tasks across three VLM families.
tldr.zh: AdaLoop 循环应用 VLM 冻结视觉编码器中的一段层，并在每次迭代中用以问题为条件的 AdaLN 调制这些共享层；在训练数据和优化器更新次数匹配时，它在三个 VLM 系列的六个 VisRO 任务上优于标准微调和以问题为条件的单次前向基线。

papers.title: LoopAhead: Speculating Ahead for Faster Decoding in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: LoopAhead drafts several future tokens from a looped LM's early-loop states with a lightweight drafter, uses deeper-loop feedback to pause or continue branches, and lets the full-depth model verify, reaching up to 7.82x decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding while preserving the output distribution.
tldr.zh: LoopAhead 用轻量的前瞻 drafter 基于循环语言模型的早期循环状态起草多个未来 token，用更深循环的反馈决定继续或暂停各草稿分支，再由完整深度模型验证；在保持输出分布不变的情况下，解码速度最高达到自回归解码的 7.82 倍。

papers.title: Retrofitting Recurrent Vision-Language Models from Pretrained Backbones

tldr.en: Retrofits TinyLLaVA-1.4B into a recurrent VLM by pruning language-backbone layers and looping a subset of the rest through a linear adapter, recovered with three-stage training and distillation; it beats the unpruned baseline trained on the same recovery data while storing 23.3% fewer language parameters.
tldr.zh: 把 TinyLLaVA-1.4B 改造成循环视觉语言模型：剪掉语言骨干中的部分层，经线性 adapter 循环剩余层中的一段，并用三阶段恢复训练和蒸馏恢复性能；它优于用相同恢复数据训练的未剪枝基线，同时语言参数少 23.3%。

papers.title: Causal Latent Workspaces for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: The causal latent workspace Transformer runs one shared block for four rounds; before each round every position writes gated vectors into prefix-specific latent slots and reads a content-addressed summary, giving the best mean held-out perplexity in five of six byte-level settings against five Transformer controls.
tldr.zh: causal latent workspace Transformer 把一个共享块运行四轮，每轮之前每个位置都把门控向量写入按前缀划分的潜在槽位，并读取按内容寻址的摘要；在六个字节级设置中的五个上，它的平均留出困惑度优于五种 Transformer 对照模型。

papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part I: Topology, Input Injection, Recurrent-State Design

tldr.en: Isolates loop placement, input injection and recurrent-state design in matched from-scratch looped LMs; a prelude-recurrent-coda Huginn-style design outperforms Ouro across all ten benchmarks at 730M parameters and 336B tokens, and the advantage transfers to MoE.
tldr.zh: 在从头训练、参数规模、逻辑深度和 token 预算都匹配的循环语言模型中分别考察循环位置、输入注入和递归状态设计；在 730M 参数、336B token 规模下，完整的 Huginn 式 prelude-recurrent-coda 设计在全部十个基准上优于 Ouro，且这一优势可迁移到 MoE 模型。

papers.title: ReLaDrift: Recurrent Language Generation via Drifting for Test-Time Scaling

tldr.en: ReLaDrift reuses one Drifting Model over rounds to draft from noise and refine in continuous latent space, trained with a sampled round count and a final-round-only loss; on Sudoku Hard and GSM8K it trades test-time compute for quality, competitive with or better than diffusion and flow LMs.
tldr.zh: ReLaDrift 多轮复用同一个 Drifting Model：先从噪声生成初稿，再在连续隐空间中迭代细化；训练时随机采样轮数，只在最后一轮计算损失并停止此前各轮的梯度；在 Sudoku Hard 和 GSM8K 上，它可用更多测试时计算换取更好的生成质量，与扩散和 flow 语言模型相当或更优。

papers.title: Looped GNNs Beyond Fixed Depth: Graph Size Generalization and Parameter-Efficient Adaptation

tldr.en: Looped GNNs reuse a pretrained processor beyond its training depth to generalize to larger graphs; Loop-Freeze-Steer freezes the processor and trains a small controller between iterations, and synthetic tasks and chip placement show its accuracy–trainable-parameter trade-off.
tldr.zh: Looped GNN 在超出训练深度时继续重复使用预训练的处理器，以泛化到更大的图；Loop-Freeze-Steer 冻结该处理器，只在迭代之间训练一个小控制器，合成任务和芯片布局实验展示了它在准确率与可训练参数量之间的权衡。

papers.title: Inside the Loop: A Mechanistic Study of Looped Transformers on Permutation Traversal

tldr.en: On directed permutation traversal, a four-layer block looped eight times solves the task in every seed while an identically trained untied transformer of equal effective depth never does; probing shows the looped model steps through intermediate nodes in a staircase that adapts to its iteration budget.
tldr.zh: 在有向置换遍历任务上，四层块循环八次的模型在每个种子下都能解出任务，而训练方式相同、有效深度相同的非共享 Transformer 从未解出；探针显示循环模型逐步推进中间节点，形成随迭代预算调整的阶梯。

papers.title: Block Recursive Transformers for Structured Parameter Sharing

tldr.en: Block Recursive Transformers split the shared core between independent first and last layers into contiguous blocks and repeat each block before moving to the next; in decoder-only models up to 1.7B parameters this improves validation NLL and downstream accuracy over static recursive sharing baselines.
tldr.zh: Block Recursive Transformers 把首尾独立层之间的共享核心划分为若干连续块，每个块重复执行后再进入下一个块；在最大 1.7B 参数的 decoder-only 模型上，这种方式的验证 NLL 和下游准确率都优于静态递归共享基线。

papers.title: UpLoop: Upcycling Large Language Models with Gated Loop

tldr.en: UpLoop upcycles a pretrained non-looped LLM by looping each selected middle layer locally, with learned hidden-wise gates on the attention and MLP residual writes of later loops; starting from Qwen3-4B Base with SFT, it improves the 20-benchmark average by 6.17% at R=3, past the common two-loop saturation.
tldr.zh: UpLoop 把预训练的非循环 LLM 中选定的中间层各自就地循环，并对后续循环的 attention 和 MLP 残差写入施加按隐藏维度学习的门控；从 Qwen3-4B Base 出发经 SFT 后，R=3 时 20 个基准的平均准确率提升 6.17%，突破了常见的两遍循环饱和。

papers.title: P2N: Reusing Deep Representations for Greater Effective Depth

tldr.en: P2N adds the previous token's middle-core output to the current token's core input, extending effective depth across tokens for one vector addition per decoding step, trained with parallel Jacobi updates; at 1.5B parameters it lifts GSM8K accuracy by over 10 percentage points at nearly unchanged decoding latency.
tldr.zh: P2N 把上一个 token 中间层核心的输出加到当前 token 的核心输入上，每个解码步只多一次向量加法即可跨 token 延伸有效深度，训练时用并行 Jacobi 更新；在 1.5B 参数规模下，GSM8K 准确率提高超过 10 个百分点，解码延迟几乎不变。

papers.title: Dual-Slot: From Serial Loops to Parallel Slots in Language Models

tldr.en: Dual-Slot runs a looped middle block's two loops as parallel latent and prediction slots, the latter adding the previous token's latent state, trained via Jacobi iterations; the 1B dense model cuts Pile validation perplexity from 7.25 to 7.00 and keeps 93.1-96.5% of vanilla decoding throughput.
tldr.zh: Dual-Slot 把循环中间块的两次循环改成并行的潜在槽和预测槽，预测槽加入上一个 token 的潜在状态，训练时用 Jacobi 迭代并行细化；1B 稠密模型的 Pile 验证困惑度从 7.25 降到 7.00，同时保留 93.1-96.5% 的原始解码吞吐量。

papers.title: Spherical Fixed-Point Reasoners: Adaptive Loop Halting on the Hypersphere

tldr.en: SFPRM runs FPRM's damped fixed-point loop of a weight-tied nGPT block on the unit hypersphere, so injection, damping and halting become geodesic operations with proven convergence; it reaches 96.6%, 87.9% and 59.1% test accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme, Maze-Hard and Mini-ARC, outperforming FPRM.
tldr.zh: SFPRM 把 FPRM 中权重共享 nGPT 块的阻尼不动点循环放到单位超球面上运行，使输入注入、阻尼和停止都成为测地线操作，并证明了收敛性；它在 Sudoku-Extreme、Maze-Hard 和 Mini-ARC 上的测试准确率分别为 96.6%、87.9% 和 59.1%，超过 FPRM。

papers.title: Internalizing Chain-of-thought into Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Constructs constant-bit-size looped Transformers that apply one shared decoder block L times per generated token, reading per-iteration KV caches; simulating a time-t(n), space-s(n) Turing machine, they cut both context window and CoT tokens by a factor of L versus the unlooped queue-machine simulation.
tldr.zh: 构造常数位宽的循环 Transformer：每生成一个 token 就把同一个共享解码器块应用 L 次，并读取每次迭代各自的 KV cache；在模拟时间 t(n)、空间 s(n) 的图灵机时，与不循环的队列机模拟相比，它们把上下文窗口和 CoT token 数都缩小 L 倍。

papers.title: Truncate or Not? A Scaling Study of Looped Transformers with Truncated Backpropagation

tldr.en: Over nearly 600 runs, a fitted scaling law for looped transformers favors full BPTT over truncation when forward and backward loops are jointly optimized; two fully trained loops get lower validation loss than the compute-optimal non-looped model with about 27% fewer non-embedding parameters and 8% more compute.
tldr.zh: 基于近 600 次训练拟合的循环 Transformer scaling law 显示，在联合优化前向和反向循环次数时，完整 BPTT 优于截断；两个完整训练的循环在非 embedding 参数少约 27%、算力只多 8% 的情况下，验证损失低于算力最优的非循环模型。

papers.title: Nested Shared-Operator Recursion on ARC-AGI-1: An Empirical Study of HRM, TRM and URM

tldr.en: Adds to HRM, TRM and URM a persistent intermediate state that the same operator updates after repeated fast-state updates, at matched parameter counts; on ARC-AGI-1 under a single-GPU budget, the nested variants show no consistent advantage, and exact solving stays near zero for all configurations.
tldr.zh: 在参数量匹配的条件下，为 HRM、TRM 和 URM 增加一个持久的中间状态，由同一算子在多次快速状态更新之后对其更新；在单 GPU 预算的 ARC-AGI-1 实验中，嵌套变体没有表现出一致优势，所有配置的精确求解率都接近零。

papers.title: recAMPLIFY: Large-Scale Pretraining of Recursive Protein Language Models

tldr.en: recAMPLIFY pretrains a masked protein LM whose weight-tied Transformer core refines residue states between a prelude and a coda; with 155M unique parameters on the same 2T tokens as AMPLIFY-350M it raises fold accuracy by 22.5%, and Gated Mixture Recurrence cuts expected layer depth by up to 37%.
tldr.zh: recAMPLIFY 预训练一个掩码蛋白质语言模型，其权重共享的 Transformer 核心在 prelude 与 coda 之间反复细化残基对齐的隐状态；它以 155M 独立参数、在与 AMPLIFY-350M 相同的 2T token 上训练，把 fold 准确率提高 22.5%，Gated Mixture Recurrence 再把期望层深最多降低 37%。

papers.title: Exploring Recurrent-Depth Language Models for Multitask Clinical Text Processing

tldr.en: Jointly fine-tunes recurrent-depth LMs (Ouro fixed at four recurrent steps, and HRM-Text-1B) and Qwen3 baselines on 9 clinical NLP datasets; across 13 datasets Ouro-1.4B-Thinking beats Qwen3-1.7B on 11, and Ouro-2.6B-Thinking is competitive with Qwen3-8B on most tasks.
tldr.zh: 在 9 个临床 NLP 数据集上联合微调循环深度语言模型（固定四个循环步的 Ouro，以及 HRM-Text-1B）和 Qwen3 基线；在 13 个数据集中，Ouro-1.4B-Thinking 在 11 个上超过 Qwen3-1.7B，Ouro-2.6B-Thinking 在多数任务上与 Qwen3-8B 相当。

papers.title: Meta Expert: Cross-Layer Expert Sharing for Storage- and Retrieval-Efficient MoE

tldr.en: Meta Experts are MoE experts shared by all layers instead of private to one layer; they lower cross-entropy loss and raise downstream accuracy, and with activated experts and expert granularity fixed the model matches Vanilla MoE using only 70-80% of the experts.
tldr.zh: Meta Expert 是被所有层共享、而非某一层私有的 MoE 专家；它降低了交叉熵损失、提高了下游准确率，在激活专家数和专家粒度不变时，只用 70-80% 的专家就达到 Vanilla MoE 的性能。

papers.title: PAR: Progress-Aligned Recurrence for Length Generalization in State Tracking

tldr.en: PAR trains a looped Qwen2.5-0.5B so iteration k predicts the state after the first k operations, and rescales recurrent states to their first-iteration norms; trained on at most 32 swap-S_5 moves, it reaches 95.5% full-state accuracy at 512 moves, versus 55.7% reported for RLT and 0.8% for explicit chain of thought.
tldr.zh: PAR 训练循环化的 Qwen2.5-0.5B，使第 k 次迭代预测执行前 k 个操作后的状态，并把循环状态重新缩放到第一次迭代时的范数；只用最多 32 步的 swap-S_5 训练，它在 512 步时达到 95.5% 的完整状态准确率，而 RLT 的报告值为 55.7%，显式思维链为 0.8%。

papers.title: HistoLoop: Iterative Contextual Inference with a Looped Transformer for Histology-Based Spatial Gene Expression Prediction

tldr.en: HistoLoop predicts spatial gene expression from H&E images by looping a shared spatial Transformer for 4 steps between pre- and post-spatial Transformers, rebuilding context from updated spot states at finer resolutions; on HEST-Bench HVG50 its macro-averaged PCC is 0.480 versus 0.435 for MoLF.
tldr.zh: HistoLoop 从 H&E 图像预测空间基因表达：在前置和后置空间 Transformer 之间把一个共享空间 Transformer 循环 4 步，并在逐步变细的分辨率上用更新后的 spot 状态重建上下文；在 HEST-Bench HVG50 上其宏平均 PCC 为 0.480，MoLF 为 0.435。

papers.title: Asymmetric Looped Transformers: Fixed Global Representations for an Iterative Decoder

tldr.en: AsymLoop runs a causal encoder once to produce per-layer Global KV fixed across iterations, while a weight-tied decoder loops and attends jointly to it and to Local KV from its evolving state; at 1B it lifts average zero-shot accuracy on seven commonsense benchmarks from 49.58% for Full Loop to 50.85%.
tldr.zh: AsymLoop 让因果编码器只运行一次，生成各层在迭代间保持不变的 Global KV，权重共享的解码器循环执行，并在同一个 softmax 中同时关注 Global KV 和由当前状态生成的 Local KV；在 1B 规模上，七个常识推理基准的平均 zero-shot 准确率从 Full Loop 的 49.58% 提高到 50.85%。

papers.title: Copied, Mixed or Computed? Testing Latent Intermediate Values with Minimal Pairs

tldr.en: With prompts that differ in one token, the paper shows that answer-position probes in two looped and two standard LMs may be reading copied inputs, and tests candidate values against copies, generic mixing and use; in looped Ouro-1.4B the tests find a small code of the unwritten intermediate whose use is unresolved.
tldr.zh: 论文用只差一个 token 的提示对表明，在两个循环和两个标准语言模型中，答案位置上的探针可能读到的是从输入复制来的信息，并给出把候选中间值分别与输入副本、一般性混合和实际使用对照检验的方法；在循环模型 Ouro-1.4B 中，这些检验找到了未写出的中间值的一个小编码，但模型是否使用它仍无定论。

papers.title: How Much Gradient Does Truncated Backprop Lose in Looped Transformers?

tldr.en: Across nine looped LMs, the weight gradient lost by backpropagating through only the last k loops barely changes with loop count (within about 0.03 from 32 to 64 loops); on Ouro keeping two of four loops still loses 81% of the final output's gradient, and the lost share falls by 0.07-0.22 within 300 fine-tuning steps.
tldr.zh: 在九个循环语言模型上，只对最后 k 次循环反向传播所丢失的权重梯度几乎不随循环次数变化（从 32 到 64 次循环变化约在 0.03 以内）；在 Ouro 上，保留四次循环中的两次仍会丢失最终输出 81% 的梯度，而微调 300 步内丢失比例下降 0.07-0.22。

papers.title: Looped Uniform Diffusion Language Models

tldr.en: Looped UDLMs repeat a two-block slice of the denoiser in each denoising step, reaching the validation NLL of a non-looped UDLM trained on about 0.5 trillion tokens with up to 2.8x fewer training FLOPs on OpenWebText and 3.3x fewer on FineWeb-Edu, and up to 9.8% lower generation perplexity at matched NFE.
tldr.zh: Looped UDLM 在每个去噪步内重复执行去噪器中由两个 Transformer 块组成的切片；它们以最多少 2.8x 的训练 FLOPs（OpenWebText）和少 3.3x 的训练 FLOPs（FineWeb-Edu）达到在约 0.5 万亿个 token 上训练的不循环 UDLM 的验证 NLL，并在相同 NFE 下把生成困惑度最多降低 9.8%。

papers.title: Think Harder Where It Matters: Item-Level Adaptive Recursion for Sequential Recommendation

tldr.en: LoopRec recursively applies a single weight-shared block in sequential recommenders, with a lightweight gate at each recursion boundary deciding exit or continue for every item; on public benchmarks with four backbone families it consistently outperforms matched fixed-depth counterparts.
tldr.zh: LoopRec 在序列推荐模型中递归应用单个权重共享块，并在每次递归边界用轻量门控为每个 item 独立决定退出或继续；在公开基准上，基于四类 backbone 的实验中它稳定优于对应的固定深度模型。

papers.title: Loop to Look Better: Learning Adaptive Depth for Question-Guided Perception in Vision-Language Models

tldr.en: LoopLook loops a middle-to-late window of a pretrained VLM's vision encoder with question-conditioned modulation, a learned exit gate and token-wise Mixture-of-Looks over loop states; across four backbones it gains up to 8.6% on MMStar and 8.1% on HallusionBench while adding 5.1-6.5% to time to first token.
tldr.zh: LoopLook 在预训练 VLM 的视觉编码器中循环中后段的一个层窗口，配合问题条件调制、学习的退出门和按 token 的 Mixture-of-Looks 融合各次循环的状态；在四个主干上，MMStar 最多提升 8.6%，HallusionBench 最多提升 8.1%，首 token 时间（TTFT）仅增加 5.1-6.5%。

papers.title: How Depth Growth and Looping Shape In-Context Learning in Language Models

tldr.en: Compares dense, depth-grown and looped language models up to 3B parameters plus controlled tasks; grown and looped models rely more on context, acquire ICL earlier and retain it more strongly than a full-depth dense reference, and lean more on induction-ranked heads for few-shot performance.
tldr.zh: 在最大 3B 参数的语言模型和受控任务上比较稠密、深度增长和循环模型；与全深度稠密参照相比，增长和循环模型更依赖上下文信息，更早习得 ICL 且保持得更牢，few-shot 表现也更依赖按 induction 排名的注意力头。

papers.title: BeNice! Closing Looping's Inference-Memory Gap via KV-Sharing

tldr.en: BeNice! lets looped LMs share the final recurrence's KV cache with earlier recurrences by pairing stochastic-depth pretraining with post-training that broadcasts that cache into the first recurrence; in simulated long-context inference, throughput rises by up to 23.6% and p90 time-to-first-token falls by up to 83.6%.
tldr.zh: BeNice! 让循环语言模型的前几遍循环共用最后一遍的 KV cache：先用随机深度预训练使残差动态收缩，再用后训练把最后一遍的 KV cache 广播到第一遍；在模拟的长上下文推理中，吞吐量最多提升 23.6%，p90 首 token 延迟最多降低 83.6%。

papers.title: Agreement rather than normalisation keeps depth reusable in looped language models

tldr.en: Removing state normalisation between loop steps drops Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B to zero accuracy by the trained budget on a balanced binary task, yet 19M-parameter looped models trained without it are never worse and extrapolate better, pointing to train-inference loop agreement as what keeps depth reusable.
tldr.zh: 去掉循环步之间的状态归一化后，Ouro-1.4B 和 Ouro-2.6B 在平衡二分类任务上到训练预算深度时准确率降为零，而不带该归一化从头训练的 19M 参数循环模型从不更差且外推更好，说明保持深度可复用的是训练与推理时循环的一致性。

papers.title: Do Halting Heads Really Save Compute in Looped Language Models?

tldr.en: Pretraining looped LMs up to 1.3B parameters, the paper finds halting heads trained on a mix of all iterations predict under half the iterations while tokens still run almost every iteration, and in batched generation, which waits for the slowest token, a model without a head is almost as good at that cost.
tldr.zh: 该文从头预训练最大 1.3B 参数的循环语言模型，发现用所有迭代混合训练的停止头预测 token 只需不到一半的迭代，但 token 实际几乎跑满所有迭代；在需等待最慢 token 的批量生成中，不带停止头的模型在同等开销下几乎一样好。

papers.title: Accordion: Elastic-Depth Inference via Fixed-Prefix Layer Looping

tldr.en: Accordion, an MoE LLM, serves five inference budgets by repeating a fixed prefix of single layers in a middle window, sampling one budget per micro-batch; after 3.6T tokens, more depth lifts Accordion-6B-A0.5B's 37-task macro-average by 3.01 points, with the middle budget capturing 89% of the gain.
tldr.zh: Accordion 是一个 MoE LLM，通过重复中间窗口内固定前缀的若干单层来提供五种推理预算，训练时每个 micro-batch 采样一种预算；经过 3.6T token 预训练后，增加推理深度使 Accordion-6B-A0.5B 在 37 个任务上的五类宏平均提高 3.01 个百分点，中间预算获得其中 89% 的提升。

papers.title: LSTM-Style Looped Transformers with Shared KV Caches

tldr.en: An LSTM-style looped Transformer shares one KV cache across its recurrent core, cutting persistent cache sets from fifteen to four and, at width 1024, using 40.4% fewer parameters than an untied control; a consistency loss in the final 10% of training removes 81–89% of the continuation-loss penalty.
tldr.zh: 一种 LSTM 式循环 Transformer 在整个循环核心中共享同一个 KV cache，把持久缓存组数从十五组减到四组，宽度 1024 时参数比不共享权重的对照少 40.4%；在训练最后 10% 的 token 预算中加入一致性损失，可消除 81–89% 的续写损失惩罚。

papers.title: One Model, Two Paths: Balancing Single-Pass and Looped Performance in Language Models

tldr.en: Adapts a pretrained model to support both single-pass and looped inference by reusing middle-layer weights, and shows joint weighted losses with frozen-model guidance reduce single-pass degradation while keeping looped gains over continued training.
tldr.zh: 通过复用中间层权重让预训练模型同时支持单遍和循环推理，并表明在两个输出上加权联合训练、配合冻结原模型的引导，可减少单遍性能下降，同时保留循环相对普通继续训练的收益。

papers.title: LoopGR: Parameter-Efficient Scaling for Generative Recommendation via Recurrent Depth

tldr.en: For generative recommendation, LoopGR alternates a shared generative decoder with a lightweight context updater over recurrent depth and self-distills a low-budget student; it beats an encoder-decoder baseline while reducing model size by up to 52%.
tldr.zh: LoopGR 面向生成式推荐，在循环深度上交替使用共享的生成式 decoder 和轻量的上下文更新器，并自蒸馏出低预算的学生模型；相比编码器-解码器基线效果更好，同时模型规模最多减少 52%。

papers.title: ScaleRLT: Exact Log-Probabilities and Fast Deferred Rollouts for Reinforcement Learning on Looped Transformers

tldr.en: ScaleRLT removes the log-probability mismatch between deferred rollouts and the learner's dense pass in RL on looped transformers, using a stop-gradient hybrid that replays the rollout schedule bit for bit and keeps the dense gradient.
tldr.zh: ScaleRLT 针对循环 Transformer 的 RL，消除延迟 rollout 与学习器 dense 前向之间的 log-probability 不一致：用一个 stop-gradient 混合项，数值上逐位重放 rollout 的调度，梯度仍取 dense 前向的梯度。

papers.title: Recency Is the Wrong Axis: A Negative Result on Windowed Deepest-Plane KV Caching in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Tests a KV policy for looped models that keeps every loop's plane for recent positions and shares the deepest plane elsewhere; across three models, sharing cost depends on late-loop convergence and position, not recency.
tldr.zh: 检验一种循环模型 KV 缓存策略：最近位置保留每个循环的 KV 平面，其余位置共享最深一遍的平面；在三个模型上，共享代价取决于后期循环平面的收敛程度和共享的位置，而非是否最近。

papers.title: Recursive CLIP: Vision-Language Distillation with Looped Transformer Blocks

tldr.en: Trains and distills CLIP models with recursive encoders that apply N transformer blocks M times at fixed ViT-B depth; CLIP tolerates substantial recurrent block reuse, though the effect depends on the encoder and downstream task.
tldr.zh: 训练并蒸馏编码器为递归结构的 CLIP 模型，用 N 个 transformer 块重复 M 次并保持 ViT-B 的深度；CLIP 能承受大量递归块复用，但效果取决于编码器和下游任务。

papers.title: Cross-Loop Query Handoff: How Later Loops Redirect Two-Hop Retrieval in the Ouro Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Transplants attention queries between loops of Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B; loop-3 queries injected into loop 1 rescue 90% and 97% of synthetic two-hop loop-1 failures that loop 3 fixes, versus 24% and 21% with shuffled donors.
tldr.zh: 在 Ouro-1.4B 和 Ouro-2.6B 中跨循环移植注意力 query；把第 3 遍的 query 注入第 1 遍，可挽救 90% 和 97% 第 1 遍答错而第 3 遍答对的合成两跳问题，打乱的供体只有 24% 和 21%。

papers.title: StateLoop: Persistent State for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: StateLoop gives each token a gated persistent state carried across looped-Transformer iterations and projected back into the backbone output; it lowers Pile perplexity versus vanilla looping, with a gap that grows with trained loop depth.
tldr.zh: StateLoop 为每个 token 维护一个门控的持久状态，跨循环迭代保留信息并投影回加到 backbone 输出上；相比普通循环模型 Pile 困惑度更低，且优势随训练时的循环深度增大。

papers.title: LoopFold: Parallelizing Recurrent Depth in Looped Transformers

tldr.en: LoopFold runs several recurrent depths of a looped Transformer in parallel batches, using a predictor for later-loop inputs and a corrector for their outputs; versus a nine-loop vanilla model it cuts decoding latency by 46%.
tldr.zh: LoopFold 把循环 Transformer 多个循环深度的计算折叠进并行批次，用预测器估计后续循环的输入、用校正器修正其输出；与九遍循环的普通模型相比，解码延迟降低 46%。

papers.title: Think Twice: The Metis-1.6 Technical Report

tldr.en: Metis-1.6 technical report on Praxis and Logos, two from-scratch models that run a hybrid Mamba-2 and attention MoE stack twice per token; Logos averages 52.93 across 40 post-trained benchmarks, and the report documents training failures.
tldr.zh: Metis-1.6 技术报告介绍从头训练的 Praxis 和 Logos 两个模型，它们对每个 token 将 Mamba-2 与注意力混合的 MoE 堆栈运行两遍；Logos 在 40 个后训练基准上平均 52.93 分，报告还记录了训练中的失败。

papers.title: Compute Has Shape: Self-Morphing the Internal Computation of Frozen LLMs

tldr.en: SelfMorph trains a selector that picks, per input, whether a frozen LLM keeps its forward path, repeats a layer span or branches hidden states; this gives an 8.06% mean relative improvement on five in-distribution benchmarks.
tldr.zh: SelfMorph 训练一个选择器，按输入决定冻结的 LLM 走原始前向路径、重复执行一段层，还是在局部分叉隐藏状态；在五个分布内基准上平均相对提升 8.06%。

papers.title: Deeper Backpropagation or More Updates? Training Looped Language Models Across Budgets

tldr.en: Compares shorter and longer truncated-backprop windows for training looped language models at roughly equal training time; the advantage of shorter windows shrinks as training budgets grow, so the preferred window can change.
tldr.zh: 在大致相同的训练时间下比较循环语言模型训练中较短与较长的截断反传窗口；随着训练预算增大，较短窗口的优势缩小，更优的窗口可能随之改变。

papers.title: CopyLoop: Fast Looped Transformer Decoding via Context Copying and Shallow Screening

tldr.en: CopyLoop, a training-free decoding algorithm for looped Transformers, proposes multi-token suffixes from repeated context, screens them at shallow recurrent depth and verifies at full depth, reaching 2.98x--10.70x speedups on Base models.
tldr.zh: CopyLoop 是面向循环 Transformer 的免训练解码算法，从重复上下文中提出多 token 后缀，先在浅层循环深度筛选、再在完整深度验证，在 Base 模型上取得 2.98x--10.70x 的加速。

papers.title: How to Loop Your Transformer: Loop Scaling, Specialization, and Parallel Inference

tldr.en: In looped decoders up to 1B parameters, full-stack looping is best at fixed parameters and middle-block looping at fixed training FLOPs; per-loop low-rank adapters help, and a normalization fix recovers Parallel Loop Transformer quality.
tldr.zh: 在最多 1B 参数的循环 decoder 上，固定参数量时循环整栈最好，固定训练 FLOPs 时循环中间块更好；每遍的低秩 adapter 有帮助，一个归一化上的改动能恢复 Parallel Loop Transformer 的质量。

papers.title: UpLoop: Training Looped Transformers via Upcycling at No Extra Pretraining Compute

tldr.en: Grows a shallow Transformer by copying layers and spends the saved compute on looping a shared middle block, at matched parameters, tokens and FLOPs; the 1.3B model's 22-task average rises from 22.99 to 27.52.
tldr.zh: 通过复制已学到的层把浅层 Transformer 逐步加深，并把早期省下的算力用于反复执行共享的中间块，参数量、训练 token 数和训练 FLOPs 均与稠密基线一致；1.3B 模型在 22 个下游任务上的平均分从 22.99 提升到 27.52。

papers.title: ElTab: Elastically Looped Tabular Transformers

tldr.en: ElTab trains one looped tabular transformer with supervision at randomly sampled early exits; on 30 OpenML datasets it matches six depth-specific looped models and a 12-layer TabPFN-style baseline with 25% fewer inference FLOPs.
tldr.zh: ElTab 在随机采样的 early exit 处加监督，训练出单个循环表格 Transformer；在 30 个 OpenML 数据集上，它与六个按深度单独训练的循环模型相当，并以少 25% 的推理 FLOPs 追平 12 层 TabPFN 式基线。

papers.title: Where KV-Cache Error Lives in Looped Language Models: A Diagnostic Study of Ouro and Huginn

tldr.en: Studies how KV and shared-weight quantization error changes next-token distributions in looped LMs Ouro and Huginn-0125; per unit of error, values carry 94% of diagonal Fisher mass, but keys dominate measured KL.
tldr.zh: 研究 KV 与共享权重的量化误差如何改变循环语言模型 Ouro 和 Huginn-0125 的下一 token 分布；按单位误差计，value 占对角 Fisher 质量的 94%，但实测 KL 主要来自 key。

papers.title: There Is No Free Loop: When Does Looping a Trained Model Pay for Its Inference Compute?

tldr.en: Adds loops to pretrained Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 models (0.8B to 9B) and compares them with equal-parameter and equal-FLOPs unlooped baselines; only the looped 0.8B model beats both, so post-pretraining loops pay only for small models.
tldr.zh: 在 0.8B 到 9B 的预训练 Qwen3 和 Qwen3.5 模型中加入循环，并与等参数、等 FLOPs 的不循环基线比较；只有循环后的 0.8B 模型同时胜过两者，说明预训练后再加循环只对小模型划算。

papers.title: How Does Chain-of-Thought Supervision Teach Models to Reason? A Theoretical Analysis

tldr.en: Studies an in-context linear-regression weight predictor trained on gradient-descent trajectories and run recursively beyond them; long-horizon reasoning has phase transitions in context length and training CoT budget, and overthinking splits into error accumulation and amplification.
tldr.zh: 研究一个在梯度下降轨迹上训练、测试时递归应用并超出训练步数的线性回归上下文权重预测模型；长程推理的成败随上下文长度和训练 CoT 总量出现相变，过度思考分为误差累积和误差放大两种机制。

papers.title: When Does Adaptive Halting Win? Selection Rules Matter in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: On a frozen Ouro-1.4B, pre-registered tests show the winner between a trained stability probe and Ouro's exit gate flips with the operating-point selection rule; the probe shows no demonstrated advantage over an untrained KL baseline.
tldr.zh: 在冻结的 Ouro-1.4B 上，预注册实验显示，训练的稳定性探针与 Ouro 原生退出门控孰优孰劣会随工作点选择规则而反转；该探针相对未训练的 KL 基线没有显示出优势。

papers.title: Solv3R: 3D Looped Transformer as a Multi-view Solver

tldr.en: Trains a looped transformer whose update operator, independent of the iteration count, keeps refining multi-view geometry from its current state, so one solver handles offline and incremental reconstruction, relocalization and streaming without task-specific training.
tldr.zh: 训练一个与迭代次数无关的循环 transformer 更新算子，从当前状态继续求解多视角几何，使同一个求解器无需针对任务训练即可用于离线重建、增量重建、重定位和流式处理。

papers.title: Library of Layers (LoL): Adaptively Ordering Transformer Layers at Runtime

tldr.en: Library of Layers uses a router to choose and order blocks from a global library at inference, covering dense, depth-recurrent and MoE designs; it is competitive with all three when pretrained on text.
tldr.zh: Library of Layers 用路由器在推理时从全局块库中选择并排列要执行的 Transformer 块，涵盖 dense、深度循环和 MoE 架构；在文本上预训练时与这三类基线表现相当。

papers.title: Dory1.0-4B: A Looped Normalized-GPT

tldr.en: Dory1.0-4B is a looped nGPT language model with elastic depth, pre-trained on 6 trillion tokens; more loops raise accuracy, and caching only last-loop KV keeps most gains at a non-looped KV footprint.
tldr.zh: Dory1.0-4B 是基于 nGPT 的弹性深度循环语言模型，预训练 6 万亿 token；循环次数越多准确率越高，只缓存最后一遍的 KV 时，KV 占用与不循环模型相同，并保留大部分收益。

papers.title: LoopKV: Loop-Aware KV Cache Compression for Serving Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Chooses 4-bit, 2-bit or final-loop KV reuse for each (loop, layer) cell of Ouro from an offline profile; serving Ouro-1.4B, the LoopKV-M plan stores 35% less KV than KIVI-4 and sustains 1.7-2.2x its goodput.
tldr.zh: 依据离线 profile 为 Ouro 的每个（循环，层）KV 单元选择 4-bit、2-bit 存储或复用末遍 KV；服务 Ouro-1.4B 时，LoopKV-M 方案比 KIVI-4 少存 35% 的 KV，goodput 为其 1.7-2.2x。

papers.title: Best-of-Depth: Learning Exploratory Dynamics in Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Best-of-Depth trains a looped Transformer's recurrent trajectory as a candidate set by minimizing prediction loss across depths; on N-Queens, coverage reaches 91.03% versus 45.75% for final-depth training.
tldr.zh: Best-of-Depth 通过在各个深度上最小化预测损失，把循环 Transformer 的递归轨迹当作候选集来训练；在 N-Queens 上覆盖率达到 91.03%，而只训练最终深度为 45.75%。

papers.title: What Sets the Serving Speed of Looped Language Models? Measurements and Optimizations Graded by Exactness

tldr.en: Measures serving of looped LMs Ouro and Huginn-0125, grading optimizations by exactness; the many small kernels per token set the cost, and fusing them behind rounding fences raises throughput 1.11-1.59x with identical outputs.
tldr.zh: 测量循环语言模型 Ouro 和 Huginn-0125 的服务性能，并按精确程度为优化分级；每 token 的大量小 kernel 才是主要开销，在舍入屏障后融合这些 kernel 使吞吐提高 1.11-1.59x，且输出完全一致。

papers.title: ARLoop: Fully-Open Pre-trained Looped Transformers with Attention Residuals

tldr.en: ARLoop gives each layer of a looped transformer attention over earlier outputs across depth; sliding-window depth attention matches full history, and a 1.2B model trained on 0.5T tokens beats Huginn-3.5B on all evaluated tasks.
tldr.zh: ARLoop 让循环 Transformer 的每一层对深度方向上更早的输出做注意力；滑窗深度注意力与完整历史效果相当，在 0.5T token 上训练的 1.2B 模型在所有评测任务上都超过 Huginn-3.5B。

papers.title: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: LoopVQ vector-quantizes the KV cache of looped transformers, coding channels of several loop steps jointly; with Ouro and Huginn at 0.5 bits per element, it outperforms KV vector quantization methods built for standard LLMs.
tldr.zh: LoopVQ 对循环 Transformer 的 KV cache 做向量量化，把多个循环步的通道联合编码；在 Ouro 和 Huginn 上、每元素 0.5 bit 时，它优于为标准 LLM 设计的 KV 向量量化方法。

papers.title: Give the Drafter a Second Chance to Guess: Parallel Reconsideration for Speculative Decoding

tldr.en: Lets a speculative-decoding drafter deepen uncertain guesses with extra passes of its shared block, run in parallel with the one-pass draft; this improves acceptance length by 5.3% to 10.2% and speedup by 3.5% to 9.2%.
tldr.zh: 让推测解码的 drafter 对没把握的猜测用共享块多跑几遍以加深特征，并与单遍草稿并行执行；接受长度提升 5.3% 到 10.2%，加速比提升 3.5% 到 9.2%。

papers.title: Loop Before You Leap: What Recurrent Depth Can and Cannot Buy in Data-Limited Pretraining

tldr.en: Compares standard and looped Transformers under a 100M-word budget; text-only, a 12-layer stack repeated four times beats a 48-layer Transformer by 5.4 BLiMP points, but recurrence does not clearly mitigate the multimodal-training drop.
tldr.zh: 在 100M 词的预算下比较标准与循环 Transformer；纯文本时，12 层堆叠重复四次比 48 层 Transformer 高 5.4 个 BLiMP 点，但循环没有明显缓解多模态训练带来的下降。

papers.title: LooM: Loop-Invariant Memory for Causal Encoder-Decoder Language Models

tldr.en: Loops the decoder layers of a causal encoder-decoder, storing each token's KV only on its first visit; one model covers 3 to 21 layer executions per token and, with enough loops, beats a single-pass baseline.
tldr.zh: 在因果 encoder-decoder 中循环 decoder 层，每个 token 的 KV 只在首次经过时写入；一个模型覆盖每 token 3 到 21 次层执行，循环足够多时优于单遍基线。

papers.title: Not All Loops Cost the Same: Phase-Dependent Depth for Serving Looped Transformers

passes.test: S for decode, P <= S for prefill, at most 32

note.en: Shown for OLMo r32, a recurrent OLMo-2 retrofit with 4/6/4 prelude/core/coda layers at width 2,048 (the r16 checkpoint has the same layout and was trained at 16 loops); Huginn-0125 has 2/4/2 layers at width 5,280. LoopDuet trains nothing. Ordinary prompt positions run P core loops, while every prompt-chunk endpoint and every decoded token runs S. Serving keeps one shared KV plane per core layer that each loop overwrites, so later queries read the last computed KV of positions that stopped early.
note.zh: 图示为 OLMo r32：OLMo-2 的循环改造版，prelude/core/coda 为 4/6/4 层，宽度 2,048（r16 布局相同，训练时 16 遍）；Huginn-0125 为 2/4/2 层，宽度 5,280。LoopDuet 不训练模型。普通 prompt 位置跑 P 遍 core，每个 prompt chunk 的末位置和每个 decode token 跑 S 遍。服务时每个 core 层只有一份共享 KV，每遍覆盖写入，后续 query 读到的是提前停下的位置最后算出的 KV。

baseline.en: Uniform-depth serving (S, S) of the same checkpoint in the same vLLM engine, with the same prompts, KV layout, precision and execution mode; (32, 32) is the full-depth reference, and fixed prefilling depths at the same S are the controls under load.
baseline.zh: 同一 checkpoint 在同一 vLLM 引擎中按均匀深度 (S, S) 服务，prompt、KV 布局、精度和执行模式都相同；(32, 32) 是满深度参照，负载实验的对照是同一 S 下的固定 prefill 深度。

headline.en: On full HotpotQA with one A100-80GB, Huginn (32, 16) gives 1.19x the throughput of (20, 20), the fastest tested uniform setting meeting the same accuracy criterion, and (14, 8) gains 6.04 EM points over uniform (8, 8) at 97% of its throughput. Under load, adapting OLMo's prefilling depth gains 0.92-1.35 EM points over the most accurate tested fixed depths at the same 100% one-second TTFT attainment.
headline.zh: 在完整 HotpotQA、单张 A100-80GB 上，Huginn (32, 16) 的吞吐是 (20, 20) 的 1.19 倍，后者是满足同一准确率标准的最快均匀设置；(14, 8) 保留均匀 (8, 8) 97% 的吞吐，EM 高 6.04 分。负载下，自适应调整 OLMo 的 prefill 深度，在一秒 TTFT 达标率同为 100% 时，比测过的最准固定深度高 0.92-1.35 EM 分。

results.setting: Huginn-0125, full HotpotQA distractor dev set (7,405 examples), one A100-SXM4-80GB, vLLM 0.14.1, bf16, no prefix caching, C = 64
Same HotpotQA serving setup, OLMo r32 with four-paragraph prompts
HotpotQA, C = 64; each LoopDuet setting against a uniform setting whose throughput differs by at most 10%
HotpotQA, C = 64, decoding depth S held fixed; LoopDuet (S, P) against uniform (S, S)
results.metric: speedup / EM uniform → LoopDuet / measured speedup as a fraction of the layer-pass ratio

results.setting: OLMo r32, S = 4, all HotpotQA examples, open-loop C = 128; queue controller with P in [2, 4]
GSM8K, all 1,319 test examples, five demonstrations, greedy decoding; changes from each checkpoint's (S, S) control
results.metric: accuracy change (pp), uniform (P, P) / LoopDuet (S, P)

findings.en: The first output token needs full depth: for Huginn on HotpotQA at S = 32 with other prompt positions at P = 16, running the final prompt position at 16 loops instead of 32 lowers EM by 1.74 points relative to (32, 16) and by 1.97 points relative to (32, 32).
findings.zh: 首个输出 token 需要满深度：Huginn 在 HotpotQA 上 S = 32、其余 prompt 位置 P = 16 时，把最后一个 prompt 位置从 32 遍降到 16 遍，EM 比 (32, 16) 低 1.74 分，比 (32, 32) 低 1.97 分。

findings.en: Split budgets do not always win: Huginn (24, 12) gives 31.60 EM at 2.43 req/s, while uniform (12, 12) gives 32.05 EM at 2.48 req/s.
findings.zh: 拆分预算不一定更好：Huginn (24, 12) 为 31.60 EM、2.43 req/s，均匀的 (12, 12) 为 32.05 EM、2.48 req/s。

findings.en: For OLMo r32 on HotpotQA, EM stays between 37.95 and 38.49 across all six tested settings, so uniform depth four, the fastest at 56.46 req/s and 0.54 points below (32, 32), is chosen as the controller's starting point.
findings.zh: OLMo r32 在 HotpotQA 上测的六种设置 EM 都在 37.95 到 38.49 之间，因此选最快的均匀 4 遍（56.46 req/s，比 (32, 32) 低 0.54 分）作为控制器的起点。

findings.en: Useful prefilling depth is task dependent: on ARC at S = 11, raising OLMo r32's P from 4 to 8 moves the accuracy change from -1.54 to +0.85 points, and Huginn (14, 8) stays 4.44 points below (14, 14).
findings.zh: 合适的 prefill 深度因任务而异：ARC 上 S = 11 时，OLMo r32 的 P 从 4 提到 8，准确率变化从 -1.54 变为 +0.85 分；Huginn (14, 8) 仍比 (14, 14) 低 4.44 分。

findings.en: The savings survive batching: Huginn (32, 16) keeps 1.84x, 1.87x and 1.88x speedups over (32, 32) at engine-step token budgets of 4,096, 8,192 and 16,384 (C = 128), and 1.87x at C = 32, 64 and 128.
findings.zh: 节省在 batching 下依然存在：C = 128 时，engine step 的 token 预算为 4,096、8,192、16,384，Huginn (32, 16) 相对 (32, 32) 的加速为 1.84、1.87、1.88 倍；C = 32、64、128 时都是 1.87 倍。

tldr.en: Serve looped Transformers with fewer core loops for ordinary prompt tokens than for the last prompt token and the decoded tokens, run the deep tail as a compact batch in vLLM, and lower prefilling depth when the queue grows.
tldr.zh: 服务循环 Transformer 时，普通 prompt token 少跑几遍，最后一个 prompt token 和 decode token 跑满；在 vLLM 里把需要继续循环的位置收成紧凑 batch，排队变长时再降低 prefill 深度。

problem.en: Serving a looped model with one loop count for all tokens ties prefill cost to decode depth. With long prompts and short answers (OLMo HotpotQA prompts average 796 tokens and answers about 4.7), prompt positions account for over 99% of layer applications, so keeping deep decoding repeats deep computation over the whole prompt.
problem.zh: 用同一个循环遍数服务所有 token，会把 prefill 成本和 decode 深度绑在一起。prompt 长、回答短时（OLMo 的 HotpotQA prompt 平均 796 token，回答约 4.7 token），prompt 位置占了 99% 以上的层计算，保留深 decode 就意味着整段 prompt 都要跑深循环。

en: Choose decode depth S and prefill depth P <= S jointly from measured quality-throughput trade-offs; ordinary prompt positions stop after P core loops, while every prompt-chunk endpoint and every decoded token runs S.

In vLLM, after P loops the engine gathers each request's final query into a compact B x d batch for the remaining S - P loops and scatters it back before the coda; prompt context stays in one shared KV plane per core layer, so existing weights and attention kernels are reused.
A queue-age controller maps the oldest first-token wait from 0.25 s to 1 s linearly onto [P_min, P_max] before each engine step, keeping S fixed (main setting S = 4, P in {2, 3, 4}).
A recurrent-state distance (90th percentile over ordinary prompt tokens, threshold about 0.24) screens candidate P values before task-accuracy checks.
zh: 根据实测的质量-吞吐权衡联合选 decode 深度 S 和 prefill 深度 P（P <= S）；普通 prompt 位置跑 P 遍 core 后停下，每个 prompt chunk 的末位置和每个 decode token 跑满 S 遍。
在 vLLM 里，跑完 P 遍后把每个请求的最后一个 query 收集成 B x d 的紧凑 batch，跑剩下的 S - P 遍，再在 coda 前散回原位；prompt 上下文留在每个 core 层一份的共享 KV 里，直接复用现有权重和 attention kernel。
队列年龄控制器在每个 engine step 前，把最早一个请求等待首 token 的时间从 0.25 秒到 1 秒线性映射到 [P_min, P_max]，S 保持不变（主实验 S = 4，P 取 {2, 3, 4}）。
用循环状态距离（普通 prompt token 的 90 分位，阈值约 0.24）先筛出候选 P，再用任务准确率验证。

en: Training-free serving study of existing checkpoints only (Huginn-0125 and the recurrent OLMo-2 retrofits r16 and r32); every tested depth is at most 32 loops (16 for OLMo r16).

Tasks are GSM8K, HotpotQA (distractor dev set) and ARC-Challenge, with model-specific prompts (OLMo four paragraphs and one demonstration under a 1,000-token cap; Huginn ten paragraphs and two demonstrations); the authors call these within-model comparisons, not a ranking between models.
All timings use one A100-SXM4-80GB, vLLM 0.14.1, bf16 and no prefix caching; the joint-depth comparison uses one execution per configuration at C = 64.
Gains depend on the workload: on GSM8K, longer responses give wall-time ratios of 0.98-1.01 across four serving pairs despite layer-pass ratios of 1.52-2.71.

Decoding reads prompt KV from the last loop each position computed, an approximation to full-depth context that the authors evaluate through task accuracy; the controller has no correctness feedback and works within a depth range chosen offline.
On the 20/80 req/s burst trace the controller reaches 87.5% one-second TTFT attainment, against 100% for fixed P = 2.
zh: 只在现有 checkpoint 上做免训练的服务研究（Huginn-0125 和 OLMo-2 循环改造版 r16、r32）；所有测试深度都不超过 32 遍（OLMo r16 不超过 16 遍）。
任务为 GSM8K、HotpotQA（distractor 开发集）和 ARC-Challenge，prompt 按模型分别构造（OLMo 四段材料加一个示例，上限 1,000 token；Huginn 十段材料加两个示例）；作者说明这些是同一模型内的对比，不是模型间排名。
所有计时都在单张 A100-SXM4-80GB、vLLM 0.14.1、bf16、不开 prefix caching 下进行；联合深度对比在 C = 64 下每个配置只跑一次。
收益取决于负载：GSM8K 回答更长，四组服务对比的墙钟时间比只有 0.98-1.01，而层计算比为 1.52-2.71。
decode 读到的 prompt KV 来自各位置最后算到的那一遍，是对满深度上下文的近似，作者通过任务准确率来评估；控制器没有正确性反馈，只在离线选定的深度范围内调整。
在 20/80 req/s 的突发流量下，控制器的一秒 TTFT 达标率为 87.5%，固定 P = 2 为 100%。

papers.glyph: prelude 4 layers -> [core 6 layers] x 32 (OLMo r32 checkpoint) -> coda 4 layers; injection n/a; KV last-pass

papers.title: Loopback Transformer: Towards a Unified View of Residual Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Loopback Transformer reads each shared-block update separately, using geometric decay for total update weight and attention to allocate it; it reaches lower validation loss than standard Transformers with 40-75% of their Transformer parameters.
tldr.zh: Loopback Transformer 把共享块每次的更新量单独读出，用几何衰减设定更新总权重、用注意力分配权重；它用标准 Transformer 40-75% 的 Transformer 参数达到更低的验证损失。

papers.title: BRIDGE: Bridging the Semantic Quantization Gap for Generative Recommendation

tldr.en: For generative recommendation, BRIDGE adds latent reasoning, self-distillation and effort-aware recurrence, which runs a shared loop decoder more times at early Semantic ID levels; it improves Recall@10 and NDCG@10 on three Amazon benchmarks.
tldr.zh: 面向生成式推荐，BRIDGE 加入隐式推理、自蒸馏和按难度分配的循环，后者在靠前的 Semantic ID 层级上让共享的循环解码器执行更多次；在三个 Amazon 基准上提升了 Recall@10 和 NDCG@10。

papers.title: Extending Reasoning in Typed Decision Models via Looping

tldr.en: RELOAD fine-tunes pretrained encoders or decoders with a damped loop over their middle block; looping improves accuracy and calibration, mostly on reasoning chains longer than in training, where encoders gain up to 23 points.
tldr.zh: RELOAD 在预训练 encoder 或 decoder 的中间块上加阻尼循环并微调；循环提升了准确率和校准，主要体现在比训练中更长的推理链上，encoder 最多提升 23 个点。

papers.title: Beyond Quadratic Attention: Separable Gaussian Operators for ODE Vision Transformers

tldr.en: Replaces ViT self-attention with a separable sum-of-Gaussians operator, globally Lipschitz with fixed kernels, across discrete, looped and Neural ODE ViTs; in the looped setting it raises CIFAR-100 Top-1 accuracy by 5.4-8.1 points.
tldr.zh: 用可分离的高斯和算子替换 ViT 的自注意力（固定核时全局 Lipschitz），并在离散、循环和 Neural ODE 三种 ViT 中测试；在循环设置下 CIFAR-100 Top-1 准确率提高 5.4-8.1 个点。

papers.title: AlterNet: Adaptive-Depth Mixture-of-Experts with Learned Halting for Elastic Inference

tldr.en: AlterNet loops over a shared pool of shallow MoE experts, picked by a depth-aware router, with per-expert halt heads for early stopping, so depth adapts and can be cut without retraining; results are preliminary.
tldr.zh: AlterNet 在共享的浅层 MoE 专家池上循环计算，由感知深度的路由器挑选专家，用每个专家的停止头提前结束，使深度可自适应，且无需重新训练即可降低；结果仍是初步的。

papers.title: Energy-Based Reasoners: Your Recurrent Reasoner Should Be an Energy-Based Model

tldr.en: Learns an energy over latent reasoning states and makes each loop a gradient step on it, giving a stopping signal; reaches 99.9% accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme with 345× less inference compute than the next-best model.
tldr.zh: 学习潜在推理状态上的能量函数，把每次循环写成对该能量的一步梯度下降，并由此得到停止信号；在 Sudoku-Extreme 上达到 99.9% 准确率，推理算力比次优模型少 345×。

papers.title: WiFo-R: Wireless Foundation Model with Recurrent Channel Representation

tldr.en: Builds a wireless channel foundation model whose parameter-shared recurrent updates refine CSI features and add latent tokens; multi-depth pretraining trains intermediate states to reconstruct CSI, and selectable depth improves the accuracy-complexity trade-off.
tldr.zh: 构建无线信道基础模型，用参数共享的循环更新细化 CSI 特征并加入新的潜在 token；多深度预训练让中间状态也能重建 CSI，可选的循环深度改善了精度与复杂度的权衡。

papers.title: Depth as a Candidate Source: Portfolio Allocation for Recurrent Test-Time Scaling in Large Language Models

tldr.en: Shows deeper recurrence in a frozen Huginn can lose correct answers found at shallower depths, and proposes Depth Portfolio Allocation, which spreads a test-time budget across depths and expands oracle coverage at matched candidate counts.
tldr.zh: 发现在冻结的 Huginn 上加深循环可能丢掉较浅深度已找到的正确解，并提出 Depth Portfolio Allocation，把测试时预算分配到多个深度上，在候选数相同时扩大 oracle 覆盖率。

papers.title: Looping Deeper Without Growing the KV Cache: Recurrent Depth for Causal Encoder-Decoders

note.en: 12-layer causal encoder-decoder (CED) in the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash layout: every layer has SWA-128; L2 is the encoder's only global KV source and L6 projects the global KV shared by the decoder. The loop repeats L2-5.
note.zh: 12 层因果编码器-解码器（CED），沿用 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的布局：每层都有 128 窗口 SWA；L2 是 encoder 唯一的全局 KV 源，L6 投影出 decoder 共用的全局 KV。循环 L2-5。

baseline.en: Unlooped CED with the same 12-layer layout; dense, decoder-loop and YOCO-U-style variants are also compared.
baseline.zh: 同样 12 层布局、不循环的 CED；另有 dense、decoder 循环和 YOCO-U 式对照。

headline.en: At 150M, the encoder loop lowers BPB from 0.8716 to 0.8468 while keeping the unlooped CED's 8 KB of global KV per token; the paper reports recovering 86-93% of a looped Transformer's gain with 1/6 of its global KV.
headline.zh: 150M 规模下，encoder 循环把 BPB 从 0.8716 降到 0.8468，每 token 全局 KV 仍是不循环 CED 的 8 KB；论文称用 1/6 的全局 KV 拿回了循环 Transformer 86-93% 的收益。

results.setting: 150M non-embedding params, 6.0B tokens, FineWeb-Edu, 2048 context, T=8 at evaluation
150M, 29.6B tokens
150M, 6.0B tokens, exact fp32 token-by-token decoding at T=8
results.metric: BPB with last-round KV minus BPB with per-round KV

results.setting: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (552B) looped for 8 rounds on 4x GB200, serving only (no loop training)
results.metric: KV per token and 128K-token requests that fit

values.Looped CED (last-round KV): 36.8x less KV per token, fits 38 requests

findings.en: Running 12 or 16 rounds instead of the trained mean of 8 lowers BPB by at most 0.0004 and never raises it.
findings.zh: 推理时跑 12 或 16 遍（训练均值是 8 遍），BPB 最多降 0.0004，从不变差。

findings.en: After 5x longer training (29.6B tokens) the decoder loop still captures only 38% of the encoder loop's improvement.
findings.zh: 训练加长到 5 倍（29.6B token）后，decoder 循环的收益仍只有 encoder 循环的 38%。

tldr.en: Loop the CED encoder layers that produce global KV, train with random depth, and keep only the last round's KV.
tldr.zh: 循环产出全局 KV 的 CED encoder 层，随机遍数训练，推理只存最后一遍的 KV。

problem.en: When every round caches its own KV, a looped model's KV cache grows with the number of rounds, which cancels the memory advantage of KV-sparse layouts such as the causal encoder-decoder.
problem.zh: 如果每一遍都存自己的 KV，循环模型的 KV 会随遍数增长，抵消掉 CED 这类稀疏 KV 布局的显存优势。

en: Loop layers L2-5 of the encoder, which contain its only global KV source, for 8 rounds with Parcae's gated input injection.
Sample the number of rounds per sequence from max(1, Poisson(8)) and backpropagate through the last 4, so the core settles into a fixed point.
At inference, past tokens keep only their last-round KV, so the resident KV equals the unlooped CED's.
zh: 循环 encoder 的 L2-5（含 encoder 唯一的全局 KV 源），跑 8 遍，用 Parcae 的门控输入注入。
每条序列的遍数从 max(1, Poisson(8)) 采样，只反传最后 4 遍，让循环块收敛到不动点。
推理时历史 token 只保留最后一遍的 KV，常驻 KV 和不循环的 CED 一样。

en: Training experiments use 12-layer dense-FFN models up to 340M non-embedding parameters at 2K context; the 552B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash runs measure serving cost only, with no loop training.
Parameters, tokens and KV are held fixed but compute is not; a looped model runs 40 layer passes per decoded token instead of 12.
All runs share one hyperparameter set (Table 8); the baselines were not tuned separately.
The encoder loop puts every round on the prefill path; in the 552B serving test, prefill cost per prompt token at T=8 is 5.12x the unlooped CED (Table 13).
zh: 训练实验是 12 层 dense FFN 模型，最大 340M 非 embedding 参数，2K 上下文；552B 的 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 只测服务成本，没训练过循环。
对齐了参数、token 和 KV，没对齐算力：循环模型每解码一个 token 执行 40 层，不循环是 12 层。
所有实验共用一套超参（Table 8），基线没有单独调。
encoder 循环让每一遍都进入 prefill；552B 服务测试里，T=8 时每个 prompt token 的 prefill 成本是不循环 CED 的 5.12 倍（Table 13）。
