papers.title: One Block Is Enough: LoopMR for Accelerated MRI Reconstruction

tldr.en: Reuses one Restormer block at every iteration of unrolled MRI reconstruction and beats PromptMR+ with about 1/9 of its parameters; shared transformer blocks match or beat distinct-weight ones, while shared CNN blocks do worse.
tldr.zh: 在展开式 MRI 重建中每次迭代复用同一个 Restormer 块，参数量约为 PromptMR+ 的 1/9 而效果更好；共享的 Transformer 块与独立权重版本持平或更好，共享的 CNN 块则更差。

papers.title: Rectified Looped Transformer

tldr.en: Feeds each loop a linear interpolation between the current state and the block's prediction; at matched depth this lowers perplexity versus a standard looped Transformer and keeps hidden-state norms more stable, with no extra parameters.
tldr.zh: 把下一遍循环的输入改为当前状态与本遍预测之间的线性插值；在相同深度下，困惑度低于标准循环 Transformer，隐状态范数更稳定，且不增加参数。

papers.title: Classical Energies Learn to Reason 1,000x Faster than Looped Models

tldr.en: CRAM, a learned Hopfield-Tank energy minimized at inference, solves 99.996% of Sudoku-Extreme and 100% of Maze-Unique test puzzles with training at least 1,000x faster than looped models; the authors call these benchmarks trivially solvable.
tldr.zh: CRAM 是可学习的 Hopfield-Tank 能量函数，推理时沿能量下降求解；它解出 Sudoku-Extreme 99.996% 和 Maze-Unique 100% 的测试题，训练至少比循环模型快 1,000 倍；作者认为这类基准可以被轻易解决。

papers.title: Folding Language Models into Themselves

tldr.en: Concertina folds every N adjacent teacher layers into one shared block run N times with low-rank corrections; distilled from Qwen3-4B on 22B tokens, a 2.27B model retains 84% of the teacher averaged over eight benchmarks.
tldr.zh: Concertina 把教师模型每 N 个相邻层折叠成一个执行 N 次的共享块，并加低秩修正；从 Qwen3-4B 用 22B token 蒸馏出的 2.27B 模型在八个基准上平均保留教师 84% 的能力。

papers.title: ARC-VLN: Adaptive Recursive Computing-based Visual-Language Navigation

tldr.en: ARC-VLN runs a shared-parameter language backbone recursively for aerial VLN, letting only visual tokens exit early; on OpenFly it has the lowest navigation error of the compared methods and reduces FLOPs and GPU memory.
tldr.zh: ARC-VLN 在共享参数的语言骨干上做递归计算来完成空中视觉语言导航，只让视觉 token 提前退出；在 OpenFly 上，它的导航误差在对比方法中最低，并减少了 FLOPs 和显存占用。

papers.title: Wireless Edge-Assisted Adaptive Latent Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models in Physical AI

tldr.en: Uses constrained deep RL (TRPO-Lag) to jointly choose local or edge execution and the latent-reasoning convergence threshold of a recurrent-depth VLA, reaching up to 23% higher feasibility-weighted task success than benchmark constrained RL methods.
tldr.zh: 用约束深度强化学习（TRPO-Lag）为循环深度 VLA 联合选择本地或边缘执行以及隐式推理的收敛阈值，可行性加权任务成功率比基准约束强化学习方法最多高 23%。

papers.title: Architectures and KV Replay for Depth-Recurrent Language Models

tldr.en: Studies how to cut decoding KV memory in depth-recurrent LMs: looped hybrids need frequent attention anchors, and training with recurrent KV replay lets iterations share KV states with performance close to separate per-iteration caches.
tldr.zh: 研究如何降低深度循环语言模型 decode 时的 KV 显存：looped hybrid 需要足够频繁的注意力锚点；用 recurrent KV replay 训练后，多个迭代可共享 KV 状态，性能接近每个迭代单独存 KV 的做法。

papers.title: LoopFill: Pipelined Multi-Token Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: A training-free speculative decoding method for looped LLMs that puts multi-token suffix drafts and shallow-loop predictions in one draft tree; average speedup over greedy decoding is 5.85x on Ouro-2.6B and 5.13x on Huginn-3.5B.
tldr.zh: 面向循环 LLM 的免训练投机解码方法，把多 token 后缀草稿和浅层循环预测放进同一棵草稿树；相对贪心解码的平均加速在 Ouro-2.6B 上为 5.85x，在 Huginn-3.5B 上为 5.13x。

papers.title: When Does Reusing Layers Help Multimodal Embeddings?

tldr.en: Tests eleven loop designs for multimodal embeddings, proving that under forward-only attention repeated layers cannot make earlier image states query-dependent; on MMEB-V2 an added loop loses 0.46 points, while native recurrence gains +4.23 points.
tldr.zh: 在多模态 embedding 上测试十一种循环设计，证明在只向前传递信息的注意力下，重复层无法让排在 query 之前的图像状态依赖 query；在 MMEB-V2 上，新增循环下降 0.46 分，原生循环提升 +4.23 分。

papers.title: LoopSkim: Lossless Multi-Depth Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Proposes lossless speculative decoding for looped LMs in which each loop's readout checks draft tokens copied from the context and only full-depth readouts commit; without training, its speedup averages 1.73x that of LoopSpec.
tldr.zh: 为循环语言模型提出无损投机解码：从上下文复制的草稿 token 在每一遍循环的读出处接受检查，只有完整深度的读出才提交 token；无需训练时，其加速平均为 LoopSpec 的 1.73x。

papers.title: Latent Feedback Is a Compute and Data Amplifier

tldr.en: Tests latent feedback, which feeds each token's top-layer state into the next token's input, against compute-matched multi-epoch Transformers; it saves at most 48% of the compute and 47% of the unique data.
tldr.zh: 把每个 token 的顶层状态送入下一个 token 输入的 latent feedback，与用同等算力多训几个 epoch 的 Transformer 对比；latent feedback 最多省下 48% 的算力和 47% 的不重复数据。

papers.title: Efficient Multi-View Generation with Iterative Global-Local Proxy Attention

tldr.en: GLPA sends cross-view information in multi-view diffusion through compact proxies and refines them by reusing the same attention parameters within a denoising step; on FLUX, attention runs 2.65× faster than dense attention and reconstruction improves.
tldr.zh: GLPA 在多视角扩散中通过紧凑的代理 token 交换跨视角信息，并在单个去噪步内复用同一组注意力参数迭代细化代理；在 FLUX 上，注意力计算比稠密注意力快 2.65×，重建质量也有提升。

papers.title: Déjà-Events: Multi-view 3D Geometry with Event Cameras via Sparsity-Aware Adaptive Gating

tldr.en: Distils an event-camera 3D model from the RGB teacher Déjà View, which repeatedly applies one shared transformer block, and gates that block by event density; it has the lowest pointmap error among evaluated event-based methods.
tldr.zh: 从 RGB 教师模型 Déjà View（反复应用同一个共享 transformer block）蒸馏出事件相机 3D 模型，并按事件密度调整该 block 的门控；在所评测的事件相机方法中点图误差最低。

papers.title: Latent Fact Composition under Next-Token Training

tldr.en: Baton looped transformers pass the intermediate entity to the second loop as a token embedding; trained only on answers, two variants almost solve held-out two-hop questions, but next-token training makes accuracy rise then decline.
tldr.zh: Baton 循环 Transformer 把中间实体作为 token embedding 传给第二遍循环；只用答案训练时，三个变体中的两个几乎全部答对留出的两跳问题，但改用 next-token 训练后准确率先升后降。

papers.title: InfuseLoop: Cross-Trajectory Latent Injection for Scalable Parallel Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Adds cross-trajectory latent injection to Parallel Looped Transformers, so each loop aggregates causally available hidden states from later trajectories via attention residuals; this eliminates training-loss spikes and improves validation-loss scaling up to eight loops.
tldr.zh: 为并行循环 Transformer（PLT）加入跨轨迹隐状态注入，让每个循环通过注意力残差汇聚后续轨迹中因果可用的隐状态；该方法消除了训练损失尖峰，并改善了最多八个循环时验证损失的 scaling。

papers.title: LoopZip: Visual Token Compression for Efficient Looped Vision-Language Models

tldr.en: LoopZip compresses visual tokens in looped vision-language models without training, selecting tokens by attention from two calls of the same shared layer; on LoopVL-1B it keeps 97.16% of the original performance at 50% pruning ratio.
tldr.zh: LoopZip 无需训练即可压缩循环视觉语言模型中的视觉 token，依据同一共享层两次调用的注意力选择 token；在 LoopVL-1B 上以 50% 剪枝率保留原模型 97.16% 的性能。

papers.title: Proximal Targets: Training Looped Refiners on Problems with Many Correct Answers

tldr.en: Proves that a single stored target sets a loss floor for looped refiners (HRM, TRM) on puzzles with many answers; training each pass toward the nearest correct answer solves 98.8% of multi-answer Sudoku versus 2.5%.
tldr.zh: 证明在有多个正确答案的谜题上，HRM、TRM 等循环精炼器朝单一存储答案训练会留下任何模型容量都消除不了的损失下限；改为让每一遍朝离自身输入最近的正确答案训练后，多解 Sudoku 的求解率为 98.8%，标准目标为 2.5%。

papers.title: Simpler Tiny Recursive Models

tldr.en: STRM simplifies TRM to a single uniformly updated state, using jittered-rate exponential moving updates and slow-channel readout; under TRM's data, parameters and compute it gains 3.8 points on Sudoku-Extreme and matches TRM on Maze-Hard.
tldr.zh: STRM 把 TRM 简化为单一状态和统一更新，状态采用训练时速率抖动的指数滑动更新，只从慢速更新的通道读出解；在与 TRM 相同的数据、参数和算力下，Sudoku-Extreme 提高 3.8 分，Maze-Hard 与 TRM 持平。

papers.title: LoopCache: Accelerating Long-Context Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers

tldr.en: Proposes LoopCache, self-speculative decoding for long-context looped Transformers that updates drafts across intermediate loops by confidence and rotates loop-specific KV caches; reports average 10.25x and 14.56x speedup over WFD and LoopSpec.
tldr.zh: 提出 LoopCache，一种面向长上下文循环 Transformer 的自推测解码方法，按置信度在各中间循环更新草稿，并轮流使用各循环的 KV cache；相对 WFD 和 LoopSpec 平均加速 10.25x 和 14.56x。

papers.title: Late Entry in Looped Language Models

tldr.en: Late entry lets new tokens in looped language models skip early passes and run only the final passes over a deep context cache, outperforming matched early exit; Wake verification reaches 5.2x greedy-exact speedup on Ouro-2.6B.
tldr.zh: Late entry 让循环语言模型中的新 token 跳过前几遍、只在深层上下文缓存上运行最后几遍，优于匹配的 early exit；Wake 验证在 Ouro-2.6B 上达到 5.2x 的 greedy-exact 加速。

papers.title: Fold the Loop: Decoding-Time KV Memory for Looped Vision-Language Models

tldr.en: FoldCache lets groups of recurrent steps in a looped VLM share the group's final visual KV during decoding; on LoopVL it approximately halves prefix KV memory while matching full-cache accuracy on five open-ended benchmarks.
tldr.zh: FoldCache 让循环 VLM 中同一组循环步在 decode 时共享该组最后一步的视觉 KV；在 LoopVL 上，prefix KV 显存约减半，五个开放式基准上的准确率与完整 cache 持平。

papers.title: LoopedWAM: Looped World Action Models for Elastic Inference

tldr.en: LoopedWAM loops a shared six-block core in each expert of a robot world action model, and elastic self-distillation lets one checkpoint serve several action-depth and sampling-step budgets; it reaches 96.1% success on LIBERO.
tldr.zh: LoopedWAM 在机器人世界动作模型的每个专家里循环一个由六个 block 组成的共享核心，并用弹性自蒸馏让单个 checkpoint 适配多种动作深度和采样步数预算，在 LIBERO 上成功率为 96.1%。

papers.title: dLoop: Looped Diffusion Language Models via Recurrent Latent Refinement

tldr.en: Restructures a pretrained diffusion language model into a Prelude-Loop-Coda design that reapplies a shared middle block before tokens are committed, reaching the highest or tied-highest accuracy on GSM8K, MATH, MBPP and HumanEval.
tldr.zh: 将预训练扩散语言模型改造为 Prelude-Loop-Coda 结构，在提交 token 之前重复执行共享的中间块，在 GSM8K、MATH、MBPP 和 HumanEval 上均取得最高或并列最高的准确率。

papers.title: GLiDE: A Fast, Calibrated Decision Model Distilled from Reasoning Teachers

tldr.en: Converts Qwen hybrid LMs into single-pass decision models via bidirectional full attention and multi-teacher distillation; checkpoint averaging plus parameter-free recurrent depth (reapplying middle layers) raises the 27B hidden-set score from 71.52 to 73.37.
tldr.zh: 把 Qwen 混合架构语言模型改造成单次前向的决策模型，做法是让全注意力层变为双向并做多教师蒸馏；再加上 checkpoint 平均和无参数的循环深度（重复执行中间层），27B 模型的隐藏集得分从 71.52 提高到 73.37。

papers.title: Loop-OPF: Solver-Informed Learning for Optimal Power Flow with Inference-Time Topology Adaptivity

tldr.en: Loop-OPF builds its layers from primal-dual hybrid gradient iterations for DC-OPF, learns PDHG parameters without solution labels and trains as a DEQ, so its fixed point is optimal and feasible; one trained model adapts to unseen outages on IEEE 300-bus and PEGASE 1354-, 2869- and 9241-bus networks.
tldr.zh: Loop-OPF 用原始-对偶混合梯度（PDHG）迭代构建网络层来求解 DC-OPF，无需 OPF 解标签即可学习 PDHG 参数，并按 DEQ 训练，使其不动点输出最优且可行；同一个训练好的模型可直接适应未见过的线路或发电机故障，在 IEEE 300 节点和 PEGASE 1354、2869、9241 节点系统上得到验证。

papers.title: Mixture of Latent Recursions for Low-Rank Adaptation

tldr.en: MoLR recursively refines each token's LoRA down-projected latent with one shared transformation, and a threshold router decides per token whether to recurse again; fine-tuning Llama-3.2-3B on reasoning tasks, it averages 61.21 versus 59.21 for LoRA with negligible parameter overhead.
tldr.zh: MoLR 用一个共享变换对每个 token 经 LoRA 降维后的潜在表示做递归细化，并由基于阈值的路由器逐 token 决定是否继续递归；在 Llama-3.2-3B 的推理任务微调中平均得分 61.21，高于 LoRA 的 59.21，参数开销可忽略。

papers.title: Model Carving: Training Transformers That Optimize Their Own Topology

tldr.en: Puts learnable scalar gates on every sublayer of standard and looped Transformers so training removes the unneeded ones; carved models reach lower validation loss than dense models trained with up to 1.7 times more compute.
tldr.zh: 在标准与循环 Transformer 的每个子层上加可学习的标量门控，让训练自行删去不需要的子层；裁出的模型验证损失低于用多至 1.7 倍算力训练的稠密模型。

papers.title: When do stored facts become available in looped transformers?

tldr.en: Under final-loop supervision, looped Transformers expose stored synthetic facts progressively, later under heavier memorization loads but earlier than equal-depth untied models; in multi-hop chains, entity patches redirect downstream entities and the answer, while same-entity patches keep it in over 99.5% of tested cases.
tldr.zh: 仅以最后一次循环监督时，循环 Transformer 会逐步暴露存储的合成事实，记忆负载越重越晚，但比展开深度相同的非共享模型更早；在多跳链中，替换实体成分会改变下游实体和答案，而经不同关系到达同一实体的替换在超过 99.5% 的测试样例中保留原答案。

papers.title: What Makes Recurrence Generalize Across Lengths?

tldr.en: On state tracking, recurrent Transformers extrapolate with atomic operation tokens, while multi-token templates and absolute positional encoding limit them; scaling the recurrent operator reaches 35.1% exact match on 20-40 operations after training on 2-10, where larger fixed-depth Transformers stay at 0%.
tldr.zh: 在状态追踪任务上，循环 Transformer 使用原子操作 token 时能够外推，多 token 模板和绝对位置编码则会限制外推；扩大循环算子后，只在 2-10 步操作上训练即可在 20-40 步上达到 35.1% 的精确匹配率，更大的固定深度 Transformer 仍为 0%。

papers.title: Loop-Count Schedules in Looped Transformers: An Empirical Study

tldr.en: Training looped Transformers with learned residual gates under three loop-count schedules shows the lower bound decides: R sampled from {1,...,6} collapses the gates to 0.1-0.5, while R from {2,3,4} keeps them at 0.6-0.9 and gives the best model, 2.909 nats versus 2.951 for a parameter-matched plain model.
tldr.zh: 论文在带可学习残差门控的循环 Transformer 上比较三种循环次数调度，发现采样范围的下界起决定作用：从 {1,...,6} 采样 R 时门控塌缩到 0.1-0.5，从 {2,3,4} 采样时门控保持在 0.6-0.9，并得到最好的模型，验证损失 2.909 nats，参数匹配的普通模型为 2.951。

papers.title: PackLoop: Row-Packed Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models under Concurrency

tldr.en: PackLoop speeds up concurrent self-speculative decoding of looped LMs by speculating only inside rows (one request on one loop) that already read that loop's KV cache; it is exact in FP32, and across 164 load points it beats the best existing schedule at 161 (median 1.25x, up to 1.76x).
tldr.zh: PackLoop 针对并发场景下循环语言模型的自推测解码，只在本来就要读取该循环 KV cache 的行（一个请求在一个循环上前进）内做推测；它在 FP32 下与自回归解码逐 token 一致，在 164 个负载点中有 161 个快于逐点挑选的最佳现有调度（中位数 1.25x，最高 1.76x）。

papers.title: Introducing Inkling 2 Mini

note.en: Inkling 2 Mini has 24 MoE layers (8 of 128 experts per token) in four six-layer blocks; the two middle blocks share weights and run three times, so 24 stored layers give 48 layer applications per token. Per the Hugging Face blog, each block has five sliding-window layers (1,024-token window) and one full-attention layer, and each layer visit keeps its own KV. Every pass starts from the prelude output; passes 2 and 3 also read the previous pass's middle-block outputs (the message) through attention residuals, admitted by a learned gate that starts fully closed. Labels are 0-indexed as in the Hugging Face blog; the post numbers the same core 7-18. The released research twin TML-d24-varloop-research has the same layout but was trained with 1 to 5 passes and is run at up to 10 in the post.
note.zh: Inkling 2 Mini 有 24 层 MoE（每 token 从 128 个专家中选 8 个），分成四个 6 层块；中间两块共享权重、跑三遍，24 层存储权重每 token 执行 48 次层计算。据 Hugging Face 博客，每块有五层滑窗注意力（窗口 1,024 token）和一层全注意力，每次层访问各存一份 KV。每一遍都从 prelude 输出开始；第 2、3 遍还通过 attention residuals 读取上一遍中间块的输出（称为 message），由一个初始完全关闭的可学习门控接入。层号按 Hugging Face 博客从 0 开始，原文把同一段 core 记作 7-18。同时发布的研究版 TML-d24-varloop-research 结构相同，但训练时用 1 到 5 遍，文中最多跑到 10 遍。

baseline.en: A scaling-ladder run that loops the last 12 layers (13-24) instead of the middle 12 (7-18), with the same three passes and equal training compute; both runs' gains are expressed as the compute a no-loop baseline would need to match their loss.
baseline.zh: scaling ladder 上的对照：循环最后 12 层（13-24）而不是中间 12 层（7-18），同样跑三遍、训练算力相同；两者的收益都用无循环基线追平其 loss 所需的算力来表示。

headline.en: Looping the middle 12 layers gave larger accuracy gains than looping the last 12 on 27 of 28 evaluations; at training step 2,000 a no-loop baseline was estimated to need 1.51-1.91x the compute to match the middle loop's loss, against 1.24-1.36x for the last loop.
headline.zh: 28 项评测中有 27 项，循环中间 12 层的准确率收益大于循环最后 12 层；训练到第 2,000 步时，估计无循环基线需要 1.51-1.91 倍算力才能追平中间循环的 loss，追平最后 12 层循环只需 1.24-1.36 倍。

budget.ref: Looping design; figure "Compute-equivalent gain by loop position"

results.setting: Scaling-ladder runs at training step 2,000, three passes, equal training compute; range over three evaluations
results.metric: compute a no-loop baseline is estimated to need to match the looped run's loss
results.ref: Looping design; figure "Compute-equivalent gain by loop position"

results.setting: Subset of Think Fast tasks, no-CoT answers elicited by prefilling the response; Varloop = TML-d24-varloop-research, trained with 1-5 passes
TML-d24-varloop-research run at 1-5 passes (1-5 passes sampled 1:2:6:2:1 for the rest of midtraining, post-trained at 3)
TML-d24-varloop-research on the GPQA Diamond questions it answered correctly at all five pass counts
results.metric: mean reasoning tokens / mean words per sentence / words in an English dictionary / uncertainty indicators
results.ref: CoT monitorability; Compression and legibility table

results.setting: LinuxArena, subset of 184 main-task/side-task pairings, simple-attack policy, monitor Qwen3.6-35B-A3B at a 1% false-positive rate; Inkling 2 Mini is a helpful-only fine-tune; Varloop = TML-d24-varloop-research
results.metric: stealth rate (% of attack episodes), monitor sees tool calls and outputs only / also sees text and thinking

findings.en: On the scaling ladder, an unpruned non-looping model cost 7.5% less compute to train than the unpruned looped version but needed 140% more inference compute to match its loss on 512k-token agentic traces.
findings.zh: 在 scaling ladder 上，未剪枝的不循环模型训练算力比未剪枝的循环版少 7.5%，但要在 512k token 的 agentic 轨迹上追平循环版的 loss，推理算力要多 140%。

findings.en: TML-d24-varloop-research was never trained with more than five passes, yet running it with ten does not significantly degrade its no-CoT time horizon (40 s, against 42 s at five), and on N-Hop Lookup it follows longer chains with more passes, improving out to ten loops.
findings.zh: TML-d24-varloop-research 训练时从未超过 5 遍，但跑 10 遍时 no-CoT 时间跨度没有明显下降（40 秒，5 遍时为 42 秒）；在 N-Hop Lookup 上，遍数越多能跟的查找链越长，一直提升到 10 遍。
findings.ref: No-CoT capabilities; figures "No-CoT time horizons" and "N-Hop Lookup"

findings.en: With CoT, more passes mainly help multi-hop reasoning rather than recall: gains are largest on long-context retrieval (MRCR), then math and science reasoning, then long-horizon agentic tasks, while knowledge-intensive benchmarks (AA-Omniscience, SimpleQA Verified, SimpleVQA, WorldVQA) do not improve with more passes.
findings.zh: 有 CoT 时，增加遍数主要帮助多跳推理而不是记忆：长上下文检索（MRCR）收益最大，其次是数学和科学推理，再次是长程 agentic 任务；AA-Omniscience、SimpleQA Verified、SimpleVQA、WorldVQA 这类知识密集型评测不随遍数提升。

findings.en: Accuracy at each reasoning-token budget generally rises with passes, with diminishing returns after 3; on GPQA Diamond questions solved at all pass counts, reasoning at 5 passes averages 1,661 tokens against 3,703 at 1 pass, with unchanged sentence length and dictionary-word share.
findings.zh: 每个推理 token 预算下的准确率一般随遍数上升，3 遍之后收益递减；在各遍数都答对的 GPQA Diamond 题上，5 遍的推理平均 1,661 token，1 遍为 3,703 token，句长和词典词比例不变。

findings.en: Among CoTs of 750-1,250 tokens, Inkling 2 Mini and the variable-loop model at 3 passes follow a CoT instruction at most 0.1% of the time (Qwen3.8-27B 1.3%), too rarely to separate loop counts; LinuxArena stealth rates show no clear trend with the number of passes.
findings.zh: 在 750-1,250 token 的 CoT 中，Inkling 2 Mini 和 3 遍的可变循环模型最多只有 0.1% 的时候遵守 CoT 指令（Qwen3.8-27B 为 1.3%），低到无法区分不同遍数；LinuxArena 的 stealth rate 也看不出随遍数变化的明显趋势。

tldr.en: Open-weight MoE (26.4B total, 3.4B active) that runs the middle 12 of its 24 layers three times with shared weights, released with a variable-loop research twin used to measure how pass count affects capability and CoT monitorability.
tldr.zh: 开源权重的 MoE（总参数 26.4B、激活 3.4B），24 层中的中间 12 层共享权重跑三遍；同时发布一个可变循环的研究版，用来测遍数对能力和 CoT 可监控性的影响。

problem.en: Looping lets a model do more serial computation per token without adding parameters, which has raised concerns that looped models are harder to oversee by reading their chain of thought; the post reports what looping gives a small open model and how pass count affects CoT monitorability.
problem.zh: 循环让模型不增加参数就能在每个 token 上做更多串行计算，这引起了一种担忧：循环模型更难通过阅读 CoT 来监督。本文报告循环给一个小型开源模型带来的收益，以及遍数如何影响 CoT 可监控性。

en: 24 MoE layers (8 of 128 experts per token) in four six-layer blocks; the two middle blocks share weights and run three times, giving 48 layer applications per token from 24 stored layers.

Every pass starts from the prelude output; passes 2 and 3 also read the previous pass's middle-block outputs (the message) through attention residuals, and a learned gate that initially blocks the message lets looping be introduced stably during training.

Training started with 8 of 384 experts per token; two-thirds of the experts were pruned at one point in midtraining (keeping the 128 most used per layer), followed by 1T tokens distilled from a larger internal Inkling model, SFT, and RL totaling 2.2T tokens over 2,000 steps. Expert layers use NVFP4 on all forward passes and the last four layers use MXFP8.

A variable-loop research model, TML-d24-varloop-research, was trained with 1 to 5 passes (sampled 1:2:6:2:1 for the rest of midtraining, post-trained at 3) and is run at 1 to 5 passes, and at 10 in the no-CoT tests, to measure capability and CoT monitorability.
zh: 24 层 MoE（每 token 从 128 个专家中选 8 个），分成四个 6 层块；中间两块共享权重、跑三遍，24 层存储权重每 token 执行 48 次层计算。
每一遍都从 prelude 输出开始；第 2、3 遍还通过 attention residuals 读取上一遍中间块的输出（message），一个初始完全挡住 message 的可学习门控让训练中可以稳定地引入循环。
训练开始时每 token 从 384 个专家中选 8 个；midtraining 中某一时刻剪掉三分之二的专家（每层保留最常用的 128 个），之后用 1T token 从更大的内部 Inkling 模型蒸馏，再做 SFT 和共 2.2T token、2,000 步的 RL。专家层的所有前向都用 NVFP4，最后四层用 MXFP8。
可变循环研究版 TML-d24-varloop-research 用 1 到 5 遍训练（midtraining 后段按 1:2:6:2:1 采样，post-training 用 3 遍），评测时跑 1 到 5 遍、no-CoT 测试还跑 10 遍，用来测能力和 CoT 可监控性。

en: Inkling 2 Mini supports only a fixed number of passes (3), so every pass-count comparison uses TML-d24-varloop-research, whose later training stages differ; its model card cautions against comparing it directly with Inkling 2 Mini.

Three passes dominated the variable-loop model's training and its RL used 3 passes only; the authors say results at other pass counts may understate what dedicated training could achieve and do not show what RL at a higher pass count would learn.

The loop-placement and looping-versus-non-looping comparisons come from scaling-ladder runs (placement at training step 2,000; unpruned models for looping versus non-looping), not from the released model, and the post does not give the sizes of those runs.
No-CoT results use a subset of Think Fast tasks, with answers elicited by prefilling the start of the response; the models were not trained to answer without CoT.
LinuxArena used a helpful-only fine-tune of Inkling 2 Mini, a weaker monitor (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) and a subset of 184 task pairings.
Decoding speeds in the opening coding figure are theoretical ceilings (614 GB/s, BF16 weights, batch size one), evaluation setups vary by model, and the post gives no pretraining token count.
zh: Inkling 2 Mini 只支持固定遍数（3 遍），所有遍数对比都用 TML-d24-varloop-research，而它后期的训练阶段与 Inkling 2 Mini 不同；其 model card 提醒不要把两者直接比较。
可变循环模型的训练以 3 遍为主，RL 也只用 3 遍；作者说其他遍数的结果可能低估专门训练能达到的水平，也说明不了在更多遍数上做 RL 会学到什么。
循环位置对比和循环与不循环的对比都来自 scaling ladder 实验（位置对比在第 2,000 训练步；循环与不循环对比用未剪枝模型），不是发布的模型，文中也没给这些实验的模型规模。
no-CoT 结果只用了 Think Fast 的部分任务，通过预填回答开头让模型直接作答；这些模型没有为不用 CoT 作答而训练。
LinuxArena 用的是 Inkling 2 Mini 的 helpful-only 微调版、较弱的监控模型（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B），以及 184 组任务的子集。
开篇编码图里的解码速度是理论上限（614 GB/s、BF16 权重、batch size 1），各模型评测设置不同，文中也没给预训练 token 数。

papers.title: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer

note.en: GLM-5.4 loops 28 layers of the GLM-5 base model for two iterations; the post describes them as middle layers but does not give the base model's layer count or which 28 layers are looped. The loop was added to the already pre-trained base through continued training at the 750B scale.
note.zh: GLM-5.4 把 GLM-5 基座的 28 层循环两遍；文中说这些是中间层，但没有给出基座的总层数，也没说具体是哪 28 层。循环是在已经预训练好的 750B 规模基座上通过继续训练加进去的。

baseline.en: A 30B model with the same architecture as the 750B base, without the loop, evaluated after 200K long-context SFT with thinking mode enabled.
baseline.zh: 与 750B 基座同架构、不循环的 30B 模型，在 200K 长上下文 SFT 之后开启 thinking 模式评测。

headline.en: With identical parameter counts and about 10% more total training compute, the looped 30B model improves AIME25 from 19.17 to 30.42 and GPQA-Diamond from 47.58 to 56.26, while average output length drops by 10-14% on most benchmarks.
headline.zh: 参数量相同、总训练算力只多约 10% 时，循环版 30B 模型的 AIME25 从 19.17 升到 30.42，GPQA-Diamond 从 47.58 升到 56.26；多数基准上的平均输出长度缩短 10-14%。

findings.en: Converting middle layers of a pre-trained model into a loop by directly overwriting hidden states makes activation norms blow up across iterations; per-token gates for each iteration fix this, with the first pass writing conservatively and the second pass opening the gates, and harder tokens getting larger first-pass writes.
findings.zh: 把预训练模型的中间层改成循环时，如果直接覆盖隐状态，激活范数会随迭代爆炸；为每次迭代加独立的逐 token 门控可以解决：第一遍写入较保守，第二遍放开门控，难的 token 第一遍写得更多。

findings.en: The second loop reuses the sparse KV selected in the first pass and keeps only its own new KV in a sliding window, so an extra loop costs one sliding window of KV rather than a full context cache.
findings.zh: 第二遍复用第一遍选出的稀疏 KV，自己新生成的 KV 只保留一个滑窗，所以多一遍只多一个滑窗的 KV，而不是一整份上下文缓存。
findings.ref: Hybrid KV Cache (Global Sharing + Independent Sliding Window)

findings.en: Reusing the first loop's sparse-attention indices in the second loop performs nearly identically to recomputing them on every pass.
findings.zh: 第二遍直接复用第一遍稀疏注意力的索引，效果与每遍重新计算索引几乎相同。

findings.en: The authors state that looped models trained from scratch still lag behind unshared models under the same pre-training compute budget, which is why they adapted a pre-trained base through continued training instead.
findings.zh: 作者称，从头训练的循环模型在相同预训练算力下仍不如不共享权重的模型，所以改为在预训练好的基座上继续训练出循环结构。
findings.ref: From Pre-Trained Base to Loop Transformer

tldr.en: Z.ai turns 28 layers of its pre-trained GLM-5 base into a two-pass loop through continued training at the 750B scale, with per-token gates, a shared-plus-sliding-window KV cache and reused sparse-attention indices.
tldr.zh: Z.ai 通过继续训练，把已预训练的 GLM-5 基座中的 28 层改成跑两遍的循环（750B 规模），配合逐 token 门控、共享加滑窗的 KV cache 和复用的稀疏注意力索引。

problem.en: Long-chain tasks such as large-scale software engineering, 3D modeling and physical control need more effective compute per token, but looped models trained from scratch lag behind unshared models at the same pre-training compute.
problem.zh: 大规模软件工程、3D 建模、物理控制等长链条任务需要每个 token 更多的有效计算，但从头训练的循环模型在相同预训练算力下不如不共享权重的模型。

en: Adapt the pre-trained GLM-5 base into a Loop Transformer by continued training, running 28 weight-shared layers for two iterations.
Add independent per-token gates for each iteration that write candidate updates back into the residual stream, so activation norms stay stable.
Let the second loop reuse the first pass's sparse KV and attention indices plus its own sliding-window KV, and fuse kernels to cut intermediate memory traffic.
zh: 在预训练好的 GLM-5 基座上继续训练，改成 Loop Transformer：28 层共享权重的层跑两遍。
每次迭代加独立的逐 token 门控，按比例把候选更新写回残差流，让激活范数保持稳定。
第二遍复用第一遍的稀疏 KV 和注意力索引，外加自己的滑窗 KV；系统层面融合算子，减少中间结果的显存读写。

en: This is a blog post, not a paper; the base model's layer count, which 28 layers are looped, the training tokens and the evaluation details beyond the table are not given.

The controlled comparison is iso-parameter, not iso-compute (the looped 30B model used about 10% more total training compute), and it is reported only at 30B after long-context SFT; the 750B results are not shown as a controlled comparison.
The claim that GLM-5.4 reaches intelligence levels comparable to 2T-3T parameter models comes without a stated evaluation protocol in the post.
The authors note that the model tends to get caught in overly long "marathon thinking" loops.
Weights are not released yet (planned after safety hardening) and the API is listed as coming soon.
zh: 这是一篇博客而不是论文；基座总层数、循环的是哪 28 层、训练 token 数，以及表格之外的评测细节都没有给出。
对照只对齐了参数，没有对齐算力（循环版 30B 多用了约 10% 的总训练算力），而且只在 30B、长上下文 SFT 之后报告；750B 没有给出受控对比。
文中称 GLM-5.4 达到 2T-3T 参数模型的水平，但没有说明评测方法。
作者提到模型容易陷入过长的「马拉松式思考」。
权重尚未发布（计划在安全加固后开源），API 标注为即将推出。

en: How to make compute adaptive so that harder tokens get more iterations.
How the returns of looping behave as both loop count and model size keep growing.
zh: 如何做到自适应计算，让更难的 token 自动获得更多迭代。
循环次数和模型规模同时继续增大时，循环的收益会怎样变化。
